Text: "자볼리, 혹시 개를 싫어하오?"

TextEng: "I have neither a great fondness for them, nor an abnormal hatred or fear of them. Why do you ask?"
Text: "특별히 좋아하지도, 비정상적으로 싫어하거나 무서워하지도 않아요. 왜 그래요?"

TextEng: "I should think that it would be obvious. I mean, I guess there are a few cats and dogs that get along, but on the whole they tend to feud for the most part."
Text: "당연히 알 것 같은데. 그러니까, 개와 고양이가 잘 지내는 경우도 있지만, 대체로 사이가 안 좋잖소."

TextEng: "What is it with you people that you seem to think that just because I have similar... features to a cat, that it means I really am a cat?"
Text: "왜 다들 내가 고양이와 비슷한... 특징이 있다고 해서 진짜 고양이라고 생각하는 거예요?"

TextEng: "It could be that when you get mad you kind of make a hissin' noise and when you are happy... well, you purr."
Text: "화나면 '하' 하고 소리를 내고, 기분 좋으면... 그르렁거리니까 그럴 수도 있겠소."

TextEng: Jaboli stares daggers at Calibast.
Text: 자볼리가 캘리바스트를 독이 든 눈으로 쏘아봅니다.

TextEng: "Well, I was just goin' to say that I like cats. Not everybody does, you know. I knew a guy once who would go out of his way to get within kickin' distance of a cat. I'm not that way."
Text: "그냥, 나는 고양이를 좋아한다는 걸 알려주고 싶었소. 모두가 그런 건 아니거든. 예전에 아는 놈은 일부러 고양이 가까이 가서 발로 차곤 했지. 나는 그런 놈이 아니오."

TextEng: "Obviously you are cut of a finer cloth than your friend. Not fine enough to recognize the difference between a cat and a rakshasa, sadly."
Text: "당신 친구보다는 교양 있군요. 고양이와 락샤사의 차이도 못 알아보긴 하지만요, 안타깝게도."

TextEng: "Good. Tell me where to stand."
Text: "좋소. 어디 서면 되겠소."

TextEng: "You don't have to take offense. I was just wantin' you to know that I thought you are a fine-lookin' female, for a cat."
Text: "기분 나쁘게 할 생각은 없었소. 그냥 당신이 매력적인 여성이라는 걸 알려주고 싶었을 뿐이오. 고양이치고는 말이지."

TextEng: "I always thought you were such a smooth talker, Calibast. But such a clumsy attempt to flirt with me tells me you must be losing your touch."
Text: "항상 말 잘한다고 생각했는데, 캘리바스트. 이렇게 서투른 추파 시도를 보니 감을 잃었나 봐요."

TextEng: "You've been dyin' for a chance to say that, haven't you?"
Text: "그 말 하려고 기다렸지, 안 그랬소?"

TextEng: Jaboli just hisses at the two of you and turns away.
Text: 자볼리가 둘에게 쉬익 소리를 내고 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "I was tryin' to get along. That was why I was tryin' to compliment her. But no... she's got to get all catty on me."
Text: "잘 지내보려고 했소. 칭찬을 한 건데. 그런데... 고양이 같은 짓을 해야겠소."

TextEng: "How long have you been saving that one?"
Text: "그 농담 얼마나 아끼고 있었소?"

TextEng: "Several days, but it was worth it." He winks at her.
Text: "며칠 아꼈는데, 그만한 가치가 있었소." 그가 그녀에게 윙크합니다.

TextEng: Jaboli just hisses at him and turns away.
Text: 자볼리가 그에게 쉬익 소리를 내고 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "I'm hurt. I was just tryin' to give her a compliment. But no... she's got to get all catty on me.""
Text: "상처 받았소. 칭찬을 해 주려고 한 건데. 그런데 아니지... 고양이 같은 짓을 해야겠소."

TextEng: "Hey, Kaidala! I think you dropped somethin' back behind you."
Text: "이봐, 카이달라! 뒤에 뭔가 떨어뜨린 것 같은데."

TextEng: "I'll do what I can for you."
Text: "할 수 있는 건 다 하겠소."

TextEng: "I did? Where? What did I drop?"
Text: "정말요? 어디요? 뭘 떨어뜨렸어요?"

TextEng: "Ah, you were right, <FirstName>. Nothin' more beautiful from where I'm standin'."
Text: "아, 맞았소, <FirstName>. 지금 서 있는 이 자리에서 이보다 아름다운 건 없군."

TextEng: "What?"
He winks at you, then leers at Kaidala again. "Come on, lass. You're a nymph, or at least you used to be. Have you forgotten your roots?"
Text: 그가 당신에게 윙크하고 카이달라를 다시 흘끗 봅니다. "이봐, 아가씨. 님프잖소, 아니 최소한 님프였잖소. 뿌리를 잊었소?"

TextEng: "Of course I haven't forgotten my roots!"
Text: "물론 뿌리를 잊지 않았어요!"

TextEng: "What a sweet girl you are!" They both look at your face and then start to laugh.
Text: "정말 착한 아가씨로군!" 둘 다 당신의 얼굴을 보더니 웃기 시작합니다.

TextEng: "Sorry, <FirstName>. We were just having a little fun with you."
Text: "미안하오, <FirstName>. 좀 장난친 거요."

TextEng: "Hoo! You should have seen your face. Now that's what I call fun!"
Text: "하! 그 표정 좀 봤어야 했는데. 이게 진짜 재미란 거지!"

TextEng: "How long have we been adventurin' together, Kaidala? Why do you stare at me with that look of horror still?"
Text: "우리가 함께 모험한 지 얼마나 됐소, 카이달라? 왜 아직도 그렇게 공포에 찬 눈으로 나를 보는 거요?"

TextEng: "I am sorry, Calibast. I don't mean to offend you. It is just the constant flames on your head... they live in my mind, still burning my own face."
Text: "미안해요, 캘리바스트. 기분 나쁘게 하려는 게 아니에요. 그냥 머리 위의 끊임없는 불꽃이... 아직도 제 얼굴을 태우던 기억이 떠올라요."

TextEng: "Jump right in and beat them all down to size, eh? Right, that's my favorite tactic. I never get killed doin' that one."
Text: "바로 뛰어들어서 다 두들겨 패란 거요? 좋아, 내가 가장 좋아하는 전술이지. 이거 하다가 안 죽어 본 적이 없소."

TextEng: "But fire is beautiful. Yes, it is also destructive and dangerous, but without it, most would not survive."
Text: "하지만 불은 아름답소. 파괴적이고 위험하기도 하지만, 불이 없으면 대부분 살아남지 못할 거요."

TextEng: "Nature keeps me warm, even in the depths of winter. I eat fruit and vegetables and nuts, so I have no need to cook food with it. Fire holds no gifts for me."
Text: "자연이 한겨울에도 저를 따뜻하게 해 줘요. 과일과 채소와 견과류를 먹으니 요리할 불도 필요 없고요. 불은 제게 주는 것이 없어요."

TextEng: "Fire allows us to make weapons and armor. Fire provides light. Even you could not survive without the sun!"
Text: "불이 있어야 무기와 갑옷을 만들 수 있소. 빛도 제공하지. 당신도 태양 없이는 살 수 없잖소!"

TextEng: "The sun... yes, it is true that my kind need the sun. And when part of a forest burns, what is left behind fertilizes the area and helps new plants grow. I am wary of fire, but I do not hate it."
Text: "태양은... 맞아요, 저 같은 존재에게 태양은 필수예요. 그리고 숲의 일부가 타면, 남은 것이 비료가 되어 새 식물이 자라죠. 불을 경계하지만 미워하지는 않아요."

TextEng: "So it is specific to the fact that my head is burnin'?"
Text: "그럼 내 머리에 불이 타고 있다는 것 자체가 문제인 거요?"

TextEng: "It is. Yes."
Text: "네. 맞아요."

TextEng: "In all the time we have been together, you have never touched my head."
Text: "함께한 시간 동안, 내 머리를 한 번도 만져본 적이 없소."

TextEng: "I... I don't think I could do that."
Text: "저... 저는 그걸 못 할 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Come, just lay your hand on my cheek. I promise I won't hurt you."
Text: "이리 와서 볼에 손을 대 보시오. 안 다치게 해 줄 테니."

TextEng: She hesitantly reaches out. "Oh... um... it's cool... like touching regular flesh."
Text: 그녀가 머뭇거리며 손을 뻗습니다. "어... 음... 시원하네요... 보통 살을 만지는 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Right. Protect the <class>. I've played this game before."
Text: "알겠소. <class>을(를) 지키란 거군. 전에도 해 봤지."

TextEng: "You are. The flames are controllable, so I can cool them for others, but they never hurt me. My entire body is immune to the touches of fire."
Text: "그렇소. 불꽃은 조절할 수 있어서 다른 사람을 위해 식힐 수 있소. 하지만 나한테는 절대 해가 안 되지. 온몸이 불에 면역이거든."

TextEng: "I guess that might help, a little. It still doesn't stop my memories."
Text: "좀 도움이 될 수도 있겠어요. 하지만 기억까지 사라지진 않네요."

TextEng: "I know, but hopefully now you can look at me without that look of total repugnance. Actually, the touch of your hand is very gentle. A lot can be said in a single touch."
Text: "알아요. 하지만 이제 날 볼 때마다 그렇게 역겨워하는 표정은 안 지었으면 좋겠소. 사실, 당신 손길이 아주 부드럽군. 한 번의 손길로도 많은 것을 전할 수 있소."

TextEng: "Oh, sorry about that. Old habits die hard, I suppose."
Text: "아, 미안해요. 오래된 습관이 쉽게 안 고쳐지네요."

TextEng: "Trip, I fear I have done you a disservice, lad. My guilty conscience must be purged."
Text: "트립, 자네한테 잘못한 게 있어서 양심에 가책이 드오. 고백해야겠소."

TextEng: "Trip is not sure what you are talking about, Calibast. What is this conscience thing you speak of?"
Text: "트립은 무슨 말인지 모르겠어요, 캘리바스트. 그 양심이라는 게 뭐예요?"

TextEng: "Mmm, well, not important. Not surprised you don't really know, but that's not what I wanted to tell you."
Text: "음, 중요한 건 아니오. 모르는 것도 놀랍지 않고. 하지만 하려는 말은 그게 아니오."

TextEng: "That makes no sense to Trip, but go ahead."
Text: "트립은 이해가 안 되지만, 계속하세요."

TextEng: "I have to admit that I once saw a wookalar. It was very much alive and more fearsome than anythin' I had ever seen, or have seen since."
Text: "사실 나도 한 번 우칼라를 봤소. 매우 살아 있었고, 내가 본 것 중 가장 무시무시한 놈이었소."

TextEng: "Then there is another one? There really is? Oh, joy! Trip was right!"
Text: "그럼 다른 것도 있다고요? 정말요? 아, 기뻐라! 트립이 맞았어요!"

TextEng: "I'm pretty sure I can dress myself, but if you have suggestions... well, go ahead. Just don't be peekin' at anythin' you shouldn't!"
Text: "옷은 혼자 입을 수 있는데, 뭔가 제안이 있다면... 말하시오. 볼 데 안 보기만 하면 되잖소!"

TextEng: "Yes, but the reason that I didn't want to talk about it, is that the... um... creature is drawn to people that talk about it."
Text: "그래, 하지만 내가 말하고 싶지 않았던 이유가, 그... 그 생물은 자기 이야기를 하는 사람에게 끌린다는 거요."

TextEng: "Really? But Trip has talked about it many times before and yet never seen one." Trip's whiskers start to tremble.
Text: "정말요? 하지만 트립은 여러 번 말했는데 한 번도 본 적 없어요." 트립의 수염이 떨리기 시작합니다.

TextEng: "You have!? How many times have you said the name?" Calibast begins to look frantically.
Text: "그래!? 몇 번이나 이름을 말했소?" 캘리바스트가 허둥지둥 주위를 둘러봅니다.

TextEng: "Trip is not so sure. Maybe fifty times." Trip starts to look very nervous.
Text: "잘 모르겠어요. 오십 번쯤?" 트립이 매우 초조해 보이기 시작합니다.

TextEng: "Fifty?" Calibast whistles. "That's just about how many times my brother talked about it when the creature came out of the shadows for him!"
Text: "오십 번?" 캘리바스트가 휘파람을 붑니다. "그건 딱 내 형이 그놈 이야기를 했다가 그림자 속에서 나타났을 때의 횟수와 같군!"

TextEng: Trip starts glancing about nervously. "You lost your brother to a wookalar?"
Text: 트립이 초조하게 주위를 살핍니다. "형을 우칼라한테 잃었다고요?"

TextEng: "You said it again! What are you tryin' to do, get us all killed?"
Text: "또 이름을 말했소! 우리 다 죽이려는 거요?"

TextEng: "Sorry! Trip is sorry! I did not mean to say it again."
Text: "미안해요! 트립이 미안해요! 또 말하려고 한 게 아니에요."

TextEng: "Wait! Shh. What was that? Did you hear it, <FirstName>?"
Text: "잠깐! 쉿. 뭔가 소리가 나지 않았소? 들었소, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "Oh no, eek!"
Text: "아이고, 으악!"

TextEng: "I doubt I'll know much more than you would, but I'll give it a try."
Text: "당신보다 더 알진 못하겠지만, 해 보겠소."

TextEng: "It's over there, behind you, Trip!"
Text: "저기 있소, 네 뒤에, 트립!"

TextEng: "Well, that was fun."
Text: "후, 재미있었소."

TextEng: "Ack, you are too soft on the lad! It was only a joke."
Text: "이런, 너무 약해빠졌소! 농담이었을 뿐이오."

TextEng: "You would joke about such a thing? That is so cruel, Calibast! Trip is ashamed of your actions. How could you be so mean?"
Text: "그런 걸 가지고 농담을 해요? 너무 잔인해요, 캘리바스트! 트립은 당신 행동이 부끄러워요. 어떻게 그렇게 못되게 굴 수 있어요?"

TextEng: Calibast looks a little guilty. "Oh, fine, I'm sorry. Now, forget about it and lets go do some more killin'!"
Text: 캘리바스트가 좀 미안한 표정을 짓습니다. "아, 알겠소, 미안하오. 자, 잊어버리고 더 죽이러 가자!"

TextEng: "Watch where you're goin', you flea-infested, giant mouse."
Text: "어디 가는 거요, 이 벼룩투성이 거대 생쥐."

TextEng: "What did Trip do now? Why you always got to be so mean to me?"
Text: "트립이 뭘 잘못했는데요? 왜 항상 그렇게 못되게 구는 거예요?"

TextEng: "You bloody-well almost tripped me, that's what you did! I suppose you got your name from the number of people you've tripped in your life?"
Text: "빌어먹을, 날 걸려 넘어뜨릴 뻔했잖소! 혹시 이름이 살면서 걸려 넘어뜨린 사람 수에서 따온 거 아니오?"

TextEng: "Oh, no. Trip is named after the smallest hero ever who also happened to destroy the worst monster ever."
Text: "아뇨. 트립은 역사상 가장 작은 영웅이면서 동시에 가장 끔찍한 괴물을 무찌른 영웅의 이름을 딴 거예요."

TextEng: "You're full of lies and deceit. I have never heard of a hero named Trip."
Text: "거짓말과 기만투성이군. 트립이라는 영웅은 들어본 적 없소."

TextEng: "Seems like as good a time as any for a break. Could you pass the wine? Just kiddin'. No drinkin' on duty, I suppose."
Text: "쉬기 딱 좋은 때군. 술 좀 넘기시겠소? 농담이오. 근무 중엔 안 마시지."

TextEng: "Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip only tries to answer big flame-head."
Text: "미안해요, <master/mistress>. 트립은 그냥 불머리한테 대답한 거예요."

TextEng: "I was just askin' ratman a question. No need to get touchy."
Text: "쥐인간한테 질문을 했을 뿐이오. 건드릴 필요 없잖소."

TextEng: "Trip is telling the truth! There was a little half-fellow named Tripcanticius who defeated the most dreadful monster in the world... the horrible wookalar!"
Text: "트립은 진실을 말하는 거예요! 트립칸티시우스라는 작은 하플링이 세상에서 가장 무서운 괴물... 무시무시한 우칼라를 무찔렀어요!"

TextEng: "There is no such thing as a wookalar! That's only a myth."
Text: "우칼라 같은 건 없소! 신화일 뿐이오."

TextEng: "No such beast now, but when the first Trip was alive, the wookalar was the most dangerous of all the monsters in the land."
Text: "지금은 없지만, 첫 번째 트립이 살던 때에는 우칼라가 세상에서 가장 위험한 괴물이었어요."

TextEng: "And you think I'm supposed to believe in this creature that had tusks, a pig's snout, and long, sharp nails that could reach up through your nose and pull out your brains?"
Text: "엄니가 있고, 돼지코에, 코를 통해 뇌를 뽑아낼 수 있는 길고 날카로운 발톱이 있는 그 생물을 믿으라는 거요?"

TextEng: "Wow, you know lots about the wookalar. Have you met a wookalar? Maybe your home has wookalars?"
Text: "와, 우칼라에 대해 많이 아시네요. 우칼라를 만나본 적 있어요? 혹시 고향에 우칼라가 있어요?"

TextEng: "THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS A WOOKALAR! It isn't real! It's a myth! Get it through your head! I just made that tripe up!"
Text: "우칼라 같은 건 없다고! 진짜가 아니오! 신화란 말이오! 그 머리통에 집어넣으시오! 그런 건 내가 지어낸 거요!"

TextEng: "But then how come you just described one perfectly?"
Text: "그런데 방금 완벽하게 묘사했잖아요?"

TextEng: "Just... get... away... from... me." He fumes and stomps his feet in aggravation.
Text: "그냥... 나한테... 오지... 마시오." 그가 분을 삭이지 못하고 발을 구릅니다.

TextEng: "Ack, now this is fun! Heaps of wee bonnie creatures to maim and mangle."
Text: "아, 이거 재미있군! 두들겨 팰 조그만 놈들이 한가득이야."

TextEng: "And how else can I help you now?"
Text: "그래서 또 뭘 도와드리면 되겠소?"

TextEng: "What? Is my head out? Hmm... nope. Seem to be fine, thanks."
Text: "뭐? 머리에 불 꺼졌소? 흠... 아니, 잘 타고 있군. 걱정해 줘서 고맙소."

TextEng: "Anything else?"
Text: "다른 건?"

TextEng: "I grow weary of walkin'. Don't suppose you've learned to fly yet?"
Text: "걷는 것도 지겹군. 혹시 나는 법이라도 배웠소?"

TextEng: "The smell of death is in the air. Let's go make a little for ourselves!"
Text: "죽음의 냄새가 나는군. 우리도 좀 만들러 가자!"

TextEng: "More killin', less talkin'!"
Text: "더 죽이고, 덜 떠들자!"

TextEng: "I need a drink, next question?"
Text: "한잔 하고 싶소. 다음 질문?"

TextEng: "Can't complain, nobody'd listen anyways!"
Text: "불만은 말해봐야 소용없지, 어차피 들어줄 사람도 없으니!"

TextEng: "I feel like a young wolf in a field of old deer. Pleasantly surprised and ready to give chase."
Text: "늙은 사슴 떼 한가운데 선 젊은 늑대 기분이오. 기분 좋게 놀라서 쫓아갈 준비가 됐다는 뜻이지."

TextEng: "Be fine if'n I could see a blasted thing!"
Text: "앞이라도 좀 보이면 좋겠군!"

TextEng: "What kind of a ragtag army is this? Pathetic!"
Text: "이게 뭔 오합지졸이야? 한심하기 짝이 없군!"

TextEng: "I've been cut worse in many a tavern brawl. Don't be worryin' about me."
Text: "술집 싸움에서 이보다 더 당했소. 걱정 마시오."

TextEng: "I'm not keelin' over, if that's your worry."
Text: "아직 쓰러지진 않았으니 걱정하시는 거라면 아니오."

TextEng: "I could be doin' better. How about you?"
Text: "더 나을 수도 있겠소. 당신은 어떻소?"

TextEng: "Never could stand a fellow who used poison. Now I remember why."
Text: "독 쓰는 놈은 항상 못마땅했는데. 이제 왜인지 확실히 알겠군."

TextEng: "My stomach does nae feel so good. I only hope the flames on me head don't catch!"
Text: "속이 안 좋군. 머릿불이 옮겨붙지만 않으면 좋겠소!"

TextEng: Calibast chuckles. "I will stay around as long as you need and want me too. Azers have long lives, so eventually I will probably try to go home and see if things have changed."
Text: 캘리바스트가 웃습니다. "필요하고 원하는 만큼 오래 곁에 있겠소. 에이저는 오래 사니까, 결국엔 고향에 돌아가서 상황이 달라졌는지 볼 거요."

TextEng: "I would like a little revenge, but I'm in no rush. In the meantime, I hope you still want me around. This keep needs a few improvements."
Text: "복수를 좀 하고 싶긴 하지만, 서두를 건 없소. 그 사이에 아직 날 곁에 두고 싶다면 좋겠소. 이 거점에는 개선할 게 좀 있으니."

TextEng: "There are a couple of powerful rulers on my home plane. They took everythin' from me and someday I shall pay them back in kind."
Text: "고향 차원에 강력한 지배자가 둘 있소. 내 모든 걸 빼앗았지. 언젠가 반드시 같은 값을 돌려주겠소."

TextEng: "I have some plans, but that can wait for the future. Makin' the keep strong right now is far more important. My improvements should help."
Text: "계획이 좀 있지만, 나중 일이오. 지금은 거점을 튼튼히 하는 게 훨씬 중요하지. 내 개선안이 도움이 될 거요."

TextEng: Calibast shrugs, "I have some plans, but that can wait for the future. Makin' the keep strong right now is far more important. My improvements should help."
Text: 캘리바스트가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "계획이 좀 있지만, 나중 일이오. 지금은 거점을 튼튼히 하는 게 훨씬 중요하지. 내 개선안이 도움이 될 거요."

TextEng: "Bet you could get loads of firewood out of that tree."
Text: "저 나무에서 장작을 한가득 뽑을 수 있겠는데."

TextEng: "I have a great deal of experience with defendin' and attackin' fortifications. For a start, some large, stake-filled pits around the walls and a barbican near the gates would help."
Text: "요새 공방에 경험이 많소. 우선 성벽 주위에 말뚝 박힌 큰 함정을 파고, 성문 근처에 바비칸을 세우면 도움이 될 거요."

TextEng: "If it is possible, I would like to divert some of the nearby river to fill a moat, which would help stop more miners from diggin under the walls."
Text: "가능하다면 근처 강물 일부를 끌어와 해자를 만들고 싶소. 성벽 아래를 파는 광부들을 막는 데 도움이 되겠지."

TextEng: "There are many different ways to make a castle more defendable. Some are more expensive, while some are quite easy and cheap."
Text: "성을 더 방어하기 쉽게 만드는 방법은 여러 가지가 있소. 비싼 것도 있고, 꽤 쉽고 싼 것도 있지."

TextEng: "Well, those are just a few of my ideas. There are many tricks to slow enemies and make a castle easier to defend."
Text: "뭐, 아이디어 몇 개에 불과하오. 적을 늦추고 성 방어를 쉽게 하는 방법은 다양하지."

TextEng: "Since you seem so sure of yourself, perhaps you won't want me around as long as I had hoped."
Text: "그렇게 자신만만하시니, 아마 내가 바랐던 만큼 오래 곁에 둘 생각은 없으시겠지."

TextEng: "We should get goin' again. Plenty more to do before we can start makin' changes to the keep."
Text: "다시 출발하자고. 거점을 손보기 전에 할 일이 아직 많소."

TextEng: "A barbican is an expanse of killin' ground, with a maze-like area to slow invaders who get inside the gates."
Text: "바비칸이란 성문 안쪽에 만드는 죽음의 지대요. 미로 같은 구역으로 침입자의 진격을 늦추는 거지."

TextEng: "A couple towers on either side would allow defenders to fire down into the kill zone and destroy many enemies."
Text: "양쪽에 탑을 세우면 방어자들이 사지(死地)로 사격해서 많은 적을 처치할 수 있소."

TextEng: "The barbican would be the most expensive, though they seem to have some good stoneworkers and masons here in the keep, judgin' by the defenses in place."
Text: "바비칸이 가장 비싸겠지만, 여기 거점에는 실력 좋은 석공들이 있는 것 같소. 기존 방어 시설을 보면 알 수 있지."

TextEng: "The pits and stakes and a moat are less expensive, just labor intensive. There be enough people in this keep to do the job fairly quickly, if everyone able could help out."
Text: "함정과 말뚝, 해자는 덜 비싸지만 노동력이 많이 드오. 거점에 사람이 충분하니 모두 힘을 합치면 꽤 빨리 끝낼 수 있을 거요."

TextEng: "There's got to be some good taverns in this keep. We should find them all!"
Text: "이 거점에 좋은 술집이 분명 있을 거야. 전부 찾아봐야지!"

TextEng: "Thank you. That's really just a start. See, with a shortage of defenders, it is more important than ever to have a good assortment of artificial defenses."
Text: "고맙소. 사실 이건 시작에 불과하오. 방어자가 부족할수록 인공 방어 시설이 더 중요해지거든."

TextEng: Calibast smiles. "I am glad to hear that. I have had an idea. Maybe when you tire of rulin' this place, or when you have reached a pinnacle of power, maybe you could help me get revenge."
Text: 캘리바스트가 미소 짓습니다. "그 말을 들으니 기쁘군. 사실 생각이 하나 있소. 이곳을 다스리는 데 지치거나, 권력의 정점에 이르면, 내 복수를 도와주지 않겠소?"

TextEng: "In return for your help, I'll help you improve the keep and make it strong."
Text: "그 도움의 대가로, 거점을 개선하고 튼튼하게 만드는 걸 돕겠소."

TextEng: "The priestess was called Wren Bloodstone. I'll always remember that, because it seemed like such a gentle, sweet name. I was only there for a week before the first attack."
Text: "그 여사제의 이름은 렌 블러드스톤이었소. 그 이름만큼은 절대 잊지 못하지, 참 부드럽고 다정한 이름이었거든. 도착한 지 일주일도 안 돼서 첫 번째 공격이 시작됐소."

TextEng: "I was only her general for a single war, but that was enough. I was more cautious than she had been in previous wars, which chafed at her a little. She wanted to attack the day after I arrived."
Text: "딱 한 번의 전쟁만 지휘했지만, 그것만으로 충분했소. 그녀가 이전 전쟁에서 보인 것보다 내가 더 신중했는데, 그게 좀 거슬렸던 모양이오. 도착한 다음 날 바로 공격하자고 했으니."

TextEng: "Once I had all the information her scouts could provide, I marched my little army into the next town. I had planned strategies and followed my trainin', expectin' the worst."
Text: "정찰병들이 줄 수 있는 정보를 모두 수집한 뒤, 소규모 군대를 이끌고 다음 마을로 진군했소. 전략을 세우고 훈련대로 움직이며 최악을 대비했지."

TextEng: He shrugs. "If that is the way you feel, I understand."
Text: 그가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "그렇게 생각한다면, 이해하겠소."

TextEng: "It all proved to be unnecessary. Our army approached the town, and the elders came out to meet us. They were prepared to surrender without a fight. They wanted to join Wren's army."
Text: "전부 쓸데없는 준비였소. 군대가 마을에 접근하자, 장로들이 나와서 맞이했지. 싸우지 않고 항복하려는 거였소. 렌의 군대에 합류하고 싶다고 했지."

TextEng: "There was a slaughter, but not of my army. Our army approached the town, and the elders came out to meet us. They were prepared to surrender without a fight. They wanted to join Wren's army."
Text: "학살이 있었지만 우리 군대가 당한 게 아니었소. 군대가 마을에 접근하자, 장로들이 나와서 맞이했지. 싸우지 않고 항복하려는 거였소. 렌의 군대에 합류하고 싶다고 했지."

TextEng: "I was overjoyed and Wren calmly accepted their surrender. She asked that all the people of the town come out and pay fealty to us."
Text: "기뻐서 어쩔 줄 몰랐고, 렌은 침착하게 항복을 받아들였소. 마을 사람 모두 나와서 우리에게 충성을 맹세하라고 했지."

TextEng: "This tavern has all the earmarks of quality. What do you say we spend a few days here and see if we can drink them dry!"
Text: "이 주점은 질 좋은 곳의 느낌이 나는군. 며칠 머물면서 술을 바닥낼 수 있을지 시험해 볼까!"

TextEng: "When all had presented themselves, she had them separated into groups. The men were asked to accompany a group of our soldiers to scour the outlyin' area for farmers and such."
Text: "모두 나오자, 그녀는 사람들을 무리로 나눴소. 남자들에게는 우리 병사 일부를 따라 주변 지역의 농부들을 찾으러 가라고 했지."

TextEng: Calibast looks very pale. "She was so calm and pleasant, even I didn't suspect anythin'. She spoke of how our combined forces would soon rule over the entire south."
Text: 캘리바스트가 매우 창백해 보입니다. "그녀는 너무 침착하고 상냥해서, 나조차 아무것도 의심하지 못했소. 우리 연합군이 곧 남쪽 전체를 지배할 거라고 말했지."

TextEng: "Once the men were gone, she had the women and elderly help build altars to Churl. Then she... I... I can't say the words. She had the men grab the villagers... they all died."
Text: "남자들이 떠나자, 여자와 노인들에게 철에게 바칠 제단을 세우라고 했소. 그리고... 차마 말을 못 하겠소. 병사들에게 마을 사람들을 잡으라고 했고... 모두 죽었소."

TextEng: "It was not a story I shared. There are none who speak of it anymore."
Text: "남에게 한 적 없는 이야기요. 더 이상 이걸 말하는 자도 없소."

TextEng: "It was more madness than religion at that point. She had twisted the minds of her followers, leavin' only greed and malevolence and hate."
Text: "그 시점에서는 종교라기보다 광기였소. 추종자들의 정신을 뒤틀어 탐욕과 악의와 증오만 남겨놓았지."

TextEng: "At first I couldn't believe that she would do such a thing. She never informed me of what she had planned."
Text: "처음에는 그녀가 그런 짓을 하리라곤 믿을 수 없었소. 뭘 계획하는지 미리 알려주지도 않았으니."

TextEng: "When the work was finished she told the villagers to kneel and worship. As soon as they did, the slaughter started. It took the villagers and myself by surprise."
Text: "작업이 끝나자 마을 사람들에게 무릎 꿇고 경배하라고 했소. 무릎을 꿇자마자 학살이 시작됐지. 마을 사람들도, 나도 허를 찔렸소."

TextEng: "By the time I recovered my wits, our army had killed all except the smallest children. Then it was my turn."
Text: "정신을 차렸을 때는, 가장 어린 아이들만 빼고 모두 죽인 뒤였소. 그리고 내 차례가 됐지."

TextEng: "Wren turned to me, laughin' and wild. She said 'You see the power of the goddess now?'"
Text: "렌이 웃으며 미친 듯이 내게 돌아서서 말했소. '이제 여신의 힘이 보이느냐?'"

TextEng: "I never said another word. I drew my axe and I attacked her. It was a long and bloody battle, since she was very powerful and I had to fend off the soldiers at the same time, but in the end I removed her cursed head."
Text: "한마디도 하지 않았소. 도끼를 뽑아 공격했지. 길고 피비린내 나는 싸움이었소. 그녀는 매우 강했고 동시에 병사들도 막아야 했으니. 하지만 결국 그 저주받은 머리를 베어냈소."

TextEng: "I can feel the debauchery seepin' right out of me in this holy place. We need to leave here quickly!"
Text: "이 성스러운 곳에 있으니 방탕한 기운이 쏙 빠지는 것 같소. 어서 나가야겠어."

TextEng: "Her death freed her followers from the spell that gripped their minds. They were so horrified by their actions, they surrendered immediately."
Text: "그녀가 죽자 추종자들을 사로잡고 있던 주문이 풀렸소. 자신들이 한 짓에 경악해서 즉시 항복했지."

TextEng: "I don't know how much of it was the spell and how much was greed, but with the death of their leader, they would have known their days were over."
Text: "주문 때문인지 탐욕 때문인지는 모르겠지만, 지도자가 죽으면 자기들도 끝이란 건 알았을 거요."

TextEng: "They deserved it. Some of them killed themselves in fits of horror, some ran off, some stayed to help the villagers rebuild, though I imagine they might have been killed by the returnin' villagers."
Text: "당연한 대가지. 일부는 공포에 빠져 스스로 목숨을 끊었고, 일부는 도주했고, 일부는 남아서 마을 재건을 도왔지만... 돌아온 마을 남자들에게 죽었을 거요."

TextEng: "Some of them killed themselves in fits of horror, some ran off, some stayed to help the villagers rebuild, though I imagine they might have been killed by the returnin' villagers."
Text: "일부는 공포에 빠져 스스로 목숨을 끊었고, 일부는 도주했고, 일부는 남아서 마을 재건을 도왔지만... 돌아온 마을 남자들에게 죽었을 거요."

TextEng: "I didn't stay around. I left behind the blood money I had been paid and I traveled for many days. When I was far away, I found a tavern and drank myself into oblivion."
Text: "난 남지 않았소. 피 묻은 보수를 남겨두고 며칠을 여행했지. 충분히 멀리 간 뒤 술집을 찾아 인사불성이 되도록 마셨소."

TextEng: "Even now, the thought of the slaughter is enough to make me dizzy and nauseous. I drink to forget. I do anythin' to forget. Enough talk, for now."
Text: "지금도 그 학살을 생각하면 어지럽고 구역질이 나오. 잊으려고 마시는 거요. 뭐든 해서라도 잊으려고. 이야기는 여기까지 하겠소."

TextEng: "What a monstrous person. I can tell from your visage what happened."
Text: "끔찍한 인간이군. 당신 표정만 봐도 무슨 일이 있었는지 알겠소."

TextEng: "This story is beginning to make me feel sick with dread."
Text: "이 이야기는 점점 두려운 기분이 드는군."

TextEng: "I wasn't prepared for what happened, no. Our army approached the town, and the elders came out to meet us. They were prepared to surrender without a fight. They wanted to join Wren's army."
Text: "일어난 일에 대비하지 못했소, 맞소. 군대가 마을에 접근하자, 장로들이 나와서 맞이했지. 싸우지 않고 항복하려는 거였소. 렌의 군대에 합류하고 싶다고 했지."

TextEng: "You don't start with the easy topics, do you? I guess you never did. <StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> Let me think."
Text: "쉬운 주제부터 시작하는 법이 없군, 그렇지? 원래 그랬지만. <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> 좀 생각해 보겠소."

TextEng: "Not yet. I will come back for you."
Text: "아직이야. 다시 올게."

TextEng: "They turned on you?"
Text: "그들이 돌아섰다고?"

TextEng: "That must have been some spell."
Text: "대단한 주문이었겠다."

TextEng: "I hope you killed them."
Text: "죽였기를 바라."

TextEng: "What did you do with them?"
Text: "그들을 어떻게 했어?"

TextEng: "I want to change your tactics."
Text: "네 전술을 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "Were you not prepared enough?"
Text: "준비가 부족했어?"

TextEng: "Why do you drink so much?"
Text: "왜 그렇게 많이 마시는 거야?"

TextEng: "How long ago was this?"
Text: "얼마나 전이야?"

TextEng: "I don't want to change anythin' else right now."
Text: "지금은 다른 걸 바꾸고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Where did you arrive in our world?"
Text: "이 세계에 어디에 도착했어?"

TextEng: "How were things different in your home?"
Text: "네 고향은 어떻게 달랐어?"

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "Isn't Churl very evil?"
Text: "처얼은 매우 사악하지 않아?"

TextEng: "I don't know anything about Churl."
Text: "처얼에 대해 아는 게 없어."

TextEng: "I want you to leave any traps that you see alone."
Text: "보이는 함정은 그냥 놔둬."

TextEng: "People will follow just about anybody."
Text: "사람들은 아무나 따르기 마련이지."

TextEng: "Sounds like she improved the village."
Text: "마을을 발전시킨 것 같은데."

TextEng: "Enough with the platitudes, just tell your story."
Text: "미사여구는 됐고, 이야기나 해."

TextEng: "Is this when you arrived?"
Text: "네가 도착한 건 그때야?"

TextEng: "No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "What? You need another drink?"
Text: "뭐? 또 한 잔 하고 싶어?"

TextEng: "What do you want to talk about?"
Text: "무슨 얘기를 하고 싶은데?"

TextEng: "I don't want to talk right now."
Text: "지금은 이야기하고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "I don't care."
Text: "상관없어."

TextEng: "I want you to disarm any traps that you see."
Text: "보이는 함정은 전부 해제해 줘."

TextEng: "You're a real class act, Calibast."
Text: "참 대단한 친구야, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "What's bothering you?"
Text: "뭐가 걱정이야?"

TextEng: "I don't want your ring."
Text: "네 반지는 필요 없어."

TextEng: "You are a good friend."
Text: "넌 좋은 친구야."

TextEng: "Thank you, Calibast."
Text: "고마워, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "Where do you think I went wrong?"
Text: "어디서 잘못된 것 같아?"

TextEng: "I can't believe I lost."
Text: "내가 졌다니 믿을 수가 없어."

TextEng: "It's not the end of the world."
Text: "세상이 끝난 건 아니잖아."

TextEng: "I didn't really want the position."
Text: "사실 그 자리를 별로 원하지 않았어."

TextEng: "I don't care."
Text: "상관없어."

TextEng: "Yes, go on."
Text: "응, 계속해."

TextEng: "I cannot accept this."
Text: "이건 받을 수 없어."

TextEng: "I need more space."
Text: "좀 더 여유가 필요해."

TextEng: "I want to move faster and not bother with searchin' or stealth."
Text: "더 빠르게 움직이고 탐색이나 은신은 하지 마."

TextEng: "I'm just not ready yet."
Text: "아직 준비가 안 됐어."

TextEng: "It is too much responsibility."
Text: "책임이 너무 커."

TextEng: "I just don't really love you, Calibast."
Text: "사실 널 사랑하지 않아, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "Nothing would please me more."
Text: "그보다 기쁜 일은 없을 거야."

TextEng: "I accept your bond."
Text: "네 유대를 받아들이겠어."

TextEng: "We haven't won yet."
Text: "아직 이긴 게 아냐."

TextEng: "I sure hope so."
Text: "그래야 할 텐데."

TextEng: "No, thanks."
Text: "아니, 됐어."

TextEng: "I hate hypothem... hypothert... what ever that word is."
Text: "가설적... 가설저... 그게 뭐든 싫어."

TextEng: "I hate hypothetical questions."
Text: "가설적인 질문은 싫어."

TextEng: "I need you to be stealthy right now."
Text: "지금 은밀하게 행동해야 해."

TextEng: "Go ahead."
Text: "말해봐."

TextEng: "I'll think about it."
Text: "생각해 볼게."

TextEng: "A drunken, lecherous, flaming dwarf as the Hand? Not a chance."
Text: "술 취하고, 밝히고, 머리에 불 붙은 드워프를 오른팔로? 절대 안 돼."

TextEng: "A drunken, lecherous, flaming dwarf as the Hand? Sure, why not?"
Text: "술 취하고, 밝히고, 머리에 불 붙은 드워프를 오른팔로? 좋지, 왜 안 되겠어."

TextEng: "You would be perfect for the job."
Text: "딱 맞는 사람이야."

TextEng: "I want you to pay more attention to me."
Text: "나한테 더 신경 써 줬으면 해."

TextEng: "Yes. Please follow me."
Text: "그래. 따라와."

TextEng: "That's all I can ask."
Text: "그 정도면 됐어."

TextEng: "I didn't realize that was how you felt."
Text: "그렇게 느끼는 줄 몰랐어."

TextEng: "It's not enough."
Text: "그것만으론 부족해."

TextEng: "I want you to stop flirting with other women."
Text: "다른 여자한테 추파 던지는 거 그만해."

TextEng: "You drink too much."
Text: "술을 너무 많이 마셔."

TextEng: "If you love me, you would never touch a drink again."
Text: "날 사랑한다면, 다시는 술에 손대지 마."

TextEng: "No. You must stop entirely!"
Text: "아니. 완전히 끊어야 해!"

TextEng: "I suppose that might work."
Text: "그 정도면 괜찮을 것 같아."

TextEng: "That would work for me."
Text: "나한테는 그 정도면 돼."

TextEng: "I love you just the way you are."
Text: "있는 그대로의 네가 좋아."

TextEng: "Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "Nothing could stop my love for you."
Text: "무엇도 내 사랑을 막을 수 없어."

TextEng: "To be honest, it really does."
Text: "솔직히 말하면, 정말 신경 쓰여."

TextEng: "Well, it does bother me a little."
Text: "글쎄, 좀 신경 쓰이긴 해."

TextEng: "I suppose that will have to do."
Text: "그것밖에 안 되는 거야."

TextEng: "It makes me very uncomfortable. Please stop."
Text: "많이 불편해. 제발 그만해."

TextEng: "If that is all it is, then I am fine with it."
Text: "그 정도뿐이라면, 괜찮아."

TextEng: "Not really. Just don't take it any further than flirtation."
Text: "별로. 바람 이상으로만 안 가면 돼."

TextEng: "Yes. It would be nice if you could stop drinking entirely."
Text: "응. 술을 완전히 끊어주면 좋겠어."

TextEng: "If you love me, you would never touch a drink again."
Text: "날 사랑한다면, 다시는 술에 손대지 마."

TextEng: "No. You must stop entirely!"
Text: "아니. 완전히 끊어야 해!"

TextEng: "That's all."
Text: "그게 다야."

TextEng: "I guess that would work."
Text: "그 정도면 될 것 같아."

TextEng: "That's all I can think of."
Text: "생각나는 건 그게 다야."

TextEng: "You're nearly perfect as you are."
Text: "지금 그대로도 거의 완벽해."

TextEng: "True. You could slow down a little."
Text: "맞아. 좀 줄일 수는 있겠지."

TextEng: "As long as you're drinking with me, keep it coming."
Text: "나랑 같이 마시는 거라면, 계속 마셔."

TextEng: "Just love me with all your heart and I shall be deliriously happy."
Text: "온 마음으로 날 사랑해 줘. 그것만으로 기쁠 거야."

TextEng: "I really don't care."
Text: "정말 상관없어."

TextEng: "What was the young duke like?"
Text: "젊은 공작은 어떤 사람이었어?"

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Maybe I just have a nicer smile."
Text: "아마 내 미소가 더 예쁜가 봐."

TextEng: "I guess Dash passed."
Text: "그래서 대쉬는 통과한 거야."

TextEng: "It was only a test?"
Text: "시험에 불과했다고?"

TextEng: "He won?"
Text: "그가 이겼어?"

TextEng: "I would have attacked him too."
Text: "나라도 공격했을 거야."

TextEng: "Sounds like you were fools."
Text: "바보 같은 짓이었군."

TextEng: "Didn't you get the king's permission first?"
Text: "왕의 허락을 먼저 받지 않았어?"

TextEng: "So the king attacked you?"
Text: "그래서 왕이 공격했어?"

TextEng: "Fools and cowards. You should have fought your way out."
Text: "바보에 겁쟁이로군. 싸워서 탈출했어야지."

TextEng: "What other choice did you have?"
Text: "다른 선택이 있었어?"

TextEng: "I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "So the king won without a fight?"
Text: "그래서 왕이 싸우지도 않고 이긴 거야?"

TextEng: "Who was the king's champion?"
Text: "왕의 대리 결투사는 누구였어?"

TextEng: "Any suggestions on what we should do next?"
Text: "다음에 뭘 해야 할지 제안은?"

TextEng: "Is it difficult telling me this?"
Text: "이걸 말하기 힘들어?"

TextEng: "I guess we should get back to the election now."
Text: "선거로 돌아가야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "It's about time you got around to asking!"
Text: "드디어 물어보는 거야!"

TextEng: "I have given it some thought, why?"
Text: "생각해 본 적은 있어, 왜?"

TextEng: "I think I might like that very much."
Text: "아주 좋을 것 같아."

TextEng: "It's a possibility. Why, is there someone with a flaming head you would like to introduce me to?"
Text: "가능성은 있지. 왜, 머리에 불 붙은 사람을 소개시켜 줄 거야?"

TextEng: "I will never love any man."
Text: "어떤 남자도 사랑하지 않을 거야."

TextEng: "I have no interest in you, if that is what you mean."
Text: "너한테 관심 없어. 그런 뜻이라면."

TextEng: "Are you flirting with me?"
Text: "나한테 작업 거는 거야?"

TextEng: "Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Do we have to talk about this now?"
Text: "꼭 지금 이 얘기를 해야 해?"

TextEng: "Is this from your experience in court?"
Text: "궁정 경험에서 나온 거야?"

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "Go on."
Text: "계속해."

TextEng: "I can't believe you couldn't see something bad coming."
Text: "안 좋은 일이 올 걸 예상 못 한 게 믿기지 않아."

TextEng: "So what happened? Did they kill the duke?"
Text: "그래서 어떻게 됐어? 공작을 죽였어?"

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "Would you protect me with the same ferocity as you did the duke?"
Text: "공작을 지킨 것처럼 나도 지켜줄 거야?"

TextEng: "You did what you had to."
Text: "해야 할 일을 한 거야."

TextEng: "You left your father behind?"
Text: "아버지를 두고 왔어?"

TextEng: "What did you do?"
Text: "어떻게 했어?"

TextEng: "Maybe. If I'm not busy."
Text: "바쁘지 않으면."

TextEng: "I would like that."
Text: "그러고 싶어."

TextEng: "I get the point."
Text: "알겠어."

TextEng: "But what has this got to do with overconfidence?"
Text: "그게 자만과 무슨 상관이야?"

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "You're turning into my mother!"
Text: "엄마가 되려는 거야!"

TextEng: "Quit worrying."
Text: "걱정 그만해."

TextEng: "What's wrong?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "If you said anything, I wasn't paying attention. I don't really care now, either."
Text: "뭔 말을 했는지 안 들었어. 지금도 별로 관심 없고."

TextEng: "You might have mentioned it in passing, but I would like to hear more."
Text: "지나가듯 말한 적은 있을지 모르지만, 더 듣고 싶어."

TextEng: "I don't think I've heard about that. Go on."
Text: "그건 못 들은 것 같아. 계속해."

TextEng: "You never told me you were so powerful once."
Text: "예전에 그렇게 힘이 있었다는 건 처음 듣는군."

TextEng: "I'd rather be a spy."
Text: "난 첩자가 낫겠어."

TextEng: "I'd rather be a warrior."
Text: "난 전사가 낫겠어."

TextEng: "Sounds like you got the best job."
Text: "네가 제일 좋은 역할을 맡았네."

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "Is this story much longer?"
Text: "이 이야기 아직 멀었어?"

TextEng: "Was your brother a traitor?"
Text: "형이 배신자였어?"

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "I don't want to hear about this right now."
Text: "지금은 그 이야기 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "You sound bitter. Do you have a point?"
Text: "씁쓸하게 들리네. 하고 싶은 말이 있어?"

TextEng: "Do you have any suggestions for me?"
Text: "나한테 조언할 게 있어?"

TextEng: "I don't trust either."
Text: "둘 다 못 믿겠어."

TextEng: "I don't trust Sir Becket, but Enivid seems nice enough."
Text: "베켓 경은 못 믿겠는데, 에니비드는 괜찮아 보여."

TextEng: "I'm not overly worried about either."
Text: "둘 다 별로 걱정 안 돼."

TextEng: "I can take care of myself."
Text: "내 몸은 내가 지킬 수 있어."

TextEng: "I'm not worried about the competition."
Text: "경쟁자는 걱정 안 해."

TextEng: "Right. I'll be careful."
Text: "알겠어. 조심할게."

TextEng: "Maybe we should just take care of Sir Becket right now."
Text: "베켓 경을 지금 바로 처리하는 게 어때?"

TextEng: "What if we don't notice assassins until it's too late?"
Text: "자객을 너무 늦게 알아채면?"

TextEng: "I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "When were you ever involved in politics?"
Text: "언제 정치에 관여해 본 거야?"

TextEng: "You think this could be dangerous?"
Text: "이게 위험할 수 있다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "This must be hard on you. Do you want your position back?"
Text: "힘들겠다. 지위를 돌려받고 싶어?"

TextEng: "Not right now."
Text: "지금은 안 돼."

TextEng: "I'm the leader, get used to it."
Text: "내가 지도자야. 익숙해져."

TextEng: "I can do without your advice, thanks anyway."
Text: "네 조언 없이도 할 수 있어, 고맙지만."

TextEng: "So you have some suggestions?"
Text: "그래서 제안이 있어?"

TextEng: "What kind of mistakes?"
Text: "어떤 실수?"

TextEng: "I really don't want to hear about this."
Text: "이 이야기 정말 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "So why did you follow me blindly then?"
Text: "그런데 왜 맹목적으로 따른 거야?"

TextEng: "Who doubted me?"
Text: "누가 의심했어?"

TextEng: "That part is all a little vague right now."
Text: "그 부분은 지금 좀 흐릿해."

TextEng: "So what do you think about things so far?"
Text: "지금까지 상황을 어떻게 봐?"

TextEng: "Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Don't worry, I won't make the same mistake."
Text: "걱정 마. 같은 실수 안 할 거야."

TextEng: "So you are blaming this on me?"
Text: "그래서 나한테 탓을 하는 거야?"

TextEng: "Go on."
Text: "계속해."

TextEng: "No, just stay here for now."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Yes, let's go."
Text: "그래, 가자."

TextEng: "What was it you wanted to say earlier?"
Text: "아까 하려던 말이 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "Let's stop and talk a moment."
Text: "잠깐 멈추고 이야기하자."

TextEng: "What's wrong, Calibast? Cat got your tongue?"
Text: "왜 그래, 캘리바스트? 고양이가 혀를 물었나?"

TextEng: "Could you two try to get along?"
Text: "둘이 좀 잘 지낼 수 없어?"

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "We're done talking."
Text: "이야기는 끝이야."

TextEng: "Nice one."
Text: "잘했어."

TextEng: "Quit looking at Kaidala that way!"
Text: "카이달라 그렇게 쳐다보지 마!"

TextEng: "I can't believe you look at other women!"
Text: "다른 여자를 쳐다보다니 믿을 수가 없어!"

TextEng: "Well, of course I'm right."
Text: "내가 맞지, 당연하지."

TextEng: "Don't be disgusting, Calibast."
Text: "역겹게 굴지 마, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "Nothing else."
Text: "다른 건 없어."

TextEng: "Hey! I didn't say that!"
Text: "이봐! 나는 그런 말 안 했어!"

TextEng: "How is everything?"
Text: "다 잘 지내?"

TextEng: "Do you need a room?"
Text: "방이 필요해?"

TextEng: "Calibast! Are you flirting with another woman?"
Text: "캘리바스트! 다른 여자한테 작업 거는 거야?"

TextEng: "Are you flirting with my girl?"
Text: "내 여자한테 작업 거는 거야?"

TextEng: "Hey! That'll be enough of that!"
Text: "이봐! 거기까지야!"

TextEng: <StartAction>[Play along with the joke.]</Start>"Oh my, Trip. We could be in trouble."
Text: <StartAction>[장난에 동조합니다.]</Start> "이런, 트립. 우리 큰일 났을지도 몰라."

TextEng: "Yes, something moving and breathing. Something very large."
Text: "응, 움직이고 숨 쉬는 뭔가. 아주 큰 것."

TextEng: "I think this has gone far enough."
Text: "이쯤이면 됐다고 생각해."

TextEng: "Calibast, leave him alone."
Text: "캘리바스트, 트립 좀 내버려둬."

TextEng: "Both of you shut up!"
Text: "둘 다 닥쳐!"

TextEng: "Tell the truth, Trip."
Text: "트립, 솔직히 말해."

TextEng: "You asked where his name came from. Let him explain."
Text: "네가 이름이 어디서 왔냐고 물었잖아. 설명하게 놔둬."

TextEng: "I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Do you have plans for what you're going to do after all this?"
Text: "이 모든 게 끝나면 뭘 할 계획이 있어?"

TextEng: "Who do you need revenge against?"
Text: "누구한테 복수하고 싶은 거야?"

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Do you think revenge is possible against the king?"
Text: "왕에게 복수할 수 있다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "What kind of improvements?"
Text: "어떤 개선을?"

TextEng: "Anything else?"
Text: "다른 건?"

TextEng: "I had already thought of all those things."
Text: "그건 이미 다 생각했어."

TextEng: "What's a barbican?"
Text: "바비칸이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "How much would this all cost?"
Text: "이 모든 게 얼마나 들어?"

TextEng: "Sounds like you have some good ideas."
Text: "좋은 생각인 것 같아."

TextEng: "I'll always want you around."
Text: "항상 곁에 있어 줬으면 해."

TextEng: "You were telling me about how you started drinking."
Text: "술을 마시기 시작한 이유를 이야기하고 있었잖아."

TextEng: "Suddenly I don't want to know..."
Text: "갑자기 알고 싶지 않아졌어..."

TextEng: "That's not much time to prepare."
Text: "준비할 시간이 많지 않았겠네."

TextEng: "Did your army get slaughtered?"
Text: "네 군대가 학살당한 거야?"

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "Did they suspect nothing?"
Text: "아무도 의심하지 않았어?"

TextEng: "They went?"
Text: "갔어?"

TextEng: "I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "How come I never heard about this before?"
Text: "왜 이 이야기를 들어본 적이 없지?"

TextEng: "This is what comes of religious fervor."
Text: "종교적 광기가 빚은 결과로군."

TextEng: "They all died?"
Text: "모두 죽었어?"

TextEng: "Did you do nothing to stop her?"
Text: "막지 않았어?"

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I see that you have returned to me. Have you discovered the errors of your ways? Do you realize that you need me now?"
Text: "돌아왔군요. 잘못을 깨달은 건가요? 내가 필요하다는 걸 이제야 알겠어요?"

TextEng: "I do not think it wise that you should travel without companions, but the choice is yours, of course."
Text: "동료 없이 여행하는 건 현명하지 않다고 생각하지만, 물론 선택은 당신 몫이에요."

TextEng: "These people are very open to diverse forms of worship. I shudder to think what happens at the shrine of fertility in the dead of night."
Text: "이 사람들은 다양한 형태의 신앙에 매우 개방적이군요. 한밤중에 풍요의 성소에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 생각하면 소름이 끼쳐요."

TextEng: "It was the inclusion of the slaves that began the slaughter though. That was my first mistake."
Text: "하지만 노예를 포함시킨 것이 학살의 시작이었어요. 그것이 제 첫 번째 실수였죠."

TextEng: "Apparently the slaves had been spreading the word that there were rakshasa willing to stand up and fight for them. They secretly prepared and when we had our meeting that night..."
Text: "분명 노예들이 자신들을 위해 싸워줄 락샤사가 있다는 소문을 퍼뜨렸어요. 비밀리에 준비를 했고, 우리가 그날 밤 모임을 열었을 때..."

TextEng: "They never stood a chance. Hundreds of thousands of slaves were killed that night. A few hundred of my people were killed, but the rebellion was put to an end. Brutally."
Text: "그들에겐 가망이 없었어요. 그날 밤 수십만의 노예가 죽었어요. 우리 종족도 수백 명이 죽었지만, 반란은 잔인하게 진압됐어요."

TextEng: "That I was. I even thought that things might change after the rebellion. I thought my people would see what despair they had wrought."
Text: "그랬죠. 반란 후에 상황이 바뀔 거라고까지 생각했어요. 동족들이 자신들이 만들어낸 절망을 보게 될 거라고요."

TextEng: "They took one look at the rebelling slaves and the burning city and they turned on them and began to slaughter them as quickly as they could"
Text: "반란을 일으킨 노예들과 불타는 도시를 한 번 보더니 노예들에게 등을 돌려 가능한 한 빨리 학살하기 시작했어요."

TextEng: "They had no interest in watching their precious society fall completely, and neither did I. We did not wish to be ruled by those we had enslaved."
Text: "소중한 사회가 완전히 무너지는 걸 보고 싶어하는 이는 없었어요. 저도 마찬가지였죠. 우리가 노예로 삼았던 이들에게 지배당하고 싶지 않았어요."

TextEng: "Our skins have magical protection, so that only weapons of powerful magic can do any damage to us. The slaves had clubs and knives."
Text: "우리의 피부에는 마법적 보호가 있어서, 강력한 마법 무기만이 피해를 줄 수 있어요. 노예들은 곤봉과 칼밖에 없었죠."

TextEng: "The slaves were tortured until my people had the names of all rakshasa who ever attended our meetings."
Text: "노예들을 고문해서 우리 모임에 참석한 모든 락샤사의 이름을 알아냈어요."

TextEng: "They gathered us up and allowed us to give ourselves into the military, to help recover our lost slave population, or choose an honorable death. I was not so lucky."
Text: "우리를 모아서 군대에 투입해 잃어버린 노예 인구를 회복하도록 돕든, 명예로운 죽음을 택하든 선택하게 했어요. 저는 그렇게 운이 좋지 못했죠."

TextEng: "Every single one of my companions joined the military. I gave what I thought was a rousing speech, but even before I could finish, my words were hidden by the hissing of my old friends."
Text: "동료 하나하나가 군대에 합류했어요. 저는 열정적인 연설을 했다고 생각했는데, 끝내기도 전에 옛 친구들의 야유 소리에 묻혔어요."

TextEng: "That is a man anticipating trouble. I wonder what his story is?"
Text: "문제를 예상하고 있는 사람이군요. 무슨 사정이 있는지 궁금하네요."

TextEng: "Idealistic... foolish... all of the things we are when we are young. Some of us, at least."
Text: "이상주의적이고... 어리석고... 젊을 때 그런 것들이죠. 적어도 일부는요."

TextEng: "They beat me, tortured me, stripped me of most of my power and exiled me from my home. There is more honor in death than in exile."
Text: "때리고, 고문하고, 대부분의 힘을 빼앗고 고향에서 추방했어요. 추방보다는 죽음이 더 명예로운 일이에요."

TextEng: She sighs. "We had best get moving. There are important things for us to do still."
Text: 그녀가 한숨을 쉽니다. "출발하는 게 좋겠어요. 아직 중요한 일이 남았으니까요."

TextEng: "Yes. They beat me, tortured me, stripped me of most of my power and exiled me from my home. There is more honor in death than in exile."
Text: "네. 때리고, 고문하고, 대부분의 힘을 빼앗고 고향에서 추방했어요. 추방보다는 죽음이 더 명예로운 일이에요."

TextEng: "I awoke on this plane, and it took all of my willpower to stand up and begin my life again."
Text: "이 차원에서 눈을 떴고, 온 의지를 모아 일어서서 새 삶을 시작했어요."

TextEng: "Trip doesn't like meetings. Too many smelly people gathered in a hot, stinky room, stepping on my tail... a horrible idea in the first place."
Text: "트립은 모임을 싫어해요. 덥고 냄새나는 방에 사람이 너무 많이 모여서 꼬리를 밟고... 처음부터 끔찍한 발상이에요."

TextEng: "I am trying to tell my story, Trip. Try not to interrupt."
Text: "제 이야기를 하고 있어요, 트립. 끼어들지 말아요."

TextEng: "When you have little reason to live, you do not fear death. I imagine the slaves felt pretty desperate."
Text: "살 이유가 없으면 죽음을 두려워하지 않아요. 노예들은 꽤 절박했을 거예요."

TextEng: "A slave is a terrible warrior, but when you have nothing worth living for, you will do almost anything to be free."
Text: "노예는 형편없는 전사예요. 하지만 살 가치가 없을 때는, 자유를 위해 거의 무엇이든 할 거예요."

TextEng: "You would not have enjoyed living there, I can tell you. Only the most beautiful of slaves had any pleasure in their lives. I fear you would have been sent to the mines, like the majority of slaves."
Text: "거기서 사는 걸 즐기지는 못했을 거예요. 가장 아름다운 노예만이 삶에서 즐거움을 얻었거든요. 당신은 대다수의 노예처럼 광산에 보내졌을 거예요."

TextEng: "The undead do not appear to like each other. We could use this to our advantage."
Text: "언데드들끼리 사이가 안 좋은 것 같아요. 이걸 이용할 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "I do not say these things to offend you. But so much of life as a rakshasa is wrapped up in our slave culture."
Text: "불쾌하게 하려는 건 아니에요. 하지만 락샤사로서의 삶은 노예 문화에 깊이 얽혀 있어요."

TextEng: "Yes, that is one of the festering wounds caused by the repugnant institution of slavery. I did not realize how detrimental to our society it was."
Text: "맞아요. 역겨운 노예 제도가 만들어낸 곪는 상처 중 하나예요. 우리 사회에 얼마나 해로운지 몰랐어요."

TextEng: "My people have many problems, it is true. We also have some very noble qualities, twisted as we have become. I did not realize how detrimental to our society slavery was."
Text: "우리 종족에 문제가 많은 건 사실이에요. 뒤틀리긴 했지만 매우 고귀한 면도 있어요. 노예제가 우리 사회에 얼마나 해로운지 몰랐었어요."

TextEng: "I had no problem with slavery until I lived here amongst societies made up of entirely free peoples. At the time I did not realize how detrimental to our society it was."
Text: "여기서 완전히 자유로운 사회 속에서 살기 전까지는 노예제에 문제가 있다고 생각하지 않았어요. 그때는 우리 사회에 얼마나 해로운지 몰랐어요."

TextEng: "No, though I have grown to believe that slavery is a repugnant institution, I did not realize how detrimental to our society it was."
Text: "아니요. 노예제가 역겨운 제도라고 믿게 되긴 했지만, 우리 사회에 얼마나 해로운지는 몰랐어요."

TextEng: "I lived in a beautiful mansion, surrounded by the fairest slaves of many races. My every whim was fulfilled, almost instantly."
Text: "아름다운 저택에서 살았어요. 여러 종족의 가장 아름다운 노예들에 둘러싸여서요. 모든 변덕이 거의 즉시 충족됐죠."

TextEng: "The problem with having everything is that life quickly grows boring. I decided, to make life more interesting, I would go out to explore other realms."
Text: "모든 것을 가지면 금방 지루해져요. 삶을 더 흥미롭게 만들기 위해 다른 세계를 탐험하러 나가기로 했어요."

TextEng: "You wouldn't understand, unless you have experienced similar situations. Let us just say that my parents were quite happy to have me joining their 'exploratory expedition', as it was called."
Text: "비슷한 경험을 하지 않으면 이해 못 할 거예요. 부모님이 저를 '탐험 원정대'에 보내게 되어 꽤 기뻐했다고만 말해둘게요."

TextEng: "We found a new people, a fascinating realm full of scholars, artists and philosophers. They were not a fierce, warlike people, which made them easy to conquer."
Text: "학자, 예술가, 철학자로 가득 찬 매혹적인 세계의 새로운 종족을 발견했어요. 호전적인 민족이 아니어서 정복하기 쉬웠죠."

TextEng: "There was one hold out. One small group of scholars who were resisting us from inside their largest library. It was the size of a small city and contained a copy of every writing ever found."
Text: "하나의 저항 세력이 있었어요. 가장 큰 도서관 안에서 저항하는 소규모 학자 집단이었어요. 도서관은 작은 도시만 했고, 발견된 모든 기록의 사본이 있었죠."

TextEng: "Looking at her beauty and wealth, I can see why Sir Becket is so anxious to marry the girl."
Text: "저 여인의 아름다움과 재산을 보면, 베켓 경이 왜 그토록 결혼을 서두르는지 알겠어요."

TextEng: "Do not ask me to tell about myself if you will not hear my tale as I would tell it."
Text: "제게 자기 이야기를 해달라고 해놓고 제가 하고 싶은 대로 들으려 하지 않으면 곤란해요."

TextEng: "Finally, the leader of our expedition made a deal with the warring scholars. He agreed to preserve every single page of writing, if the scholars would give up peacefully."
Text: "마침내 원정대장이 저항하는 학자들과 거래를 했어요. 학자들이 평화적으로 항복하면 모든 글을 한 장도 빠짐없이 보존하겠다고 약속했죠."

TextEng: "The scholars agreed and were horrified when our men took each book and scroll and ripped them apart, shuffling all the pages together into one giant, undecipherable mess."
Text: "학자들이 동의했는데, 우리 병사들이 모든 책과 두루마리를 가져다가 찢어서 모든 페이지를 섞어 거대하고 해독 불가능한 더미로 만들자 경악했어요."

TextEng: "Watching the tears of the scholars, not from the chains on their necks, but from the destruction of their knowledge, I became sickened by the 'honor' of my people. But that is enough for now. Let us continue."
Text: "학자들의 눈물을 보면서 — 목의 사슬 때문이 아니라 지식의 파괴 때문에 흘리는 눈물 — 우리 종족의 '명예'에 역겨움을 느꼈어요. 하지만 이건 여기까지. 계속합시다."

TextEng: "No, they were quite happy to have me joining their 'exploratory expedition', as it was called, though it turned out to be little more than a conquering force."
Text: "아니요, 부모님은 저를 '탐험 원정대'에 보내게 되어 꽤 기뻐했어요. 사실은 정복군에 불과했지만요."

TextEng: "No, that was much later in life. I joined one of our 'exploratory expeditions', as they were called, though it turned out to be little more than a conquering force."
Text: "아니요, 그건 훨씬 나중 일이에요. '탐험 원정대'에 참가했는데, 사실은 정복군에 불과했죠."

TextEng: "You would have made a lovely slave there. My people like their slaves to be examples of great beauty from the races they have conquered."
Text: "거기서 당신은 사랑스러운 노예가 됐을 거예요. 우리 종족은 정복한 종족에서 뛰어난 미녀를 노예로 삼는 걸 좋아하니까요."

TextEng: "I see that you have returned to me. Have you discovered the errors of your ways? Do you realize that you need me now?"
Text: "돌아왔군요. 잘못을 깨달은 건가요? 내가 필요하다는 걸 이제야 알겠어요?"

TextEng: "I see that you have returned to me. Have you discovered the errors of your ways? Do you realize that you need me now?"
Text: "돌아왔군요. 잘못을 깨달은 건가요? 내가 필요하다는 걸 이제야 알겠어요?"

TextEng: "Leave me be, then. I am studying with Yenna. I have learned a lot already. Soon I shall be ready to journey off on my own."
Text: "그럼 가세요. 저는 예나와 공부하고 있어요. 벌써 많이 배웠어요. 곧 혼자 여행을 떠날 준비가 될 거예요."

TextEng: "The smell of this place turns my stomach. Let us not linger here."
Text: "이곳의 냄새가 속이 뒤집혀요. 오래 머물지 말아요."

TextEng: "It seems to me that you are the one with a poor attitude. You mistreated me; cast me off like unwanted debris. Why should I come with you now?"
Text: "태도가 나쁜 건 당신 쪽이에요. 나를 쓸모없는 쓰레기처럼 버렸잖아요. 왜 지금 와서 따라가야 해요?"

TextEng: "I have not been paid! I do not see any reason for me to treat this as a professional choice! If it is a job, then you already fired me. If you rescind your decision to fire me... I QUIT!"
Text: "보수도 못 받았어요! 이걸 직업으로 볼 이유가 없어요! 직업이라면 당신이 이미 해고한 거예요. 해고를 철회한다면... 저는 관둡니다!"

TextEng: "I suppose that is the only argument that could compel me to follow you again. Very well, let us be off."
Text: "그 논리만이 저를 다시 따르게 할 수 있겠군요. 좋아요, 출발하죠."

TextEng: "I will do so, but mind that you treat me with the same respect that you would be treated with."
Text: "그러죠. 하지만 저를 대할 때 당신이 대접받고 싶은 만큼의 존중을 보여주세요."

TextEng: "If you could pause for just a moment, I would like to speak to you, my friend."
Text: "잠깐 시간이 되면, 이야기하고 싶은 게 있어요, 친구."

TextEng: "As you wish. I will allow you to fumble about on your own without any advice from friends."
Text: "뜻대로 하세요. 친구의 조언 없이 혼자 더듬거리도록 내버려둘게요."

TextEng: "Look at my fingernails; they are filthy! I was hoping you might give me a manicure. Of course it is important!"
Text: "제 손톱 좀 보세요, 더러워요! 매니큐어를 해 줬으면 해서요. 물론 중요하죠!"

TextEng: "And here I thought you would like to discuss the latest dress-styles in this border town. How silly of me."
Text: "이 변경 도시의 최신 의상 유행에 대해 이야기하고 싶을 줄 알았는데요. 제가 어리석었네요."

TextEng: "I always judge whether my words are important enough to present your royal ears; you should know that by now."
Text: "제 말이 당신의 고귀한 귀에 전할 만큼 중요한지 항상 판단한다는 거, 이제 아셔야 할 텐데요."

TextEng: "I always stop you so that I can discuss trivialities. I probably just wanted to know if my hair was ruffled, but now you have ruined the moment!"
Text: "항상 사소한 것을 논의하려고 멈추잖아요. 아마 머리카락이 헝클어졌는지 물어보려 했을 텐데, 분위기를 망쳤네요!"

TextEng: "Perhaps I should wait outside this room, so that no one gets caught in the trap."
Text: "아마 제가 밖에서 기다리는 게 나을 것 같아요. 함정에 걸릴 사람이 없도록."

TextEng: "Do you think I would ask you to stop if all I wanted to know was if this outfit made me look fat? I don't think so."
Text: "이 옷이 뚱뚱해 보이냐고 물으려고 멈춘 줄 아세요? 천만에요."

TextEng: "No. I enjoy watching you fumble about on your own. I can hold my advice to myself."
Text: "아니에요. 혼자 더듬거리는 걸 보는 것도 좋아요. 조언은 삼가겠어요."

TextEng: "<FirstName>, I wanted to tell you that I have made up my mind. I would like to offer you the honor of being my Rakathi, my <brother/sister>."
Text: "<FirstName>, 마음을 정했다고 말하고 싶어요. 당신에게 라카티, 즉 나의 <brother/sister>라는 영예를 드리고 싶어요."

TextEng: Her eyes harden and her hair stands on end. "How dare you insult me after I have tried to offer you the greatest honor my people can bestow."
Text: 그녀의 눈이 굳어지고 머리카락이 곤두섭니다. "감히 우리 종족이 줄 수 있는 최고의 영예를 드리려는데 모욕하다니."

TextEng: "You can finish this quest on your own. I want nothing more to do with you!"
Text: "이 임무는 혼자 끝내세요. 더 이상 당신과 관련되고 싶지 않아요!"

TextEng: "I have a bonding present for you, Rakathi. I have given some of my own energy to create this amulet. I hope that you will wear it proudly."
Text: "라카티에게 줄 결연 선물이 있어요. 제 에너지 일부를 담아 이 부적을 만들었어요. 자랑스럽게 착용해 주세요."

TextEng: Jaboli stands shocked."I... I am sorry if I have misled you, <FirstName>. I love you too, but only as a <brother/sister>!"
Text: 자볼리가 충격을 받고 서 있습니다. "저... 오해하게 했다면 미안해요, <FirstName>. 저도 사랑하지만, <brother/sister>로서일 뿐이에요!"

TextEng: "No, it isn't. You forget that I can read a lie quite easily."
Text: "아니에요. 거짓말은 쉽게 읽을 수 있다는 거 잊었어요?"

TextEng: "There is nothing we can do about this situation now, but someday we will have to resolve it. For now, we should be going."
Text: "이 상황에 대해 지금 할 수 있는 건 없지만, 언젠가 해결해야 할 거예요. 지금은 가야 해요."

TextEng: Jaboli stares into your eyes. "Good. I guess we should continue then. Sorry for the misunderstanding."
Text: 자볼리가 당신의 눈을 응시합니다. "좋아요. 그럼 계속합시다. 오해에 대해 미안해요."

TextEng: "Such a disreputable shop. I do not feel comfortable in here."
Text: "이런 천한 가게라니. 여기서는 편하지 않아요."

TextEng: "As are you, <FirstName>. We should be going now. I am proud of you, my Rakathi!"
Text: "당신도요, <FirstName>. 이제 가야 해요. 자랑스러워요, 나의 라카티!"

TextEng: "It is one of the greatest honors one of my people can bestow, and, to my knowledge, it has never been bestowed on a non-rakshasa before."
Text: "우리 종족이 줄 수 있는 가장 큰 영예 중 하나이며, 제가 알기로 락샤사가 아닌 이에게 주어진 적은 없어요. 하지만 계속 명예롭게 행동한다면, 당신이 최초가 될 거예요."

TextEng: "I would like to talk to you about Feran."
Text: "페란에 대해 이야기하고 싶어요."

TextEng: "I am reasonably impressed with your handling of the situation. It was fairly done, yet managed to gain you the vote."
Text: "상황을 처리한 방식에 꽤 감명받았어요. 공정하면서도 표를 얻어냈으니까요."

TextEng: "I feared that you might have betrayed his trust and blackmailed him for gold or for a vote. But you dealt honorably with him."
Text: "그의 신뢰를 배신하고 금이나 표를 위해 협박할까 봐 걱정했어요. 하지만 명예롭게 대했군요."

TextEng: "My respect for you is growing. I did not think I would ever see such honorable actions from you. I am glad I was wrong."
Text: "당신에 대한 존경심이 커지고 있어요. 당신에게서 이런 명예로운 행동을 볼 줄은 몰랐어요. 틀려서 기뻐요."

TextEng: "I have come to expect you to do the honorable thing, but I still love to watch you in action."
Text: "명예로운 일을 할 거라고 기대하게 됐지만, 그래도 행동하는 모습을 보는 건 좋아요."

TextEng: "I am sorry. I should not have been so presumptuous in thinking that you would be glad to have my good opinion."
Text: "미안해요. 제 좋은 평가를 기뻐할 거라고 짐작한 건 주제넘었어요."

TextEng: "We should continue. I just wanted you to know that I approve, if that means anything to you."
Text: "계속합시다. 당신의 행동을 인정한다는 걸 알려주고 싶었을 뿐이에요. 의미가 있다면요."

TextEng: "You took advantage of that man. You pretended to be his friend and then you broke him, most cruelly."
Text: "그 사람을 이용했어요. 친구인 척하다가 가장 잔인하게 무너뜨렸어요."

TextEng: "There is the home of the mage. We should go and see her."
Text: "마법사의 집이에요. 가서 만나봐야겠어요."

TextEng: "I have a feeling that I can no longer trust you either. I will not be turning my back on you, <FirstName>. I cannot trust a person like you."
Text: "더 이상 당신을 믿을 수 없는 느낌이에요. 등을 돌리지 않겠어요, <FirstName>. 당신 같은 사람은 믿을 수 없어요."

TextEng: "What you did in bringing those two together... it is nothing short of miraculous! Somewhere inside you there is a romantic spirit. You showed him a justice I would not have expected."
Text: "두 사람을 맺어준 것은... 기적이라고밖에 할 수 없어요! 당신 안 어딘가에 낭만적인 영혼이 있군요. 기대하지 못한 정의를 보여줬어요."

TextEng: "Every time I think I understand you better, you do something to annoy me and destroy my respect. Have it your way then. But I know you are hiding a romantic soul. Deeply hidden."
Text: "당신을 이해했다고 생각할 때마다, 짜증나는 짓을 해서 존경심을 무너뜨리네요. 마음대로 하세요. 하지만 깊이 숨겨진 낭만적인 영혼이 있다는 건 알아요."

TextEng: "That or he'll regret that he ever opened his mouth to you. Well, I just wanted you to know that I was impressed."
Text: "아니면 입을 연 걸 후회할지도 모르죠. 감명받았다는 걸 알려주고 싶었어요."

TextEng: She laughs, merrily. "You could be right about that, but maybe it will turn out better than we expect. I just wanted you to know that I am impressed."
Text: 그녀가 즐겁게 웃습니다. "그럴 수도 있지만, 기대보다 잘 될 수도 있어요. 감명받았다는 걸 알려주고 싶었어요."

TextEng: "I agree. I never took you for such a soft heart, but I am impressed. I just wanted you to know that."
Text: "동감이에요. 이렇게 마음이 여린 줄 몰랐는데, 감명받았어요. 알려주고 싶었어요."

TextEng: "I think we need to speak about your actions in regards to Gelani and Thaddeus."
Text: "젤라니와 태디어스 건에 대한 당신의 행동에 대해 이야기해야 할 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Your actions were very honorable. You restored the faith of one who had no hope and in doing so you earned the trust of not only Gelani, but also of many others in the keep."
Text: "매우 명예로운 행동이었어요. 희망이 없던 사람의 믿음을 되살렸고, 그로 인해 젤라니뿐만 아니라 거점의 많은 사람들의 신뢰를 얻었어요."

TextEng: "I do not feel as though I say it enough, but it is at times like this when I deeply respect you as a friend. I have not decided yet, but I am thinking I would like to call you my Rakathi."
Text: "충분히 말하지 않았지만, 이런 때 깊이 친구로서 존경해요. 아직 결정하지 않았지만, 당신을 나의 라카티라 부르고 싶다고 생각하고 있어요."

TextEng: "That means <brother/sister> in my native tongue. It is an honor that is rarely given, and never to one who is not a rakshasa. But if your actions continue to be honorable, you will be the first."
Text: "우리 종족의 말로 <brother/sister>라는 뜻이에요. 거의 주어지지 않는 영예이며, 락샤사가 아닌 이에게는 절대 준 적이 없어요. 하지만 계속 명예롭게 행동한다면, 당신이 최초가 될 거예요."

TextEng: "Leading stupid beasts around? This is not a noble task for such as us."
Text: "멍청한 짐승들을 끌고 다닌다고요? 우리 같은 이에게 고귀한 임무는 아니군요."

TextEng: "I see that I was mistaken. Perhaps, you are undeserving of such a title then."
Text: "제가 틀렸나 보네요. 아마 그런 칭호를 받을 자격이 없는 것 같군요."

TextEng: "Ha! You can keep dreaming. It does involve a bonding gift; however, I have not decided what it will be."
Text: "하! 꿈이나 꾸세요. 결연 선물이 포함되긴 하는데, 뭘로 할지 아직 정하지 못했어요."

TextEng: "I am glad you see it that way. I always worry how others will comprehend my foreign ways, but with you, it is like speaking to a close sibling."
Text: "그렇게 봐 주니 기뻐요. 외국인의 방식을 남들이 어떻게 받아들일지 항상 걱정하는데, 당신과는 마치 가까운 형제자매에게 말하는 것 같아요."

TextEng: "That is all I wanted to say. We should carry on."
Text: "말하고 싶었던 건 그게 다예요. 계속합시다."

TextEng: "Your actions were cruel, cold, and despicable. You acted without judging the merits of the situation, and for that I feel as though I should condemn you!"
Text: "당신의 행동은 잔인하고, 냉혹하고, 비열했어요. 상황의 당위를 따지지도 않고 행동했고, 그래서 비난해야 한다고 느껴요!"

TextEng: "Tell me, why should I remain with you? Why should I continue to help one such as you? You are every bit as bad as my own, corrupt peoples."
Text: "왜 당신과 함께해야 하는 건가요? 왜 이런 사람을 도와야 하죠? 우리의 부패한 동족과 다를 바가 없어요."

TextEng: "Then I shall go. If you come to your senses and realize how much you need me, you shall find me in Yenna's tower. Maybe I can learn something useful from her."
Text: "그럼 가겠어요. 정신이 돌아와서 내가 얼마나 필요한지 깨닫게 되면, 예나의 탑에서 찾으세요. 그녀에게서 유용한 걸 배울 수 있을지도 몰라요."

TextEng: "Of course you need me! Look at all the trouble you have caused already, and I was with you."
Text: "물론 저가 필요하죠! 이미 얼마나 많은 문제를 일으켰는지 보세요, 제가 함께 있었는데도요."

TextEng: "Very well, I shall stay with you for now. But I shall be watching you carefully and judging your actions. I trust you shall stick to a more honorable code in the future."
Text: "좋아요, 우선은 함께하겠어요. 하지만 주의 깊게 지켜보며 행동을 판단할 거예요. 앞으로는 더 명예로운 방식을 지키길 바라요."

TextEng: "There are always options. You just figured you could make some easy gold by preying on the innocent."
Text: "항상 선택지가 있어요. 무고한 사람을 이용해서 쉬운 돈을 벌 수 있다고 생각했을 뿐이죠."

TextEng: "We could use these explosives to block the tunnels, unless you plan on killing all the duergar yourself."
Text: "이 폭약으로 터널을 막을 수 있어요. 직접 듀에르가를 모두 죽일 생각이 아니라면요."

TextEng: "I can judge you on all your actions and all of the things you have done including this one, and it does not look so good from where I sit!"
Text: "이번 건을 포함해서 지금까지의 모든 행동으로 판단할 수 있는데, 제 입장에서는 좋아 보이지 않아요!"

TextEng: "You cannot claim to be saving lives when you kill an innocent such as Gelani. She had done nothing to deserve this fate!"
Text: "젤라니 같은 무고한 사람을 죽이면서 생명을 구한다고 할 수는 없어요. 그녀는 이런 운명을 받을 짓을 한 적이 없어요!"

TextEng: "This is a perplexing situation. Yenna is a very powerful mage, yet she is bound by someone who is obviously more powerful."
Text: "당혹스러운 상황이에요. 예나는 매우 강력한 마법사인데, 분명히 더 강력한 누군가에게 속박되어 있어요."

TextEng: "I don't mean frightening, although it is that too. I just wonder why she would choose to let us know about this person."
Text: "무섭다는 게 아니에요, 물론 그것도 맞지만. 왜 이 인물에 대해 우리에게 알려주기로 했는지 궁금해요."

TextEng: "If this other person is more powerful than her, why would she risk telling us anything? If she isn't really afraid of this person, then why not do battle herself?"
Text: "상대가 그녀보다 강하다면, 왜 우리에게 아무것이라도 알려주는 위험을 감수하겠어요? 진짜 무서워하는 게 아니라면, 왜 직접 싸우지 않는 건가요?"

TextEng: "I just don't think that I fully understand her motives. I need to work this out. I think it could be important."
Text: "그녀의 동기를 완전히 이해하지 못하겠어요. 더 생각해야 해요. 중요할 수 있다고 봐요."

TextEng: "It might be more pressing than that. She said that you had the blood of an outsider. That would suggest to me that your lineage is possibly connected to some kind of demon or devil."
Text: "그보다 더 시급할 수도 있어요. 당신에게 외부자(아웃사이더)의 피가 흐른다고 했잖아요. 혈통이 악마나 마귀와 연결되어 있을 가능성을 시사해요."

TextEng: "I am not sure what to think. But follow my logic here and see if it makes sense to you. It is obvious that this creature has taken an interest in you and knows your background."
Text: "뭐라고 생각해야 할지 모르겠어요. 하지만 제 논리를 따라가 보고 말이 되는지 봐요. 이 존재가 당신에게 관심을 갖고 당신의 배경을 알고 있다는 건 분명해요."

TextEng: "It also knew that you would come here. Mages often call upon outsiders for information, so the creature you face might also be an outsider."
Text: "당신이 여기 올 것도 알고 있었어요. 마법사들은 종종 외부자를 소환해 정보를 얻으니, 당신이 맞서는 존재도 외부자일 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Such a creature would have powers possibly beyond that of Yenna. Such a creature would also be capable of controlling an army. Do you see where I am going with this?"
Text: "그런 존재는 예나를 넘어서는 힘을 가질 수 있어요. 군대를 통제하는 것도 가능하겠죠. 어디로 가고 있는지 알겠어요?"

TextEng: "I will follow you gladly, for I owe you much."
Text: "기꺼이 따르겠어요. 은혜를 많이 입었으니까요."

TextEng: "So this is the place where justice could rule. I could get used to this."
Text: "정의가 지배할 수 있는 곳이로군요. 이런 곳이라면 적응할 수 있겠어요."

TextEng: "We know that there is an illithid involved. This does not mean that there is no one else involved."
Text: "일리시드가 관련되어 있다는 건 알아요. 하지만 다른 누군가가 더 있을 수 없다는 뜻은 아니에요."

TextEng: "It is more than that. I think he is controlling his forces and spending time here in the keep."
Text: "그 이상이에요. 그가 병력을 조종하면서 이 거점에서도 시간을 보내고 있다고 생각해요."

TextEng: "I... I need more time to think about this. But you should be wary. Anyone you are talking to in the keep might actually be an enemy."
Text: "더... 더 생각할 시간이 필요해요. 하지만 조심하세요. 거점에서 이야기하는 누구라도 사실은 적일 수 있어요."

TextEng: "That is good. I am glad you will heed my advice."
Text: "좋아요. 제 조언을 들어줘서 기뻐요."

TextEng: "I am not the type who is usually paranoid. I will keep thinking on this and watching those to whom we speak."
Text: "원래 편집증적인 편은 아니에요. 계속 생각하면서 우리가 대화하는 사람들을 관찰하겠어요."

TextEng: "I don't think <FirstName> could possibly be a demon or a devil. I just can't imagine it."
Text: "<FirstName>이(가) 악마나 마귀일 리 없어요. 상상도 안 돼요."

TextEng: "I do not find your imagination, nor your ability to think to be an overwhelming talent. Mind your own business." She turns away from Kaidala, dismissing her entirely.
Text: "당신의 상상력도, 사고 능력도 그리 대단하다고 생각하지 않아요. 자기 일이나 신경 쓰세요." 그녀가 카이달라에게서 완전히 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "You know that I too am an outsider, if the wizards are to be believed. But I don't think the <lad/lass> looks much like an azer."
Text: "마법사들의 말이 맞다면 저도 외부자예요. 하지만 <lad/lass>가 에이저와 비슷하게 생기진 않았어요."

TextEng: "You think <master/mistress> might be a demon? Trip finds this to be most exciting!"
Text: "<master/mistress>가 악마일 수도 있다고요? 트립은 아주 흥미진진해요!"

TextEng: "I am not sure. She said that you had the blood of an outsider. That would suggest to me that your lineage is possibly connected to some kind of demon or devil."
Text: "잘 모르겠어요. 당신에게 외부자의 피가 흐른다고 했잖아요. 혈통이 악마나 마귀와 연결되어 있을 가능성을 시사해요."

TextEng: "I expected greater displays of wealth from Sir Becket."
Text: "베켓 경에게 더 큰 부의 과시를 기대했는데요."

TextEng: "If my conjectures do not interest you, then I shall quit them entirely. Do not make the mistake of believing I am without feelings. Your insults are remembered."
Text: "제 추측에 관심이 없다면, 완전히 그만두겠어요. 저에게 감정이 없다고 착각하지 마세요. 당신의 모욕은 기억하고 있어요."

TextEng: "I would like to speak to you about this home that Serah mentioned."
Text: "세라가 언급한 그 집에 대해 이야기하고 싶어요."

TextEng: "I think you made a wise decision in purchasing it. I am thinking that it could contain some fine treasure in it. Maybe even some gear to make up for the loss of ours."
Text: "구매하기로 한 건 현명한 결정이라고 생각해요. 훌륭한 보물이 있을 수도 있어요. 우리가 잃어버린 장비를 보충할 만한 것도 있을지 몰라요."

TextEng: "I thought that might spark some interest in you. There are other reasons to do it, as well."
Text: "관심을 끌 줄 알았어요. 다른 이유도 있어요."

TextEng: "I know, but that is only one of the reasons why I think it is a good idea."
Text: "알아요. 하지만 그건 좋은 생각이라고 보는 이유 중 하나일 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "It shows that you are seriously committed to the people of the keep. You would only purchase an expensive piece of property if you plan on staying."
Text: "거점 사람들에게 진심으로 헌신하고 있다는 걸 보여줘요. 비싼 부동산을 사는 건 오래 머물 계획이 있어야 하니까요."

TextEng: "It also proves that you have the courage to face an enemy head on. Since no one here was willing to drive out the haunting spirits, it will encourage your followers and intimidate your opponents."
Text: "적에게 정면으로 맞설 용기가 있다는 것도 증명해요. 여기 누구도 유령을 쫓아낼 엄두를 못 냈으니, 지지자들에게 용기를 주고 반대자들을 위축시킬 거예요."

TextEng: "It is important that everyone knows you are serious in your commitment to the keep. Besides... you never know what will happen."
Text: "모두가 당신이 거점에 진심이라는 걸 아는 게 중요해요. 게다가... 무슨 일이 생길지 모르잖아요."

TextEng: "Yes. I am excited to see what we may find in our new home."
Text: "네. 우리 새 집에서 뭘 발견할지 기대돼요."

TextEng: "I was there when you earned that gold. We are a party and we share the gold, remember? It is *our* purchase. Get used to the idea."
Text: "그 금을 벌 때 저도 함께였어요. 우리는 한 팀이고 금을 나누는 거잖아요? *우리의* 구매예요. 받아들이세요."

TextEng: "I am sorry. Did you wish to speak to me, my friend?"
Text: "미안해요. 말 걸고 싶었어요, 친구?"

TextEng: "It is just a hunch I have. I cannot explain it any better than that, but I feel like it is a good thing that we own this house."
Text: "직감이에요. 이보다 더 잘 설명할 수 없지만, 이 집을 소유하는 게 좋은 일이라는 느낌이 들어요."

TextEng: "I was there when you earned that gold. We are a party and we share the gold, remember? It is *our* purchase. Get used to the idea."
Text: "그 금을 벌 때 저도 함께였어요. 우리는 한 팀이고 금을 나누는 거잖아요? *우리의* 구매예요. 받아들이세요."

TextEng: "I think we should seriously consider purchasing it. I know it probably seems like a lot of gold, but it has been abandoned for a long time and adventurers died in it."
Text: "진지하게 구매를 고려해 봐야 할 것 같아요. 금이 많이 드는 것 같지만, 오래 방치된 데다 모험가들이 그 안에서 죽었어요."

TextEng: "I am thinking that it could contain some fine treasure in it. Maybe even some gear to make up for the loss of ours."
Text: "훌륭한 보물이 있을 수도 있어요. 잃어버린 장비를 보충할 만한 것도 있을지 몰라요."

TextEng: "I thought that might spark some interest in you. There are other reasons to do it, as well."
Text: "관심을 끌 줄 알았어요. 다른 이유도 있어요."

TextEng: "I know, but that is only one of the reasons why I think it is a good idea."
Text: "알아요. 하지만 그건 좋은 생각이라고 보는 이유 중 하나일 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "It shows that you are seriously committed to the people of the keep. You would only purchase an expensive piece of property if you plan on staying."
Text: "거점 사람들에게 진심으로 헌신하고 있다는 걸 보여줘요. 비싼 부동산을 사는 건 오래 머물 계획이 있어야 하니까요."

TextEng: "It would also prove you have the courage to face an enemy head on. Since no one here was willing to drive out the haunting spirits, it would encourage your followers and intimidate your opponents."
Text: "적에게 정면으로 맞설 용기가 있다는 것도 증명해요. 여기 누구도 유령을 쫓아낼 엄두를 못 냈으니, 지지자들에게 용기를 주고 반대자들을 위축시킬 거예요."

TextEng: "It is important that everyone knows you are serious in your commitment to the keep. Besides... you never know what will happen."
Text: "모두가 당신이 거점에 진심이라는 걸 아는 게 중요해요. 게다가... 무슨 일이 생길지 모르잖아요."

TextEng: "Yes. Consider what I said. Despite the danger, I see little that could cause us a problem."
Text: "네. 제 말을 생각해 봐요. 위험에도 불구하고, 우리에게 문제가 될 만한 건 거의 없어 보여요."

TextEng: "I do not think it wise that we should part. There is much danger here and you might need someone to watch your back."
Text: "헤어지는 건 현명하지 않다고 생각해요. 여기는 위험이 많고 등을 지켜줄 사람이 필요할 거예요."

TextEng: "It is just a hunch I have. I cannot explain it any better than that, but I feel like it is important that we should own this house."
Text: "직감이에요. 이보다 더 잘 설명할 수 없지만, 이 집을 소유해야 한다는 느낌이 들어요."

TextEng: "I suppose you will have to make your own decisions for your own reasons."
Text: "자기 이유에 따라 스스로 결정해야겠죠."

TextEng: "Now let us get going. We have much to do and I feel time pressing on us."
Text: "이제 출발합시다. 할 일이 많고 시간이 촉박한 느낌이에요."

TextEng: "Good. Now let us get going. We have much to do and I feel time pressing on us."
Text: "좋아요. 이제 출발합시다. 할 일이 많고 시간이 촉박한 느낌이에요."

TextEng: "While I know that completing quests and gaining votes in town is important, it strikes me that our job is two-fold. We also need to worry about the Masked Man's forces."
Text: "퀘스트를 완료하고 마을에서 표를 얻는 것도 중요하지만, 우리 임무는 두 가지라는 생각이 들어요. 가면 남자의 병력도 걱정해야 해요."

TextEng: "Very well, but what good is becoming the ruler of a place, if it is destroyed before you get a chance to do anything with it? Think about it."
Text: "좋아요, 하지만 다스리기도 전에 파괴되면 무슨 소용이에요? 생각해 봐요."

TextEng: "There must be those in town who hire adventurers to complete quests beyond the walls. There always are."
Text: "성벽 너머 퀘스트를 위해 모험가를 고용하는 사람들이 마을에 있을 거예요. 항상 있으니까요."

TextEng: "If you ask around, I am sure others could tell you who is hiring."
Text: "주변에 물어보면, 누가 사람을 구하는지 알 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "I find I am still shaken from the suddenness of our deaths and our return to life. I am pleased that I am not dead, but I wonder what the price might be for our lives?"
Text: "갑작스러운 죽음과 부활에 아직 동요하고 있어요. 살아서 기쁘지만, 우리 목숨의 대가가 뭘지 궁금해요."

TextEng: "I think we should watch what happens and see how much this power expects to guide our actions. If we test the limits, we might find out how much control it really has."
Text: "상황을 지켜보면서 이 힘이 우리 행동을 얼마나 이끌려 하는지 봐야 해요. 한계를 시험하면, 실제로 얼마나 통제력이 있는지 알 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "What a lovely decision. I do hope you don't return to find me murdered or eaten or anything."
Text: "참 좋은 결정이네요. 돌아왔을 때 제가 살해당하거나 잡아먹히지 않았으면 좋겠군요."

TextEng: "Do not push too hard, but when we are being guided, perhaps try to make a choice that is not obvious. Until we are in a specific situation, I cannot say exactly."
Text: "너무 세게 밀어붙이진 말되, 인도받을 때 뻔하지 않은 선택을 해 봐요. 구체적인 상황이 되기 전까진 정확히 뭐라 말하기 어렵지만요."

TextEng: "I will try to suggest something when I have the opportunity. Until then, we should be going."
Text: "기회가 되면 뭔가 제안해 볼게요. 그때까지, 출발해야 해요."

TextEng: "I think you should take this more seriously. This thing has a power to bring us back to life. It might also have the power to suddenly kill us."
Text: "더 심각하게 받아들여야 해요. 이 존재는 우리를 되살릴 힘이 있어요. 갑자기 죽일 힘도 있을 수 있어요."

TextEng: "It is true! I can no longer take this! You have been an embarrassment to me and a dishonorable stain on my reputation!"
Text: "더 이상 못 참겠어요! 당신은 저에게 수치였고 제 명예에 씻을 수 없는 오점이에요!"

TextEng: "You do not tell me what to do anymore! I am tired of hearing you bark commands and treat others as though they were cattle for you to chew upon! I am leaving!"
Text: "더 이상 제게 명령하지 마세요! 짖어대듯 명령하고 남을 가축 다루듯 하는 것도 지쳤어요! 떠나겠어요!"

TextEng: "I have been thinking and I have decided that I can no longer work with you. Your actions have proven that you care nothing for me. You are evil, <FirstName>!"
Text: "생각해 봤는데, 더 이상 당신과 함께할 수 없어요. 당신의 행동은 저를 신경도 안 쓴다는 걸 증명했어요. 당신은 악인이에요, <FirstName>!"

TextEng: "The voice is right. It is clear to me now that you have no intention of changing your ways or working towards making a stable, lawful society."
Text: "그 목소리가 맞아요. 당신이 행실을 고치거나 안정되고 합법적인 사회를 만들 의향이 없다는 게 이제 분명해요."

TextEng: "You are everything that I fought against on my home plane and I will not submit to your tyranny anymore than I submitted to theirs!"
Text: "당신은 제가 고향에서 맞서 싸웠던 모든 것 그 자체예요. 그들의 폭정에 굴복하지 않았듯, 당신의 폭정에도 굴복하지 않겠어요!"

TextEng: "What good to protect them from the Masked Man's army if it means leaving them under your cruel thumb! You are an evil despot and I should never have helped you become their leader!"
Text: "가면 남자의 군대에서 보호해 봤자 당신의 잔인한 손아귀에 맡기는 것뿐이라면 무슨 소용이에요! 당신은 사악한 폭군이고, 지도자로 만드는 걸 돕지 말았어야 했어요!"

TextEng: "That... that is true. You did choose me as Banner, so perhaps you will be willing to listen to reason and serve justice."
Text: "그건... 맞아요. 저를 군기(배너)로 선택했으니, 어쩌면 이성에 귀 기울이고 정의를 실현할 의향이 있을지도요."

TextEng: "Very well. I think I shall go and speak with Yenna in her tower. I think there is much I could learn from her."
Text: "좋아요. 예나의 탑에 가서 이야기하겠어요. 그녀에게 배울 게 많을 것 같아요."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "Even now you try to impose your tyrannical control over me! I am gone, and you cannot stop me!"
Text: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "지금도 폭압적인 지배력을 행사하려 하다니! 떠나겠어요, 막을 수 없어요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "There is no evidence of change from where I am standing. I can no longer assist you in this endeavor."
Text: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "제가 서 있는 곳에서 변화의 증거는 없어요. 더 이상 이 일을 도울 수 없어요."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "There has been little evidence of change from where I stand. Still, to listen to the Masked Man's voice would be foolish. We must destroy it, and soon."
Text: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "제가 서 있는 곳에서 변화의 증거는 거의 없어요. 그래도 가면 남자의 목소리에 귀 기울이는 건 어리석은 일이에요. 그를 파괴해야 해요, 빨리."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "I am not heeding the voice. He is simply telling me things I already knew. I can no longer assist you in this endeavor."
Text: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "목소리에 귀 기울이는 게 아니에요. 이미 알고 있던 걸 말해주고 있을 뿐이에요. 더 이상 이 일을 도울 수 없어요."

TextEng: "I will leave you... leave here... and try to find a place where I can use my powers to improve people's lives, rather than destroy them!"
Text: "떠나겠어요... 여기를 떠나서... 힘을 파괴하는 대신 사람들의 삶을 개선하는 데 쓸 수 있는 곳을 찾아볼 거예요!"

TextEng: "As if I would fall trembling to your threats! I have faced foes more fearsome than you! I leave you here, coward!"
Text: "협박에 벌벌 떨 줄 알았어요! 당신보다 무서운 적도 상대해 봤어요! 여기서 떠나요, 비겁한 자!"

TextEng: "Is it possible? Have you actually learned something about honor, that you would let me go when you need me the most?"
Text: "설마? 가장 필요할 때 저를 보내주다니, 명예에 대해 뭔가 배운 건가요?"

TextEng: "It is too late for such pleas! I am no longer yours to command. I leave you here."
Text: "너무 늦었어요! 더 이상 당신의 명령을 받지 않아요. 여기서 떠나겠어요."

TextEng: "I thought your mind was strong, lass. The Masked Man's voice speaks to me too, but he is easy to resist. He is our enemy. Don't let him weaken you."
Text: "당신의 정신은 강한 줄 알았는데요. 가면 남자의 목소리가 저에게도 들리지만, 쉽게 저항할 수 있어요. 그는 적이에요. 약해지게 하지 마세요."

TextEng: "<FirstName> has many flaws, Jaboli. If you leave now, how can we ever teach <him/her> the path <he/she> must follow?"
Text: "<FirstName>에게는 결점이 많아요, 자볼리. 지금 떠나면, 어떻게 <him/her>에게 가야 할 길을 알려줄 수 있겠어요?"

TextEng: "And how would you have me behave now?"
Text: "어떻게 행동하면 되겠어요?"

TextEng: "Trip can hear the Masked Man's voice too, Jaboli. He tries to trick your mind! You must fight him!"
Text: "트립도 가면 남자의 목소리가 들려요, 자볼리. 정신을 속이려는 거예요! 싸워야 해요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "The voice is... is our enemy, the Masked Man. He is preying on my fears. But what I have stated is still the truth. You are not to be trusted! Still, I must finish this enemy."
Text: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "그 목소리는... 적인 가면 남자예요. 제 두려움을 이용하고 있어요. 하지만 제가 말한 건 여전히 사실이에요. 당신은 믿을 수 없어요! 그래도, 이 적을 끝내야 해요."

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>! I worry so much about you and the path you have chosen. But I shall stay by your side, at least until the Masked Man is truly dead and the people of the keep are safe."
Text: "아, <FirstName>! 당신과 당신이 선택한 길이 너무 걱정돼요. 하지만 적어도 가면 남자가 정말로 죽고 거점 사람들이 안전해질 때까지는 곁에 있겠어요."

TextEng: "Let us go, and teach this creature a lesson. Our purpose is set. Let none cross us now!"
Text: "갑시다, 이 존재에게 한 수 가르쳐 줘요. 목적은 정해졌어요. 아무도 우리를 막지 못해요!"

TextEng: "Once again I am beholden to you and your magic weapon for my life. I worry what the final cost might entail... Shall we be on our way again?"
Text: "또다시 당신과 마법 무기 덕에 목숨을 건졌네요. 최종적인 대가가 뭘지 걱정돼요... 다시 출발할까요?"

TextEng: "I shall watch your back for you. I fear our enemy has spies everywhere."
Text: "등을 지켜줄게요. 적의 첩자가 곳곳에 있을 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Be careful. I fear our enemy might have spies everywhere we go. You should have someone watching your back."
Text: "조심하세요. 적의 첩자가 우리가 가는 곳마다 있을 것 같아요. 누군가 등을 봐줘야 해요."

TextEng: "I am afraid my services have already been reserved. Please leave me be."
Text: "죄송하지만 이미 예약된 몸이에요. 가만히 놔두세요."

TextEng: "We must never give up... never give in... never be less than the best we can be."
Text: "절대 포기하지 말아요... 절대 굴복하지 말아요... 최선을 다하지 않는 자가 되지 말아요."

TextEng: "Trip, why are you shaking so? Is something wrong?"
Text: "트립, 왜 그렇게 떨어요? 무슨 일이에요?"

TextEng: "Why would you want to bring a wizard along in your group if you do not want them to cast spells. This is utter foolishness."
Text: "마법사를 데려오면서 왜 주문을 시전하지 말라는 건가요. 완전히 어리석은 짓이에요."

TextEng: "Trip was just remembering what it was like being dead. I don't like dying much."
Text: "트립은 죽었을 때가 어땠는지 떠올리고 있었어요. 트립은 죽는 거 싫어요."

TextEng: "Nobody likes dying much. It's not as if it is a whole lot of fun."
Text: "죽는 걸 좋아하는 사람은 없어요. 즐거운 일이 아니잖아요."

TextEng: "Trip knows that, it is just that Trip is so used to hiding in the shadows and feeling safe there, but when I died the shadows frightened me."
Text: "트립도 알아요, 그런데 트립은 그림자에 숨어서 안전하게 느끼는 데 익숙한데, 죽었을 때 그림자가 무서웠어요."

TextEng: "You were familiar with something and now it frightens you. This has translated into a fear of shadows in life too?"
Text: "익숙한 것이 이제 두렵게 된 거군요. 그게 현실에서도 그림자에 대한 공포로 이어진 건가요?"

TextEng: "You are so smart Jaboli! That is exactly it. How can Trip make it better?"
Text: "자볼리 정말 똑똑해요! 바로 그거예요. 트립은 어떻게 하면 나아질까요?"

TextEng: "How should I know? I discerned the problem; that doesn't mean I know how to solve it."
Text: "제가 어떻게 알아요? 문제를 알아낸 거지, 해결법까지 안다는 건 아니에요."

TextEng: "But... but... you are the smartest one. There must be some way for Trip to feel safe in the shadows again!"
Text: "하... 하지만... 자볼리가 제일 똑똒잖아요. 트립이 다시 그림자에서 안전하게 느낄 방법이 있을 거예요!"

TextEng: "Uh, sure you are, <master/mistress>, but... um... Trip did not want to bother you with petty problems. That why I went to Jaboli... yes, that's why!"
Text: "어, 물론이에요, <master/mistress>. 하지만... 음... 트립은 사소한 문제로 귀찮게 하고 싶지 않았어요. 그래서 자볼리에게 간 거예요... 네, 그래서요!"
