TextEng: "Poor Trip. I do not mean to be such a coward, <master/mistress>. Maybe when you died everything was bright and cheery?"
Text: "불쌍한 트립. 이렇게 겁쟁이가 되려는 건 아니에요, <master/mistress>. 어쩌면 당신이 죽었을 때는 모든 게 밝고 즐거웠나요?"

TextEng: "I guess I can try to think of something. Hmm, you like dirt, right?"
Text: "뭔가 생각해 볼게요. 음, 흙 좋아하죠?"

TextEng: "It would be foolish of me not to cast combat spells. I am tough in a fight, but not as powerful as a well timed spell."
Text: "전투 주문을 안 쓰는 건 어리석은 짓이에요. 싸움에서 강하긴 하지만, 적절한 타이밍의 주문만큼 강하진 않아요."

TextEng: "Yes, dirt is very nice. Trip likes to take his food and rub it in the dirt real good and then chew the dirt with its gritty, yummy taste."
Text: "네, 흙은 아주 좋아요. 트립은 음식을 흙에 비벼서 바삭바삭한 맛을 느끼면서 씹는 걸 좋아해요."

TextEng: "So imagine that the shadows are just dirt that you can hide in. Like you are rolling in the dirty light."
Text: "그럼 그림자가 숨을 수 있는 흙이라고 상상해 봐요. 더러운 빛 속에서 뒹구는 것처럼요."

TextEng: "You mean like a corpse hides in the dirty ground?"
Text: "시체가 더러운 땅에 숨는 것처럼요?"

TextEng: "No, that's not what I'm mean..."
Text: "아니, 그런 뜻이 아니라..."

TextEng: "That is genius! Trip is in awe of Jaboli. I love finding corpses in the ground, like some really tricky game of hide and seek! Now Trip can play it too."
Text: "천재예요! 트립은 자볼리에게 경탄해요. 트립은 땅에서 시체 찾는 거 좋아해요, 아주 기발한 숨바꼭질 같아서! 이제 트립도 할 수 있겠어요."

TextEng: "Uh... glad I could help." Jaboli shakes her head in disgust.
Text: "어... 도움이 됐다니 다행이에요." 자볼리가 역겨운 듯 고개를 젓습니다.

TextEng: "Dirty light! Genius!"
Text: "더러운 빛! 천재!"

TextEng: "Now where is that... I thought I had it right here? It must be... TRIP, GET OVER HERE RIGHT NOW AND GIVE IT BACK!"
Text: "어디 갔지... 여기 있었는데? 분명... 트립, 당장 이리 와서 돌려줘!"

TextEng: "What are you yowling about, Jaboli? What did Trip do wrong?"
Text: "뭘 야옹야옹대는 거예요, 자볼리? 트립이 뭘 잘못했어요?"

TextEng: "You know what you did, now give it back!"
Text: "뭘 했는지 알잖아요, 당장 돌려줘요!"

TextEng: "That is a plan I can heartily agree with."
Text: "진심으로 동의할 수 있는 계획이에요."

TextEng: "Trip has no idea what you are talking about. Trip would never steal something from a friend."
Text: "트립은 무슨 말인지 전혀 몰라요. 트립은 절대 친구 물건을 훔치지 않아요."

TextEng: "If I have to ask you one more time, you will be on tonight's menu."
Text: "한 번만 더 말하게 하면, 오늘 밤 식사 메뉴가 될 줄 알아요."

TextEng: "Oh, ha, ha, you mean this little thing? I thought you had thrown it away. I didn't want you to litter so I picked it up."
Text: "아, 하하, 이 작은 거 말하는 거예요? 버린 줄 알았어요. 쓰레기 버리면 안 되니까 주웠어요."

TextEng: "Don't you ever touch my things again!"
Text: "다시는 제 물건에 손대지 마세요!"

TextEng: "Of course not, Jaboli. Trip is sorry."
Text: "물론이에요, 자볼리. 트립이 잘못했어요."

TextEng: "I guess I can overlook it this time."
Text: "이번은 봐줄게요."

TextEng: "Jaboli? Would you really eat Trip?"
Text: "자볼리? 진짜로 트립을 잡아먹을 거예요?"

TextEng: "You're a little scrawny, but with some fattening up, you might taste all right." Jaboli eyes him slowly.
Text: "좀 야위긴 했지만, 살 좀 찌우면 맛있을지도 몰라요." 자볼리가 그를 천천히 훑어봅니다.

TextEng: "Eek!"
Text: "으악!"

TextEng: "I have been thinking, Kaidala. There is little reason for us to fight. We can both work together and we both want different things out of life. We should try to get along."
Text: "생각해 봤는데요, 카이달라. 우리가 싸울 이유가 별로 없어요. 둘 다 협력할 수 있고 원하는 것도 다르니까요. 잘 지내 봐요."

TextEng: "I see we have found the dregs of society."
Text: "사회의 밑바닥을 찾은 것 같군요."

TextEng: "I do not think I shall be of much assistance there."
Text: "거기서는 큰 도움이 안 될 것 같아요."

TextEng: "I guess you're right. It's not as if we are in a competition. Actually, I've never really figured out what you want out of life."
Text: "그런 것 같아요. 경쟁 관계도 아니고요. 사실 자볼리가 삶에서 뭘 원하는지 모르겠어요."

TextEng: "That is because you are not as intuitive when it comes to understanding other people's motivations and desires."
Text: "그건 다른 사람의 동기와 욕구를 이해하는 직관력이 부족하기 때문이에요."

TextEng: "Oh, yes, we're going to get along really well, as long as you keep the humility flowing. If you are so good at this, what do you think I want out of life?"
Text: "아, 네, 겸손함만 유지해 주면 정말 잘 지낼 수 있겠네요. 그렇게 잘 아시면, 제가 삶에서 뭘 원하는지 맞춰 봐요."

TextEng: "And here I thought you might actually hand me a challenge. You are too simple to read. You want <FirstName>, of course."
Text: "도전거리를 줄 줄 알았는데. 너무 단순해서 읽기 쉬워요. <FirstName>을 원하는 거잖아요, 당연히."

TextEng: "Don't... don't be ridiculous. That's... that's impossible. Why... why would you say such a thing?"
Text: "그... 말도 안 돼요. 그건... 불가능해요. 왜... 왜 그런 말을 하는 거예요?"

TextEng: "You can try to hold your emotions in however you want, but they are there in every glance, in every touch, in every moment you share with <him/her>."
Text: "감정을 숨기려 해도, 모든 시선에, 모든 접촉에, 함께하는 모든 순간에 드러나 있어요."

TextEng: "You don't know what you are talking about!"
Text: "무슨 소리 하는지 모르겠어요!"

TextEng: "That is fine. You keep yourself in a state of denial. As long as you have something to be passionate about, perhaps you won't whine about seeking death so much."
Text: "좋아요. 부정 속에 살아요. 열정을 가질 대상이 있으면, 죽고 싶다는 투정은 좀 줄겠죠."

TextEng: "Why don't you just shut up?"
Text: "입 좀 다물어요!"

TextEng: "I guess we won't be getting along so well after all."
Text: "잘 지내기는 어려울 것 같네요."

TextEng: "As you wish."
Text: "알겠어요."

TextEng: "I guess not."
Text: "그런 것 같네요."

TextEng: Kaidala blushes. "Oh... I guess I have been a little obvious about that. But there are other things I want out of life. Why don't you name a few?"
Text: 카이달라가 얼굴을 붉힙니다. "아... 좀 티가 났나 봐요. 하지만 다른 것도 원해요. 몇 가지 맞춰 봐요."

TextEng: "All of your ambitions in life are now focused around <FirstName>. Even your dream of going back and restoring your forest is permeated with visions of you and <him/her>. It is rather pathetic."
Text: "삶의 모든 야망이 <FirstName>을 중심으로 돌아가요. 숲을 되찾겠다는 꿈조차 당신과 <him/her>의 환상으로 가득하죠. 좀 한심해요."

TextEng: "Pathetic? Because I want to live in my home with the one I love? Some people would call it romantic. People with real emotions!"
Text: "한심하다고요? 사랑하는 사람과 집에서 살고 싶어서? 어떤 사람들은 그걸 낭만적이라고 해요. 진짜 감정이 있는 사람들이요!"

TextEng: "It is pathetic that your every dream would collapse and you would lose your entire will to live if <he/she> died. What <FirstName> really needs is someone strong and independent."
Text: "<he/she>가 죽으면 모든 꿈이 무너지고 살 의지를 완전히 잃는다는 게 한심한 거예요. <FirstName>에게 정말 필요한 건 강하고 독립적인 사람이에요."

TextEng: "Do you think that when <he/she> is trying to rule an empire, that there will be time for <him/her> to cater to your every need? You need to grow some backbone, child."
Text: "<he/she>가 제국을 다스리려 할 때, 당신의 모든 필요를 챙겨줄 시간이 있을 것 같아요? 좀 더 강인해져요, 애야."

TextEng: "Are you suggesting that <FirstName> would be better off with you?"
Text: "<FirstName>이 자볼리와 함께하는 게 낫다는 건가요?"

TextEng: "No!"
Text: "아니요!"

TextEng: "This is our fight. Don't get in the way."
Text: "우리 둘의 싸움이에요. 끼어들지 마세요."

TextEng: "I have no interest in such things. But, yes, <he/she> would be better off with someone like me, who can think independently and survive without constant attention."
Text: "그런 건 관심 없어요. 하지만 네, <he/she>는 독립적으로 생각하고 끊임없는 관심 없이 살 수 있는 사람과 함께하는 게 나을 거예요."

TextEng: "I will move as silently as I know how."
Text: "제가 아는 한 가장 조용히 움직이겠어요."

TextEng: "Ha! I have no interest in such things. But, yes, <he/she> would be better off with someone like me, who can think independently and survive without constant attention."
Text: "하! 그런 건 관심 없어요. 하지만 네, <he/she>는 독립적으로 생각하고 끊임없는 관심 없이 살 수 있는 사람과 함께하는 게 나을 거예요."

TextEng: "I can do just fine without constant attention. Besides, two rulers are better than one. I will be there to support <him/her>, as <his/her> friend, if nothing else."
Text: "끊임없는 관심 없이도 잘 지낼 수 있어요. 게다가 통치자가 둘이면 하나보다 나아요. 친구로서라도 <him/her>를 곁에서 돕겠어요."

TextEng: "What a valuable resource to have sitting by your side. An emotionally crippled nymph."
Text: "곁에 두기에 정말 귀중한 자원이네요. 감정적으로 불구인 님프라니."

TextEng: "Kaidala, I wish to speak to you about something, but it is a delicate subject. I fear you are going to feel insulted."
Text: "카이달라, 할 말이 있는데 민감한 주제예요. 기분 나쁠 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Go ahead, Jaboli. I doubt you could say anything bad about me that I haven't already thought about myself."
Text: "말해요, 자볼리. 제가 이미 생각해 보지 않은 나쁜 말은 없을 거예요."

TextEng: "You don't know my people very well. We can insult people as quickly as we can say hello. But what I have to say... it is a request."
Text: "우리 종족을 잘 모르나 봐요. 인사하는 것만큼 빨리 모욕할 수 있어요. 하지만 할 말은... 부탁이에요."

TextEng: "Spit it out or hold it to yourself. Just make up your mind."
Text: "말하든지 삼키든지. 빨리 결정해요."

TextEng: "It is just that I grow tired of your wallowing in self-pity. Yes, you have lost some of your physical beauty. Yes, you have been scarred by your past. But get over it! Get on with life!"
Text: "자기연민에 빠져 허우적대는 게 지겨워요. 네, 미모를 일부 잃었어요. 네, 과거에 상처받았어요. 하지만 이겨내요! 삶을 살아요!"

TextEng: "What?!? You have no idea what I feel like! How dare you judge my attitude and my actions? You are so confident about everything, you obviously don't know what real pain is like!"
Text: "뭐라고?! 제 기분이 어떤지 모르잖아요! 감히 제 태도와 행동을 판단해요? 모든 것에 자신만만하니까, 진짜 고통이 뭔지 모르는 거죠!"

TextEng: "I don't know pain? My own people despise me! I was stripped of my most powerful magic, of my wealth and privilege, of my true love, and sent here to begin everything again!"
Text: "고통을 모른다고요? 내 동족이 나를 경멸해요! 가장 강력한 마법과 재산과 특권과 진정한 사랑을 빼앗기고, 여기서 다시 시작하라고 보내졌어요!"

TextEng: "I shall do as you say. I was not very good at it anyway."
Text: "말씀대로 하겠어요. 어차피 잘하지도 못했으니까요."

TextEng: "I face suspicious looks and outright hatred by the people of this world and I desperately miss... it doesn't matter."
Text: "이 세계 사람들의 의심과 노골적인 증오를 받으면서, 절실히 그리워하는... 상관없어요."

TextEng: "My point is that we have both suffered tragedy, yet you seem so trapped inside your pain that you don't see all that is good in your life."
Text: "말하고 싶은 건, 우리 둘 다 비극을 겪었지만, 당신은 고통에 갇혀서 삶의 좋은 면을 못 보고 있다는 거예요."

TextEng: The women glare at you, then at each other. Finally, they drop their gaze and ignore each other.
Text: 두 여인이 당신을 노려보고, 서로를 노려본 다음, 마침내 시선을 내리고 서로를 무시합니다.

TextEng: "What have I done to face your scorn, Jaboli? I still fight to help you. Even as the pain in my face still scorches me, I struggle on. If I am a little depressed, have I not earned it?"
Text: "왜 비난하는 거예요, 자볼리? 아직도 당신을 도우려고 싸우고 있잖아요. 얼굴의 고통이 아직 저를 태우는 데도 악전고투하고 있어요. 좀 우울하면, 그럴 자격 없나요?"

TextEng: "You take her side in this? What have I done to face such scorn? I still fight to help you. Even as the pain in my face still scorches me, I struggle on. If I am a little depressed, have I not earned it?"
Text: "카이달라 편을 드는 거예요? 왜 비난하는 거예요? 아직도 당신을 도우려고 싸우고 있잖아요. 얼굴의 고통이 아직 저를 태우는 데도 악전고투하고 있어요. 좀 우울하면, 그럴 자격 없나요?"

TextEng: "We have both earned the right to give up and just lay down and die. I don't ask you to forget the pain that you suffer, merely to learn to cope with it without... whining so much."
Text: "우리 둘 다 포기하고 누워서 죽을 권리가 있어요. 고통을 잊으라는 게 아니에요, 그저 투덜거리지 않고 감당하는 법을 배우라는 거예요."

TextEng: "Whining?!?"
"And if you could stop with the shrill shrieking too, that would be good."
Text: "날카로운 비명도 좀 그만두면 좋겠어요."

TextEng: Kaidala stares at Jaboli furiously, but refuses to make any retort.
Text: 카이달라가 자볼리를 분노에 차서 바라보지만, 반박을 거부합니다.

TextEng: "See. That's already an improvement." Jaboli smiles wickedly and turns away from Kaidala.
Text: "봐요. 벌써 나아졌잖아요." 자볼리가 사악하게 미소 짓고 카이달라에게서 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "Though it is not my specialty, I will do what I can."
Text: "전문은 아니지만, 할 수 있는 건 하겠어요."

TextEng: "Calibast, you seemed to have a rough dream last time we rested. Would you care to talk about it?"
Text: "캘리바스트, 지난번 쉴 때 거친 꿈을 꾼 것 같던데요. 이야기하고 싶어요?"

TextEng: "Was I that restless?"
Text: "그렇게 뒤척였소?"

TextEng: "You woke me out of a dead sleep. I could hardly focus on memorizing my spells the next day."
Text: "깊이 잠든 저를 깨웠어요. 다음 날 주문 암기에 집중하기 어려웠다고요."

TextEng: "Sorry about that, lass. It was a strange dream. I had killed a man and was fleeing from justice. I had a really good reason for killing him, but whenever I went to tell my side of the story, I froze up."
Text: "미안하오, 아가씨. 이상한 꿈이었소. 사람을 죽이고 사법 당국에서 도망치고 있었는데, 내 쪽 이야기를 하려고 하면 얼어붙었소."

TextEng: "That is a disturbing dream. Does it mean anything to you? Maybe something from your past?"
Text: "불안한 꿈이네요. 무슨 뜻이 있어요? 과거와 관련된 건가요?"

TextEng: "Somedays your discernment is downright chilling, Jaboli. I am thinking it is something from my past. When I was young, my father and I got into an argument."
Text: "때로는 그 눈썰미가 섬뜩할 정도요, 자볼리. 과거와 관련된 것 같소. 어렸을 때 아버지와 말다툼을 했소."

TextEng: "I told him I wished he was dead and stormed off in a rage. He died the next day when an angry slave, an earth elemental, got loose and caught my father off-guard."
Text: "죽었으면 좋겠다고 하고 분노에 차서 뛰쳐나갔소. 다음 날 화난 노예 원소, 대지 원소가 풀려나서 아버지가 방심한 틈에 죽였소."

TextEng: "So you blamed yourself for the accident. You do know it was not your fault, do you not?"
Text: "그래서 사고를 자기 탓으로 돌린 거군요. 당신 잘못이 아닌 거 알고 있죠?"

TextEng: Both of your companions glare at you, then shrug and turn away. "Very well, we should continue."
Text: 두 동료가 당신을 노려본 다음, 어깨를 으쓱하고 돌아섭니다. "좋아요, 계속합시다."

TextEng: "I know that! I didn't say it was. I just thought it might be connected to my dream."
Text: "그건 아오! 그렇다고 안 했소. 그냥 꿈과 연결될 수 있을 것 같았을 뿐이오."

TextEng: "As you wish. How far would you have me stand?"
Text: "알겠어요. 얼마나 멀리 서 있을까요?"

TextEng: "There was something else that helped you make that connection, perhaps?"
Text: "그 연결을 짓게 한 다른 것이 있나요?"

TextEng: "Just before I awoke, I was attacked by a large earth elemental. The thing laughed at me and said 'I killed your father for you, just like you wanted. Now it's time for you to pay up.' I figure that says it all."
Text: "깨기 직전에 거대한 대지 원소에게 공격받았소. 그놈이 비웃으며 '네가 원한 대로 아버지를 죽여줬다. 이제 대가를 치를 때다'라고 했소. 그게 다 말해주는 것 같소."

TextEng: "That is... unusual. I would say that your guilt is not resolved yet. You need to deal with it soon though. These inner torments could be the cause for your erratic behavior towards yourself."
Text: "그건... 특이하네요. 아직 죄책감이 해소되지 않은 것 같아요. 곧 다뤄야 해요. 이런 내면의 갈등이 자해적인 행동의 원인일 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Don't hurt your brain or anything. It was just a dream. I have plenty to feel guilty about. My father is a long, distant hurt."
Text: "머리 아프게 하지 마시오. 그냥 꿈이오. 죄책감을 느낄 일은 많으니. 아버지 건은 오래된 상처요."

TextEng: Calibast gives you a glare, then begins to laugh.
Text: 캘리바스트가 당신을 노려보다가 웃기 시작합니다.

TextEng: "We are both here for you."
Text: "우리 둘 다 당신 편이에요."

TextEng: "All right, enough sentimentality. Let's get some work done. I feel the need to kill something soon. Oh, and... thank you. Both of you."
Text: "좋소, 감상은 이만. 일이나 합시다. 뭔가 죽이고 싶어지는군. 아, 그리고... 고맙소. 둘 다."

TextEng: "<FirstName>, you should know better than that."
Text: "<FirstName>, 그런 말 하면 안 돼요."

TextEng: "No, he is right. There was something else that connects the dream to my past."
Text: "아니오, <he/she> 말이 맞소. 꿈과 과거를 연결하는 다른 것이 있었소."

TextEng: "Calibast? Would you mind if I ask you a question?"
Text: "캘리바스트? 질문 하나 해도 될까요?"

TextEng: "As you have stated, so shall it be done."
Text: "말씀하신 대로 하겠어요."

TextEng: "Of course not, Jaboli. I always have time for a pretty lass. What is on your mind?"
Text: "물론이오, 자볼리. 예쁜 아가씨를 위한 시간은 항상 있소. 무슨 생각을 하는 거요?"

TextEng: "You spend so much time and effort on carousing with women and drinking, yet you do not seem to ever be pleased with yourself after the fact."
Text: "여자들과 어울리고 술 마시는 데 그렇게 시간과 노력을 쏟으면서, 정작 끝나고 나면 자기 자신에게 만족하지 않는 것 같아요."

TextEng: "That's not a question, lass. It's more of an accusation. Besides, are you jealous?"
Text: "그건 질문이 아니라 비난이오, 아가씨. 게다가, 질투하는 거요?"

TextEng: "Hardly jealous and don't try to change the subject. <FirstName>, do you not think the behavior of our companion is odd?"
Text: "질투는 전혀요, 화제를 돌리지 말아요. <FirstName>, 우리 동료의 행동이 이상하다고 생각하지 않아요?"

TextEng: "Sorry, I didn't realize it had gone so far. I saw that you both had feelings for each other, but... well, never mind. Not my business."
Text: "미안, 그 정도인 줄 몰랐어. 둘 다 서로에게 감정이 있는 건 알았지만... 뭐, 내 일이 아니지."

TextEng: "Tame me? What is that supposed to mean... ah, never mind!" It is an unusual sight to see an azer blush.
Text: "길들인다고? 그게 무슨 뜻이오... 아, 됐소!" 에이저가 얼굴을 붉히는 것은 보기 드문 광경입니다.

TextEng: "It doesn't truly bother me one way or another, but it bothers <him/her>. That was my point. Why act in a way that disgusts you so much?"
Text: "제겐 어느 쪽이든 상관없지만, <him/her>에게는 신경 쓰이잖아요. 그게 제 요점이에요. 왜 자기도 역겨운 행동을 계속하는 거예요?"

TextEng: "You see Jaboli, there is nothing odd about my behavior. Besides, I don't have to justify myself to you."
Text: "보시오 자볼리, 내 행동에 이상한 건 없소. 게다가 당신에게 해명할 필요도 없소."

TextEng: "I wasn't asking for justification. I was just wondering why you continue to act that way, when your own behavior disgusts you?"
Text: "해명을 요구한 게 아니에요. 자기 행동이 역겹다면서 왜 계속 그러는지 궁금했을 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "I... I can't... I don't..." He throws his hands up in disgust. "Women!"
Text: "나... 그건... 안 그래..." 그가 역겨운 듯 두 손을 들어올립니다. "여자들이란!"

TextEng: "I will do as you say. I can spot an enemy as quickly as anyone."
Text: "말씀대로 하겠어요. 저도 적을 누구 못지않게 빨리 발견할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "You can avoid the question for now, but someday you will have to face whatever has you so troubled that you fear commitment more than death."
Text: "지금은 질문을 피할 수 있지만, 언젠가는 죽음보다 헌신을 두려워하게 만드는 것과 마주해야 할 거예요."

TextEng: "That is fine, though I think I could discern an enemy as quickly as you could."
Text: "좋아요. 하지만 저도 당신만큼 빨리 적을 알아볼 수 있다고 생각해요."

TextEng: "I would think I am capable of doing so on my own, but if you have suggestions... I can allow that."
Text: "혼자서도 할 수 있을 것 같지만, 제안이 있다면... 받아들이겠어요."

TextEng: "The men guarding this place have lost all hope; a good opportunity for us to gain a reputation, yes?"
Text: "이곳을 지키는 자들은 희망을 잃었어요. 명성을 얻기 좋은 기회가 아닐까요?"

TextEng: "I will use my extensive knowledge to see if I can identify anything you have."
Text: "폭넓은 지식을 활용해서 가지고 있는 물건을 감정해 보겠어요."

TextEng: "I see. What manner of buffing spells would you have me use?"
Text: "알겠어요. 어떤 종류의 강화 주문을 원하세요?"

TextEng: "And what is my target?"
Text: "그래서 내 목표가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "So be it!"
Text: "좋아, 그렇게 하지!"

TextEng: "What shall I cast, then?"
Text: "그러면 무슨 주문을 시전할까요?"

TextEng: "I can do that. Are you certain?"
Text: "할 수 있어요. 확실해요?"

TextEng: "And what is my target?"
Text: "그래서 내 목표가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Was there anything else then, friend?"
Text: "다른 건 없어요, 친구?"

TextEng: "So be it!"
Text: "좋아, 그렇게 하지!"

TextEng: "Oh course, my friend. What can Jaboli bring her wisdom to bear on?"
Text: "물론이에요, 친구. 자볼리의 지혜가 무엇에 필요한가요?"

TextEng: "That man was passing strange, wouldn't you agree?"
Text: "저 사람 정말 이상하지 않았어요?"

TextEng: "Would you like anything else, my friend?"
Text: "다른 건 필요 없어요, 친구?"

TextEng: "I must have slept wrong last time we rested. I can't get my hair to lay down at all."
Text: "지난번 쉴 때 자세가 안 좋았나 봐요. 머리카락이 아무리 해도 눕지 않아요."

TextEng: "Do you want anything else?"
Text: "다른 건요?"

TextEng: "My neck is a little sore. I could use a good massage, but now is not the time for such things."
Text: "목이 좀 뻐근해요. 마사지를 받고 싶지만, 지금은 때가 아니죠."

TextEng: "I was just contemplating the meaning of life. I think I just about had an answer, but now it is gone. Thanks. I'm just kidding, my friend!"
Text: "인생의 의미에 대해 사색하고 있었어요. 거의 답을 찾았는데, 이제 날아가 버렸네요. 고마워요. 농담이에요, 친구!"

TextEng: "I feel like a goddess... I am that wonderful!"
Text: "여신이 된 기분이에요... 그만큼 훌륭하다고요!"

TextEng: "I would be better if we would not get killed again. Do try to watch what you are doing."
Text: "또 죽지만 않으면 더 좋겠어요. 좀 조심해 주세요."

TextEng: "I think I swallowed a morsel that does not agree with me. Wait... <StartAction>[Belch]</Start> ah, that is better."
Text: "뭔가 안 맞는 걸 삼킨 것 같아요. 잠깐... <StartAction>[트림]</Start> 아, 나았어요."

TextEng: "I am not so delicate that I need you to worry about me constantly."
Text: "그렇게 연약하지 않으니 항상 걱정할 필요 없어요."

TextEng: "I can use my other senses to stop from bumping into walls, but it is hard to cast spells at an opponent you cannot see."
Text: "다른 감각으로 벽에 부딪히진 않겠지만, 보이지 않는 적에게 주문을 시전하기는 어려워요."

TextEng: "The difference between wealthy and poor parts of the keep is quickly obvious here."
Text: "거점의 부유한 곳과 가난한 곳의 차이가 여기서 금방 드러나네요."

TextEng: "I have had worse wounds from playful wrestling with my siblings. Do not worry so much about me."
Text: "형제자매와 장난으로 씨름할 때 이보다 더 다쳤어요. 너무 걱정하지 마세요."

TextEng: "I have taken some serious wounds, but I shall live. We might want to rest a bit soon."
Text: "꽤 심한 상처를 입었지만, 살 수 있어요. 곧 잠시 쉬는 게 좋겠어요."

TextEng: "I have been gravely wounded. I request a brief stop soon, that I might recover from these injuries."
Text: "중상을 입었어요. 이 부상에서 회복할 수 있도록 곧 잠시 멈춰주세요."

TextEng: "I can feel a poison flowing through my veins. We need to find an antidote before it cripples me."
Text: "혈관으로 독이 퍼지는 게 느껴져요. 몸이 마비되기 전에 해독제를 찾아야 해요."

TextEng: "I seem to have contracted some kind of disease. I will survive for a while, but we should seek a cure as soon as we can."
Text: "무슨 병에 걸린 것 같아요. 한동안은 버틸 수 있겠지만, 빨리 치료법을 찾아야 해요."

TextEng: "I would stay and advise you, if you would be interested in listening to my advice. I have always wanted to be involved in politics, without being the leader."
Text: "남아서 조언을 해 드릴게요, 제 조언에 귀를 기울이신다면요. 지도자가 되지 않고 정치에 관여하는 것이 항상 꿈이었어요."

TextEng: "I have no real plans. I might go out on my own and see what the world has to offer me. Who knows, maybe someone will want me to become their advisor."
Text: "특별한 계획은 없어요. 혼자 나가서 세상이 제게 뭘 줄 수 있는지 보겠어요. 누군가 저를 참모로 삼고 싶어할지도 모르죠."

TextEng: "It is also possible that you will somehow still achieve your dream and become the ruler of the keep, though I know not how. Somehow, this just doesn't feel like it is over."
Text: "어떻게 될지는 모르지만, 당신이 꿈을 이루어 거점의 통치자가 될 가능성도 있어요. 왠지 이게 끝이 아닌 것 같아요."

TextEng: "I have no real plans. I might go out on my own and see what the world has to offer me. Who knows? Maybe someone will want me to become their advisor."
Text: "특별한 계획은 없어요. 혼자 나가서 세상이 제게 뭘 줄 수 있는지 보겠어요. 누군가 저를 참모로 삼고 싶어할지도 모르죠."

TextEng: "The truth is, I have no idea. I thought you would make a good leader, yet recent events have shown me otherwise. I am sorry. I do hope you can achieve your dreams, but I do not think I will be a part of them."
Text: "솔직히 모르겠어요. 당신이 좋은 지도자가 될 거라 생각했는데, 최근 일들이 그렇지 않다는 걸 보여줬어요. 유감이에요."

TextEng: "Secret passages in our home! It is like playing some elaborate game, yes?"
Text: "우리 집에 비밀 통로라니! 정교한 게임을 하는 것 같지 않아요?"

TextEng: "I would stay with you, if you would have me. Perhaps, if you win the election, you could make me your Banner. I have always wanted to be involved in politics, without being the leader."
Text: "원하신다면 곁에 남겠어요. 선거에서 이기면 저를 기수(旗手)로 삼아주세요. 지도자가 되지 않고 정치에 관여하는 것이 항상 꿈이었거든요."

TextEng: "I want to see what a good leader with good advisors can accomplish. I think it is possible that you could usher in a new era of growth and peace for these lands, given enough time and resources."
Text: "좋은 지도자와 좋은 참모가 무엇을 이룰 수 있는지 보고 싶어요. 충분한 시간과 자원이 있다면, 이 땅에 성장과 평화의 새 시대를 열 수 있다고 생각해요."

TextEng: "I would also be good at the role of judge for your people, I think. It is something that holds great interest for me. As your Banner, I could serve such a function."
Text: "백성을 위한 재판관 역할도 잘할 수 있을 거예요. 매우 관심 있는 일이에요. 기수로서 그런 역할을 할 수 있겠죠."

TextEng: "If you die and do not return to life? I would leave here. I do not care for leadership myself and I know no one who would make a better leader than you."
Text: "당신이 죽고 부활하지 못한다면? 저는 떠나겠어요. 지도자가 되는 것에는 관심이 없고, 당신보다 더 나은 지도자가 될 사람도 모르니까요."

TextEng: "You have a confidence that makes people trust you. You are not evil. Your motives are not always apparent, but you have proven you can hold your own, even in difficult situations."
Text: "사람들이 신뢰하게 만드는 자신감이 있어요. 악하지 않아요. 동기가 항상 뚜렷하진 않지만, 어려운 상황에서도 해낼 수 있다는 걸 증명했어요."

TextEng: "I did not like the way you treated the Gelani/Thaddeus situation, but everyone makes mistakes. I know in your heart you are not evil. And you are undeniably capable of accomplishing your goals."
Text: "젤라니/태디어스 건을 처리한 방식은 마음에 안 들었지만, 누구나 실수는 해요. 마음속으로는 악하지 않다는 걸 알아요. 그리고 목표를 달성하는 능력은 부정할 수 없죠."

TextEng: "The way you handled Feran and Ellysia was like a poet who carefully chooses which words to use and which to discard to gain the greatest beauty."
Text: "페란과 엘리시아 건을 처리한 방식은 마치 가장 큰 아름다움을 위해 어떤 단어를 쓰고 버릴지 신중히 선택하는 시인 같았어요."

TextEng: "That alone was enough to show me that you have the true heart of a good leader."
Text: "그것만으로도 진정한 좋은 지도자의 마음을 가지고 있다는 걸 보여줬어요."

TextEng: "Politics is entirely about motivation and discernment. I should think that by now you would realize that these are exactly the skills that I have."
Text: "정치란 전적으로 동기 부여와 분별에 관한 것이에요. 지금쯤이면 그것이 정확히 제가 가진 능력이라는 걸 알아차렸을 텐데요."

TextEng: "If you are willing to trust me and listen to my advice, most of the time, then yes, I will do my best to help you become one of the best rulers this world has ever known."
Text: "저를 믿고 대부분의 경우 제 조언에 귀를 기울인다면, 이 세상이 본 적 없는 최고의 통치자가 되도록 최선을 다해 돕겠어요."

TextEng: "I see Alias and the old woman. We should speak to this Momma Dane, since she is such an ardent supporter."
Text: "앨리어스와 그 할머니가 보여요. 열렬한 지지자인 마마 데인과 이야기해 봐야 해요."

TextEng: "I already think you would be a good ruler, or I would not have made such an offer. Still, I think any good ruler knows that they need to surround themselves with people who will give good advice."
Text: "이미 좋은 통치자가 될 거라고 생각했으니 제안한 거예요. 하지만 좋은 통치자라면 좋은 조언을 해줄 사람들로 둘러싸여야 한다는 걸 알 거예요."

TextEng: "I would not have made the suggestion, if I did not want to know."
Text: "알고 싶지 않았다면 제안하지 않았을 거예요."

TextEng: "I would not expect you to do so. A good ruler has advisors to advise <him/her>, not to make <his/her> decisions. I advise, you listen, then decide for yourself. That is wise discernment."
Text: "그러리라 기대하지 않아요. 좋은 통치자에게는 결정을 내려주는 게 아니라 조언하는 참모가 있는 거예요. 저는 조언하고, 당신은 듣고, 스스로 결정해요. 그것이 현명한 분별이에요."

TextEng: "I am pleased to hear you say so. For a non-rakshasa you have amazing discernment."
Text: "그 말을 들으니 기뻐요. 락샤사가 아닌 이로서는 놀라운 분별력이에요."

TextEng: "I would not have expected such from you, but it is true. I never expected such a meeting of the minds in this realm... what a strange thing."
Text: "당신에게 그런 면이 있을 줄은 몰랐는데, 사실이군요. 이 세계에서 이런 정신적 교감을 기대하지 못했어요... 참 이상한 일이에요."

TextEng: "You have proven this time and time again. I never expected such a meeting of the minds in this realm... what a strange thing."
Text: "몇 번이고 증명해 보였죠. 이 세계에서 이런 정신적 교감을 기대하지 못했어요... 참 이상한 일이에요."

TextEng: "That is what I feared. So be it, I shall find something else to do when this is over. Perhaps I might travel to some place far from here. A journey by ship over the eastern sea might be pleasant."
Text: "그런 줄 알았어요. 좋아요, 이게 끝나면 다른 할 일을 찾겠어요. 먼 곳으로 여행을 떠날지도 몰라요. 동쪽 바다를 건너는 뱃길도 나쁘지 않겠어요."

TextEng: "I do not know what has made you so hostile, but I do not like it. Perhaps you would prefer that I leave right now? You can finish this on your own."
Text: "왜 그렇게 적대적인지 모르겠지만, 마음에 안 들어요. 지금 당장 제가 떠나는 게 나을까요? 혼자 끝내도 되잖아요."

TextEng: Jaboli snarls, then stalks off.
Text: 자볼리가 으르렁거리더니 뚜벅뚜벅 걸어갑니다.

TextEng: "If you want to be treated with respect, then treat others with respect. Your mocking of me cannot be tolerated for long. Do better, or I shall leave you to do this on your own."
Text: "존중받고 싶으면 남도 존중하세요. 저를 조롱하는 건 오래 참을 수 없어요. 나아지지 않으면 혼자 하도록 놔두겠어요."

TextEng: "I do not care for that bard's first song, but his second one was quite interesting."
Text: "저 음유시인의 첫 번째 노래는 별로였지만, 두 번째는 꽤 흥미로웠어요."

TextEng: "There is more to this world than your foolish scholars and priests know. Just because no one has ever returned successfully from such a voyage does not mean it cannot be done."
Text: "당신들의 어리석은 학자와 사제가 아는 것보다 세상은 넓어요. 그 항해에서 무사히 돌아온 사람이 없다고 해서 불가능한 건 아니에요."

TextEng: "We should get going again. There is much to be done."
Text: "다시 출발합시다. 할 일이 많아요."

TextEng: "When my people banished me, I was told in no uncertain terms that to return would mean death. No, I do not foresee a time when I am eager to see others of my kind again."
Text: "우리 종족이 저를 추방할 때, 돌아오면 죽음뿐이라고 분명히 말했어요. 아니요, 다시 동족을 만나고 싶은 날이 올 것 같지 않아요."

TextEng: She shrugs. "I suppose." She sighs in painful reminiscence and turns away.
Text: 그녀가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "글쎄요." 고통스러운 추억에 한숨을 쉬며 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "I didn't think of it as a rebellion. Not at first, though that is certainly where it led."
Text: "반란이라고 생각하지 않았어요. 처음에는요. 결국 거기에 이르렀지만요."

TextEng: "Yes. I killed many of my own kind."
Text: "네. 동족을 많이 죽였어요."

TextEng: "It started innocently enough. I simply began to talk to other young, wealthy rakshasa. I would feel out which ones might be sympathetic to my point of view and get them to attend meetings."
Text: "순수하게 시작했어요. 그냥 다른 젊고 부유한 락샤사들과 이야기를 나누기 시작했어요. 제 관점에 공감할 만한 이들을 알아보고 모임에 초대했죠."

TextEng: "It started innocently enough. I simply began to talk to other young, wealthy rakshasa. I would feel out which ones might be sympathetic to my point of view and get them to attend meetings."
Text: "순수하게 시작했어요. 그냥 다른 젊고 부유한 락샤사들과 이야기를 나누기 시작했어요. 제 관점에 공감할 만한 이들을 알아보고 모임에 초대했죠."

TextEng: "We weren't doing anything wrong, but our ideas were subversive. One night we had about thirty rakshasa and a hundred slaves."
Text: "잘못된 건 아니었지만, 사상이 전복적이었어요. 어느 날 밤 락샤사 삼십 명과 노예 백 명이 모였어요."

TextEng: "It is a lot of rakshasa, but slaves are very numerous in our home. It was the inclusion of the slaves that began the slaughter though. That was my first mistake."
Text: "락샤사로서는 많은 수지만, 우리 고향에서 노예는 매우 많아요. 하지만 노예를 포함시킨 것이 학살의 시작이었어요. 그것이 제 첫 번째 실수였죠."

TextEng: "Not yet. I will come back for you."
Text: "아직이야. 다시 올게."

Text: "지금은 다른 걸 바꾸고 싶지 않아."

Text: "내 사역마에게 시전해."

Text: "나에게 시전해."

Text: "네 자신에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I want you to go ahead and cast spells on your own."
Text: "알아서 주문을 써도 좋아."

TextEng: "Bless."
Text: "축복."

TextEng: "Animate Dead."
Text: "시체 조종."

TextEng: "Aid."
Text: "지원."

TextEng: "What was it you wanted to say earlier?"
Text: "아까 하려던 말이 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "Let's stop and talk a moment."
Text: "잠깐 멈추고 이야기하자."

TextEng: "We're done talking."
Text: "이야기는 끝이야."

TextEng: "No, nothing else."
Text: "아니, 다른 건 없어."

TextEng: "How is everything?"
Text: "다 잘 지내?"

TextEng: "I want you to leave any traps that you see alone."
Text: "보이는 함정은 그냥 놔둬."

TextEng: "Do you have plans for what you're going to do after all this?"
Text: "이 모든 게 끝나면 뭘 할 계획이 있어?"

TextEng: "Why would you want to assist me?"
Text: "왜 나를 도우려는 거야?"

TextEng: "What will you do if I die right away?"
Text: "내가 바로 죽으면 어쩔 건데?"

TextEng: "No one?"
Text: "아무도?"

TextEng: "What would you have to offer a ruler?"
Text: "통치자에게 줄 수 있는 게 뭔데?"

TextEng: "You would help me be a good ruler?"
Text: "내가 좋은 통치자가 되도록 도와준다고?"

TextEng: "Do you want to know what I think?"
Text: "내 생각을 알고 싶어?"

TextEng: "I suppose I could listen to your advice, but I don't promise to always follow it."
Text: "조언을 듣긴 하겠지만, 항상 따르겠다고는 약속 못 해."

TextEng: "I will take you up on that offer. I think you would be marvelous."
Text: "좋아, 받아들이지. 훌륭할 것 같아."

TextEng: "I want you to disarm any traps that you see."
Text: "보이는 함정은 전부 해제해 줘."

TextEng: "I do not think I could take advice from you."
Text: "너한테 조언을 받을 수 있을 것 같지 않아."

TextEng: "I don't care. So long as you stay away from me."
Text: "상관없어. 나한테서 멀리 떨어져 있기만 해."

TextEng: "Go ahead. Leave. I don't really care."
Text: "가. 떠나. 난 별로 신경 안 써."

TextEng: "Don't leave yet. There are innocent lives at stake."
Text: "아직 떠나지 마. 무고한 생명이 걸려 있어."

TextEng: "I was only joking, sorry."
Text: "농담이었어, 미안."

TextEng: "That is a dangerous journey. No one has ever survived it."
Text: "위험한 여정이야. 아무도 살아 돌아온 적이 없어."

TextEng: "Everybody knows if you sail east you'll fall off the edge of the world."
Text: "동쪽으로 항해하면 세계의 끝에서 떨어진다는 건 다 알잖아."

TextEng: "Yes. Please follow me."
Text: "그래. 따라와."

TextEng: "Do you ever think you shall return home?"
Text: "고향에 돌아갈 수 있을 거라고 생각해?"

TextEng: "That's all I wanted to know."
Text: "알고 싶었던 건 그게 다야."

TextEng: "Tell me about your rebellion."
Text: "반란에 대해 얘기해 줘."

TextEng: "What, did you kill somebody?"
Text: "뭐, 누구 죽였어?"

TextEng: "I want to move faster and not bother with searching or stealth."
Text: "더 빨리 이동하고 탐색이나 은밀 행동은 하지 마."

TextEng: "What did you do to upset them so?"
Text: "뭘 했길래 그렇게 화가 났어?"

TextEng: "Is that a lot?"
Text: "그게 많은 건가?"

TextEng: "Slaves?"
Text: "노예?"

TextEng: "What?"
"You were young and foolish."
Text: "젊고 어리석었던 거지."

TextEng: "Didn't your friends assist them?"
Text: "친구들이 도와주지 않았어?"

TextEng: "How did your people stop them?"
Text: "동족들이 어떻게 막았는데?"

TextEng: "That many slaves?"
Text: "노예가 그렇게 많아?"

TextEng: "Did nothing change?"
Text: "아무것도 안 바뀌었어?"

TextEng: "Did all the slaves die?"
Text: "노예가 다 죽었어?"

TextEng: "What did your people do after that?"
Text: "그 후에 동족이 뭘 했는데?"

TextEng: "You really were a fool."
Text: "정말 바보였구나."

TextEng: "Why didn't they kill you?"
Text: "왜 안 죽였어?"

TextEng: "I need you to be stealthy right now."
Text: "지금 은밀하게 행동해야 해."

TextEng: "So you were banished?"
Text: "그래서 추방당한 거야?"

TextEng: "Tell me about your home."
Text: "고향에 대해 얘기해 줘."

TextEng: "No wonder you act so arrogantly."
Text: "거만하게 구는 게 이해가 되네."

TextEng: "Your people sound truly despicable."
Text: "너희 종족은 정말 혐오스럽다."

TextEng: "How did you feel about that?"
Text: "그때 기분이 어땠어?"

TextEng: "Is that part of why you were banished from your home?"
Text: "그것도 고향에서 추방당한 이유 중 하나야?"

TextEng: "Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "How could you grow bored?"
Text: "어떻게 지루해질 수가 있어?"

TextEng: "Hurry up, this tale is starting to drag."
Text: "빨리 해, 이야기가 늘어지기 시작했어."

TextEng: "What happened next?"
Text: "그다음에는?"

TextEng: "Did the other rakshasa get upset?"
Text: "다른 락샤사들이 화났어?"

TextEng: "That's how you came here?"
Text: "그렇게 여기 온 거야?"

TextEng: "No, I just came to taunt you!"
Text: "아니, 놀리러 왔어!"

TextEng: "No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "I have need of you, though I don't like your attitude."
Text: "네가 필요해, 태도가 마음에 안 들지만."

TextEng: "Fine, don't come with me. I don't really care."
Text: "좋아, 같이 안 가도 돼. 별로 상관없어."

TextEng: "Because it's your job!"
Text: "네 일이니까!"

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Innocent lives are at stake."
Text: "무고한 생명이 걸려 있어."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "Is it really important, Jaboli?"
Text: "정말 중요한 거야, 자볼리?"

TextEng: "You have something to say, Jaboli?"
Text: "할 말이 있어, 자볼리?"

TextEng: "I'm not interested in your honors, Jaboli."
Text: "네 명예 따위 관심 없어, 자볼리."

TextEng: "Thank you, Jaboli."
Text: "고마워, 자볼리."

TextEng: "I think I love you, Jaboli."
Text: "자볼리, 사랑한다고 생각해."

TextEng: "Oh, sorry."
Text: "아, 미안."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "That's what I meant too."
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "나도 그런 뜻이었어."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Truth]</Start> "That's what I meant too."
Text: <StartAction>[진실]</Start> "나도 그런 뜻이었어."

TextEng: "A lousy amulet? I was hoping for a real gift!"
Text: "부적이 전부야? 진짜 선물을 기대했는데!"

TextEng: "I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "I will, Jaboli. You are a dear friend."
Text: "그럴게, 자볼리. 소중한 친구야."

TextEng: "What does that mean?"
Text: "그게 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "Yes?"
"Like I care what you think."
Text: "네 생각 따위 관심 없어."

TextEng: "Thank you."
Text: "고마워."

TextEng: "I got what I wanted. I don't care if you liked it or not."
Text: "원하는 걸 얻었어. 네가 좋아했든 아니든 상관없어."

TextEng: "I hope they enjoy each other."
Text: "서로 행복하길 바라."

TextEng: "Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "I think he will grow to regret loving her."
Text: "그녀를 사랑한 걸 후회하게 될 것 같아."

TextEng: "They deserved more happiness."
Text: "더 큰 행복을 누릴 자격이 있었어."

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I could care less about your honors. I do what I must to get ahead."
Text: "네 명예 따위 관심 없어. 나는 앞서 나가기 위해 할 일을 할 뿐이야."

TextEng: "It doesn't involve large sums of gold does it?"
Text: "거액의 금이 포함되는 건 아니겠지?"

TextEng: "Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "That is an honor I shall strive for."
Text: "그런 영예를 위해 노력하겠어."

TextEng: "I don't care what you do. If you don't want to help me, then leave."
Text: "네 맘대로 해. 돕기 싫으면 떠나."

TextEng: "I need your help, Jaboli. Don't abandon me now, please!"
Text: "도움이 필요해, 자볼리. 지금 날 버리지 마, 제발!"

TextEng: "I didn't have any other options."
Text: "다른 선택지가 없었어."

TextEng: "You cannot judge me on this one act alone."
Text: "이 한 가지 행동만으로 날 판단할 수는 없어."

TextEng: "I am trying to save innocent lives here!"
Text: "무고한 생명을 구하려는 거야!"

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "How is that perplexing?"
Text: "뭐가 당혹스럽다는 거야?"

TextEng: "Yes. That is rather frightening."
Text: "그래. 꽤 무서운 얘기네."

TextEng: "Tell me if you come up with anything."
Text: "뭐 알아내면 알려줘."

TextEng: "That's nonsense! I don't believe it."
Text: "말도 안 돼! 믿을 수 없어."

TextEng: "That's just great. Who wants to vote for the evil one?"
Text: "잘됐다. 악한 자에게 누가 투표하고 싶겠어?"

TextEng: "You think I am a devil?"
Text: "내가 악마라고 생각해?"

TextEng: "But we know the Masked Man is an illithid."
Text: "하지만 가면 남자가 일리시드라는 건 알고 있잖아."

TextEng: "You think the Masked Man might be a demon."
Text: "가면 남자가 악마일 수 있다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "I doubt it, but I'll be careful."
Text: "그럴 것 같지 않지만, 조심하지."

TextEng: "I shall keep that in mind."
Text: "기억해 둘게."

TextEng: "And I thought Trip was crazy!"
Text: "트립이 미쳤다고 생각했는데!"

TextEng: "You're just paranoid!"
Text: "편집증이야!"

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Is there anything I can do to help?"
Text: "내가 도울 일이 있어?"

TextEng: "Quit wasting my time with this nonsense."
Text: "이런 쓸데없는 것으로 내 시간 낭비하지 마."

TextEng: "What about it?"
Text: "그게 어쨌는데?"

TextEng: "I like your thinking. Yes... treasure!"
Text: "마음에 드는 생각이야. 그래... 보물!"

TextEng: "You aren't normally the gold digger of the group."
Text: "평소에는 그렇게 보물에 집착하지 않잖아."

TextEng: "The only reason you want it is for treasure?"
Text: "보물 때문에만 사려는 거야?"

TextEng: "It sounds too dangerous to waste time on."
Text: "시간 낭비하기엔 너무 위험해 보이는데."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Insight]</Start> "You are hedging around something. What else is there?"
Text: <StartCheck>[통찰]</Start> "뭔가 숨기고 있지. 다른 이유가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I don't care about that, but the treasure sounds good."
Text: "그건 관심 없지만, 보물은 좋겠다."

TextEng: "I guess those are good reasons."
Text: "좋은 이유들인 것 같아."

TextEng: "I guess we should be going."
Text: "출발해야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Right."
Text: "그렇지."

TextEng: "*Our* new home?"
Text: "*우리* 새 집이라고?"

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "What does that mean?"
Text: "그게 무슨 뜻이야?"
