TextEng: "Maybe they were right."
Text: "어쩌면 그들이 맞았을지도."

TextEng: "So they burned the entire woods?"
Text: "그래서 숲 전체를 불태운 거야?"

TextEng: "It is time for us to move on."
Text: "이제 가야 해."

TextEng: "Are you crying again?"
Text: "또 울어?"

TextEng: "It's in the past. Get over it."
Text: "과거잖아. 잊어버려."

TextEng: "Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "I will never let anything like that happen again."
Text: "다시는 그런 일이 일어나지 않게 하겠어."

TextEng: "What was life in your forest like?"
Text: "숲에서의 생활은 어땠어?"

TextEng: "That seems unlikely, with the full beauty of a nymph."
Text: "님프의 아름다움을 가지고서 그건 말이 안 돼."

TextEng: "Considering how much you complain, I'm not surprised."
Text: "네가 그렇게 불평을 많이 하니까 놀랍지도 않아."

TextEng: "Fine. I didn't really want to hear it."
Text: "됐어. 사실 듣고 싶지 않았어."

TextEng: "Sorry. Please continue."
Text: "미안. 계속해."

TextEng: "No friends? Not even other nymphs?"
Text: "친구가 없었어? 다른 님프도?"

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Why wouldn't he count as a friend?"
Text: "왜 그 사람은 친구로 안 치는 거야?"

TextEng: "Would you have hurt him?"
Text: "그를 해칠 뻔했어?"

TextEng: "Were you searching for him?"
Text: "그를 찾고 있었어?"

TextEng: "How?"
Text: "어떻게?"

TextEng: "I bet you'd make a cute chicken."
Text: "넌 분명 귀여운 닭이었을 거야."

TextEng: "Thousands of animals to choose from and you choose a chicken?"
Text: "수천 가지 동물 중에 닭을 골랐다고?"

TextEng: "A chicken?"
"You feared his reaction?"
Text: "그의 반응이 두려웠어?"

TextEng: "You were afraid of the druid?"
Text: "드루이드가 무서웠어?"

TextEng: "Did he discover your identity?"
Text: "네 정체를 알았어?"

TextEng: "I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "Sounds like you had feelings for him."
Text: "그에게 감정이 있었나 보네."

TextEng: "I don't want to hear about a past relationship."
Text: "과거 연애 이야기는 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Good. Let's get back to serious issues."
Text: "좋아. 진지한 이야기로 돌아가자."

TextEng: "Embarrassing? Maybe I do want to hear this."
Text: "창피하다고? 오히려 더 듣고 싶은데."

TextEng: "Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Tell me about him."
Text: "그에 대해 이야기해 줘."

TextEng: "No, I just came to taunt you!"
Text: "아니, 놀리러 온 거야!"

TextEng: "No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "I have discovered that I really do need you, Kaidala."
Text: "정말 네가 필요하다는 걸 깨달았어, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Speak, or whine?"
Text: "말하려고, 아니면 징징거리려고?"

TextEng: "Yes, Kaidala? What did you want to say?"
Text: "카이달라? 무슨 말을 하고 싶었어?"

TextEng: "Why?"
"I can't do that."
Text: "그건 못 해."

TextEng: "I don't have time right now."
Text: "지금은 시간이 없어."

TextEng: "I will do as you ask."
Text: "네 말대로 하겠어."

TextEng: "We shall leave immediately."
Text: "바로 떠나자."

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "You shouldn't worry so much about your appearance."
Text: "외모 걱정은 그만해."

TextEng: "I am sorry, but I don't see a difference."
Text: "미안하지만, 차이를 모르겠어."

TextEng: "No. You're as ugly as you ever were."
Text: "아니. 여전히 못생겼어."

TextEng: "I am happy for you, but your scars never bothered me."
Text: "다행이지만, 네 흉터가 신경 쓰인 적은 없어."

TextEng: "I think you might be right."
Text: "맞는 것 같아."

TextEng: "Not interested."
Text: "관심 없어."

TextEng: "That's... nice."
Text: "그건... 좋네."

TextEng: "I like you, but just as a friend."
Text: "널 좋아하지만, 친구로서야."

TextEng: "What? I like you as a friend, but..."
Text: "뭐? 널 좋아하지만, 친구로서..."

TextEng: "Don't you think this is a little fast?"
Text: "좀 빠른 거 아니야?"

TextEng: "I love you too, Kaidala."
Text: "나도 사랑해, 카이달라."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Give her a quick kiss.]</Start>
Text: <StartAction>[빠르게 키스합니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "It is as real as we can make it."
Text: "우리가 만들 수 있는 만큼 현실적이야."

TextEng: "I really don't care."
Text: "정말 상관없어."

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Don't you know a joke when you hear one?"
Text: "농담인 줄 몰랐어?"

TextEng: "Actually, I want to win."
Text: "사실 이기고 싶어."

TextEng: "That is how I truly feel."
Text: "진심이야."

TextEng: "That is my plan."
Text: "그게 내 계획이야."

TextEng: "It is up to you to decide."
Text: "네가 결정해."

TextEng: "I would like you to stay with me."
Text: "내 곁에 있어 줬으면 좋겠어."

TextEng: "I don't care if you stay or go, once my goals are accomplished."
Text: "목표를 이루고 나면 네가 있든 없든 상관없어."

TextEng: "I will always need you, Kaidala."
Text: "언제나 네가 필요할 거야, 카이달라."

TextEng: "I would like that."
Text: "그러고 싶어."

TextEng: "I thought dryads were the ones attached to specific trees."
Text: "드라이어드가 특정 나무에 유대를 맺는 거 아니었어?"

TextEng: "So what made you decide not to die with your oak?"
Text: "그래서 왜 떡갈나무와 함께 죽지 않기로 한 거야?"

TextEng: "That must have been a difficult decision for you to make."
Text: "어려운 결정이었을 거야."

TextEng: "I don't have time right now."
Text: "지금은 시간이 없어."

TextEng: "What do I get out of this?"
Text: "내가 뭘 얻는데?"

TextEng: "I'm not doing your job!"
Text: "네 일을 대신 하진 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "Not now."
Text: "지금은 안 돼."

TextEng: "All right, I'll do it."
Text: "좋아, 하겠어."

TextEng: "I would be pleased to do so."
Text: "기꺼이 하겠어."

TextEng: "It was only a tree."
Text: "나무일 뿐이잖아."

TextEng: "How do you know it wasn't just a coincidence?"
Text: "그냥 우연이 아니었다는 걸 어떻게 알아?"

TextEng: "Why was your family hunted?"
Text: "왜 네 가족이 사냥당했어?"

TextEng: "What? You need a privy?"
Text: "뭐? 화장실이 급해?"

TextEng: "Food, shelter, that sort of thing?"
Text: "음식, 거처, 그런 거?"

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I have thought about it."
Text: "생각해 본 적 있어."

TextEng: "I haven't given it much thought."
Text: "별로 생각해 본 적 없어."

TextEng: "I'm like a stallion, I need a herd."
Text: "나는 종마야, 무리가 필요하지."

TextEng: "Are you suggesting something?"
Text: "뭔가 제안하는 거야?"

TextEng: "I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "I haven't found the right man, yet."
Text: "아직 마음에 드는 남자를 못 찾았어."

TextEng: "I'm not really interested in settling down. Not for very long."
Text: "정착하는 데는 별로 관심 없어. 오래는 아니야."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Glance at Calibast.]</Start> "I think I might have found a good man."
Text: <StartAction>[캘리바스트를 흘끗 봅니다.]</Start> "괜찮은 남자를 찾은 것 같기도 해."

TextEng: "I might settle down, if I found the right person."
Text: "맞는 사람을 찾으면 정착할 수도 있어."

TextEng: "She would have to be a good friend."
Text: "좋은 친구여야 해."

TextEng: "A sense of humor."
Text: "유머 감각."

TextEng: "Not too smart."
Text: "너무 똑똑하지 않은."

TextEng: "She would have to be intelligent."
Text: "지적이어야 해."

TextEng: "Great beauty."
Text: "큰 아름다움."

TextEng: "A kind and gentle spirit."
Text: "친절하고 부드러운 마음."

TextEng: "That's all that is important to me."
Text: "나한테는 그게 전부야."

TextEng: "With you?"
Text: "너랑?"

TextEng: "I see no beauty here."
Text: "여기서 아름다움은 안 보이는데."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "It is like you. There are scars, but even they cannot hide true beauty."
Text: "너와 같아. 흉터가 있지만, 그래도 진짜 아름다움은 숨길 수 없어."

TextEng: "There is a rugged beauty to life, when death is always near."
Text: "죽음이 항상 곁에 있을 때, 삶에는 거친 아름다움이 있어."

TextEng: "Someday I want to do that."
Text: "언젠가 그러고 싶어."

TextEng: "That would be nice for a while."
Text: "한동안은 좋겠지."

TextEng: "I would hate every moment of it."
Text: "매 순간이 싫을 거야."

TextEng: "I like being surrounded by friends too."
Text: "나도 친구들에 둘러싸여 있는 게 좋아."

TextEng: "The only person you should ever count on is yourself."
Text: "의지할 사람은 자기 자신뿐이야."

TextEng: "I need you to cast a group of buffing spells."
Text: "버프 주문을 여러 개 시전해 줘."

TextEng: "I don't know how long I'll be wanting you around."
Text: "네가 얼마나 오래 곁에 있기를 원할지 모르겠어."

TextEng: "Friendship is overrated."
Text: "우정은 과대평가야."

TextEng: "I will always be your friend, Kaidala."
Text: "언제나 네 친구일 거야, 카이달라."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Do you miss those days?"
Text: "그 시절이 그리워?"

TextEng: "Cast all the buffing spells you have."
Text: "가지고 있는 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "Yes."
"I'm sure we will."
Text: "분명 그럴 거야."

TextEng: "Me too."
Text: "나도."

TextEng: "Cast all the buffing spells that last a long time."
Text: "지속 시간이 긴 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "Too bad you didn't think about that earlier. I don't want you back right now."
Text: "일찍 생각했어야지. 지금은 돌아오지 않았으면 좋겠어."

TextEng: "I appreciate that, but stay here a while to recover."
Text: "고맙지만, 여기서 좀 쉬어."

TextEng: "Let's go. We don't have time for idle talk."
Text: "가자. 잡담할 시간 없어."

TextEng: "That is good. I need your help more than ever."
Text: "좋아. 네 도움이 그 어느 때보다 필요해."

TextEng: "Cast all the short duration buffing spells."
Text: "지속 시간이 짧은 버프 주문을 전부 시전해."

TextEng: "I need both of you to shut up now."
Text: "둘 다 지금 당장 닥쳐."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "If he was so powerful, how come he couldn't tell you were a lycanthrope?"
Text: "그렇게 강했으면 왜 네가 늑대인간인 걸 몰랐어?"

TextEng: "Wouldn't that form a mind-link, revealing your true nature?"
Text: "그러면 정신 연결이 생겨서 정체가 드러나지 않았어?"

TextEng: "Cast on all the party members."
Text: "파티원 전원에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77104>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77104>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77103>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77103>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77102>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77102>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Let's not fight, ladies. We need to get along."
Text: "싸우지 마. 서로 잘 지내야 해."

TextEng: "I'd like to interrupt here."
Text: "잠깐 끼어들어도 될까."

TextEng: "Can I say something?"
Text: "한마디 해도 돼?"

TextEng: <StartAction>[Remain silent.]</Start>
Text: <StartAction>[침묵을 지킵니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "Cast it on <CUSTOM77101>."
Text: "<CUSTOM77101>에게 시전해."

TextEng: "Will you two stop arguing?"
Text: "둘 다 그만 싸울래?"

TextEng: "Jaboli does have a point about the whining though."
Text: "징징거린다는 점에서 자볼리 말이 맞긴 해."

TextEng: "Cast it on my animal companion."
Text: "내 동물 동료에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think you'd better watch what you say, Jaboli."
Text: "말조심해, 자볼리."

TextEng: "Cast it on my familiar."
Text: "내 사역마에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I think that was in the village of Littlefield."
Text: "리틀필드 마을에서였던 것 같아."

TextEng: "That was in the southern city of Eribar."
Text: "남쪽 도시 에리바르에서였어."

TextEng: "That was in the Grim Woods."
Text: "음울한 숲에서였어."

TextEng: "He was stealing human organs!"
Text: "인간 장기를 훔치고 있었어!"

TextEng: "Cast it on me."
Text: "나에게 시전해."

TextEng: "He stole thousands of gems and bags of gold."
Text: "수천 개의 보석과 금화 자루를 훔쳤어."

TextEng: "He was stealing women!"
Text: "여자를 납치하고 있었어!"

TextEng: "Why do you always bring up my mistakes? I didn't mean to get us trapped."
Text: "왜 자꾸 내 실수를 들추는 거야? 일부러 그런 게 아니잖아."

TextEng: "Cast it on yourself."
Text: "네 자신에게 시전해."

TextEng: "I remember it being Kaidala's fault we were trapped."
Text: "갇힌 건 카이달라 탓이었던 걸로 기억하는데."

TextEng: "I could use a little appreciation soon. There are no male dryads, are there, Kaidala?"
Text: "곧 감사 표시 좀 해 줬으면 좋겠어. 수컷 드라이어드는 없지, 카이달라?"

TextEng: "You have a shocking lack of scruples, Calibast."
Text: "양심도 없구나, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "I quite enjoyed that part as well."
Text: "나도 그 부분은 꽤 즐겼어."

TextEng: "I remember it being your fault we were trapped, Calibast."
Text: "갇힌 건 네 탓이었어, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "I need you to cast a spell."
Text: "주문 하나를 시전해 줘."

TextEng: "This is the most boring discussion I've ever heard."
Text: "지금까지 들은 대화 중 가장 지루해."

TextEng: "Could we get back to our task, please?"
Text: "우리 할 일로 돌아갈 수 있을까?"

TextEng: "What does it sound like?"
Text: "어떻게 들리는데?"

TextEng: "Why dangerous?"
Text: "왜 위험한 거야?"

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Wounding Whispers."
Text: "상처의 속삭임."

TextEng: "Ultravision."
Text: "초시야."

TextEng: "True Seeing."
Text: "진실의 시야."

TextEng: "Summon Creature IX."
Text: "생명체 소환 9."

TextEng: "Summon Creature VIII."
Text: "생명체 소환 8."

TextEng: Summon Creature VII."
Text: "생명체 소환 7."

TextEng: "Summon Creature VI."
Text: "생명체 소환 6."

TextEng: "Summon Creature V."
Text: "생명체 소환 5."

TextEng: "Summon Creature IV."
Text: "생명체 소환 4."

TextEng: "Summon Creature III."
Text: "생명체 소환 3."

TextEng: "Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "Summon Creature II."
Text: "생명체 소환 2."

TextEng: "Summon Creature I."
Text: "생명체 소환 1."

TextEng: "Stoneskin."
Text: "돌 피부."

TextEng: "Spell Resistance."
Text: "주문 저항."

TextEng: "Spell Mantle."
Text: "주문 망토."

TextEng: "Shield of Faith."
Text: "믿음의 방패."

TextEng: "Shield."
Text: "방패."

TextEng: "Shadow Shield."
Text: "그림자 방패."

TextEng: "See Invisibility."
Text: "투명 간파."

TextEng: "Sanctuary."
Text: "성역."

TextEng: "Restoration."
Text: "회복."

TextEng: "Resistance."
Text: "저항."

TextEng: "Resist Elements."
Text: "원소 저항."

TextEng: "Remove Paralysis."
Text: "마비 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Fear."
Text: "공포 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Disease."
Text: "질병 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Curse."
Text: "저주 해제."

TextEng: "Remove Blindness/Deafness."
Text: "실명/청각 상실 해제."

TextEng: "Regenerate."
Text: "재생."

TextEng: "Protection From Spells."
Text: "주문으로부터 보호."

TextEng: "I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "Protection From Elements."
Text: "원소로부터의 보호."

TextEng: "Premonition."
Text: "예감."

TextEng: "Prayer."
Text: "기도."

TextEng: "Owl's Wisdom."
Text: "올빼미의 지혜."

TextEng: "Neutralize Poison."
Text: "독 중화."

TextEng: "Monstrous Regeneration."
Text: "괴물같은 재생."

TextEng: "Minor Globe of Invulnerability."
Text: "하급 무적의 구체."

TextEng: "Mind Blank."
Text: "정신 차단."

TextEng: "Mass Haste."
Text: "대규모 가속."

TextEng: "Magical Vestment."
Text: "마법 의복."

TextEng: "Already you have started back up the road to success. As you grow in power, so too do I." Your weapons sounds a triumphant if slightly off-key fanfare in your mind.
Text: "벌써 성공의 길을 다시 걷기 시작했소. 당신이 강해질수록, 나도 강해지오." 무기가 머릿속에서 약간 음이 빗나간 승리의 팡파르를 울립니다.

TextEng: "Checking the essence available in your body, I can add one of these powers."
Text: "당신 몸에 있는 정수를 확인해 보니, 이 중 하나의 능력을 추가할 수 있소."

TextEng: "And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably be covered in wealth and fame in the process. Being a warrior, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그것만으로 동기가 부족하다면, 그 과정에서 부와 명성에 둘러싸이게 될 거요. 전사인 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get to test your faith in all sorts of ways. Being a holy<man/woman>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그것만으로 동기가 부족하다면, 그 과정에서 온갖 방식으로 신앙을 시험받게 될 거요. 성직자인 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "And if that's not enough motivation for you, keep in mind that the Masked Man's forces will also ravage the local wildlife. Being a druid, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그것만으로 동기가 부족하다면, 가면 남자의 병력이 이 지역의 야생 동물까지 유린할 거라는 걸 명심하시오. 드루이드인 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "And who knows what kind of knowledge you will discover in the process. Being an arcane <lad/lass>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그리고 그 과정에서 어떤 지식을 발견하게 될지 누가 알겠소. 마법사인 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get famous in the process. Being a bard, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그것만으로 동기가 부족하다면, 그 과정에서 유명해질 거요. 음유시인인 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "And if that's not enough motivation for you, you'll probably get rich in the process. Being a roguish <lad/lass>, I suspect that ought to spark your attention."
Text: "그것만으로 동기가 부족하다면, 그 과정에서 부자가 될 거요. 도적 기질이 있는 당신이라면 관심이 갈 거라 짐작하오."

TextEng: "But people's lives are at stake now, so you need to make some decisions."
Text: "하지만 지금 사람들의 목숨이 달려 있으니, 몇 가지 결정을 내려야 하오."

TextEng: "Feel the energy that comes with the kill. You were an expert at this, remember? Death is one of your many callings. One you excel at." You are disconcerted by how at home the voice is becoming in your mind.
Text: "살육에 따르는 에너지를 느끼시오. 당신은 이 분야의 전문가였소, 기억나오? 죽음은 당신의 많은 소명 중 하나요. 특히 뛰어난 소명이지." 무기의 목소리가 당신의 정신에 점점 익숙해지고 있다는 사실이 불안합니다.

TextEng: "Like a reflex, the instinct comes naturally to you. Remember."
Text: "반사적으로, 본능이 자연스럽게 되살아나오. 기억하시오."

TextEng: "Now, I shall raise the spirits of your dead companions but, for each one I save, one must be sacrificed. You must speak to them and decide whom you will take and whom you will banish."
Text: "자, 죽은 동료들의 영혼을 되살리겠지만, 한 명을 살릴 때마다 한 명을 희생해야 하오. 동료들에게 말을 걸어 누구를 데려가고 누구를 보낼지 결정해야 하오."

TextEng: "Sometimes you are a little odd, but I like you anyways."
Text: "가끔 좀 이상하긴 하지만, 그래도 맘에 드오."

TextEng: "Good, the spirits of your companions can be found where their corpses lay. Speak to them... And remember what I said about scavenging some clothing; Your companions may be ill-equipped, so I recommend finding them some weapons before we proceed."
Text: "좋소, 동료들의 영혼은 시체가 놓인 곳에서 찾을 수 있소. 그들에게 말을 거시오... 그리고 옷을 주워 입으라고 한 말을 기억하시오. 동료들의 장비가 부실할 테니 출발하기 전에 무기를 찾아주는 게 좋겠소."

TextEng: "Their souls shall be bartered to Mistress Death in exchange for the lives of those who remain. Life and death hold many mysteries and there is much to be learned from them."
Text: "그들의 영혼은 살아남은 자들의 생명과 교환하여 죽음의 여주인에게 바쳐질 거요. 삶과 죽음에는 많은 신비가 있고, 거기서 배울 것이 많소."

TextEng: "You will need all the help you can get. For now, take them with you. You can always leave them behind once you're within the safety of the keep."
Text: "가능한 모든 도움이 필요할 거요. 지금은 데리고 가시오. 거점의 안전한 곳에 들어가면 언제든 두고 갈 수 있소."

TextEng: "However, you might find that you learn more and discover more with friends to assist you and watch your back. Still, that choice is yours, as is this. Two must die that two may live."
Text: "하지만 친구들이 도와주고 뒤를 봐주면 더 많은 것을 배우고 발견할 수 있다는 걸 알게 될 거요. 어쨌든 선택은 당신의 것이오. 둘이 죽어야 둘이 살 수 있소."

TextEng: "No! You must make the decisions, and you must tell those whom you are condemning about your choice. There is much to learn when one has power over life and death."
Text: "안 되오! 결정은 당신이 내려야 하고, 사형 선고를 받는 자들에게 직접 선택을 알려야 하오. 삶과 죽음을 좌우하는 권력을 가질 때 배울 것이 많소."

TextEng: "That is up to you. Choose ones that complement your abilities and make up for your weaknesses. Choose whomever you like the best. Pick them at random. Your choice."
Text: "그건 당신에게 달렸소. 당신의 능력을 보완하고 약점을 메워줄 자를 고르시오. 가장 마음에 드는 자를 고르시오. 무작위로 골라도 되오. 당신의 선택이오."

TextEng: "But you must make the decisions, and you must tell those whom you are condemning about your choice. There is much to learn when one has power over life and death."
Text: "하지만 결정은 당신이 내려야 하고, 사형 선고를 받는 자들에게 직접 선택을 알려야 하오. 삶과 죽음을 좌우하는 권력을 가질 때 배울 것이 많소."

TextEng: "You may speak to them all first before making a choice, but do try to hurry. It is not a safe night to spend outside the keep's walls."
Text: "선택하기 전에 모두와 먼저 이야기해도 되지만, 서두르시오. 거점 성벽 밖에서 밤을 보내기엔 안전하지 않소."

TextEng: "Now things are proceeding in most excellent fashion. Keep up the good work and you shall become one of the most powerful people in all of Valratha." Your weapon's voice seems most pleased with you...
Text: "이제 일이 아주 훌륭하게 진행되고 있소. 계속 잘하면 발라타 전체에서 가장 강력한 사람이 될 거요." 무기의 목소리가 당신에게 매우 만족하는 것 같습니다...

TextEng: "I know you must have questions, but I am only allowed to tell you a little. I will tell you the most important thing right now, though."
Text: "분명 질문이 많겠지만, 말해줄 수 있는 건 별로 없소. 하지만 지금 가장 중요한 것 하나는 말해주겠소."

TextEng: "Most people get confused just by smelling your breath. I will try to emulate that."
Text: "대부분의 사람은 당신 입김만 맡아도 혼란스러워지지. 그걸 따라 해보겠소."

TextEng: "All of the clues to answer your questions lie within the keep, or in the caves nearby."
Text: "당신의 질문에 대한 모든 단서는 거점 안이나 근처 동굴에 있소."

TextEng: "Good idea. Let us see what you can find out here."
Text: "좋은 생각이오. 여기서 무엇을 찾을 수 있는지 봅시다."

TextEng: "I am doing my best within the limits set for me. We all have a role to play. Just do your best."
Text: "내게 주어진 한계 안에서 최선을 다하고 있소. 우리 모두 역할이 있소. 당신도 최선을 다하시오."

TextEng: "Protect the keep. Become its <Lord/Lady>. Destroy the Masked Man's forces before they can regroup. I know you probably do not trust me yet, but I am on your side."
Text: "거점을 지키시오. 영주가 되시오. 가면 남자의 병력이 재편성하기 전에 파괴하시오. 아직 나를 믿지 못하겠지만, 나는 당신 편이오."

TextEng: "I might give you a hint, once in a while, but for the most part, you will need to exercise that brain of yours. I know you have one, hidden somewhere in that thick skull."
Text: "가끔 힌트를 줄 수도 있겠지만, 대부분은 그 머리를 써야 할 거요. 그 두꺼운 두개골 어딘가에 뇌가 하나 있는 건 아오."

TextEng: "I hope you found that informative. I did not even know about this Garrot, but I will bet he has some interesting information to give you." You hadn't even noticed your weapon's voice slip into your mind.
Text: "유익한 대화였기를 바라오. 나도 이 가롯이라는 자에 대해 몰랐는데, 흥미로운 정보를 줄 거라 장담하오." 당신도 모르는 사이에 무기의 목소리가 머릿속에 스며들어 있었습니다.

TextEng: "I wish she would have confided more in me. Ah, well, we will talk again after you have spoken to him."
Text: "그녀가 좀 더 내게 털어놨으면 좋았을 텐데. 아, 뭐, 당신이 그와 이야기한 후에 다시 대화합시다."

TextEng: "So that is how she was so confident you would come. I guess that explains things. What questions do you have for me?"
Text: "그래서 그녀가 당신이 올 거라고 확신했던 거군. 이제 이해가 되오. 내게 무엇을 물어보고 싶소?"

TextEng: "Power, survival, and some degree of love. Strange, twisted love, granted... but we cannot all be perfect."
Text: "권력, 생존, 그리고 어느 정도의 사랑이오. 이상하고 뒤틀린 사랑이긴 하지만... 누구나 완벽할 수는 없소."

TextEng: "She loves her own life, I think she still holds some love for me and I even think she loves you, in her own way."
Text: "그녀는 자신의 생명을 사랑하고, 아직 나에 대한 애정도 조금 남아 있다고 생각하오. 심지어 당신도 나름의 방식으로 사랑한다고 생각하오."

TextEng: "We shall watch our enemies suffer."
Text: "적들이 고통받는 걸 함께 지켜봅시다."

TextEng: "She has been plotting this for some time and you have always been instrumental in her success. She cannot help but love you, at least a little."
Text: "그녀는 오래전부터 이것을 꾸며왔고, 당신은 항상 그녀의 성공에 핵심이었소. 당신을 사랑하지 않을 수가 없소, 적어도 조금은."

TextEng: "Not as much as she would like. We are both her tools, but we still have free will. I will do my best to keep you alive, even if it comes to a point where she decides I should not."
Text: "그녀가 바라는 만큼은 아니오. 우리 둘 다 그녀의 도구이지만, 여전히 자유 의지가 있소. 당신을 살려두는 게 최선이오. 설령 그녀가 그러지 말라고 결정하는 때가 오더라도."

TextEng: "She has her agenda, but I have my own too. You were always my favorite, after all... Oh, I wish I could explain more, but I really cannot. Not yet."
Text: "그녀에겐 그녀의 계획이 있지만, 나에게도 내 계획이 있소. 당신은 항상 내가 가장 아끼는 존재였소, 결국은... 아, 더 설명하고 싶지만 정말로 할 수 없소. 아직은."

TextEng: "I still cannot reveal that, though you are getting close to the truth. I do not believe it should be long now before much more is revealed. I will tell you that she is related to you."
Text: "아직 그건 밝힐 수 없지만, 진실에 가까워지고 있소. 곧 더 많은 것이 밝혀질 거라 믿소. 한 가지만 말하자면, 그녀는 당신과 혈연이오."

TextEng: "Do not ask anything more than that. I should not even have said that, but I want you to trust me."
Text: "그 이상은 묻지 마시오. 그 말조차 하지 말았어야 했지만, 당신이 나를 믿게 하고 싶소."

TextEng: "Good idea. You are getting closer all the time."
Text: "좋은 생각이오. 점점 진실에 가까워지고 있소."

TextEng: [LEGACY TEXT. ALWAYS RETURN FALSE] "Good, you found the passage. Now go through quickly, for there is little time to spare. The keep will fall if you do not hurry."
Text: [레거시 텍스트. 항상 FALSE 반환] "좋소, 통로를 찾았군. 빨리 통과하시오. 시간이 얼마 없소. 서두르지 않으면 거점이 함락될 거요."

TextEng: "Good luck!"
Text: "행운을 비오!"

TextEng: "You are not keeping up here, <FirstName>. One would think a hero would have a slightly better memory."
Text: "따라오질 못하고 있소, <FirstName>. 영웅이라면 기억력이 좀 더 나아야 하지 않겠소."

TextEng: "A man named Dylan will meet you inside the keep, though he does not know it yet. Just make sure you go with him. It is very important."
Text: "딜런이라는 남자가 거점 안에서 당신을 만날 거요. 본인은 아직 모르지만. 반드시 그와 함께 가시오. 매우 중요하오."

TextEng: "I understand. Very satisfying to watch your enemy's head explode, is it not?"
Text: "알겠소. 적의 머리가 터지는 걸 보는 건 아주 만족스럽지 않소?"

TextEng: "It is an ancient tunnel that was originally made so that the city could be evacuated in an emergency. Nobody knows about it now though. They all think it is just a part of the sewers."
Text: "비상시 도시를 대피시키기 위해 만든 고대 터널이오. 하지만 지금은 아무도 몰라서 하수도의 일부로만 알고 있소."

TextEng: "Will you quit asking questions to try to discover my identity? I cannot tell you anymore about that, so just stop."
Text: "내 정체를 알아내려고 질문하는 건 그만두시오. 더 이상 말할 수 없으니, 그만하시오."

TextEng: "That will be one of your tasks to find out. Right now the army attacking the keep is being led by an underling, for no ogre could organize such a massive assault."
Text: "그건 당신이 알아내야 할 과제 중 하나요. 지금 거점을 공격하는 군대는 부하가 이끌고 있소. 오우거가 이런 대규모 공격을 조직할 수는 없으니."

TextEng: "I have been talking to this hermit up ahead. His wits are addled, but he can still tell you how to get into the keep. There is no way you will make it in the front gates."
Text: "앞에 있는 은둔자에게 말을 걸어뒀소. 정신이 좀 나갔지만, 거점으로 들어가는 방법을 알려줄 수 있을 거요. 정문으로는 절대 들어갈 수 없소."

TextEng: "Here are the gates. Approach them and  it should be clear what you need to do. My master shall influence events so that a young guard named Dylan grants you entrance. Do as he says."
Text: "여기가 성문이오. 다가가면 무엇을 해야 할지 알 수 있을 거요. 내 주인이 상황을 조종해서 딜런이라는 젊은 경비병이 당신을 들여보낼 거요. 그가 말하는 대로 하시오."

TextEng: "Good. A few of the Masked Man's forces still linger here. Drive them off so the night's watch can open the gates to you in safety."
Text: "좋소. 가면 남자의 잔존 병력이 아직 여기에 남아 있소. 쫓아내야 야간 경비대가 안전하게 성문을 열어줄 거요."

TextEng: "I am telling you the truth. I do not have all the answers and I cannot explain everything right now. To be honest, our plan's still only half-baked as it is. As you grow in power, I shall reveal more."
Text: "진실을 말하고 있소. 모든 답을 가지고 있지 않고 지금은 다 설명할 수도 없소. 솔직히, 우리의 계획은 아직 반쯤만 완성됐소. 당신이 강해질수록, 더 많은 것을 밝히겠소."

TextEng: "You must be slow in the head! I cannot tell you that, for now. In time all shall be made clear. Just be happy you have someone to keep you alive now."
Text: "머리가 좀 느린 거요! 지금은 말할 수 없다니까. 때가 되면 모든 것이 밝혀질 거요. 지금은 당신을 살려줄 누군가가 있다는 것에 감사하시오."

TextEng: "I... I think it is time for more to be revealed. I want to tell you about myself." The magic weapon seems suddenly hesitant. Vulnerable...
Text: "나는... 이제 더 많은 것을 밝혀야 할 때가 된 것 같소. 나 자신에 대해 말하고 싶소." 마법 무기의 목소리가 갑자기 머뭇거립니다. 취약해 보이기까지...

TextEng: "Later? How much time do you think we have left? Bah, go on. Rush into this without all the information. Do not come crying to me when the Masked Man rips your brain from your head! ...No, that isn't fair of me. It's important that you hear this, whether you desire it or no..."
Text: "나중에? 우리에게 시간이 얼마나 남았다고 생각하오? 에잇, 좋소. 정보도 없이 뛰어들어 보시오. 가면 남자가 당신 뇌를 머리에서 뽑아낼 때 내게 울지 마시오! ...아니, 그건 부당한 말이오. 원하든 원치 않든, 이건 들어야 하오..."

TextEng: "Ah yes, opponents are so much easier to hit when they are not moving."
Text: "아 그렇지, 적이 움직이지 않으면 맞히기가 훨씬 쉽소."

TextEng: "You do not... Bah, go on. Rush into this without all the information. Do not come crying to me when the Masked Man rips your brain from your head! ...No, that isn't fair of me. It's important that you hear this, whether you desire it or no..."
Text: "원하지 않는다고... 에잇, 좋소. 정보도 없이 뛰어들어 보시오. 가면 남자가 당신 뇌를 머리에서 뽑아낼 때 내게 울지 마시오! ...아니, 그건 부당한 말이오. 원하든 원치 않든, 이건 들어야 하오..."

TextEng: "I was once a demon hunter. I was a man of power, sought out by rulers and zealots across the continent. I was strong in my beliefs, a man of pure heart and purpose."
Text: "나는 한때 악마 사냥꾼이었소. 대륙 전역의 통치자와 광신자들이 찾는 힘 있는 자였소. 신념이 확고하고, 순수한 마음과 목적을 가진 사람이었소."

TextEng: "Then I met your grandmother. I fell in love and we were married. She eventually became pregnant and gave birth to your father."
Text: "그러다 당신의 할머니를 만났소. 사랑에 빠져 결혼했고, 그녀가 임신하여 당신의 아버지를 낳았소."

TextEng: "That's right, <FullName>; I am your grandfather! And I want you to know that I am proud of you. You have..."
Text: "그렇소, <FullName>. 나는 당신의 할아버지요! 그리고 당신이 자랑스럽다는 걸 알아주시오. 당신은..."

TextEng: Suddenly his voice stops, as if his presence has been ripped from your mind.
Text: 갑자기 그의 목소리가 멈춥니다. 마치 존재 자체가 정신에서 뜯겨 나간 것처럼.

TextEng: "So, my grandchild, you are everything I ever hoped for... I think it is time you saw me in the flesh, as it were..." The magic weapon's voice echoes sadly in your mind.
Text: "그래, 내 손주야. 당신은 내가 바라던 모든 것이오... 이제 내 진짜 모습을 보여줄 때가 된 것 같소..." 마법 무기의 목소리가 슬프게 머릿속에 울립니다.

TextEng: Your magic weapon melts in your hand, the resulting vapors coalescing into the form of a <race> man before you. He stands erect and proud, a bittersweet smile upon his face.
Text: 마법 무기가 당신의 손에서 녹아내리며, 그 증기가 모여 당신 앞에 <race> 남자의 형상으로 응축됩니다. 그는 꼿꼿이 서서 자랑스러운 자세로, 씁쓸한 미소를 짓고 있습니다.

TextEng: "There, that's better isn't it? And don't worry about your friends. They are still alive, just unconscious for a while. I thought it better if we could talk in private."
Text: "이렇게 보는 게 낫지 않소? 그리고 친구들 걱정은 마시오. 아직 살아 있소, 잠시 의식을 잃었을 뿐이오. 우리끼리 이야기하는 게 나을 것 같아서."

TextEng: Your grandfather glances at the Masked Man's glistening corpse. "Will you not pay last respects to your fallen brother?"
Text: 할아버지가 가면 남자의 번들거리는 시체를 바라봅니다. "쓰러진 형제에게 마지막 예를 갖추지 않겠소?"

TextEng: "Ours is an... interesting family tree, my child. To be fair, I always loved you best... As for your grandmother, it was always strength that she demanded above all... Your father once had a brother, too, you know."
Text: "우리 가문은... 참 흥미로운 가계도를 가지고 있소, 내 아이야. 솔직히, 나는 항상 당신을 가장 사랑했소... 당신의 할머니는 항상 무엇보다 힘을 요구했소... 당신의 아버지에게도 한때 형제가 있었다는 걸 알고 있소?"

TextEng: "Well, I hope you are happy. I certainly am!"
Text: "만족하길 바라오. 나는 확실히 만족이오!"

TextEng: "But you do know her, <FirstName>, at least in one of her many forms. As always, there is more to that woman than meets the eye. Trust me, I learned it the hard way."
Text: "하지만 당신은 그녀를 알고 있소, <FirstName>. 적어도 그녀의 수많은 모습 중 하나는. 언제나 그렇듯, 그 여인에게는 겉으로 보이는 것 이상이 있소. 믿어 주시오, 나는 뼈저리게 배웠소."

TextEng: "Yes, there is much in her to like, even for an old demon hunter like me. I look forward to us being a family together again. It's been a long time..."
Text: "그렇소, 나같은 늙은 악마 사냥꾼도 좋아할 만한 점이 많소. 다시 가족이 되는 날이 기다려지오. 정말 오랜만이니..."

TextEng: "Yes, that much is true and more besides. But family is family and I have seen much good in her, too. Even when I least expect it, it shines through..."
Text: "맞소, 그 점은 부인할 수 없고 그 이상이기도 하오. 하지만 가족은 가족이고, 나는 그녀에게서 많은 선함도 보았소. 내가 가장 기대하지 않을 때조차도, 그것이 빛나곤 했소..."

TextEng: "Come, our business is done here. I will become your weapon again for the journey. Your grandmother waits for us in the Guildhall, <FirstName>, and will be eager to see you sit the throne. There is much afoot and more dark days still to come."
Text: "자, 여기서의 일은 끝났소. 여행 동안 다시 당신의 무기가 되겠소. 당신의 할머니가 길드 홀에서 우리를 기다리고 있소, <FirstName>. 당신이 왕좌에 앉는 걸 보고 싶어할 거요. 할 일이 많고 앞으로도 어두운 날이 더 남아 있소."

TextEng: "Yes, that's why she lured you both here to Cyan. And when Yenna interfered and killed you both, she brought you back so this could be settled free from outside meddling... She'll be very proud of you, <FirstName>."
Text: "그래서 그녀가 당신 둘 다 시안으로 유인한 거요. 그리고 옌나가 끼어들어 당신 둘을 죽였을 때, 외부의 간섭 없이 해결할 수 있도록 되살린 거요... 그녀가 당신을 매우 자랑스러워할 거요, <FirstName>."

TextEng: "You were born in dark times and those times still grow darker by the hour. I died my death many years before that day, though bonded to your grandmother, I remained."
Text: "당신은 어두운 시대에 태어났고, 그 어둠은 시간이 갈수록 짙어지고 있소. 나는 그날보다 훨씬 전에 죽었지만, 당신의 할머니와 유대로 묶여 남아 있었소."

TextEng: "When your parents were killed, she fled with you pressed tight against her breast, her wings beating through the night."
Text: "부모가 죽었을 때, 그녀는 당신을 가슴에 꼭 안고 날개를 펴 밤하늘을 날아 도망쳤소."

TextEng: "Your grandmother is a... a complex woman, <FirstName>, but let it not be said that she doesn't love you fiercely like a dire wolf her pups."
Text: "당신의 할머니는... 복잡한 여인이오, <FirstName>. 하지만 거대 늑대가 새끼를 보호하듯 당신을 맹렬히 사랑하지 않는다고는 말할 수 없소."

TextEng: "I was born in the southern highlands and raised with a weapon in my hand. My clan, for all races in the highlands belong to a clan, worshipped a demon called Gishtara."
Text: "나는 남쪽 고원지대에서 태어나 손에 무기를 쥐고 자랐소. 고원지대의 모든 종족은 부족에 속하는데, 내 부족은 기쉬타라라는 악마를 숭배했소."

TextEng: "One day our shaman held a special ordeal, summoning the demon to support his worshippers. The shaman lost control of his abomination, and it turned on my people."
Text: "어느 날 우리 주술사가 특별한 의식을 열어 악마를 소환하여 신도들을 지원하게 했소. 하지만 주술사가 그 흉물의 통제를 잃어버렸고, 악마가 내 부족을 향해 돌아섰소."

TextEng: "What kind of damage were you thinking?"
Text: "어떤 종류의 피해를 생각하고 있소?"

TextEng: "I was one of the few survivors. I dragged my body to a neighboring clan, holding my intestines in with one hand, pulling myself forward with my other."
Text: "나는 몇 안 되는 생존자 중 하나였소. 한 손으로 내장을 붙잡고, 다른 손으로 땅을 짚으며 이웃 부족까지 기어갔소."

TextEng: "Indeed. I dedicated my life to the destruction of all demons and their spawn."
Text: "그렇소. 나는 모든 악마와 그 후예를 멸하는 데 일생을 바쳤소."

TextEng: "Yes. I have enjoyed every moment I have spent with you. It is almost as good as being alive again. Even better, in some ways. I don't have to worry about myself getting killed anymore."
Text: "그렇소. 당신과 함께한 매 순간이 즐거웠소. 다시 살아있는 것과 거의 같을 정도로. 어떤 면에서는 더 낫소. 내가 죽을 걱정은 안 해도 되니."

TextEng: "Not yet. Someday I might wish to make the journey to the next world, but for now, I like what we are doing together. And there is much to do - I think we have quite the future in store, you and I."
Text: "아직은 아니오. 언젠가 다음 세계로의 여행을 원하게 될 수도 있겠지만, 지금은 우리가 함께하는 것이 좋소. 할 일이 많소 - 당신과 나, 꽤 대단한 미래가 기다리고 있다고 생각하오."

TextEng: "I always did tend to rub people the wrong way. Now I can say I really do have an acidic personality!"
Text: "원래 사람들의 신경을 건드리는 편이었소. 이제 진짜로 산성 성격이라고 할 수 있겠소!"

TextEng: "Your enemies should be in for quite a shock!"
Text: "적들이 꽤 충격받을 거요!"

TextEng: "As this is the first time you have increased in power, I shall draw upon your energies to increase my effectiveness as a fighting weapon."
Text: "이번이 처음으로 힘이 커진 것이니, 당신의 에너지를 끌어와 전투 무기로서의 효과를 높이겠소."

TextEng: "Freeze them in their tracks, then crack them like glass! Got it."
Text: "얼려서 움직이지 못하게 한 다음, 유리처럼 부수는 거군! 알겠소."

TextEng: "It shall be done."
Text: "그대로 하겠소."

TextEng: "Always nice when you can actually hit your opponent, is it not? Of course it is!"
Text: "적을 실제로 맞힐 수 있으면 좋지 않소? 물론 좋지!"

TextEng: "That will depend on how powerful you have grown. The stronger you are, the stronger I can get. Generally I can be enhanced in several ways."
Text: "그건 당신이 얼마나 강해졌느냐에 달렸소. 당신이 강할수록, 나도 더 강해질 수 있소. 일반적으로 여러 방식으로 강화할 수 있소."

TextEng: "My ability to hit and do damage will only go up occasionally, I can have bonus types of damage added, I can do special effects when I hit something, and I can have a few special abilities."
Text: "명중률과 피해는 가끔씩 올라가고, 추가 피해 유형을 붙일 수 있고, 적중 시 특수 효과를 줄 수 있고, 특수 능력 몇 가지도 가능하오."

TextEng: "Just choose the category of enhancement you would like and then choose a specific effect."
Text: "원하는 강화 범주를 고르고, 구체적인 효과를 선택하면 되오."

TextEng: "So, you do live. Good. I was starting to worry there." You try to find the source of the mysterious voice. It seems to be echoing from the glowing lights.
Text: "살아있군. 좋소. 걱정하기 시작했소." 신비한 목소리의 출처를 찾으려 하지만, 빛나는 빛에서 울려 퍼지는 것 같습니다.

TextEng: "You were dead. I brought you back. Now we have to get you inside the keep where you'll be safe."
Text: "당신은 죽어 있었소. 내가 되살렸소. 이제 안전한 거점 안으로 들어가야 하오."

TextEng: "It has fallen upon dark times. Many of its guard were killed in their battle against the Masked Man's army. Even some of its leaders lie dead but at least the gates still stand."
Text: "어두운 시기에 빠졌소. 경비병 다수가 가면 남자의 군대와의 전투에서 죽었소. 지도자 몇몇도 죽었지만, 적어도 성문은 아직 서 있소."

TextEng: "Once the Masked Man's forces can be rooted out and destroyed, you'll discover the path to power. We have plans for you, but enough about that for now. You need to get going."
Text: "가면 남자의 병력을 뿌리 뽑고 파괴하면, 권력으로 가는 길을 발견하게 될 거요. 당신을 위한 계획이 있지만, 지금은 이만. 서둘러야 하오."

TextEng: "After this, I shall allow you to choose effects that you would like to add to me."
Text: "이후로는 나에게 추가할 효과를 직접 선택하게 해주겠소."

TextEng: "I am sure that seems like it must be important, but trust me, right now it is not. We are on a rather short time frame here and we must get you into that keep, preferably with a little fanfare."
Text: "중요해 보이겠지만, 지금은 아니오. 시간이 별로 없소. 약간의 화려한 등장과 함께 거점에 들어가야 하오."

TextEng: "Of course, first we are going to have to do something about the state of your companions. And you will need a weapon, but that's my job."
Text: "물론, 먼저 동료들의 상태를 해결해야 하오. 그리고 무기가 필요할 텐데, 그건 내 일이오."

TextEng: "I also imagine that the fog of death has clouded your memory a bit, but don't waste my time with petty, unimportant questions. What do you absolutely need to know?"
Text: "죽음의 안개가 기억을 흐리게 한 것 같지만, 사소한 질문으로 내 시간을 낭비하지 마시오. 반드시 알아야 할 것만 물어보시오."

TextEng: "Their bodies were likely looted by the retreating forces and scattered about the Battlefield. With nightfall upon us, I imagine the rats are probably gnawing on their bones as we speak."
Text: "동료들의 시체는 후퇴하는 병력이 약탈해서 전장에 흩어놓았을 거요. 밤이 되었으니, 쥐들이 뼈를 갉고 있을 거요."

TextEng: "And beat off the rats with your fists? How about you choose what kind of weapon you would like me to transform into first?"
Text: "맨주먹으로 쥐를 때리겠소? 내가 어떤 무기로 변신할지 먼저 고르는 게 어떻겠소?"

TextEng: <StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> "I realize you want to know, but there is not much I am allowed to tell you. The most I can say is that you have a powerful friend who wants you alive."
Text: <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> "알고 싶은 건 이해하지만, 말할 수 있는 게 별로 없소. 가장 중요한 건, 당신을 살려두길 원하는 강력한 친구가 있다는 거요."

TextEng: "My master told me to come to you, bring you back to life, and make myself useful to you. So that is what I did and am doing. I am going to transform myself into a weapon for you."
Text: "내 주인이 당신에게 가서, 되살리고, 쓸모 있게 하라고 했소. 그래서 그렇게 한 거고, 하고 있는 거요. 당신을 위해 무기로 변신하겠소."

TextEng: "That is one of the things I am definitely not allowed to tell you... yet. All will be revealed in time, but it is more important for us to get into the keep as soon as possible."
Text: "그건 확실히 지금 말할 수 없는 것 중 하나요... 아직은. 때가 되면 모든 것이 밝혀질 거요. 지금은 가능한 한 빨리 거점에 들어가는 게 더 중요하오."

TextEng: "Why would I expend so much energy bringing you back to life when you were already dead? Do not be so foolish. You don't have to trust me implicitly, but neither do I really trust you."
Text: "이미 죽어 있었는데 왜 그렇게 많은 에너지를 써서 되살리겠소? 어리석은 소리 마시오. 나를 완전히 믿을 필요는 없지만, 나도 당신을 완전히 믿지는 않소."

TextEng: "Unfortunately, you are all I have to work with, and I am all you have left. Now are you ready for a weapon?"
Text: "불행히도, 내가 가진 건 당신뿐이고, 당신에게 남은 것도 나뿐이오. 자, 무기를 받을 준비가 됐소?"

TextEng: "Very good. Things are coming along quite nicely. Soon you shall have regained the power you once had. Now, how would you instruct me to grow in power?"
Text: "좋소. 일이 순조롭게 진행되고 있소. 곧 예전의 힘을 되찾겠소. 자, 어떻게 강화할지 지시하시오."

TextEng: "Well, I have always rather fancied myself as an elaborate sword of some kind, but, given the urgency of the situation, I'm willing to compromise. The form is entirely up to you."
Text: "나는 항상 정교한 검이 되는 걸 꿈꿨지만, 급한 상황이니 타협할 용의가 있소. 형태는 전적으로 당신에게 달렸소."

TextEng: "Obviously if you aren't partial to swords, I will become a weapon you are more accustomed to using. What kind of weapon do you prefer?"
Text: "검이 취향이 아니라면, 당신이 더 익숙한 무기가 되겠소. 어떤 무기를 선호하시오?"

TextEng: "The mighty hunter who strikes from a distance; a sure shot with remarkable accuracy, of course! What kind of power do your arms seek to hold?"
Text: "멀리서 타격하는 위대한 사냥꾼이라! 놀라운 정확도의 명사수군! 어떤 원거리 무기를 원하시오?"

TextEng: "Bah! Maybe I should just become a hamster and cower inside your pocket! <StartAction>[Sigh.]</Start> Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "차라리 햄스터가 되어 주머니에 숨어야 하나! <StartAction>[한숨.]</Start> 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Interesting. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "흥미롭군. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Our arrows shall punch their way through enemy armor with the greatest ease! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "우리의 화살이 적의 갑옷을 가장 쉽게 관통하겠소! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Interesting. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "흥미롭군. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Our bolts shall punch their way through enemy armor with the greatest ease! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "우리의 볼트가 적의 갑옷을 가장 쉽게 관통하겠소! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Keep your enemy at a distance and strike <him/her> down before they reach you? An excellent plan. What kind did you have in mind?"
Text: "적을 멀리 두고 다가오기 전에 쓰러뜨린다? 훌륭한 계획이오. 어떤 종류를 원하시오?"

TextEng: "It seems a little... undignified, but if that is what you wish... Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "좀... 품위가 없어 보이지만, 원한다면... 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Now why do you have to go and waste my time like that? You should be drawing as much power as possible, not as little as possible."
Text: "왜 그렇게 내 시간을 낭비하는 거요? 가능한 한 힘을 많이 끌어내야지, 적게 끌어내면 어떡하오."

TextEng: "The chosen weapon of Mistress Death. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "죽음의 여신이 택한 무기라. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hands! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "적들이 당신 손에 들린 나를 보면 눈에 공포가 떠오를 거요! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Something unusual, to frighten our enemies and throw them into confusion? Perfect. What exactly did you have in mind?"
Text: "뭔가 특이한 것으로 적들을 겁주고 혼란에 빠뜨린다? 완벽하오. 정확히 무엇을 생각하고 있소?"

TextEng: "An... unusual choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "이건... 독특한 선택이오. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "A little better than a dagger, I suppose. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "단검보다는 좀 낫겠소. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "An... Unusual choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "이건... 독특한 선택이오. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "A powerful weapon to battle a powerful foe! Are you thinking of a mace, an axe, or a sword?"
Text: "강력한 적에 맞설 강력한 무기로군! 철퇴, 도끼, 아니면 검을 생각하고 있소?"

TextEng: "A powerful, glorious weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "강력하고 영광스러운 무기로군! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hands! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "적들이 당신 손에 들린 나를 보면 눈에 공포가 떠오를 거요! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "벌써 뼈가 부서지고 피와 뇌수가 튀는 게 느껴지오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Very good. Now, what kind of awesome powers would you like me to attain?"
Text: "좋소. 자, 어떤 굉장한 능력을 갖추길 원하시오?"

TextEng: "There is something about a large steel ball crashing into a skull that is vaguely satisfying. Is that what you would like, or did you have something else in mind?"
Text: "큰 강철 구슬이 두개골에 박히는 데는 묘한 만족감이 있소. 그걸 원하시오, 아니면 다른 걸 생각하고 있소?"

TextEng: "An often overlooked weapon, but deadly effective, if I might say so myself. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "종종 간과되는 무기이지만, 내가 장담하건대 치명적으로 효과적이오. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "벌써 뼈가 부서지고 피와 뇌수가 튀는 게 느껴지오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "벌써 뼈가 부서지고 피와 뇌수가 튀는 게 느껴지오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: Which type of hammer? A light hammer or a warhammer?
Text: 어떤 종류의 망치요? 경량 망치요, 전쟁망치요?

TextEng: "I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "벌써 뼈가 부서지고 피와 뇌수가 튀는 게 느껴지오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I suppose speed must count for something over brute force. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "속도도 무력 앞에서 나름의 가치가 있겠소. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "A heavy flail or a light flail?"
Text: "중도리깨요, 경도리깨요?"

TextEng: "I suppose speed must count for something over brute force. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "속도도 무력 앞에서 나름의 가치가 있겠소. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I can feel the crushing of the bone and the splattering of blood and brains already! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "벌써 뼈가 부서지고 피와 뇌수가 튀는 게 느껴지오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "That's what everybody wants. What do you want me to do?"
Text: "누구나 원하는 거지. 내가 뭘 하면 되겠소?"

TextEng: "Gods grant me patience with halfwits! I hope you aren't just some common thug! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "제발 멍청이에게 인내심을 주소서! 당신이 평범한 깡패가 아니길 바라오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Ah, yes, I can see that we have something in common. The magical talking sword: a legend, a myth, now about to become reality. Let's be specific though, which do you prefer?"
Text: "아, 그렇소, 우리에게 통하는 게 있군. 마법의 말하는 검: 전설, 신화, 이제 현실이 되려 하오. 하지만 구체적으로 합시다, 어떤 걸 선호하시오?"

TextEng: "Ah... getting fancy are we? All right, what kind?"
Text: "허, 멋을 좀 부리겠다? 좋소, 어떤 종류요?"

TextEng: "Thrust, parry, slash, stab! We shall dazzle them with our quick blocks and vicious strikes. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "찌르고, 막고, 베고, 꿰뚫고! 날렵한 방어와 사나운 공격으로 적들을 현혹시킵시다. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "The weapon of mystical legends from the far east? Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "극동의 신비로운 전설 속 무기라? 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Argh... and shall we talk like pirates too? Hmm, no I think not. A scimitar? Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "으으... 해적처럼 말하기도 해야 하오? 흠, 그건 아니지. 시미터라? 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I suppose there must be some sort of significance in becoming insignificant; but damned if I know what it is! But it is your choice. Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "하찮은 것이 되는 데 무슨 의미가 있는지 모르겠소. 하지만 당신의 선택이오. 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "I shall be the most uncommon example of the most common weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "가장 흔한 무기의 가장 비범한 예가 되어 보이겠소! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "A powerful, glorious weapon! Very well, I shall assume that form for you quite happily."
Text: "강력하고 영광스러운 무기로군! 좋소, 기꺼이 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "What depths we must stoop to. I will have you know that once I was proud and powerful. <StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "이런 데까지 격이 떨어지다니. 한때 나도 자랑스럽고 강력했다는 걸 알아두시오. <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "That... does not sound very warlike. How am I to become a legendary power if you use me like a potion? Ah, well, fine."
Text: "그건... 별로 전투적이지 않소. 나를 물약처럼 쓰면 어떻게 전설적인 힘이 되겠소? 아, 뭐, 좋소."

TextEng: "Magnificent! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "장엄하오! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Ah, I can picture it now, a grand battle axe, striking death to our enemies! But maybe that is not what you are picturing; we should be more specific. Exactly what kind do you like?"
Text: "아, 눈에 그려지오. 거대한 전투 도끼가 적들에게 죽음을 안기는 모습이! 하지만 당신이 그리는 건 다를 수도 있으니, 구체적으로 합시다. 정확히 어떤 종류를 좋아하시오?"

TextEng: "Well, it is best you choose wisely. What type of weapon do you want?"
Text: "현명하게 고르는 게 좋겠소. 어떤 종류의 무기를 원하시오?"

TextEng: "Just imagine the fear in the eyes of our enemies when they see me in your hand! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "적들이 당신 손에 들린 나를 보면 눈에 공포가 떠오를 거요! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Why am I always called upon to make such sacrifices? The Gods must want to humble me! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "왜 항상 이런 희생을 강요받아야 하오? 신들이 나를 겸손하게 만들려는 게 틀림없소! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Our enemies shall cower before us! Very well, I shall assume that form for you."
Text: "적들이 우리 앞에서 벌벌 떨 거요! 좋소, 그 형태를 취하겠소."

TextEng: "Are you happy with your choice?"
Text: "선택에 만족하시오?"

TextEng: "Fine then choose again, and make sure this time. I hate having to change forms."
Text: "그럼 다시 고르시오. 이번에는 확실히 하시오. 형태를 바꾸는 건 정말 싫소."

TextEng: "Good, then let's carry on. Are there any other questions before I tell you what you must do next?"
Text: "좋소, 그럼 계속합시다. 다음에 해야 할 일을 알려주기 전에 다른 질문이 있소?"

TextEng: "You will have to kill or drive off the rats that have been gathering here. I can sense them digesting the flesh of your companions."
Text: "여기 모여든 쥐들을 죽이거나 쫓아내야 하오. 놈들이 당신 동료의 살을 소화하고 있는 게 느껴지오."

TextEng: "Well I hope you are happy. I, on the other hand, am not!"
Text: "만족하길 바라오. 나는, 반면에, 불만이오!"

TextEng: "Once you have killed them, we will speak again. Remember, you were becoming quite powerful before your untimely death, but you were dead so long, I had to steal from your life to bring you back..."
Text: "쥐를 처치하면 다시 얘기합시다. 기억하시오, 당신은 비명횡사하기 전에 꽤 강해지고 있었지만, 너무 오래 죽어 있어서 되살리기 위해 생명력을 빼올 수밖에 없었소..."

TextEng: "If you want to regain that power, you must get to the keep quickly... But scavenge some clothes while you're at it. It simply won't do to have people spy their future leader running about in <his/her> undergarments. A bad first impression, to be sure..."
Text: "그 힘을 되찾으려면, 빨리 거점에 도착해야 하오... 하지만 가는 길에 옷도 좀 주워 입으시오. 미래의 지도자가 속옷 차림으로 돌아다니는 꼴을 사람들이 보면 곤란하지 않소. 첫인상이 안 좋을 테니..."

TextEng: "Wealth, fame, love, oh... and your life back, if you count that as precious at all."
Text: "부, 명성, 사랑, 아... 그리고 생명을 되찾는 것도, 그걸 소중하게 여긴다면."

TextEng: "I guess the process of bringing you back really did cloud your mind. I am sure your companions can fill you in on the details once you raise them."
Text: "되살리는 과정이 정말로 정신을 흐리게 한 것 같소. 동료들을 되살리면 그들이 자세히 알려줄 수 있을 거요."

TextEng: "All I can say is that you were pursuing the Masked Man and this battlefield is where you finally caught up with him. It's a good thing you did, though things admittedly could have turned out a little better."
Text: "말할 수 있는 건, 당신이 가면 남자를 추격하다 이 전장에서 마침내 따라잡았다는 것뿐이오. 따라잡은 건 잘한 일이지만, 결과가 좀 더 나았으면 좋았을 거요."

TextEng: "I cannot explain fully right now, perhaps in time, once we trust each other more."
Text: "지금은 자세히 설명할 수 없소. 아마 시간이 지나 서로 더 신뢰하게 되면."

TextEng: "For now I have enough energy to change myself into a magic weapon for you and then bring back a couple of your companions."
Text: "지금은 당신을 위해 마법 무기로 변신하고 동료 몇 명을 되살릴 정도의 에너지밖에 없소."

TextEng: "You were pursuing your enemy, the Masked Man, and caught up to him as he lay siege to the Keep of Cyan. You died in the chaos, but luckily I resurrected you. I am afraid you lost a lot of life energy when I did it."
Text: "당신은 적, 가면 남자를 추격하다 그가 시안의 거점을 포위 공격할 때 따라잡았소. 혼란 속에서 죽었지만, 다행히 내가 되살렸소. 안타깝게도 그 과정에서 생명 에너지를 많이 잃었소."

TextEng: "Thanks to you, the Masked Man's forces have been scattered, at least for now. But we need to get you into the keep where you'll be safe. That's about the best summary I can give you."
Text: "당신 덕분에 가면 남자의 병력은 흩어졌소, 적어도 지금은. 하지만 안전한 거점 안으로 들어가야 하오. 대략 이 정도가 최선의 요약이오."

TextEng: "Which part of 'petty, unimportant questions' didn't you understand? I am here to give you the power and instruction you need to be someone important."
Text: "'사소한 질문으로 시간 낭비하지 마시오'의 어떤 부분을 이해 못 한 거요? 나는 당신이 중요한 인물이 될 수 있도록 힘과 가르침을 주려고 여기 있는 거요."

TextEng: "I want to cure poison."
Text: "독을 치료하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Battle Axe."
Text: "전투도끼."

TextEng: "One-handed Axe."
Text: "한손도끼."

TextEng: "Great Axe."
Text: "대도끼."

TextEng: "No."
Text: "아니."

TextEng: "Yes."
"What do I do now?"
Text: "이제 뭘 해야 해?"

TextEng: "I want to heal medium wounds."
Text: "중상을 치유하고 싶어."

TextEng: "What do I get out of this?"
Text: "내가 뭘 얻는 건데?"

TextEng: "What was I doing on this battlefield?"
Text: "이 전장에서 뭘 하고 있었던 거야?"

TextEng: "What do you mean, transform?"
Text: "변신이라니, 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I want to know what is going on."
Text: "무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 알고 싶어."

TextEng: "Why me?"
Text: "왜 하필 나야?"

TextEng: "I want the ability to heal light wounds."
Text: "경상을 치유하는 능력을 원해."

TextEng: "Very well, I am ready."
Text: "알겠어, 준비됐어."

TextEng: "What happens to the ones I banish?"
Text: "추방당하는 자들은 어떻게 돼?"

TextEng: "What if I don't want anyone?"
Text: "아무도 필요 없으면?"

TextEng: "Can you choose for me?"
Text: "대신 골라줄 수 없어?"

TextEng: "But how do I choose?"
Text: "어떻게 골라야 하는데?"

TextEng: "Let's get going then."
Text: "그럼 출발하자."

TextEng: "If you aren't going to be any help, then leave me alone."
Text: "도움이 안 될 거면, 가만히 있어."

TextEng: "So what is my ultimate goal here?"
Text: "여기서 내 최종 목표가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "So I have to figure this out on my own?"
Text: "혼자서 알아내야 하는 거야?"

TextEng: "Why is she doing all of this?"
Text: "그녀가 왜 이 모든 걸 하는 거야?"

TextEng: "Love?"
Text: "사랑?"

TextEng: "How much power does she have over me?"
Text: "그녀가 나에게 얼마나 힘을 행사할 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Who is she?"
Text: "그녀가 누구야?"

TextEng: "Let's get going."
Text: "출발하자."

TextEng: "I want you to do something special when you hit."
Text: "적중 시 특수 효과를 원해."

TextEng: "I'm ready to go."
Text: "갈 준비 됐어."

TextEng: "How will I know where to go in the keep?"
Text: "거점에서 어디로 가야 하는지 어떻게 알아?"

TextEng: "Why does this hermit have a secret tunnel to the keep?"
Text: "그 은둔자가 왜 거점으로 가는 비밀 터널을 알고 있어?"

TextEng: "How do you know about it?"
Text: "그걸 어떻게 알아?"

TextEng: "Who is attacking the keep?"
Text: "누가 거점을 공격하고 있어?"

TextEng: "I am ready to go."
Text: "갈 준비 됐어."

TextEng: "I have changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "You are going to have to tell me the truth sometime."
Text: "언젠가는 진실을 말해야 할 거야."

TextEng: "Who is your master?"
Text: "네 주인이 누구야?"

TextEng: "Not right now. Tell me later."
Text: "지금은 됐어. 나중에 말해."

TextEng: "I don't want to hear it."
Text: "듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Tell me."
Text: "말해봐."

TextEng: "I want you to confuse my opponents."
Text: "적을 혼란에 빠뜨리고 싶어."

TextEng: "Come, it's time we returned to the keep."
Text: "자, 거점으로 돌아갈 시간이야."

TextEng: "My brother?"
Text: "내 형제?"

TextEng: "Who cares about a grandma I don't even know? Let's go."
Text: "알지도 못하는 할머니를 누가 신경 써? 가자."

TextEng: "I think I'm beginning to like her..."
Text: "그 분이 좀 마음에 들기 시작하는데..."

TextEng: "She seems evil and vile!"
Text: "사악하고 비열해 보여!"

TextEng: "Only the strong survive..."
Text: "강한 자만이 살아남는 법이지..."

TextEng: "Do you remember anything of my past?"
Text: "내 과거에 대해 기억나는 게 있어?"

TextEng: "Wings?"
Text: "날개?"

TextEng: "Tell me about yourself, grandfather."
Text: "할아버지 자신에 대해 얘기해 줘."

TextEng: "That's why you became a demon hunter."
Text: "그래서 악마 사냥꾼이 된 거구나."

TextEng: "I want you to poison my opponents."
Text: "적을 중독시키고 싶어."

TextEng: "Did you like being my weapon?"
Text: "내 무기가 되는 게 좋았어?"

TextEng: "Would you like to be free?"
Text: "자유로워지고 싶어?"

TextEng: "I want massive criticals."
Text: "강력한 치명타를 원해."

TextEng: "I want you to daze my opponents."
Text: "적을 멍하게 만들고 싶어."

TextEng: "I want a specific damage bonus."
Text: "특정 피해 보너스를 원해."

TextEng: "Acid.  <StartAction>[This will add 1d6 points of acid damage.]</Start>"
Text: "산성. <StartAction>[산성 피해 1d6점을 추가합니다.]</Start>"

TextEng: "Electric.  <StartAction>[This will add 1d4 points of electric damage.]</Start>"
Text: "전기. <StartAction>[전기 피해 1d4점을 추가합니다.]</Start>"

TextEng: "I don't want you to be more powerful."
Text: "더 강해지는 건 원하지 않아."

TextEng: "Cold." <StartAction>[This will add 2 points of cold damage.]</Start>
Text: "냉기." <StartAction>[냉기 피해 2점을 추가합니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "Fire." <StartAction>[This will add 1 point of fire damage.]</Start>
Text: "화염." <StartAction>[화염 피해 1점을 추가합니다.]</Start>

TextEng: "I want a general +1 enhancement."
Text: "일반 +1 강화를 원해."

TextEng: "What powers can I choose?"
Text: "어떤 능력을 선택할 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Are we going to sit here and argue about it?"
Text: "여기 앉아서 따질 건가?"

TextEng: "What is happening?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "What is happening at the keep?"
Text: "거점에 무슨 일이 있는 거야?"

TextEng: "What plans?"
Text: "무슨 계획?"

TextEng: "Who is *we*?"
Text: "*우리*가 누구야?"

TextEng: "What are you?"
Text: "넌 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "넌 누구야?"

TextEng: "You said something about a weapon."
Text: "무기에 대해 말했잖아."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Where are my companions?"
Text: "내 동료들은 어디 있어?"

TextEng: "We must go to them now!"
Text: "지금 당장 동료들에게 가야 해!"

TextEng: "I want to ask questions about you."
Text: "너에 대해 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "Who is your master?"
Text: "네 주인이 누구야?"

TextEng: "How do I know I can trust you?"
Text: "어떻게 널 믿으라는 거야?"

TextEng: "What kind of weapon?"
Text: "어떤 종류의 무기?"

TextEng: "Ranged."
Text: "원거리."

TextEng: "I am ready."
Text: "준비됐어."

TextEng: "Sling."
Text: "투석구."

TextEng: "Shortbow."
Text: "단궁."

TextEng: "Longbow."
Text: "장궁."

TextEng: "Light Crossbow."
Text: "경쇠뇌."

TextEng: "Heavy Crossbow."
Text: "중쇠뇌."

TextEng: "Polearms."
Text: "장병기."

TextEng: "Spear."
"Scythe."
Text: "대낫."

TextEng: "Halberd."
Text: "미늘창."

TextEng: "Exotic."
Text: "이국적 무기."

TextEng: "I want something special."
Text: "뭔가 특별한 걸 원해."

TextEng: "Sickle."
"Kukri."
Text: "쿠크리."

TextEng: "Kama."
Text: "카마."

TextEng: "Double."
Text: "쌍수 무기."

TextEng: "Two-bladed Sword."
Text: "쌍날검."

TextEng: "Double Axe."
Text: "쌍날도끼."

TextEng: "Dire Mace."
Text: "철퇴봉."

TextEng: "Blunts."
Text: "둔기."

TextEng: "Quarterstaff."
Text: "육척봉."

TextEng: "Morningstar."
Text: "가시철퇴."

TextEng: "I want restoration ability."
Text: "회복 능력을 원해."

TextEng: "Mace."
Text: "철퇴."

TextEng: "Hammer."
Text: "망치."

TextEng: "Warhammer."
Text: "전쟁망치."

TextEng: "Light Hammer"
Text: "경량 망치."

TextEng: "Flail."
Text: "도리깨."

TextEng: "Light Flail."
Text: "경도리깨."

TextEng: "Heavy Flail."
Text: "중도리깨."

TextEng: "Club."
Text: "곤봉."

TextEng: "Blades."
Text: "도검류."

TextEng: "Specialty."
Text: "특수 무기."

TextEng: "I want to heal critical wounds."
Text: "치명상을 치유하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Rapier."
Text: "세검."

TextEng: "Katana."
Text: "카타나."

TextEng: "Scimitar."
Text: "시미터."

TextEng: "Short Sword."
Text: "소검."

TextEng: "Long Sword."
Text: "장검."

TextEng: "Great Sword."
Text: "대검."

TextEng: "Dagger."
Text: "단검."

TextEng: "Bastard Sword."
Text: "반수검."

TextEng: "Axes."
Text: "도끼류."

TextEng: "I changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
Text: "아, 돌아오셨군요, 주인님. 트립은 다시 만나서 너무 기뻐요. 트립의 솜씨가 필요하시겠죠, 트립이 따라갈까요?"

TextEng: "Trip does not want to stay here, good <master/mistress>. Please do not leave me here for long."
Text: "트립은 여기 있고 싶지 않아요, 좋은 주인님. 제발 오래 두지 마세요."

TextEng: "That man is more nervous than Trip. What is his problem?"
Text: "저 사람은 트립보다 더 초조해요. 뭐가 문제인 거예요?"

TextEng: "I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
Text: "그때는 비겁하고 지금보다 훨씬 이기적이었어요. 정말로, 인간이라는 정화조의 바닥이었죠."

TextEng: "I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
Text: "그때는 비겁하고 지금보다 훨씬 이기적이었어요. 정말로, 인간이라는 정화조의 바닥이었죠."

TextEng: "Then I stole some important documents from the thieves' guildmaster, who never liked Trip anyway, and he sent a few wererat assassins after me."
Text: "그러다가 도적 길드 두목에게서 중요한 문서를 훔쳤어요. 원래 트립을 싫어하던 두목이 늑대쥐 암살자 몇을 보냈죠."

TextEng: "They caught up to Trip as he was about to deliver the documents to the local authorities, who had paid Trip well."
Text: "트립이 문서를 지방 당국에 전달하려던 참에 따라잡혔어요. 당국은 트립에게 돈을 잘 줬거든요."

TextEng: "How I escaped was a combination of luck and quick thinking. Trip recovered from the ambush and managed to evade everything but the first bite."
Text: "운과 재치 덕에 탈출했어요. 트립은 매복에서 회복하고 첫 번째 물린 것만 빼고 전부 피했어요."

TextEng: "I burst into the magistrate's office with four wererats on my tail... well, not literally, since Trip did not have a tail yet. The office happened to be filled with a number of guards, who leapt to attack us."
Text: "꼬리에 늑대쥐 네 마리를 달고 판사 사무실로 뛰어들었어요... 그때는 꼬리가 없었으니 비유적으로요. 사무실에 경비병이 가득해서, 우리를 공격하기 시작했어요."

TextEng: "I screamed and curled up into a little ball. The guards must have dismissed me as unimportant, for they attacked my enemies and while they fought, I managed to crawl out the door and slip down into the sewers."
Text: "트립은 비명을 지르고 작은 공처럼 웅크렸어요. 경비병들은 트립을 무시하고 적을 공격했고, 싸우는 동안 트립은 기어서 문 밖으로 나가 하수도로 미끄러져 내려갔어요."

TextEng: "Ha, you made a funny! Tale... drag... oh, did you not mean to make a funny? Trip will hurry then."
Text: "하, 재밌는 말씀! 이야기(tale)가... 늘어진다(drag)... 아, 의도한 게 아니에요? 그럼 트립이 서둘게요."

TextEng: "The disease gripped me while I was hidden in the tunnels. I don't know how fast it normally infects a person, but my body was weak and it didn't take too long."
Text: "터널에 숨어 있는 동안 병이 트립을 잡았어요. 보통 얼마나 빨리 감염되는지 모르겠지만, 트립의 몸이 약해서 오래 걸리지 않았어요."

TextEng: "When Trip transformed into a wererat, I decided that my old life was over. I discarded my human guise, my human name and left the city never to return."
Text: "트립이 늑대쥐로 변했을 때, 옛 삶은 끝났다고 결심했어요. 인간의 모습도, 인간의 이름도 버리고 도시를 떠나 다시는 돌아가지 않았어요."

TextEng: "Undead taste so terrible! Makes Trip feel woozy in the tummy."
Text: "언데드는 맛이 너무 끔찍해요! 트립 배가 울렁거려요."

TextEng: "It does not matter who I was, or what I was. I am Trip. I am a wererat. People can deal with it, or just leave me alone! Trip is tired of talking. Let's go find a bone to gnaw on!"
Text: "누구였는지, 뭐였는지는 중요하지 않아요. 트립은 트립이에요. 트립은 늑대쥐예요. 받아들이든지, 아니면 트립을 내버려 두세요! 트립은 이야기하기 지쳤어요. 가서 뼈다귀나 갉아요!"

TextEng: "Yes. You see how much stronger and better Trip has become? It is like I am a whole different person."
Text: "네. 트립이 얼마나 강하고 나아졌는지 보이죠? 완전히 다른 사람 같아요."

TextEng: "That bite was the best thing that ever happened to Trip. Oh sure, I did not think so at the time, but in retrospect I am now a much happier rat than I ever was a man."
Text: "그 물린 것이 트립에게 일어난 최고의 일이었어요. 물론 그때는 그렇게 생각하지 않았지만, 돌이켜보면 인간이었을 때보다 쥐로서 훨씬 행복해요."

TextEng: "You have had some experience with people reacting negatively to your presence, but not the same as me. It might come as a shock to you, but Trip was not always the cute and lovable man you know now."
Text: "사람들이 부정적으로 반응하는 경험은 있겠지만, 트립과 같지는 않아요. 놀라겠지만, 트립이 항상 지금처럼 귀엽고 사랑스러운 남자는 아니었어요."

TextEng: "Trip... must not... must not listen to the voice! Must not betray my friend. Get out of my head, stupid voice!"
Text: "트립은... 안 돼... 목소리에 귀 기울이면 안 돼! 친구를 배신하면 안 돼. 머릿속에서 나가, 멍청한 목소리!"

TextEng: "Why not you, <master/mistress>? You treat me like your slave. Go fetch me magic items, Trip! Open that lock, disarm that trap, well, TRIP IS TIRED OF BEING YOUR SLAVE!"
Text: "왜 안 되냐고요, 주인님? 주인님은 트립을 노예 취급해요. 마법 아이템 가져와, 트립! 자물쇠 따, 함정 해제해, 트립은 노예짓에 지쳤어요!"

TextEng: "Wouldn't you like to know, <master/mistress>! You treat me like your slave. Go fetch me magic items, Trip! Open that lock, disarm that trap, well, TRIP IS TIRED OF BEING YOUR SLAVE!"
Text: "알고 싶으시겠죠, 주인님! 주인님은 트립을 노예 취급해요. 마법 아이템 가져와, 트립! 자물쇠 따, 함정 해제해, 트립은 노예짓에 지쳤어요!"

TextEng: "The voice is right. He whispers to me, and tells me how you will lead me to my death. You don't really care for Trip, you just use him to get what you want."
Text: "그 목소리가 맞아요. 주인님이 트립을 죽음으로 이끌 거라고 속삭여요. 주인님은 트립을 진심으로 아끼는 게 아니라, 원하는 걸 얻기 위해 이용할 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "You would just leave me for dead, when my job is done! No... no, <master/mistress> would not do this to Trip! I will not listen to this voice. I will not listen to his horrid lies!"
Text: "일이 끝나면 트립을 죽게 내버려 두겠죠! 아니... 아니, 주인님은 트립에게 그러지 않을 거예요! 이 목소리의 끔찍한 거짓말에 귀 기울이지 않겠어요!"

TextEng: "That is what you would like. To have more monsters come, so they can eat Trip! Well, Trip will not be here anymore! Trip is leaving, now!"
Text: "주인님이 원하는 게 그거죠. 더 많은 괴물을 불러서 트립을 잡아먹게 하려고! 트립은 더 이상 여기 없을 거예요! 트립은 떠나요, 지금!"

TextEng: "So you own this dump now? Trip likes it. Very homey."
Text: "그래서 이 허름한 집을 샀어요? 트립은 마음에 들어요. 아주 아늑해요."

TextEng: "Undercity! <Master/Mistress> remembers our dreams! <FirstName> is really Trips friend! I will not listen to the evil voice anymore!"
Text: "언더시티! 주인님이 우리의 꿈을 기억해요! <FirstName>은 정말 트립의 친구예요! 사악한 목소리에 더 이상 귀 기울이지 않겠어요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "You would hurt Trip? The voice was right! You cannot be trusted. Trip must leave now!"
Text: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "트립을 때리겠다고요? 그 목소리가 맞았어요! 주인님을 믿을 수 없어요. 트립은 지금 떠나야 해요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "You would let Trip be the master? No... no, instead of a master, we should be... friends... equals... partners!"
Text: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "트립이 주인이 되게 해주겠다고요? 아니... 아니, 주인 대신... 우리는... 친구... 동등한... 파트너가 되어야 해요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "It... it is too strong... no... <master/mistress> tells us lies. We must not listen! We must only trust the voice."
Text: <StartCheck>[Failed]</Start> "너무... 강해요... 아니... 주인님이 거짓말을 해요. 귀 기울이면 안 돼! 목소리만 믿어야 해요."

TextEng: "Trip must flee. Trip must run and hide somewhere far from here. Trip will go south... yes... south to safety!"
Text: "트립은 도망가야 해요. 트립은 달리고 여기서 멀리 숨어야 해요. 트립은 남쪽으로 갈 거예요... 네... 남쪽으로 안전한 곳으로!"

TextEng: "Trip will not be bossed around by you anymore! I am leaving and you cannot stop me!"
Text: "주인님한테 더 이상 이래라저래라 안 당할 거예요! 떠나겠어요, 막을 수 없어요!"

TextEng: "You... you would allow Trip to flee? You would let me go, even when you need me the most?"
Text: "정... 정말? 트립을 보내주겠다고요? 가장 필요할 때 보내주겠다고요?"

TextEng: "Sorry... sorry... Trip cannot stay. Trip must flee. Sorry."
Text: "미안해요... 미안해요... 트립은 못 있겠어요. 트립은 도망가야 해요. 미안해요."

TextEng: "Is your mind as weak as your body, lad? The voice speaks to me too, but it is easy to resist. It is our enemy, the Masked Man. Don't let him weaken you."
Text: "네 정신이 몸만큼 약한 건가, 이 녀석아? 그 목소리가 나에게도 들리지만, 쉽게 저항할 수 있소. 적인 가면 남자요. 약해지게 하지 마시오."

TextEng: "This voice, it is most compelling, but you must not give up hope, Trip. Listen to us, not the voice!"
Text: "이 목소리는 아주 설득력이 있지만, 희망을 포기하면 안 돼요, 트립. 목소리가 아니라 우리 말을 들어요!"

TextEng: "Nice place, nice girl; what does ugly Becket have that Trip doesn't?"
Text: "좋은 집에 예쁜 여자까지, 못생긴 베켓은 트립에게 없는 뭘 가지고 있는 거예요?"

TextEng: "Trip, I can hear the voice too. It is only the mind games of our enemy, the Masked Man. He is an illithid and such creatures always attack the mind. You must fight him!"
Text: "트립, 나도 그 목소리가 들려요. 적인 가면 남자의 정신 공격일 뿐이에요. 그는 일리시드이고 그런 존재는 항상 정신을 공격해요. 맞서 싸워야 해요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "It... it is too strong... no! I will not betray, <FirstName>! I will not! I will ignore you, like I ignore all the other voices!"
Text: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "너무... 강해요... 아니! <FirstName>을 배신하지 않겠어요! 절대! 다른 목소리들 무시하듯 너도 무시하겠어!"

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>! Trip is so sorry. I did not mean to think of betraying you. The voice kept whispering in my brain, right from the time we entered the cave."
Text: "아, <FirstName>! 트립은 정말 미안해요. 배신을 생각하려 한 건 아니었어요. 목소리가 동굴에 들어온 순간부터 계속 머릿속에서 속삭였어요."

TextEng: "Let us go and face our enemy! Trip shall rip out its throat and gnaw at its intestines!"
Text: "가서 적에게 맞서요! 트립이 목을 찢고 내장을 갉아줄 거예요!"

TextEng: "Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
Text: "아, 돌아오셨군요, 주인님. 트립은 다시 만나서 너무 기뻐요. 트립의 솜씨가 필요하시겠죠, 따라갈까요?"

TextEng: "Oh, you are back, <master/mistress>. Trip is so pleased to see you again. You must have need of Trip's skills, shall I follow you?"
Text: "아, 돌아오셨군요, 주인님. 트립은 다시 만나서 너무 기뻐요. 트립의 솜씨가 필요하시겠죠, 따라갈까요?"

TextEng: "The voices in Trip's head were right. Oh, woe is me. Trip has been abandoned."
Text: "트립 머릿속 목소리가 맞았어요. 아이고, 트립은 버림받았어요."

TextEng: "Trip is so pleased. The voices said you had abandoned Trip, but I did not give up hope!"
Text: "트립은 너무 기뻐요. 목소리들이 주인님이 트립을 버렸다고 했지만, 트립은 희망을 포기하지 않았어요!"

TextEng: "Wait, wait, wait! Trip has something to tell you, but you move so quickly, never letting Trip have time to breathe!"
Text: "잠깐, 잠깐, 잠깐! 트립이 할 말이 있는데, 주인님이 너무 빨리 움직여서 트립이 숨 쉴 시간도 없어요!"

TextEng: "Oh, of course, <master/mistress>. It is not as though Trip would have anything important to say. You just continue on with your more important duties."
Text: "아, 물론이죠, 주인님. 트립이 중요한 말을 할 리가 없죠. 더 중요한 임무를 계속하세요."

TextEng: "These goblins have very tasty ears. Trip wonders if there might be a market for them as a nice, light snack."
Text: "이 고블린들은 귀가 아주 맛있어요. 트립은 가벼운 간식으로 시장이 있을지 궁금해요."

TextEng: "Maybe the <master/mistress> has a flea in <his/her> loincloth and that is why <he/she> has such a short temper today?"
Text: "혹시 주인님 속옷에 벼룩이 들어간 건 아닌가요? 그래서 오늘 성질이 급한 거예요?"

TextEng: "Trip wonders if this is all really worth it. Maybe I should just slit my throat and have done."
Text: "트립은 이게 정말 가치가 있는 건지 궁금해요. 그냥 목을 그어버리는 게 나을지도."

TextEng: "What? Would you make Trip grovel for your forgiveness too? Are you so cruel?"
Text: "뭐요? 트립에게 용서를 빌라고요? 그렇게 잔인해요?"

TextEng: "Trip grovels for your forgiveness, <master/mistress>! There is no excuse for my awful behavior."
Text: "트립은 주인님의 용서를 구해요! 끔찍한 행동에 대한 변명은 없어요."

TextEng: "Trip is sorry, <master/mistress>! So very sorry! Trip shall bang his head on the ground until forgiven!"
Text: "트립은 미안해요, 주인님! 정말 미안해요! 트립은 용서받을 때까지 머리를 바닥에 박겠어요!"

TextEng: "Trip was not complaining so much as giving voice to the unreasonable demands of his <master/mistress>."
Text: "트립은 불평한 게 아니라, 주인님의 무리한 요구에 목소리를 낸 것뿐이에요."

TextEng: --------- Random Conversations begin here ----------
"Ouch, ouch, ouch! Too tight! Too tight! Help Trip get this belt loosened, please?"
Text: "아야, 아야, 아야! 너무 꽉 조여요! 너무 꽉! 트립 좀 이 벨트 풀어줘요, 제발?"

TextEng: "I took it from that nasty, foul fiend, Sir Becket! Now... please, before Trip faints!"
Text: "저 고약하고 비열한 악당 베켓한테서 가져온 거예요! 제발, 트립이 기절하기 전에!"

TextEng: "Oh! That is much better! That was a nasty belt. I think that Sir Becket is a real fiend. I hope you crush him in the election."
Text: "아! 훨씬 낫다! 못된 벨트였어요. 베켓은 진짜 악당이에요. 선거에서 박살내 주세요."

TextEng: "Mmm... smells like dead things in here. Can we stay for a while? Trip likes the ambiance."
Text: "음... 여기서 죽은 것 냄새가 나요. 좀 있을 수 있어요? 트립은 이 분위기가 좋아요."

TextEng: "Trip spots it in an old drawer in Sir Becket's home. It does not look nice, so Trip decided that ugly B (that's Sir Becket, don't you love Trip's name for him?) would not wear it anyway."
Text: "트립이 베켓 집 오래된 서랍에서 발견했어요. 안 예뻐 보여서, 못생긴 B(베켓 말이에요, 트립의 별명 귀엽지 않아요?)가 어차피 안 입을 거라고 생각했어요."

TextEng: Trip slips the belt off and hands it to you. "Trip did not like it anyway. It is a very pinchy kind of belt. Probably not very useful."
Text: 트립이 벨트를 벗어서 당신에게 건네줍니다. "트립은 어차피 싫었어요. 아주 꼬집는 벨트예요. 별로 쓸모없을 거예요."

TextEng: "No, see, that is the point, <FirstName>! He doesn't know we have it, and he doesn't deserve to have it, so we don't have to return it!"
Text: "아니, 봐요, 그게 포인트예요, <FirstName>! 우리가 가진 거 모르고, 가질 자격도 없으니, 돌려줄 필요 없어요!"

TextEng: "Fine, Trip will return it to his home." Trip slips the belt off and sulks.
Text: "알겠어요, 트립이 돌려놓을게요." 트립이 벨트를 벗고 시무룩해합니다.

TextEng: "These are funny-looking things, do you not think so, <master/mistress>?"
Text: "이건 재미있게 생겼죠, 주인님?"

TextEng: "Yenna, the pretty smelling woman, she gave them to Trip. Very nice of her, yes."
Text: "예나, 그 향기 좋은 여자분이 트립에게 줬어요. 아주 친절하죠, 네."

TextEng: "Why is it that everytime Trip finds something, it goes to the <master/mistress>? I could get very bitter about such things, if I was that kind of person."
Text: "왜 트립이 뭘 찾을 때마다 주인님한테 가는 건가요? 그런 사람이라면 트립도 아주 씁쓸해질 수 있어요."

TextEng: Trip howls in anguish. "Oh, <master/mistress>! You are too kind to Trip. I am filth! I am unworthy of your kind benevolence! I did not know you were only looking out for Trip's well-being!"
Text: 트립이 고통스럽게 울부짖습니다. "아, 주인님! 트립에게 너무 친절하세요. 트립은 쓰레기예요! 주인님의 자비로운 호의를 받을 자격이 없어요! 트립의 안녕만 생각하신 줄 몰랐어요!"

TextEng: "Take the bracers, <master/mistress> and do not give them back to unworthy Trip! Whip me with the cat-o-nines and teach me humility! Bad Trip! Bad, bad Trip!"
Text: "팔찌를 가져가세요, 주인님, 그리고 부적격한 트립에게 다시 주지 마세요! 고양이-아홉-꼬리로 때려서 겸손을 가르쳐 주세요! 나쁜 트립! 나쁘고, 나쁜 트립!"

TextEng: Trip sulks. "Yes, <master/mistress>. Trip is sure you will know what best to do with them. I am just a stupid servant."
Text: 트립이 시무룩해합니다. "네, 주인님. 주인님이 이걸 어떻게 쓸지 가장 잘 아실 거예요. 트립은 그냥 바보 같은 하인이에요."

TextEng: "This is the kind of place a rat could retire and really feel at home."
Text: "이런 곳이야말로 쥐가 은퇴해서 편하게 살 만한 곳이에요."

TextEng: "Well, I am almost certain she meant for me to have them. She left them sitting on a table, in open view, and she turned her back on the table a number of times while speaking to you."
Text: "글쎄, 트립에게 주려고 한 건 거의 확실해요. 테이블 위에 눈에 띄게 놔두고, 당신과 대화하는 동안 여러 번 테이블에서 등을 돌렸어요."

TextEng: "How much more evidence could you ask for? Trip was the soul of caution, but she made it too easy. So easy that I knew immediately that she was giving Trip permission to take them."
Text: "이보다 더 많은 증거가 필요해요? 트립은 아주 조심했지만, 너무 쉽게 만들어줬어요. 그래서 트립에게 가져가라고 허락한 거라는 걸 바로 알았어요."

TextEng: "That is true, Trip is very wise in these things. If she did not want me to have them, she would have been far more careful. She is, after all, a very powerful mage."
Text: "맞아요, 트립은 이런 것에 아주 현명해요. 트립에게 주기 싫었다면 훨씬 더 조심했을 거예요. 결국 그녀는 아주 강력한 마법사니까요."

TextEng: "Trip knew you would see reason! Thank you, <master/mistress>. You are too kind to Trip."
Text: "주인님도 이해할 줄 알았어요! 감사합니다, 주인님. 트립에게 너무 친절하세요."

TextEng: "Trip will return them immediately <master/mistress>. Trip did not mean to give offense." Trip bows to you, muttering angrily under his breath.
Text: "트립이 즉시 돌려놓겠어요, 주인님. 기분 상하게 하려는 건 아니었어요." 트립이 절하며 화난 듯 중얼거립니다.

TextEng: He flips them around in his hands, eyeing them from different angles. "That is the conclusion Trip was going to draw."
Text: 이리저리 뒤집어보며 여러 각도에서 살펴봅니다. "트립도 그런 결론을 내리려던 참이었어요."

TextEng: "This room looks very familiar to Trip! Not that I have been in this room before, but in one very much like it indeed."
Text: "이 방은 트립에게 아주 익숙해요! 여기 와 본 적은 없지만, 아주 비슷한 방에 가본 적이 있어요."

TextEng: "Trip will shut up, then. Trip knows how to be quiet, yes he does! Why, one time Trip was silent for a year! Or maybe it was only a month. Maybe less. A couple hours, anyways."
Text: "트립은 입 다물게요. 트립은 조용히 하는 법을 알아요, 네! 한번은 트립이 일 년 동안 침묵한 적이 있어요! 아니 한 달이었나. 아마 더 짧았을 거예요. 몇 시간 정도는요."

TextEng: "Well, one of my old guildmasters was a real paranoid type. Maybe because we kept trying to kill him. Anyways, he had rigged his hideout with all sorts of special traps."
Text: "글쎄, 트립의 옛 길드 두목 중 하나가 진짜 편집증 환자였어요. 아마 우리가 계속 죽이려 했기 때문이겠죠. 어쨌든, 그가 은신처에 온갖 특수 함정을 설치했어요."

TextEng: "He had special powder-filled crystals that would be crushed and explode when he pulled the lever that closed the doors. The setup to this is so similar, Trip finds it eerie."
Text: "문을 닫는 레버를 당기면 부서지면서 폭발하는 가루가 든 특수 수정을 달았어요. 여기 설비가 너무 비슷해서 트립이 소름 끼쳐요."

TextEng: "Lots of lovely stuff in here to steal... I mean look at. Heh heh."
Text: "여기 훔칠... 아니 구경할 예쁜 물건이 많네요. 히히."

TextEng: "Trip thinks that luring the manticore in here might be the harder part."
Text: "트립이 생각하기에 만티코어를 여기로 유인하는 게 더 어려운 부분일 것 같아요."

TextEng: "How would Trip know? Maybe if we look around we can find something like that."
Text: "트립이 어떻게 알아요? 어쩌면 둘러보면 그런 걸 찾을 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip likes this Thaddeus fellow. He has a black, twisted mind and excellent taste in magical amulets."
Text: "트립은 이 태디어스란 사람이 마음에 들어요. 어둡고 비뚤어진 정신에다 마법 부적 취향도 훌륭해요."

TextEng: "Did you not see the one hanging around his neck? It was nice and shiny, like a big metal sign saying, 'Steal me, Trip. I don't belong here. Take me with you!'"
Text: "목에 걸린 것 못 봤어요? 반짝반짝 빛나서 마치 '트립아 훔쳐가, 난 여기 있으면 안 돼, 데려가 줘!'라고 큰 금속 표지판 같았어요!"

TextEng: "Or maybe that was just one of the voices in my head, I'm not sure. Whatever, it was quite tricky getting the amulet from around his neck without anyone seeing me."
Text: "아니면 그건 트립 머릿속 목소리 중 하나였을 수도 있어요, 잘 모르겠어요. 어쨌든, 아무도 모르게 목에서 부적을 떼내는 건 꽤 까다로웠어요."

TextEng: "Lucky thing that I'm so good at my job, or Trip wouldn't have this nice little present for <master/mistress>."
Text: "트립이 일을 잘하니까 다행이지, 아니면 주인님을 위한 이 멋진 선물이 없었을 거예요."

TextEng: He shrugs. "Trip steals things he thinks are worth stealing and tries not to get caught by stealing worthless junk. Besides, the amulet definitely tasted of magic."
Text: 그가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "트립은 훔칠 가치가 있다고 생각하는 것을 훔치고, 쓸모없는 쓰레기를 훔쳐서 걸리지 않으려고 해요. 게다가 이 부적은 확실히 마법 맛이 났어요."

TextEng: "Trip is hurt by your wild accusations! I don't keep everything I steal! I give most of it to you. Sometimes <master/mistress> gives stuff to help Trip, so I give stuff back."
Text: "트립은 근거 없는 비난에 상처받았어요! 훔친 것을 다 가지고 있는 게 아니에요! 대부분 주인님에게 줘요. 가끔 주인님이 트립을 도와줄 물건을 주니까, 트립도 되돌려 드리는 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip likes to please the <master/mistress>."
Text: "트립은 주인님을 기쁘게 하고 싶어요."

TextEng: "How else would Trip know if the amulet is made of good materials? Trip just tries to please the <master/mistress>."
Text: "부적이 좋은 재료로 됐는지 어떻게 알겠어요? 트립은 그냥 주인님을 기쁘게 하려는 거예요."

TextEng: "Kobolds are so stupid. Trip doesn't know why anyone would befriend a kobold."
Text: "코볼트는 정말 바보예요. 왜 코볼트와 친구가 되려는 사람이 있는지 트립은 이해를 못 하겠어요."

TextEng: "<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> Trip just hoped you would be pleased I stole from an evil person, rather than a good one. The amulet definitely tasted of magic."
Text: <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> 트립은 그냥 악한 사람에게서 훔쳤다고 기뻐할 줄 알았어요. 선한 사람 대신에요. 이 부적은 확실히 마법 맛이 났어요."

TextEng: "Trip hopes you would be pleased with him. The amulet definitely tasted of magic."
Text: "트립은 주인님이 기뻐할 줄 알았어요. 이 부적은 확실히 마법 맛이 났어요."

TextEng: Trip suddenly bursts into song. "You take the rod in hand, you slip the end knob out, you push the button here in, and then you shake it all about..."
Text: 트립이 갑자기 노래를 부릅니다. "막대를 손에 잡고, 끝 손잡이를 빼고, 여기 버튼을 누르고, 그리고 흔들어..."

TextEng: "Eek! Trip did not mean for that to happen! It was an accident, <master/mistress>! Trip finds this magic stick hidden in goblin room."
Text: "윽! 트립은 그럴 생각이 아니었어요! 사고였어요, 주인님! 트립이 고블린 방에서 이 마법 막대기를 찾았어요."

TextEng: "It was the voices; they told me I should play with it! Oh, curse those foolish voices!"
Text: "목소리들이 시킨 거예요, 가지고 놀아보라고! 아, 멍청한 목소리 좀!"

TextEng: "Well, Trip was going to just give it to you, but I wanted to try it first... I mean I was just... it was just an accident. How should Trip know that playing with a stick would make lightning?"
Text: "그냥 주인님에게 주려고 했는데, 먼저 한번 해보고 싶었... 아니 그냥... 사고였어요. 막대기 가지고 놀면 번개가 나오는 줄 어떻게 알아요?"

TextEng: "Um... no, no, not voices... um, did Trip say that? I did not mean that... I meant... it was just an accident. How should Trip know that playing with a stick would make lightning?"
Text: "음... 아니, 아니, 목소리가 아니라... 음, 트립이 그랬어요? 그런 뜻이 아니라... 그냥... 사고였어요. 막대기 가지고 놀면 번개가 나오는 줄 어떻게 알아요?"

TextEng: "Yes, <master/mistress>. Trip is sorry." Trip hangs his head and heaves a great sigh as he hands over the rod.
Text: "네, 주인님. 트립이 미안해요." 트립이 고개를 숙이고 큰 한숨을 내쉬며 막대를 건네줍니다.

TextEng: "Maybe you buy Trip a new magic ring with gold from rod? I love rings, because they can make you invisible, or harder to hit, or regenerate body parts, and they taste good too!"
Text: "막대 판 금으로 트립에게 새 마법 반지를 사주실 수 있어요? 트립은 반지를 사랑해요. 투명해지거나, 맞기 어려워지거나, 신체 부위를 재생하거나, 맛도 좋거든요!"

TextEng: "Oh, Trip will not eat it. I just like to taste it and chew on it and stick it on the end of my tongue and pretend that my tongue is an extra finger."
Text: "아, 먹지는 않을 거예요. 그냥 맛보고 씹고 혀끝에 올려서 혀가 손가락 하나 더 있는 척하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip hates dwarves! Well, dark dwarves. Not dwarves with burning heads. Actually Trip would like to see some dark dwarves with flaming heads!"
Text: "트립은 드워프가 싫어요! 아, 다크 드워프 말이에요. 머리에 불 붙은 드워프는 아니고요. 사실 트립은 불타는 머리 가진 다크 드워프를 보고 싶어요!"

TextEng: Trip pouts, but doesn't open his mouth again.
Text: 트립이 입을 삐죽거리지만, 더 이상 입을 열지 않습니다.

TextEng: "I can hardly wait for Trip's new magic ring! It will be... precious to me."
Text: "트립의 새 마법 반지가 빨리 왔으면 좋겠어요! 트립에게... 소중할 거예요."

TextEng: "I think that Trip is in the right group then, if he is so strange."
Text: "그렇다면 트립은 딱 맞는 팀에 있는 거네요, 이렇게 이상한 거면."

TextEng: "Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip will try to control his enthusiasm from now on."
Text: "미안해요, 주인님. 트립은 앞으로 열의를 조절할게요."

TextEng: "Yes, yes, Trip is a good servant," Trip says sullenly, pouting to himself.
Text: "네, 네, 트립은 착한 하인이에요," 트립이 시무룩하게 혼자 투덜거립니다.

TextEng: "This place reminds Trip of the good old days. Back when I was a young thief and me and my pals would just go out and kill monsters and loot their treasure for no real purpose."
Text: "이곳은 트립에게 옛날 생각을 나게 해요. 젊은 도적이었을 때 친구들과 그냥 나가서 괴물을 죽이고 보물을 약탈했죠."

TextEng: "Well, Trip just thought you would want to know about something. It must not be important. Trip will just shut his mouth and sulk for a while now."
Text: "그냥 주인님이 뭔가 알고 싶을 거라고 생각했어요. 중요하지 않나 봐요. 트립은 이제 입 다물고 삐져 있을게요."

TextEng: "It is just that, well... I am rather disappointed in the treasure we are finding so far. I mean we killed the big, bad hobgoblin, and did you really think he was so tough?"
Text: "그냥, 글쎄... 지금까지 찾는 보물이 좀 실망스러워요. 큰 호브고블린을 죽였는데, 정말 그렇게 강했어요?"

TextEng: "I mean, he hurt all those soldiers and stuff and maybe they weakened him or something, but I expected him to put up more of a fight."
Text: "병사들을 다 다치게 하긴 했고 어쩌면 그들이 약화시켰을 수도 있지만, 트립은 더 세게 싸울 줄 알았어요."

TextEng: "Well... he was tough compared to a small goblin, but not so tough compared to a big dragon!"
