Text: "글쎄... 작은 고블린에 비하면 강했지만, 큰 드래곤에 비하면 별로였어요!"

TextEng: "I will try to help you as best I can, <FirstName>... I mean master."
Text: "최선을 다해 돕겠어요, <FirstName>... 아니 주인님."

TextEng: "This is the castle? Stinks of civilization. When you win, we put in walls and make a maze in here."
Text: "여기가 성이에요? 문명 냄새가 나요. 당신이 이기면, 벽을 세우고 미로를 만들어요."

TextEng: "Well, Trip did not fight a dragon himself, but one of the voices in my head was telling me about a dragon fight that sounded so scary, it made this fight seem boring."
Text: "트립이 직접 드래곤과 싸운 건 아니지만, 머릿속 목소리 중 하나가 드래곤 싸움 이야기를 해줬는데, 너무 무서워서 이번 싸움이 지루해 보였어요."

TextEng: "And the hobgoblin didn't have much treasure, except for this one thing that Trip found. Not like a dragon has treasure, that's for certain!"
Text: "그리고 호브고블린한테 보물이 별로 없었어요, 트립이 찾은 이것 하나만 빼면요. 드래곤 보물에 비하면 아무것도 아니에요!"

TextEng: "Oh, right. It is just that I found this ring on the hobgoblin's toe, and I thought maybe you might have missed it."
Text: "아, 맞아요. 호브고블린 발가락에서 이 반지를 찾았는데, 주인님이 놓쳤을 수도 있을 것 같아서요."

TextEng: "Trip was just going to keep it and not say anything, but Trip was not knowing what the ring would do and he thought maybe he should give it to <master/mistress>."
Text: "트립은 그냥 가지고 아무 말 안 하려고 했는데, 반지가 뭘 하는지 몰라서 주인님에게 드리는 게 낫겠다고 생각했어요."

TextEng: "Trip would not want to put the ring on and then find himself turned into a frog, or teleported into the middle of an ocean, or crushed by falling rocks, or any of the things that a magic ring might decide to do."
Text: "반지를 끼면 개구리가 되거나, 바다 한가운데로 순간이동되거나, 바위에 깔리거나, 마법 반지가 할 수 있는 온갖 나쁜 일이 생길 수 있으니까요."

TextEng: "That would be a wise idea. We would not want something bad to happen to the <master/mistress> and leave poor Trip all alone."
Text: "현명한 생각이에요. 주인님에게 나쁜 일이 생겨서 불쌍한 트립을 혼자 남겨두면 안 되니까요."

TextEng: "That would be very bad for Trip... I mean for you."
Text: "트립에게 아주 나쁠 거예요... 아니 주인님에게요."

TextEng: "No, no, no! Is that what Trip says? That was a bad thing that the voices said to do! Trip would not listen to them and decided to give you the ring!"
Text: "아니, 아니, 아니! 트립이 그랬다고요? 목소리가 시킨 나쁜 짓이에요! 트립은 귀 기울이지 않고 반지를 주기로 했어요!"

TextEng: "But do be careful with it, <master/mistress>. Trip heard an old mage once say that a ring is like a sharp sword, if you don't know how to use it, you'll probably lose a few toes."
Text: "하지만 조심하세요, 주인님. 트립이 옛날 마법사가 말하는 걸 들었는데, 반지는 날카로운 검 같아서 사용법을 모르면 발가락 몇 개 잃을 거라고요."

TextEng: "Trip is not sure what that means, but I have been extra careful ever since I heard it. Trip needs all his toes."
Text: "무슨 뜻인지 잘 모르겠지만, 그 말을 듣고 나서 트립은 아주 조심하고 있어요. 트립은 발가락이 다 필요하거든요."

TextEng: "For such a rich fiend, ugly Becket's home is not so grand."
Text: "그렇게 부유한 악당치고는, 못생긴 베켓의 집이 별로 대단하지 않네요."

TextEng: "Hee, hee, hee! I can't believe they missed my amulet! I thought they would have stripped it off of me with my other equipment."
Text: "히히히! 트립의 부적을 못 찾았어요! 다른 장비와 함께 빼앗을 줄 알았는데."

TextEng: "Trip does not care what anybody says, I need this amulet. Trip would give up a million gold to keep his wonderful amulet."
Text: "다른 사람이 뭐라 하든 트립은 이 부적이 필요해요. 백만 금화를 줘도 이 멋진 부적을 지킬 거예요."

TextEng: "It is the filth that keeps people from discovering the truth about Trip's treasure!"
Text: "이 때가 사람들이 트립의 보물의 진실을 알아채지 못하게 해주는 거예요!"

TextEng: "I got it the same day Trip became a wererat. I do not wish to talk about that experience right now, but I can tell you about how I found my amulet, if you wish to hear it."
Text: "트립이 늑대쥐가 된 날 얻었어요. 그 경험에 대해서는 지금 이야기하고 싶지 않지만, 부적을 어떻게 찾았는지는 말해줄 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Then I shall not bother you with my tale. Trip is simply pleased to keep his magic talisman."
Text: "그럼 이야기로 귀찮게 하지 않을게요. 트립은 마법 부적을 간직할 수 있어서 기뻐요."

TextEng: "I do not have to tell you anything, if you do not truly care to hear it. It is your choice."
Text: "진심으로 듣고 싶지 않다면 아무것도 말할 필요 없어요. 선택은 당신 거예요."

TextEng: "Perpetit... pepitant... whatever you try to say, I am not sure, but I will nod my head and pretend understanding. I will tell my tale."
Text: "퍼페팃... 페피탄트... 뭐라고 하려는지 모르겠지만, 고개를 끄덕이며 이해하는 척할게요. 이야기할게요."

TextEng: "I was huddled in fear in a sewer, hiding from the thieves who hunted me. A fever raged in my brain, the fever of lycanthropy. My stomach ached, my head burned and I needed food, badly."
Text: "트립을 쫓는 도적들을 피해 하수도에 웅크리고 있었어요. 수인병 열이 머릿속을 태웠어요. 배가 아프고, 머리가 타고, 절실히 음식이 필요했어요."

TextEng: "I saw some movement and realized it was a rat. A nice big juicy rat! It came towards me, sniffing to see if Trip was edible. How foolish it was!"
Text: "뭔가 움직이는 게 보였는데 쥐였어요. 크고 통통한 쥐! 트립이 먹을 만한지 냄새 맡으러 다가왔어요. 얼마나 어리석은 쥐인지!"

TextEng: "I lashed out my newly clawed and hairy paw, grabbed the rat, and tore it apart with my sharp fangs. The taste of the blood was like nothing I had ever enjoyed before."
Text: "새로 자란 털 많은 발톱으로 쥐를 낚아채서, 날카로운 송곳니로 찢었어요. 피의 맛은 한 번도 경험해 본 적 없는 것이었어요."

TextEng: "Trip is always ready to speak to you, fearless leader."
Text: "트립은 항상 두려움 없는 지도자와 대화할 준비가 되어 있어요."

TextEng: "Ick, why ruin perfectly good rat flesh with cooking. The salt is a good idea though. Trip might have to try that sometime."
Text: "으, 왜 완벽하게 좋은 쥐 고기를 요리해서 망쳐요. 소금은 좋은 생각이긴 해요. 트립도 언젠가 시도해 봐야겠어요."

TextEng: "Sorry, Trip gets carried away when he thinks of tearing the flesh of of small, furry animals... mmm."
Text: "미안해요, 트립은 작고 털 많은 동물의 살을 찢는 생각을 하면 좀 과해져요... 음."

TextEng: "Well, I prayed to the gods to protect me and when I clasped the rat skull, I felt like I was... more hidden. The thieves that were hunting me never found me, thanks to that skull."
Text: "신들에게 보호해 달라고 기도하고 쥐 해골을 쥐었더니, 더... 숨겨진 느낌이 들었어요. 트립을 쫓던 도적들이 결국 못 찾았어요, 그 해골 덕분이에요."

TextEng: "I don't know whether there was divine intervention, or maybe I just got lucky and found a rat with a magic skull. But Trip takes no chances and gives gold to shrines of Veragok, god of shadows."
Text: "신의 도움인지, 아니면 그냥 운 좋게 마법 해골을 가진 쥐를 찾은 건지 몰라요. 하지만 트립은 만일을 대비해 그림자의 신 베라곡의 신전에 금을 바쳐요."

TextEng: "You would be well served to remember that and go to the temple in the keep as soon as we get there."
Text: "그걸 잘 기억하고 거점에 도착하면 바로 신전에 가는 게 좋을 거예요."

TextEng: "Oh yes, it is powerful magic for Trip. It is Trip's lucky talisman. If it were not for this amulet, Trip would have died years ago."
Text: "아 네, 트립에게는 강력한 마법이에요. 트립의 행운의 부적이에요. 이 부적이 없었다면 트립은 몇 년 전에 죽었을 거예요."

TextEng: "It is a filthy and disgusting object."
Text: "더럽고 역겨운 물건이라고요."

TextEng: "You know, there are many shadows in Mistress Death's realm, but they are not the shadows that comfort and protect... no they are not!"
Text: "죽음의 여신 영역에는 그림자가 많은데, 위안을 주고 보호해 주는 그림자가 아니에요... 절대 아니에요!"

TextEng: "Trip notices things moving in those shadows. Things with nasty, sharp teeth. Trip is glad you brings me back. I'll just come with you then, right?"
Text: "트립은 그 그림자 속에서 뭔가 움직이는 걸 봤어요. 날카롭고 더러운 이빨을 가진 것들. 살려줘서 기뻐요. 그러면 트립이 따라가면 되죠?"

TextEng: "Trip thanks you <master/mistress>. You are such a good <master/mistress>."
Text: "감사해요, 주인님. 주인님은 정말 좋은 주인님이에요."

TextEng: "Say it isn't so, <master/mistress>! Do not abandon poor Trip to the hostile monsters! And Trip includes the people of the keep in that description!"
Text: "그럴 리 없어요, 주인님! 불쌍한 트립을 적대적인 괴물들에게 버리지 마세요! 거점 사람들도 포함해서요!"

TextEng: "Oh no! Do not leave Trip here, <master/mistress>! I beg of you; do not make me stay here long!"
Text: "안 돼요! 트립을 여기 두지 마세요, 주인님! 제발, 오래 두지 마세요!"

TextEng: "Eek! I don't wanna bite you and you don't wanna get any diseases, so just stay away from Trip!"
Text: "윽! 물지 않을 거예요, 주인님도 병 옮기 싫잖아요, 트립한테서 떨어져요!"

TextEng: "What... what is that smell? Like the stench of death... oh... wait... that's me. Never mind."
Text: "뭐... 뭐지 이 냄새? 죽음의 악취 같은... 아... 잠깐... 그건 트립이에요. 신경 쓰지 마세요."

TextEng: "You know, Jaboli, for all of your arrogance, Trip thinks you are not so bad."
Text: "자볼리, 거만하긴 하지만, 트립은 그래도 나쁘지 않다고 생각해요."

TextEng: "I am so glad I meet with your approval. I care so deeply for your opinion," Jaboli says, her voice steeped in sarcasm.
Text: "당신의 인정을 받으니 다행이네요. 당신 의견을 정말 소중히 여기는데," 자볼리가 비꼬는 목소리로 말합니다.

TextEng: "Trip is glad you care. Trip was thinking something and wanted to surprise you with my thoughts."
Text: "자볼리가 소중히 여겨줘서 기뻐요. 트립이 뭔가 생각해 냈는데 깜짝 놀라게 해주고 싶었어요."

TextEng: "That your head contains thoughts at all is of great surprise to me."
Text: "당신 머리에 생각이 있다는 것 자체가 놀라운 일이네요."

TextEng: "Yes, you and I are very similar! We are both intelligent and furry!"
Text: "네, 당신과 저는 아주 비슷해요! 둘 다 똑똑하고 털이 많잖아요!"

TextEng: "I really don't like where this is going."
Text: "이 대화가 어디로 가는지 불안해요."

TextEng: "I was just thinking that if I could just give you a little nibble, then you would make a lovely wererat-cat girlfriend!"
Text: "제가 생각한 건, 트립이 살짝만 물면, 자볼리가 멋진 늑대쥐-고양이 여자친구가 될 거라는 거예요!"

TextEng: "Trip does not want to be left here! Oh, do not be long, cruel <master/mistress>!"
Text: "트립을 여기 두지 마세요! 아, 잔인한 주인님, 오래 걸리지 마세요!"

TextEng: "Ew! Not in a million years! If the Gods came down and threatened to destroy the entire universe unless I did as you say, I would allow us all to die!"
Text: "으! 백만 년이 지나도 싫어요! 신들이 내려와서 안 그러면 온 우주를 파괴하겠다고 해도, 차라리 다 같이 죽겠어요!"

TextEng: "I'll give you some time to get used to the idea. You'll come around."
Text: "생각할 시간을 줄게요. 결국 마음이 바뀔 거예요."

TextEng: "You alright, Jaboli? Trip is concerned."
Text: "괜찮아요, 자볼리? 트립이 걱정돼요."

TextEng: "Of course I am alright. What would make you think otherwise?"
Text: "물론 괜찮아요. 왜 그렇지 않다고 생각하는 거예요?"

TextEng: "It is just that Trip hears you making little choking noises and thinks maybe you are choking up a hairball."
Text: "자볼리가 작은 목 막히는 소리를 내길래 어쩌면 헤어볼을 토하는 건가 생각했어요."

TextEng: "A hairball?!? Why you mangy, little rat! I am not a cat! I don't get hairballs!"
Text: "헤어볼?!? 이 더러운 쥐 놈! 난 고양이가 아니에요! 헤어볼 같은 거 안 토해요!"

TextEng: "Then why were you making that sound? It sounded much like a cat I once had when I was a human. It coughed up hairballs all the time, just before it died."
Text: "그러면 왜 그런 소리를 냈어요? 트립이 인간이었을 때 키우던 고양이랑 똑같았어요. 그 고양이도 죽기 전에 항상 헤어볼을 토했거든요."

TextEng: "Well, it's not a hairball! I was simply laughing about something."
Text: "헤어볼이 아니에요! 그냥 뭔가에 대해 웃은 거예요."

TextEng: "What was so funny? Trip could use a good laugh."
Text: "뭐가 그렇게 웃겨요? 트립도 한번 웃고 싶어요."

TextEng: "None of your business, wererat!"
Text: "당신 알 바 아니에요, 늑대쥐!"

TextEng: "Then I will go and hide out in the Mossy Tree. Trip hopes you will come and find him there soon."
Text: "그럼 이끼 나무에 가서 숨어 있을게요. 트립은 주인님이 곧 찾아와 주길 바라요."

TextEng: "You aren't even going to tell Trip why you were laughing? Why not?"
Text: "왜 웃었는지도 안 알려줄 거예요? 왜요?"

TextEng: "Because it was a private observation! Besides, you wouldn't even understand."
Text: "사적인 관찰이었으니까요! 게다가 당신은 이해도 못 할 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip knows what he understands. Jaboli has hairballs and is too proud to admit it. Maybe soon Jaboli dies like Trip's cat, then we see who doesn't understand stuff!"
Text: "트립은 뭘 이해하는지 알아요. 자볼리는 헤어볼이 있는데 너무 자존심이 세서 인정 못 하는 거예요. 곧 트립의 고양이처럼 죽겠죠, 그때 보면 누가 이해 못 하는지 알 거예요!"

TextEng: "You are an annoying little rat. I shall ignore you, now."
Text: "정말 짜증나는 쥐 같으니라고. 이제 무시하겠어요."

TextEng: "You are always so sad, Kaidala. You shouldn't be sad. Trip thinks you are quite beautiful, yes!"
Text: "카이달라, 왜 항상 슬퍼해요. 슬퍼하면 안 돼요. 트립은 당신이 꽤 아름답다고 생각해요, 네!"

TextEng: "Trip, you're just saying that because of the nice things I said to you."
Text: "트립, 내가 좋은 말 해줘서 그런 거죠."

TextEng: "No, no, no! Trip thinks you are quite pretty, like a gem with a small flaw. The gem is still pretty and and can be cherished as much as any other beautiful thing."
Text: "아니, 아니에요! 트립은 당신이 꽤 예쁘다고 생각해요. 작은 흠이 있는 보석 같아요. 보석은 여전히 예쁘고 다른 아름다운 것만큼 소중히 여길 수 있어요."

TextEng: "That... that is a very nice thing to say, Trip. Thank you."
Text: "그건... 정말 좋은 말이네요, 트립. 고마워요."

TextEng: "Look, Trip has found this and wants you to have it. It is also very pretty." Trip hands her a ring.
Text: "봐요, 트립이 이걸 찾았는데 당신에게 주고 싶어요. 이것도 아주 예뻐요." 트립이 그녀에게 반지를 건네줍니다.

TextEng: "Oh Trip, that is so sweet! I must admit, I never saw this side of you before."
Text: "아 트립, 정말 다정하네요! 이런 면이 있는 줄 몰랐어요."

TextEng: "Did Trip do something wrong?"
Text: "트립이 뭘 잘못했어요?"

TextEng: "It is pretty, like you! Wait, what are you doing? Don't put it on, it will..."
Text: "당신처럼 예뻐요! 잠깐, 뭐 하는 거예요? 끼지 마세요, 그러면..."

TextEng: "What is happening to me?" Kaidala collapses.
Text: "나한테 무슨 일이 일어나는 거예요?" 카이달라가 쓰러집니다.

TextEng: "Trip tells you it is pretty like you! Why you want to put it on? It sucks the strength from your limbs, being cursed and all."
Text: "당신처럼 예쁘다고 했잖아요! 왜 끼는 거예요? 저주받아서 팔다리에서 힘이 빠져요."

TextEng: "Then why did you give it to me?"
Text: "그러면 왜 나한테 준 거예요?"

TextEng: "Because Trip knows it is flawed beauty, like Kaidala. Pretty to look at, but can kill you real quick."
Text: "트립이 흠 있는 아름다움이라고 했잖아요, 카이달라처럼. 보기엔 예쁘지만, 순식간에 죽일 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Ugh... keep your little present, Trip."
Text: "으... 선물은 됐어요, 트립."

TextEng: "Sheesh, Trip will never understand some people!"
Text: "쳇, 트립은 절대 사람들을 이해 못 할 거예요!"

TextEng: "You are both a nymph and a druid, Kaidala, so Trip is thinking you know lots about nature."
Text: "카이달라, 당신은 님프이자 드루이드니까, 자연에 대해 많이 아시죠."

TextEng: "Yes, that is one subject that I would consider myself an expert. Why do you ask?"
Text: "네, 그건 제가 전문가라고 할 수 있는 분야예요. 왜 물어요?"

TextEng: "People... normal people, that is... well, they call me a freak... an unatural monstrosity... and I was just wondering, do you think I am unnatural?"
Text: "사람들이... 보통 사람들이... 글쎄, 트립을 괴물이라고 해요... 부자연스러운 흉물이라고... 그래서 궁금했어요, 트립이 부자연스럽다고 생각해요?"

TextEng: "<Master/Mistress> likes the sound and feel of explosions? And people think Trip is strange!"
Text: "주인님은 폭발의 소리와 느낌을 좋아하세요? 사람들이 트립이 이상하다고 하더니!"

TextEng: "That is a difficult question, Trip. On one hand, you have a disease. Disease is a perversion of nature, one that druids will usually fight to destroy."
Text: "어려운 질문이에요, 트립. 한편으로는, 당신은 병에 걸린 거예요. 병은 자연의 왜곡이고, 드루이드는 보통 파괴하려고 싸우는 것이에요."

TextEng: "So you think I should be destroyed?!?"
Text: "그러면 트립을 파괴해야 한다고 생각해요?!?"

TextEng: "Not at all, though I would cure you if I could... and if you wanted me to. But what I was going to say is that sometimes a disease can lead to the creation of something better... stronger."
Text: "전혀요. 할 수 있다면 치료해 주겠지만... 당신이 원한다면요. 하지만 말하려던 건, 가끔 병이 더 나은... 더 강한 무언가를 만들기도 한다는 거예요."

TextEng: "So you don't wish to destroy Trip? You think Trip is better than he was?"
Text: "그러면 트립을 파괴하고 싶지 않다고요? 트립이 전보다 나아졌다고 생각해요?"

TextEng: "I don't know what you were before, but you do seem to use your abilities to keep yourself alive. That you refuse to change to other forms makes me believe that you find strength you didn't have before."
Text: "전에 어떤 사람이었는지 모르지만, 능력을 살아남기 위해 잘 사용하는 것 같아요. 다른 모습으로 변신하기를 거부하는 걸 보면, 전에 없던 힘을 찾은 것 같아요."

TextEng: "I... I used to hate myself. I had a weak chin, a pocked face, and was very disliked by... well, pretty much everyone."
Text: "트립은... 자기 자신을 싫어했어요. 빈약한 턱, 곰보 얼굴, 거의... 글쎄, 거의 모든 사람에게 미움받았어요."

TextEng: "I can see how this form would be... um... better."
Text: "이 모습이 어떻게... 음... 더 나은지 알 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Do you think so? That is very kind of you to say. So would you like to give Trip a little kiss?"
Text: "그렇게 생각해요? 정말 친절하네요. 그러면 트립에게 작은 뽀뽀 해줄래요?"

TextEng: "Oh... um... it's just that fur makes me... sneeze... ah choo!"
Text: "아... 음... 그냥 털 때문에... 재채기가... 에취!"

TextEng: "I understand. Trip will find someone, someday. Thank you for your kind words though."
Text: "이해해요. 트립은 언젠가 누군가를 찾을 거예요. 친절한 말 감사해요."

TextEng: "Much better than hearing, 'click, KABOOM'. Trip will do his best."
Text: "'딸깍, 쾅!'보다는 훨씬 낫죠. 트립이 최선을 다할게요."

TextEng: "Calibast, you are very brave. How is it that you can rush into a battle and not worry about getting hurt?"
Text: "캘리바스트, 당신은 아주 용감해요. 어떻게 전투에 돌진하면서 다치는 걸 걱정 안 해요?"

TextEng: "I am strong enough to withstand many blows, so I figure that if I kill my opponents quickly, I can survive whatever attacks they land."
Text: "나는 많은 타격을 견딜 만큼 강하니, 적을 빨리 죽이면 살 수 있다고 보는 거요."

TextEng: "Ah, Trip was thinking perhaps you were not smart enough to know about danger, with your head on fire all the time."
Text: "아, 트립은 머리에 항상 불이 붙어 있으니 위험을 모를 만큼 멍청한 줄 알았어요."

TextEng: "You had better watch what you say about my mind, lad. You don't seem all that bright yourself."
Text: "내 정신에 대해 말 조심하는 게 좋을 거요, 꼬마. 자네도 그리 똑똒해 보이진 않소."

TextEng: "That's not what Trip meant, exactly. It is just that you never used some of the strategies that <FirstName> uses. Maybe because your brain is hot, you lose temper easily."
Text: "트립이 그런 뜻은 아니었어요. 다만 <FirstName>이 쓰는 전략을 왜 안 쓰는지 궁금했어요. 뇌가 뜨거워서 화를 잘 내는 건가요."

TextEng: "I'm about to begin losing my temper right now!"
Text: "지금 당장 화가 나려고 하는 중이오!"

TextEng: "That's what Trip meant. Your brain is sizzling in your skull and you lose all rational thought."
Text: "그게 트립이 말하는 거예요. 두개골 안에서 뇌가 지글거려서 이성적 사고를 잃는 거예요."

TextEng: "Get this filthy, little coward away from me, <FirstName>!"
Text: "이 더럽고 비겁한 놈을 나한테서 치우시오, <FirstName>!"

TextEng: "That's what Trip was saying. I was just wondering why he... acts so explosively."
Text: "트립이 말하던 거예요. 왜 그렇게... 폭발적으로 행동하는지 궁금했을 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "Trip didn't mean any harm in it. I was just wondering why he... acts so explosively."
Text: "트립은 나쁜 뜻이 아니었어요. 왜 그렇게... 폭발적으로 행동하는지 궁금했을 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "Moving quickly is what gets good folks like us killed! But Trip will follow <master/mistress>, even in foolishness."
Text: "빠르게 움직이는 게 우리 같은 선량한 이들을 죽이는 거예요! 하지만 트립은 주인님을 따를 거예요, 어리석은 행동이라도요."

TextEng: "I act that way because of little cretins like you, Ratboy, who don't know how to keep their mouths shut."
Text: "자네 같은 하찮은 놈들, 쥐인간, 입을 다물 줄 모르는 것들 때문에 그러는 거요."

TextEng: "Trip will be quiet now. Your eyeballs look like they are ready to burst into flames too."
Text: "트립은 이제 조용히 할게요. 눈알까지 불타오르려는 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Blast it, Calibast! Your flaming head makes it very tricky for Trip to avoid unwanted attention!"
Text: "이런, 캘리바스트! 불타는 머리 때문에 트립이 몰래 다니기가 아주 힘들어요!"

TextEng: "You really think that a giant wererat would be ignored if my head wasn't on fire?"
Text: "내 머리에 불이 안 붙어 있으면 거대한 늑대쥐가 무시당할 줄 아시오?"

TextEng: "It's called blending, dwarf. Trip is short compared to everyone else, so if I just hunch my shoulders a bit and keep my head down, people overlook me in a crowd."
Text: "그건 블렌딩이라고 해요, 드워프. 트립은 다른 사람보다 작으니까, 어깨를 좀 움츠리고 고개를 숙이면 군중 속에서 무시당해요."

TextEng: "An azer is not the same as a dwarf! Boy, whatever pity I ever felt for you is shortly being used up. Why don't you go gnaw on a bone?"
Text: "에이저는 드워프와 다르오! 이봐, 자네에 대한 동정심이 점점 바닥나고 있소. 가서 뼈다귀나 갉지 그러시오?"

TextEng: "Where is this bone? Does it have flesh on it? Wait... you... you are tricking Trip! The bone I should gnaw on is your leg!"
Text: "뼈다귀가 어디 있어요? 살이 붙어 있어요? 잠깐... 트립을 속이는 거죠! 갉아야 할 뼈다귀는 당신 다리잖아요!"

TextEng: "Sorry, <master/mistress>. Trip only tries to keep you safe."
Text: "미안해요, 주인님. 트립은 주인님을 안전하게 지키려는 것뿐이에요."

TextEng: "You'd better look to your own skin and leave the protection up to me."
Text: "자기 몸이나 걱정하고 보호는 나한테 맡기시오."

TextEng: "Maybe if he soaks his head in a bucket of water it puts out the flames. Then he could be like a normal dwarf."
Text: "머리를 물 양동이에 담그면 불이 꺼질 수도 있어요. 그러면 보통 드워프처럼 될 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Elf twins... yummy!"
Text: "엘프 쌍둥이... 맛있겠다!"

TextEng: "Trip always wants to stay in the shadows, so this is an easy thing!"
Text: "트립은 항상 그림자 속에 있고 싶으니까, 이건 쉬운 일이에요!"

TextEng: "What?!? I'll soak your head in a bucket of water for about an hour and see how many fleas float to the surface!"
Text: "뭐라고?! 자네 머리를 물 양동이에 한 시간쯤 담그고 벼룩이 얼마나 떠오르는지 보겠소!"

TextEng: "See? Trip makes a perfectly innocent suggestion and the dwarf explodes like a fireball!"
Text: "봐요? 트립이 완전 무해한 제안을 하면 드워프가 화염구처럼 폭발해요!"

TextEng: "I AM NOT A DWARF! I'M A FLAMING AZER; LEARN THE DIFFERENCE!"
Text: "나는 드워프가 아니오! 나는 불타는 에이저란 말이오! 차이를 좀 배우시오!"

TextEng: "Oh... sorry, <master/mistress>."
Text: "아... 미안해요, 주인님."

TextEng: "Just stay out of my reach, ratman."
Text: "내 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 있어라, 쥐인간."

TextEng: "That has yet to be proven. There a world of difference."
Text: "그건 아직 증명되지 않았어요. 엄청난 차이가 있거든요."

TextEng: "Not much if you'd take a nice long bath."
Text: "목욕 한번 하면 별 차이 없을걸요."

TextEng: "That little carrion-eater had better stay away from my legs. I don't need any filthy diseases!"
Text: "저 시체 먹는 놈이 내 다리에서 멀리 떨어져 있어야 하오. 더러운 병 옮기면 안 되니!"

TextEng: "Trip would chew on your head, but the meat would be too cooked for my tastes!"
Text: "트립이 당신 머리를 갉겠지만, 고기가 너무 익어서 트립 입맛에 안 맞아요!"

TextEng: "Just keep the filthy creature away from me."
Text: "저 더러운 놈 좀 나한테서 떨어뜨려 놓으시오."

TextEng: "That is just silly. That is what Trip does best!"
Text: "그건 바보 같아요. 그게 트립이 제일 잘하는 건데!"

TextEng: "Sorry, master. Trip will try to do better for you."
Text: "미안해요, 주인님. 트립이 더 잘하도록 노력할게요."

TextEng: "Unlocking locksies and chewing on rings, these are a few of Trip's favorite things!"
Text: "자물쇠를 따고 반지를 씹고, 이것들은 트립이 좋아하는 것들이에요!"

TextEng: "Trip did not mean to smell bad, if this is what brings you to change my pace."
Text: "트립이 냄새가 나서 그러시는 거라면, 일부러 그런 건 아니에요."

TextEng: "Trip will do as kind <master/mistress> suggests."
Text: "트립은 친절한 주인님이 시키는 대로 할게요."

TextEng: "Trip is not meant for making such bold melee! I will do my best, but I make no promises!"
Text: "트립은 그런 대담한 근접전을 위해 태어나지 않았어요! 최선을 다하겠지만, 장담은 못 해요!"

TextEng: "Trip does not like to attack. Always better to run or hide."
Text: "트립은 공격하는 걸 좋아하지 않아요. 도망치거나 숨는 게 항상 더 나아요."

TextEng: "Trip is always happy to take advice from <master/mistress> on how to dress."
Text: "트립은 주인님에게 옷 입는 법 조언 받는 걸 항상 좋아해요."

TextEng: "Trip will sniff at it and gnaw at it and see if I can discover what it is!"
Text: "트립이 냄새 맡고 갉아보고 뭔지 알아볼게요!"

TextEng: "I shall do my best to remain hidden. That is where Trip prefers to be, always."
Text: "최선을 다해 숨어 있겠어요. 트립은 항상 그게 좋아요."

TextEng: "This part of the city makes Trip feel uncomfortable. Too clean. Too rich."
Text: "이 동네는 트립을 불편하게 해요. 너무 깨끗하고. 너무 부유하고."

TextEng: "Talk? What do you want Trip to talk about?"
Text: "이야기요? 트립이 뭘 이야기하면 좋겠어요?"

TextEng: "Is there anything else humble Trip can do for you, <master/mistress>?"
Text: "보잘것없는 트립이 주인님을 위해 더 할 일이 있을까요?"

TextEng: "Trip could not do that, no. After all, if Trip was not beholden to <master/mistress>, Trip would not be here in these gods-forsaken lands of the north."
Text: "트립은 그럴 수 없어요. 결국 트립이 주인님에게 빚지지 않았다면, 이 북쪽 황무지에 있지도 않았을 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip owes <master/mistress> his life, and so I will follow you, even into such danger. Trip is pleased to serve you, <master/mistress>."
Text: "트립은 주인님에게 목숨을 빚지고 있으니, 이런 위험 속에서도 따를 거예요. 트립은 주인님을 섬기게 되어 기뻐요."

TextEng: "I am not dead yet, so Trip figures that is a good sign. Always good not to be dead yet."
Text: "아직 안 죽었으니, 트립은 좋은 징조라고 봐요. 아직 안 죽은 건 항상 좋은 거예요."

TextEng: "You want anything else from Trip?"
Text: "주인님, 트립에게 다른 것도 원하세요?"

TextEng: "Trip would like to rest soon. Not that I am tired, but sleep is always good."
Text: "트립은 곧 쉬고 싶어요. 피곤한 건 아니지만, 잠은 항상 좋은 거예요."

TextEng: "Now why you have to go and interrupt Trip's daydream with such nonsense? I was chewing on a nice, ripe, bloated carcass... yummy, yummy."
Text: "왜 그런 쓸데없는 소리로 트립의 백일몽을 깨우는 거예요? 트립은 멋지고 잘 익고 부풀어 오른 시체를 씹고 있었는데... 냠냠."

TextEng: "What? You're talking about the voices in Trip's head, aren't you? Well, there are no voices... so stop talking to me... all of you!"
Text: "뭐요? 트립 머릿속 목소리들 얘기하는 거예요? 글쎄, 목소리 같은 건 없어요... 그러니까 그만 말 걸어요... 여러분 다!"

TextEng: "Trip has a headache, probably from too much sun. Maybe we should travel only at night and sleep all day."
Text: "트립은 두통이 있어요, 아마 햇빛을 너무 쬐서 그런 것 같아요. 밤에만 이동하고 낮에는 자는 게 어떨까요."

TextEng: "Graves and tombs; one of the very best places for a hungry rat to hide!"
Text: "무덤과 묘지라니, 배고픈 쥐가 숨기 가장 좋은 장소예요!"

TextEng: "There is a thorn in Trip's paw, and it really hurts. Wait... ah... that's better!"
Text: "트립 발바닥에 가시가 박혔는데, 정말 아파요. 잠깐... 아... 나았다!"

TextEng: "Trip is fine. I am not hurt, or mangled, or chewed on, or digested, or anything!"
Text: "트립은 괜찮아요. 다치지도, 으깨지지도, 씹히지도, 소화되지도, 아무것도 안 됐어요!"

TextEng: "Darkness! Darkness all around! The shadows have come for Trip and soon he will be dead!"
Text: "어둠! 사방이 어둠이에요! 그림자가 트립을 잡으러 와서 곧 죽을 거예요!"

TextEng: "Almost dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
Text: "거의 죽어가요... 주인님! 트립은... 치유사가... 필요해요!"

TextEng: "Close to dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
Text: "죽기 직전이에요... 주인님! 트립은... 치유사가... 필요해요!"

TextEng: "Dying... <master/mistress>! Trip... needs... healer!"
Text: "죽어가요... 주인님! 트립은... 치유사가... 필요해요!"

TextEng: "Trip thinks he might have eaten a bit of rotting meat. I do not feel so good."
Text: "트립이 상한 고기를 좀 먹은 것 같아요. 몸이 안 좋아요."

TextEng: "Trip feels sick. I know I am always diseased, but now I feel more so than before."
Text: "트립이 아파요. 원래 항상 병에 걸려 있긴 한데, 지금은 그때보다 더 아파요."

TextEng: Trip blinks rapidly at your question. "Trip has high aspirations. I would like to make a big dungeon and fill it with monsters and traps and spells and treasures and make people pay to go into it."
Text: 트립이 질문에 눈을 빠르게 깜빡입니다. "트립은 큰 포부가 있어요. 거대한 던전을 만들어서 괴물과 함정과 주문과 보물로 가득 채우고 사람들에게 입장료를 받고 싶어요."

TextEng: "When you are the adventurer, the monsters try to kill you. When you are the monster, adventurers try to kill you. Trip is tired of being both."
Text: "모험가일 때는 괴물이 죽이려 하고, 괴물일 때는 모험가가 죽이려 해요. 트립은 둘 다 하는 게 지쳤어요."

TextEng: "What dark, secrets might this hidden passage hold? Trip is curious."
Text: "이 숨겨진 통로에는 어떤 어둡고 은밀한 비밀이 있을까요? 트립은 궁금해요."

TextEng: "If Trip ran a famous adventure place that both monsters and adventurers wanted to be, nobody would want to be killing him!"
Text: "트립이 괴물과 모험가 모두 오고 싶어하는 유명한 모험 장소를 운영하면, 아무도 트립을 죽이려 하지 않을 거예요!"

TextEng: Trip shrugs, "Maybe Trip can find some crazy wizard to help me. Or profit sharing."
Text: 트립이 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "어쩌면 트립이 미친 마법사를 찾아서 도움을 받을 수 있을 거예요. 아니면 수익 분배로."

TextEng: "Yes, Trip will offer monsters a split of loot from people they kill and Trip keeps the rest, plus the entrance fee."
Text: "네, 트립은 괴물들에게 죽인 사람의 전리품 일부를 나눠주고 나머지와 입장료는 트립이 가져요."

TextEng: "To attract the most attention, Trip thinks it would be best to have it underneath a large city. I will call it something simple and easy to remember... maybe, Undercity!"
Text: "가장 큰 관심을 끌려면, 큰 도시 밑에 만드는 게 좋을 것 같아요. 간단하고 기억하기 쉬운 이름을 붙일 거예요... 어쩌면, 언더시티!"

TextEng: "If you are an adventurer, you have to go and search around and find monsters to battle and sometimes those monsters have no treasure."
Text: "모험가라면, 돌아다니며 싸울 괴물을 찾아야 하는데, 가끔 그 괴물들한테 보물이 없어요."

TextEng: "If monsters and treasure were all in one challenging place, Trip thinks people would pay lots of gold to go there, in hopes of proving themselves and finding a big treasure trove."
Text: "괴물과 보물이 한곳에 모여 있는 도전적인 장소가 있으면, 사람들이 자신을 증명하고 큰 보물을 찾기 위해 많은 금을 낼 거라고 생각해요."

TextEng: "Trip always wants to know what good <master/mistress> thinks."
Text: "트립은 항상 좋은 주인님이 어떻게 생각하는지 알고 싶어요."

TextEng: "Trip has no idea what you are talking about, <master/mistress>. I think you mean you would not like such a place, but that is alright. I think there are many out there who would like it."
Text: "트립은 주인님이 무슨 말을 하는지 모르겠어요. 그런 곳이 싫다는 뜻인 것 같은데, 괜찮아요. 좋아하는 사람은 많을 거예요."

TextEng: "Trip cannot please everyone, but he hopes to please enough to make me lots of gold."
Text: "트립은 모든 사람을 만족시킬 수 없지만, 충분히 많은 사람을 만족시켜서 금을 많이 벌고 싶어요."

TextEng: "We should get going again. Staying in one spot for very long makes Trip nervous."
Text: "다시 출발해야 해요. 한곳에 오래 있으면 트립은 불안해져요."

TextEng: "That merchant over there is selling dead rats! Trip should scare him and say I come in revenge for my kin!"
Text: "저기 상인이 죽은 쥐를 팔고 있어요! 트립이 가서 겁을 줘야겠어요, 동족의 복수를 위해 왔다고!"

TextEng: "Trip is pleased that you like his idea, and I think such a big undertaking would need more than just Trip's efforts."
Text: "트립은 주인님이 제 아이디어를 좋아해 주셔서 기뻐요. 이렇게 큰 사업은 트립 혼자만으로는 부족할 거예요."

TextEng: "When that day comes, perhaps Trip and <FirstName> will work together in equality. Then Trip can stop calling you <master/mistress>."
Text: "그날이 오면, 어쩌면 트립과 <FirstName>이 동등하게 함께 일할 수 있을 거예요. 그때는 트립이 주인님이라고 부르지 않아도 되겠죠."

TextEng: "Trip has heard that before. Trip is not surprised that <master/mistress> would not like his idea much, but I think there are many out there who would like it."
Text: "트립은 그 말 전에도 들어봤어요. 주인님이 제 아이디어를 별로 좋아하지 않을 거라고 놀랍진 않지만, 좋아하는 사람은 많을 거예요."

TextEng: "Which part: the fleas, the overwhelming desire to chew on dead things, the voices in my head, or the way everybody always stares at me? "
Text: "어느 부분이요: 벼룩, 죽은 것을 씹고 싶은 압도적 욕구, 머릿속 목소리, 아니면 사람들이 항상 쳐다보는 거요?"

TextEng: He shrugs. "Trip loves being a wererat." Scratching furriously, he turns away.
Text: 그가 어깨를 으쓱합니다. "트립은 늑대쥐인 게 좋아요." 미친 듯이 긁으며 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "Life was so lonely before the voices. Trip likes being a wererat, for the voices more than anything. Of course the voices didn't start until I met you."
Text: "목소리들 이전에는 외로웠어요. 트립은 무엇보다 목소리 때문에 늑대쥐인 게 좋아요. 물론 목소리는 당신을 만나고 나서 시작됐지만요."

TextEng: "Not really. I suppose Trip had the fleas before I became a wererat. People often stared at me as a human, since I was so ugly. Chewing on dead things is new, though. And the voices started when I met you."
Text: "그렇진 않아요. 아마 벼룩은 늑대쥐가 되기 전부터 있었을 거예요. 사람일 때도 너무 못생겨서 사람들이 쳐다봤고요. 죽은 걸 씹는 건 새로운 거예요. 그리고 목소리는 당신을 만나고 나서 시작됐고요."

TextEng: "Yes. Trip was enjoying his travels through the countryside, frightening the locals and eating their chi... I mean livestock."
Text: "네. 트립은 시골을 돌아다니며 현지인들을 겁주고 그들의 닭... 아니 가축을 먹으며 여행을 즐기고 있었어요."

TextEng: "Then you and the flaming dwarf and cathead caught me. I don't know how well you remember it, but the image is burned into Trip's memory."
Text: "그때 당신과 불타는 드워프와 고양이머리가 트립을 잡았어요. 당신이 얼마나 기억하는지 모르겠지만, 그 장면은 트립의 기억에 각인되어 있어요."

TextEng: "Apparently you had been paid to find me, though I doubt it could have been much, coming from farmers."
Text: "누군가 트립을 찾아달라고 돈을 냈나 봐요. 농부들한테서 나온 거라면 많지는 않았겠지만요."

TextEng: "This tavern is too clean. There must be a proper dive in this city for Trip to drink at."
Text: "이 선술집은 너무 깨끗해요. 이 도시에 트립이 마실 만한 제대로 된 허름한 술집이 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "And then you took Trip's treasure, which is why you allowed Trip to live, was it not?"
Text: "그리고 트립의 보물을 가져갔죠. 그래서 트립을 살려둔 거 아니에요?"

TextEng: "You did find Trip with treasure. That was why Trip was allowed to live, was it not?"
Text: "트립을 보물과 함께 발견했잖아요. 그래서 트립을 살려둔 거 아니에요?"

TextEng: "Yes, you have love for strange creatures, which causes some problems for Trip, though I was happy for it when you allowed me to live."
Text: "네, 당신은 이상한 생물을 사랑하는 마음이 있어요. 그게 트립에게 좀 문제가 되긴 하지만, 살려줬을 때는 기뻤어요."

TextEng: "Yes, you seem to enjoy these heroic moments more than Trip would like. But I was glad for your heroic nature when you let me live."
Text: "네, 당신은 이런 영웅적인 순간을 트립이 원하는 것보다 더 즐기는 것 같아요. 하지만 살려줬을 때는 영웅적인 성격이 고마웠어요."

TextEng: "And Trip is very useful, isn't he, <master/mistress>? You chose me over others in the group, and I am thankful. I shall continue to be useful to you. Trip shall find you more things and make you rich and powerful."
Text: "그리고 트립은 아주 유용하죠, 주인님? 팀에서 다른 사람 대신 트립을 선택했잖아요, 감사해요. 계속 유용할 거예요. 트립이 더 많은 물건을 찾아서 부자가 되고 강해지게 해줄게요."

TextEng: "Oh, <master/mistress>, Trip has changed his ways. Trip is the soul of kindness and love when it comes to doing your will. I will feed the hungry and clothe the poor, if that is your wish."
Text: "아, 주인님, 트립은 개과천선했어요. 주인님의 뜻을 행할 때 트립은 친절과 사랑의 화신이에요. 주인님이 원하시면 배고픈 자를 먹이고 가난한 자에게 옷을 입히겠어요."

TextEng: "And that is why Trip has such deep care for you, <master/mistress>! Trip has the same love for pretty things as you do, so we work well together."
Text: "그래서 트립이 주인님을 깊이 아끼는 거예요! 트립도 주인님처럼 예쁜 것을 좋아해요. 그래서 우리는 잘 맞아요."

TextEng: "Oh, and kind <master/mistress>, Trip will grovel at your feet for as long as you wish. Trip is humbled by your mighty presence and simply wishes to bask in your noble glow."
Text: "아, 그리고 친절한 주인님, 트립은 원하시는 만큼 발밑에서 엎드려 있을게요. 트립은 주인님의 위대한 존재감에 겸허해지며 고귀한 빛 속에서 쬐고 싶을 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "You should not be worried about Trip's loyalty. You are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
Text: "트립의 충성심을 걱정하지 마세요. 주인님은 정말 좋은 주인님이에요. 상상도 못 할 위험한 곳으로 이끌면서도 트립은 멍에와 채찍을 거의 느끼지 못해요!"

TextEng: "You... you call Trip a friend? You are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
Text: "트... 트립을 친구라고 부르세요? 주인님은 정말 좋은 주인님이에요. 상상도 못 할 위험한 곳으로 이끌면서도 트립은 멍에와 채찍을 거의 느끼지 못해요!"

TextEng: "Trip should make an offering at Veragok's shrine. Or maybe just a prayer. Cheaper that way."
Text: "트립은 베라곡의 신전에 공물을 바쳐야겠어요. 아니면 그냥 기도만. 그쪽이 더 싸니까요."

TextEng: He sniffles. "Trip thinks we should get going now. You have many important things for Trip to help you with. We should go do them now."
Text: 그가 훌쩍입니다. "트립은 이제 출발해야 할 것 같아요. 주인님이 트립의 도움을 필요로 하는 중요한 일이 많잖아요. 가서 해요."

TextEng: "And you are such a good <master/mistress>. Trip hardly feels the yoke and whip as you lead me into places too dangerous to imagine!"
Text: "그리고 주인님은 정말 좋은 주인님이에요. 상상도 못 할 위험한 곳으로 이끌면서도 트립은 멍에와 채찍을 거의 느끼지 못해요!"

TextEng: "Like this place. Why, Trip would never have come here in a thousand years... would never even have dreamed of chasing after a beholder, and yet here I am."
Text: "이곳처럼요. 트립은 천 년이 지나도 절대 여기 오지 않았을 거예요... 비홀더를 쫓아갈 생각은 꿈에도 못 했을 거예요, 그런데 여기 있네요."

TextEng: "Watch what names you call me, Trip, or we shall play a game of cat and mouse."
Text: "뭐라고 부르는지 조심해, 트립. 아니면 고양이와 쥐 게임을 하게 될 거야."

TextEng: "I wanted to kill you then just about as bad as I've ever wanted to kill anyone."
Text: "그때 당신을 죽이고 싶었어요. 누구를 죽이고 싶었던 것 중 거의 최고였어요."

TextEng: "What do you mean, I do not like it? Trip loves it! Life is much more interesting now, especially around you. Of course, the voices didn't start talking to me until I met you."
Text: "싫다니 무슨 소리예요? 트립은 좋아해요! 인생이 훨씬 더 재미있어졌어요, 특히 당신 주변에서. 물론 목소리는 당신을 만나고 나서 말하기 시작했지만요."

TextEng: "You do not know what it is like to be ugly and shunned by people, <FirstName>. It might come as a shock to you, but Trip was not always the cute and lovable man you know now."
Text: "못생기고 사람들에게 기피당하는 게 어떤 건지 모를 거예요, <FirstName>. 놀라겠지만, 트립이 항상 지금처럼 귀엽고 사랑스러운 남자는 아니었어요."

TextEng: "Trip was once an ugly, selfish man. Small, pockmarked and hated by all, I became bitter and self-absorbed. I was a petty thief, with few friends to call my own."
Text: "트립은 한때 못생기고 이기적인 남자였어요. 작고, 곰보자국 투성이에 모두에게 미움받아서, 비뚤어지고 자기중심적이 됐어요. 친구도 거의 없는 소매치기였죠."

TextEng: "I was cowardly then, and much more selfish than I am now. Truly, I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
Text: "그때는 비겁하고 지금보다 훨씬 이기적이었어요. 정말로, 인간이라는 정화조의 바닥이었죠."

TextEng: "That is because you did not know the old, horrible Trip. I am much better than I once was. I was at the bottom of the cesspool called humanity."
Text: "옛날의 끔찍한 트립을 몰랐으니 그래요. 지금은 예전보다 훨씬 나아졌어요. 인간이라는 정화조의 바닥이었거든요."

TextEng: "Not yet. I will come back for you."
Text: "아직이야. 다시 올게."

TextEng: "You aren't too bad a companion, Trip."
Text: "넌 나쁘지 않은 동료야, 트립."

TextEng: "So you don't like being a wererat?"
Text: "그러면 늑대쥐인 게 싫어?"

TextEng: "Me?"
"Why don't you ever assume your human form?"
Text: "왜 인간 모습으로 안 돌아가?"

TextEng: "I want to change your tactics."
Text: "네 전술을 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "Now you are just a cowardly, ugly, selfish rat."
Text: "지금은 그냥 비겁하고, 못생기고, 이기적인 쥐지."

TextEng: "I'm not seeing much of a change here."
Text: "별로 변한 것 같지 않은데."

TextEng: "I am glad you have... improved."
Text: "나아졌다니... 다행이네."

TextEng: "So you were worse than you are now?"
Text: "지금보다 더 나빴다고?"

TextEng: "How did you survive that meeting?"
Text: "그 만남에서 어떻게 살아남았어?"

TextEng: "I don't want to change anything else right now."
Text: "지금은 다른 걸 바꾸고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Hurry up, this tale is starting to drag."
Text: "빨리 해, 이야기가 늘어지기 시작했어."

TextEng: "What happened next?"
Text: "그다음에는?"

TextEng: "You betrayed your master?"
Text: "주인을 배신한 거야?"

TextEng: "That's how you became a wererat?"
Text: "그래서 늑대쥐가 된 거야?"

TextEng: "I want you to leave any traps that you see alone."
Text: "보이는 함정은 그냥 놔둬."

TextEng: "What is the voice saying, Trip?"
Text: "목소리가 뭐라고 해, 트립?"

TextEng: "Betray who? Better not be me!"
Text: "누구를 배신한다고? 나 아니겠지!"

TextEng: "Trip, what's happening?"
Text: "트립, 무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "Trip, why are you getting so excited?"
Text: "트립, 왜 이렇게 흥분하는 거야?"

TextEng: "You had better stop yelling, Trip, before you draw more monsters to us."
Text: "소리 좀 지르지 마, 트립. 괴물이 몰려올라."

TextEng: "Trip, remember your dream! Remember the dungeon!"
Text: "트립, 꿈을 기억해! 던전을 기억해!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Intimidate]</Start> "Back down, Trip! I don't want to have to hurt you!"
Text: <StartCheck>[위협]</Start> "물러서, 트립! 다치게 하고 싶지 않아!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> "Would you like to be the master now, Trip?"
Text: <StartCheck>[허세]</Start> "이제 네가 주인이 되고 싶어, 트립?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "Fight the voice, Trip!"
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "목소리에 맞서 싸워, 트립!"

TextEng: "You coward! You stay with me or I'll end your life now!"
Text: "비겁한 놈! 남아서 돕든가, 아니면 여기서 끝장내 주겠어!"

TextEng: "Trip, I am your friend. Trust me, just one last time."
Text: "트립, 나는 네 친구야. 딱 한 번만 더 믿어줘."

TextEng: "Very well. I release you, Trip. Do as you must."
Text: "좋아. 보내줄게, 트립. 해야 할 일을 해."

TextEng: "I want you to disarm any traps that you see."
Text: "보이는 함정은 전부 해제해 줘."

TextEng: "I need your help. Just this one last mission, and then you can go where you want."
Text: "도움이 필요해. 이번 임무 하나만 더, 그 다음엔 원하는 곳으로 가도 돼."

TextEng: "No, stay here for the moment."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Yes, come with me."
Text: "그래, 나와 함께 가자."

TextEng: "Not right now. I'm busy."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 바빠."

TextEng: "Quit complaining, Trip."
Text: "불평 좀 그만해, 트립."

TextEng: "What do you want, Trip?"
Text: "뭘 원하는 거야, 트립?"

TextEng: "Trip, did you steal that from someone in the keep?"
Text: "트립, 거점 사람한테서 훔친 거야?"

TextEng: "First tell me where you got that new belt."
Text: "먼저 그 새 벨트를 어디서 구했는지 말해봐."

TextEng: "Here." <StartAction>[Help Trip loosen his *new* belt.]</Start>
Text: "여기." <StartAction>[트립의 *새* 벨트를 풀어준다.]</Start>

TextEng: "I want to move faster and not bother with searching or stealth."
Text: "더 빨리 이동하고 탐색이나 은밀 행동은 하지 마."

TextEng: "Where did you find the belt?"
Text: "벨트를 어디서 찾았어?"

TextEng: "I will. So what is the belt?"
Text: "그래. 그래서 벨트가 뭔데?"

TextEng: "I would like to see the belt, please."
Text: "벨트를 보여줘."

TextEng: "You have to return this, Trip."
Text: "이건 돌려줘야 해, 트립."

TextEng: "Now, Trip!"
Text: "당장, 트립!"

TextEng: "Where did you get those bracers?"
Text: "그 팔찌 어디서 구한 거야?"

TextEng: "Give them to me."
Text: "나한테 줘."

TextEng: "I just want to figure out what they do. If you can use them, I'll give them back."
Text: "뭘 하는 건지 알고 싶어서. 쓸 수 있으면 돌려줄게."

TextEng: "I don't like your attitude, ratman! Give them to me, now!"
Text: "태도가 마음에 안 들어, 쥐인간! 당장 나한테 줘!"

TextEng: "Just give me the bracers."
Text: "팔찌 그냥 줘."

TextEng: "You stole them from her, you mean?"
Text: "훔친 거잖아, 맞지?"

TextEng: "She gave them to you?"
Text: "그녀가 줬다고?"

TextEng: "You could justify any action with that kind of logic."
Text: "그런 논리면 뭐든 정당화할 수 있겠다."

TextEng: "Fine, you can keep them."
Text: "알겠어, 가져."

TextEng: "Give them back to her, now!"
Text: "당장 돌려줘."

TextEng: "Those are bracers."
Text: "그건 팔찌야."

TextEng: "I need you to be stealthy right now."
Text: "지금 은밀하게 행동해야 해."

TextEng: "I really don't care."
Text: "정말 상관없어."

TextEng: "How is it familiar?"
Text: "어떻게 익숙한데?"

TextEng: "Tell me what you know, then."
Text: "뭘 아는지 말해봐."

TextEng: "Crystals. Got it. An easy trap."
Text: "수정이라. 알았어. 쉬운 함정이네."

TextEng: "Do you think there might be crystals here?"
Text: "여기도 수정이 있을 것 같아?"

TextEng: "Well, I think he could prove to be quite useful."
Text: "꽤 유용할 수 있을 것 같아."

TextEng: "I can't stand him."
Text: "견딜 수가 없어."

TextEng: "Yes. Please follow me."
Text: "그래. 따라와."

TextEng: "What do you mean? What amulets?"
Text: "무슨 소리야? 무슨 부적?"

TextEng: "Is that all you managed to steal?"
Text: "훔친 게 그게 전부야?"

TextEng: "I'm surprised you didn't keep it for yourself."
Text: "자기가 안 가지고 있다니 놀랍네."

TextEng: "A magic amulet... very good."
Text: "마법 부적이라... 잘했어."

TextEng: "Oh, ick, that's why it's wet!"
Text: "으, 그래서 젖어 있었구나!"

TextEng: "Trip, you shouldn't steal from people in the keep!"
Text: "트립, 거점 사람들한테서 훔치면 안 돼!"

TextEng: "Ha, ha! I like having you around, Trip."
Text: "하하! 네가 있으니 좋아, 트립."

TextEng: "Don't help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패해도 돕지 마."

TextEng: "What are you doing, Trip?!?"
Text: "뭐 하는 거야, 트립?!?"

TextEng: "Why would you be so careless with a magic rod?"
Text: "왜 마법 막대를 그렇게 함부로 다뤄?"

TextEng: "Why didn't you show it to me right away?"
Text: "왜 바로 안 보여줬어?"

TextEng: "Which voices told you to play with it?"
Text: "어떤 목소리가 가지고 놀라고 했어?"

TextEng: "Give me the rod... now!"
Text: "막대를 줘... 지금."

TextEng: "You are going to give that to me right now, yes?"
Text: "지금 당장 그거 나한테 줄 거지?"

TextEng: "You could have killed somebody with that."
Text: "그거 때문에 사람 죽을 뻔했어."

TextEng: "You should always be careful with magic items."
Text: "마법 물건은 항상 조심해야 해."

TextEng: "I should be able to get some gold for this."
Text: "이거 팔면 금 좀 받겠네."

TextEng: "I have the rod, so shut up until you have something useful to say!"
Text: "막대는 내가 가졌으니, 쓸모 있는 말이 있을 때까지 입 닥쳐!"

TextEng: "You can't eat a ring, if I buy it for you."
Text: "반지를 사줘도 먹으면 안 돼."

TextEng: "Maybe I can buy a ring to make you shut up."
Text: "입 다물게 하는 반지를 살 수 있으면 좋겠다."

TextEng: "Whatever."
Text: "뭐든 상관없어."

TextEng: "You are very strange."
Text: "넌 정말 이상해."

TextEng: "We'll see."
Text: "두고 보자."

TextEng: "I'm not buying you a ring!"
Text: "반지 안 사줘!"

TextEng: "Well, I'm glad you found it. It should be useful."
Text: "찾아줘서 고맙다. 유용하겠어."

TextEng: "I don't want to hear about this right now."
Text: "지금은 그 이야기 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "Help me if I fail to open a locked door or chest."
Text: "내가 잠긴 문이나 상자를 여는 데 실패하면 도와줘."

TextEng: "Do you have a point?"
Text: "요점이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Yeah, he did seem rather easy."
Text: "그래, 좀 쉬웠긴 하지."

TextEng: "He was really tough! He nearly killed us!"
Text: "정말 강했어! 거의 죽을 뻔했잖아!"

TextEng: "I don't need this. You're just wasting my time."
Text: "이런 건 필요 없어. 시간 낭비야."

TextEng: "Whatever. Why was it so important for you to speak to me?"
Text: "상관없어. 왜 나한테 말하는 게 그렇게 중요했어?"

TextEng: "When did you ever fight a dragon?"
Text: "언제 드래곤이랑 싸워봤어?"

TextEng: "Do you think your mind could hold to a single subject for a minute?"
Text: "한 가지 주제에 1분만 집중할 수 없어?"

TextEng: "Right. I'll be careful with it."
Text: "맞아. 조심할게."

TextEng: "You were planning on keeping it and not telling me?"
Text: "가지고 있으면서 말 안 하려고 했어?"

TextEng: "That might be fun to watch, but I'll take the ring."
Text: "보는 건 재밌겠지만, 반지는 내가 가질게."

TextEng: "Good. Give me the ring."
Text: "좋아. 반지 줘."

TextEng: "I want to change the distance you stay away from me."
Text: "나한테서 떨어져 있는 거리를 바꾸고 싶어."

TextEng: "You were talking about treasure?"
Text: "보물 얘기하고 있었지?"

TextEng: "We have a purpose here."
Text: "우리는 여기서 해야 할 일이 있어."

TextEng: "I don't really care, Trip."
Text: "관심 없어, 트립."

TextEng: "Give that to me!"
Text: "그거 나한테 줘!"

TextEng: "Isn't that mold growing on the skull?"
Text: "그 해골에 곰팡이 아니야?"

TextEng: "I wouldn't really want the filthy thing."
Text: "더러운 거 가지고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "What are you talking about?"
Text: "무슨 소리야?"

TextEng: "What is so special about it?"
Text: "뭐가 특별한데?"

TextEng: "I really don't want to hear about it."
Text: "정말 듣고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "If you absolutely must tell me."
Text: "꼭 얘기해야 하면."

TextEng: "Stay a long distance away."
Text: "먼 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "Go ahead."
Text: "말해봐."

TextEng: "If you think it might be pertinent to what we are doing now."
Text: "지금 하는 일과 관련 있을 수 있으면."

TextEng: "I would like to hear that."
Text: "듣고 싶어."

TextEng: "I really prefer my rat cooked with a pinch of salt."
Text: "나는 쥐를 소금 좀 뿌려서 익혀 먹는 게 좋은데."

TextEng: "Ugh, I don't need those kind of details."
Text: "으, 그런 세부 사항은 필요 없어."

TextEng: "Keep a medium distance."
Text: "중간 거리를 유지해."

TextEng: "When does the magic come into this gruesome tale?"
Text: "이 끔찍한 이야기에서 마법은 언제 나와?"

TextEng: "You mean that rat skull you are always chewing on?"
Text: "항상 씹고 있는 그 쥐 해골 말이야?"

TextEng: "Yes, let's go."
Text: "그래, 가자."

TextEng: "Stay close."
Text: "가까이 있어."

TextEng: "No, just stay here for now."
Text: "아니, 지금은 여기 있어."

TextEng: "Go ahead and attack as soon as you see enemies."
Text: "적이 보이면 바로 공격해."

TextEng: "Defend me and don't attack until I do."
Text: "나를 방어하고, 내가 공격할 때까지 공격하지 마."

TextEng: "I'm not getting in the middle of this."
Text: "여기 끼어들고 싶지 않아."

TextEng: "You're a big boy, Calibast. Learn to deal with criticism."
Text: "넌 다 큰 어른이잖아, 캘리바스트. 비판에 대처하는 법을 배워."

TextEng: "Trip, leave him alone."
Text: "트립, 캘리바스트 좀 내버려 둬."

TextEng: "I want to adjust your equipment."
Text: "네 장비를 조정하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Leave him alone, Trip."
Text: "캘리바스트 좀 놔둬, 트립."

TextEng: "What is Calibast supposed to do, Trip?"
Text: "캘리바스트가 뭘 어떻게 하란 거야, 트립?"

TextEng: "Don't taunt him, Trip."
Text: "놀리지 마, 트립."

TextEng: "I think azers are related to dwarves though."
Text: "에이저는 드워프와 관련이 있긴 한 것 같은데."

TextEng: "Stop it, both of you!"
Text: "둘 다 그만해!"

TextEng: "Can you identify my equipment?"
Text: "내 장비를 감정해 줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Enough!"
Text: "그만!"

TextEng: "I need you to blend into the shadows."
Text: "그림자에 숨어 있어."

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "What was it you wanted to say earlier?"
Text: "아까 하려던 말이 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "Let's stop and talk a moment."
Text: "잠깐 멈추고 이야기하자."

TextEng: "We're done talking."
Text: "이야기는 끝이야."

TextEng: "No, nothing else."
Text: "아니, 다른 건 없어."

TextEng: "I want you to stop calling me <master/mistress>."
Text: "나를 주인님이라고 부르지 마."

TextEng: "How is everything?"
Text: "다 잘 지내?"

TextEng: "I think we need to part ways."
Text: "이제 헤어져야 할 것 같아."

TextEng: "No, never mind."
Text: "아니, 신경 쓰지 마."

TextEng: "Do you have plans for what you're going to do after all this?"
Text: "이 모든 게 끝나면 뭘 할 계획이 있어?"

TextEng: "Why would you want to do that?"
Text: "왜 그런 걸 하고 싶어?"

TextEng: "How would you get all the monsters in there?"
Text: "괴물들을 어떻게 다 그곳에 모을 건데?"

TextEng: "Profit sharing?"
Text: "수익 분배?"

TextEng: "What would you call your dungeon?"
Text: "던전 이름은 뭘로 지을 건데?"

TextEng: "Why would people pay to go into such a place?"
Text: "왜 사람들이 돈을 내고 그런 곳에 가겠어?"

TextEng: "Do you want my opinion on your idea?"
Text: "내 의견을 듣고 싶어?"

TextEng: "It wouldn't be much fun. Far too linear and combat-oriented."
Text: "별로 재미없을 거야. 너무 일직선이고 전투 위주야."

TextEng: "Wait here until I return."
Text: "내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려."

TextEng: "Good plan. If you need any help getting started, just ask."
Text: "좋은 계획이야. 시작할 때 도움이 필요하면 말해."

TextEng: "I'd love to help you with that. I think it would be quite successful."
Text: "기꺼이 도와줄게. 꽤 성공할 것 같아."

TextEng: "You're doomed to failure."
Text: "실패할 운명이야."

TextEng: "What is it like being a wererat?"
Text: "늑대쥐로 사는 게 어때?"

TextEng: "Suddenly I don't want to know..."
Text: "갑자기 알고 싶지 않아졌어..."

TextEng: "Let's talk about the voices."
Text: "목소리에 대해 얘기하자."

TextEng: "Me?"
"Are you sure that's from being a wererat?"
Text: "그게 정말 늑대쥐라서 그런 거야?"

TextEng: "Me?"
"We got every gold piece the farmers had. It was barely enough."
Text: "농부들이 가진 금을 다 받았어. 겨우 됐지."

TextEng: "We were hoping to find you with a bunch of treasure."
Text: "보물을 잔뜩 가지고 있길 기대했어."

TextEng: "I need to go."
Text: "가야 해."

TextEng: "We were more interested in finding out about you."
Text: "너에 대해 알고 싶었어."

TextEng: "They spoke of your atrocities, so we thought it was worth doing."
Text: "네 만행에 대해 들어서, 해볼 만하다고 생각했어."

TextEng: "Your *treasure* was a horde of refuse. I just figured you might be useful."
Text: "네 *보물*은 쓰레기 더미였어. 쓸모가 있을 것 같아서 살려둔 거야."

TextEng: "An enemy deserves mercy, if they change their ways, which you promised to do."
Text: "적도 개과천선하면 자비를 받을 자격이 있어, 네가 약속한 것처럼."

TextEng: "You lived because you paid us off."
Text: "돈을 줘서 살려둔 거야."

TextEng: "I let you live because you groveled so pathetically."
Text: "너무 한심하게 빌어서 살려줬어."

TextEng: "Sometimes I wonder about your loyalty, Trip."
Text: "가끔 네 충성심이 궁금해, 트립."

TextEng: "You are a good friend, Trip."
Text: "넌 좋은 친구야, 트립."

TextEng: The Masked Man seems to sense your presence amidst all the chaos of battle. He turns to you, his eyes glinting like dark pools of liquid from behind his visor.
Text: 가면 쓴 자가 전투의 혼란 속에서 당신의 존재를 감지한 것 같습니다. 가면 뒤의 검은 웅덩이 같은 눈을 빛내며 당신에게 돌아섭니다.

TextEng: "Too late, <FirstName>, too late. The keep shall be mine and the destiny that comes with it. History will remember you as nothing but another corpse upon the battlefield."
Text: "너무 늦었다, <이름>, 너무 늦었어. 이 성채는 내 것이 될 것이고 그와 함께 운명도. 역사는 너를 그저 성벽 아래의 시체 중 하나로 기억할 것이다."

TextEng: "No, we not want to see! We not want to know!"
Text: "아냐, 우리 보기 싫어! 알고 싶지 않아!"

TextEng: "On the contrary. It is you who dies today..."
Text: "그 반대다. 오늘 죽는 것은 바로 너다..."

TextEng: Dark and ominous, the Masked Man's laughter echoes inside your mind.
Text: 어둡고 불길한 가면 쓴 자의 웃음이 당신의 마음속에 울려 퍼집니다.

TextEng: "Yes, you heard us correctly. Surrender or face your death!"
Text: "그래, 제대로 들은 거야. 항복하든가 죽음을 맞이하든가!"

TextEng: "Right now this keep is nothing! But under me it shall become the seat of a new empire. Destiny has called me here, <FirstName>, just as it called you to follow in my wake and now grovel here before me."
Text: "지금 이 성채는 아무것도 아니야! 하지만 나 아래서 새 제국의 중심이 될 것이다. 운명이 나를 여기로 불렀어, <이름>, 너를 부른 것처럼."

TextEng: "Do not burn it. Please... anything but flames."
Text: "불태우지 마. 제발... 불만은 안 돼."

TextEng: "I know all about you. I know about all of you. I know you better than you know yourselves. Every thought, every doubt, every fear. And I know that today is the day you are meant to die."
Text: "나는 너에 대해 다 알아. 너희 모두에 대해. 너희 자신보다 더 잘 알아. 모든 생각, 모든 의심, 모든 두려움. 그리고 알아..."

TextEng: "Enough of this talk and trickery! Drive a blade into his gullet and let's be done with it."
Text: "이 수다와 속임수는 그만! 칼날을 목구멍에 꽂고 끝내자."

TextEng: "And give you the dignity of seeing your better's face? Never! I am better than you, <FirstName>. Better than all your kind!"
Text: "네 상전의 얼굴을 볼 품위를 주겠다고? 절대로! 나는 너보다 뛰어나, <이름>. 너희 종족 모두보다!"

TextEng: "Enough talk. It's time I killed you."
Text: "수다는 그만. 이제 널 죽일 시간이다."

TextEng: "Lay down your arms and surrender immediately!"
Text: "무기를 내려놓고 즉시 항복해라!"

TextEng: "What's so important about this keep?"
Text: "이 성채가 뭐가 그리 중요하지?"

TextEng: "How do you know my name?"
Text: "내 이름을 어떻게 알지?"

TextEng: "Unmask yourself, coward."
Text: "가면을 벗어라, 겁쟁이."

TextEng: "What are you doing you fool! I brought you back for the one and *only* purpose of becoming lord of this keep."

"No, there is no excuse for this.  A simple thug like yourself could never become a lord. You've wasted my time, betrayed my hope, and broken my heart. There is nothing more I can do for you... I'm sorry, <FirstName>, but this has to end..."
"You see..."
"I was just..."
The bird is too busy hunting for food that might scurry or hop across the ground to really pay much attention to you.
Text: 새는 땅 위를 지나가는 먹이를 찾느라 바빠서 당신에게 별 관심을 두지 않습니다.

TextEng: "Oxen are such stupid beasts."
Text: "황소란 참 멍청한 짐승이야."

TextEng: "My feet were getting sore. I need to find a horse."
Text: "발이 아파 죽겠어. 말을 구해야겠어."

TextEng: "I'm glad we were able to avoid the army. I love working for the mistresses."
Text: "군대를 피할 수 있어서 다행이야. 아가씨들 밑에서 일하는 게 좋아."

TextEng: "The route up here has grown very dangerous in the last few years."
Text: "이쪽으로 올라오는 길이 최근 몇 년 사이에 아주 위험해졌어."

TextEng: "I just work here. I don't know nothing."
Text: "난 그냥 여기서 일하는 사람이야. 아무것도 몰라."

TextEng: "Talk to the ladies if you want to buy something."
Text: "뭘 사고 싶으면 아가씨들한테 말해."

TextEng: "Oh look, it is our friend, come back..."
Text: "어머, 보세요, 우리 친구가 다시..."

TextEng: "... to visit us. How can we help you..."
Text: "... 왔네요. 뭘 도와 드릴까요..."

TextEng: "We are always happy..."
Text: "저희는 항상 기꺼이..."

TextEng: "... to answer any questions a customer might have."
Text: "... 손님의 질문에 답해 드려요."

TextEng: "Would you like to purchase some..."
Text: "저희 물건을 좀..."

TextEng: "... of our goods, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 사시겠어요, 손님?"

TextEng: "I think we should be all right, as long as..."
Text: "저희는 괜찮을 거예요. 그 괴물들만..."

TextEng: "... those monsters don't come back. Thank you for..."
Text: "... 다시 오지 않으면요. 걱정해 주셔서..."

TextEng: "... asking, though."
Text: "... 감사해요."

TextEng: "Our goods are always welcome here..."
Text: "저희 물건은 여기서 항상 환영받아요..."

TextEng: "... since many people in the north think of the south as the only place to get real *civilized* goods. We have done a brisk trade..."
Text: "... 북쪽 사람들은 남쪽만이 진정한 *문명화된* 물건을 구할 수 있는 곳이라고 생각하거든요. 염료와 이국적인 재료로 장사가 잘 됐는데..."

TextEng: "... with our dyes and exotic materials. But I think now we will have to wait..."
Text: "... 하지만 이제는 침략자들이 막힐 때까지 기다려야..."

TextEng: "... today, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 오늘은, 손님?"

TextEng: "... until the invaders are stopped, before continuing on to the keep."
Text: "... 성채로 계속 갈 수 있을 것 같아요."

TextEng: They both giggle. "It's just something we started when we were..."
Text: 둘 다 킥킥 웃습니다. "그냥 어렸을 때부터 시작한 건데요..."

TextEng: "... just children. Our parents hated it, but after doing it for years..."
Text: "... 그때는 아이였으니까요. 부모님은 싫어하셨지만, 몇 년이나 하다 보니..."

TextEng: "... they got used to it and so did we."
Text: "... 부모님도 익숙해지셨고 저희도 그렇게 됐어요."

TextEng: "I am well versed in the magical arts, and we were able to make our entire caravan invisible when..."
Text: "저는 마법에 능통해서, 대상 전체를 투명하게 만들 수 있었어요..."

TextEng: "...I was scouting and saw the routed army fleeing the keep."
Text: "...제가 정찰하다가 패주하는 군대가 성채에서 도망치는 걸 봤거든요."

TextEng: "Oh, we have never heard that one before..."
Text: "어머, 그런 말은 처음 들어보네요..."

TextEng: "... you are a witty one."
Text: "... 재치 있으시네요."

TextEng: "We are not that powerful and without solid walls to retreat behind..."
Text: "저희는 그렇게 강하지 않고 뒤로 물러날 튼튼한 벽도 없으니까..."

TextEng: "... we would have been easy prey. Better to just be invisible."
Text: "... 쉬운 먹잇감이 됐을 거예요. 그냥 투명해지는 게 나아요."

TextEng: Two identical female elves stand here amidst a caravan that seems to have escaped the invading army's notice. One begins, "Good day to you..."
Text: 똑같이 생긴 엘프 여성 둘이 침략군의 눈을 피한 대상 가운데 서 있습니다. 한 명이 말을 꺼냅니다. "안녕하세요..."

TextEng: "Did you have other questions..."
Text: "다른 질문이..."

TextEng: "... for us, kind <sir/madam>?"
Text: "... 있으신가요, 손님?"

TextEng: "Yes, there would be little else these sweet elves could have done. Now which of you lasses was Alexis again?"
Text: "그래, 이 귀여운 엘프 아가씨들이 달리 뭘 할 수 있었겠어. 그런데 둘 중 알렉시스가 어느 쪽이더라?"

TextEng: "I'm Alexis, and you certainly are..."
Text: "제가 알렉시스예요, 정말..."

TextEng: "... the most handsome dwarf we've ever met. Besides, I am Alexis."
Text: "... 이렇게 잘생긴 드워프는 처음 봐요. 게다가 알렉시스는 저예요."

TextEng: "I don't suppose it matters. You both be fine looking lasses."
Text: "뭐 상관없지. 둘 다 예쁜 아가씨들이야."

TextEng: "Too bad we are both promised to be married..."
Text: "안타깝게도 저희 둘 다 약혼한 사이라서요..."

TextEng: "... to very wealthy elven lords, alas."
Text: "... 아주 부유한 엘프 영주들이랍니다, 유감이네요."

TextEng: "No, I just keep a number of scrolls around with globe of invisibilty spells on them..."
Text: "아뇨, 저는 투명화 구체 주문이 적힌 두루마리를 여러 개 갖고 다녀요..."

TextEng: "... for just such an occassion."
Text: "... 바로 이런 상황을 대비해서요."

TextEng: Then the other finishes, "stranger. Would you be interested in purchasing some of our goods? Most are in perfect condition..."
Text: 그러자 다른 한 명이 마무리합니다. "낯선 분이시군요. 저희 물건에 관심 있으신가요? 대부분 완벽한 상태인데..."

TextEng: "I am Alenor Kinthalis, merchant wizard, and this is my sister..."
Text: "저는 상인 마법사 알레노르 킨탈리스이고, 이쪽은 제 동생..."

TextEng: "Alexis Kinthalis, merchant and scout. We own this modest enterprise you see here."
Text: "알렉시스 킨탈리스, 상인 겸 정찰꾼이에요. 여기 보이는 이 소박한 사업체가 저희 거예요."

TextEng: "...though there might be some smoke damage. What do you say?"
Text: "...연기 냄새가 좀 밸 수도 있어요. 어떠세요?"

TextEng: "Be careful, good <sir/madam>. There are many dangerous creatures..."
Text: "조심하세요, 손님. 이 언덕 지대에는 위험한 생물이..."

TextEng: "... in this hilly land."
Text: "... 많거든요."

TextEng: "We have a variety of goods brought..."
Text: "남쪽의 문명화된 도시에서 가져온..."

TextEng: "...all the way from the civilized southern cities. Have a look."
Text: "...다양한 물건이 있어요. 한번 보세요."

TextEng: "I have some questions for you."
Text: "질문이 좀 있어요."

TextEng: "That's all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어요."

TextEng: "Do you need any help?"
Text: "도움이 필요하신가요?"

TextEng: "What brought you this far north?"
Text: "이렇게 먼 북쪽까지 뭐 때문에 왔나요?"

TextEng: "Why do you finish each other's sentences?"
Text: "왜 서로 말을 이어서 끝내시죠?"

TextEng: "How did you avoid the monsters that attacked the keep?"
Text: "성채를 공격한 괴물들을 어떻게 피했어요?"

TextEng: "I guess two heads are better than one."
Text: "머리 둘이 하나보다 낫다더니."

TextEng: "So why didn't you help, instead of just hiding?"
Text: "그럼 숨기만 하지 않고 왜 도와주지 않았어요?"

TextEng: "That's a powerful spell."
Text: "그건 강력한 주문이네요."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕히."

TextEng: "Back to my other questions."
Text: "다른 질문으로 돌아갈게요."

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "누구세요?"

TextEng: "What do you have for sale?"
Text: "무엇을 파나요?"

TextEng: The chicken eyes you cautiously, then resumes pecking the ground.
Text: 닭이 조심스럽게 당신을 살피더니 다시 땅을 쪼기 시작합니다.

TextEng: The chicken looks you up and down, searching for signs of a bushy tail or pointed, hairy ears. It then begins to ask you a series of tricky questions about your culinary habits.
Text: 닭이 당신을 위아래로 훑어보며 덥수룩한 꼬리나 뾰족한 털 귀가 있는지 살핍니다. 그러더니 당신의 식습관에 대해 까다로운 질문을 퍼붓기 시작합니다.

TextEng: It tells you to eat lots of grass seeds and get plenty of rest.
Text: 풀씨를 많이 먹고 푹 쉬라고 충고합니다.

TextEng: The chicken impatiently pecks at your toes, as is it pretty sure you are standing on a seed it was eyeing. As you move back a step it keeps telling you to back up more.
Text: 닭이 조급하게 당신의 발가락을 쪼며, 당신이 노리고 있던 씨앗 위에 서 있다고 확신합니다. 한 걸음 물러서자 더 뒤로 가라고 계속 재촉합니다.

TextEng: It is entirely possible that the chicken was lying about the seed and merely wants you to go away.
Text: 씨앗 이야기는 거짓말이었고, 그저 당신이 가 버리기를 바라는 것일 가능성이 높습니다.

TextEng: Finally it decides that you probably aren't a fox and it goes back to pecking at the ground. Seconds later it seems to have forgotten who you are and resumes looking for a bushy tail.
Text: 마침내 당신이 여우는 아닐 거라고 판단하고 다시 땅을 쪼기 시작합니다. 몇 초 후 당신이 누군지 잊어버리고 다시 덥수룩한 꼬리를 찾기 시작합니다.

TextEng: The chicken quietly informs you that it believes one of the other chickens is actually a spy for a criminal egg-theft ring.
Text: 닭이 조용히 알려주기를, 다른 닭 중 하나가 사실은 알 도둑 조직의 첩자라고 합니다.

TextEng: Before it resumes eating, it warns you to be careful around the chicken with the wandering eye.
Text: 다시 먹이를 쪼기 전에, 눈이 빙글빙글 도는 닭을 조심하라고 경고합니다.

TextEng: The chicken chokes on a grass seed as you speak to it. It then glares at you, angry at the interruption to its meal and lets out a churlish squawk.
Text: 당신이 말을 걸자 닭이 풀씨에 걸려 사레들립니다. 그러더니 식사를 방해한 당신을 노려보며 심술궂게 꼬꼬댁 소리를 지릅니다.

TextEng: Raising its beak in the air, it turns and struts arrogantly away, feeling it has made its point.
Text: 부리를 치켜세우고 뒤돌아서 거드름을 피우며 걸어갑니다. 자기 주장이 통했다고 생각하는 모양입니다.

TextEng: The chicken sits down and begins to describe in detail how it believes that the world was made by a giant chicken, and one day the world will end in what it calls, "The Great Hatching".
Text: 닭이 앉더니 세상이 거대한 닭에 의해 만들어졌으며, 언젠가 "위대한 부화"라 불리는 것으로 세상이 끝날 것이라는 이야기를 장황하게 늘어놓기 시작합니다.

TextEng: When that day comes the giant chicken god will be reborn and lay a new egg and the cycle will begin again.
Text: 그날이 오면 거대한 닭 신이 다시 태어나 새 알을 낳고, 순환이 다시 시작될 것이라고 합니다.

TextEng: The chicken is quickly confused and seems to decide you are just another chicken. It feels much pity for you, as you seem to have molted and lost all your feathers.
Text: 닭은 금세 혼란에 빠져 당신을 그냥 다른 닭이라고 판단합니다. 깃털이 다 빠진 것 같다며 당신을 몹시 불쌍해합니다.

TextEng: "Hello, chicken."
Text: "안녕, 닭아."

TextEng: Your warrior friend, the flaming azer Calibast, turns to you. He breathes heavily from all of the running and fighting in the last few hours. He eyes the rest of the group, trying to gauge their condition.
Text: 전사 동료인 불꽃의 아저 캘리바스트가 당신에게 돌아섭니다. 지난 몇 시간 동안의 달리기와 전투로 거친 숨을 몰아쉽니다. 당신을 바라보며 침착하게 입을 엽니다.

TextEng: Trip, your wererat companion, sniffs the air and licks the blood from a superficial cut on his arm. He does not seem as winded as the others, but his craven ways have kept him from most of the fighting.
Text: 웨어랫 동료 트립이 공기의 냄새를 맡으며 팔의 가벼운 상처에서 피를 핥습니다. 다른 이들만큼 숨이 차 보이지는 않지만, 머리 속의 목소리들이 점점 거슬리는 듯합니다.

TextEng: "Trip's gained us some time through the woods but not enough. They'll set fire to the keep."
Text: "트립이 숲을 통해 시간을 벌어 줬지만 충분하지 않았어. 놈들이 성채에 불을 지를 거야."

TextEng: "Stupid! Trip said we could not fight the big masked man. Not strong enough are we, so now we shall die! We run, we hide and maybe we live!"
Text: "바보들! 트립이 큰 가면 쓴 남자와 싸울 수 없다고 했잖아. 우리는 충분히 강하지 않으니, 이제 죽을 거야! 도망치고, 숨어야 살 수 있어!"

TextEng: "I'll not flee from this or any other foe! We are not cowards; we march for the keep's gates and make our stand against them there. What do you say <FirstName>?"
Text: "이 적이든 다른 적이든 도망치지 않겠다! 우리는 겁쟁이가 아니다. 성채 문으로 진군해서 거기서 맞서 싸우자. 어떻게 생각하나, <이름>?"

TextEng: "If this is our destiny, I would hate to have it said that we did not face it bravely. I will face the storm and weather it or die."
Text: "이것이 우리의 운명이라면, 용감하게 맞서지 않았다는 말은 듣기 싫다. 폭풍에 맞서 이겨내겠다. 아니면 죽겠다."

TextEng: "Then the majority says we stand and fight. That has always been enough for us."
Text: "그렇다면 다수결로 싸운다. 그것이 항상 우리의 방식이었다."

TextEng: "I... I am sorry... I cannot agree with you, <FirstName>. I say we stand and face our fate."
Text: "나는... 미안하지만... 당신에게 동의할 수 없어, <이름>. 나는 맞서 싸우겠다."

TextEng: "Three say stand, two say flee. It is good that we are not all cowards. The vote is cast and the majority says we stand and fight. That has always been enough for us."
Text: "셋은 싸우자, 둘은 도망치자. 우리 모두가 겁쟁이는 아니니 다행이다. 다수결로 싸운다. 그것이 항상 우리의 방식이었다."

TextEng: "I too will face our foes. Perhaps today we will finally rest."
Text: "나도 적과 맞서겠다. 어쩌면 오늘 드디어 쉴 수 있겠지."

TextEng: "You all willing to die? My voices, they tell me to run. Trip wishes to leave here. Why do we not all leave?"
Text: "다들 죽을 각오야? 내 목소리들은 도망치라고 하는데. 트립은 떠나고 싶어. 왜 다 같이 떠나지 않는 거야?"

TextEng: "Bollocks! Shut your cowardly mouth, Trip! We march from this place and face our foes. We must slay the Masked Man at any cost."
Text: "엉터리 소리! 비겁한 입 닫아, 트립! 여기서 나아가 적과 맞서자. 무슨 수를 써서라도 가면 쓴 자를 죽여야 해."

TextEng: Jaboli, a rakshasa wizard, mumbles to herself, obviously trying to recall some of the spells she has already used. It is doubtful she has many more left.
Text: 락샤사 마법사 자볼리가 혼잣말로 중얼거리며, 이미 사용한 주문 몇 가지를 떠올리려 애씁니다. 남은 주문이 많지 않을 것 같습니다.

TextEng: "Oh yes, that is a splendid idea! Trip will run far and wide, warning everyone of impending doom!"
Text: "오, 그래, 좋은 생각이야! 트립이 멀리 뛰어다니며 다가오는 재앙을 모두에게 알릴게!"

TextEng: "It would take weeks for forces to be mustered. By that time, the keep will have fallen and the Masked One will have moved on, leaving nothing but a smoking ruin. If we're to stop him, it must be now."
Text: "군대를 모으려면 몇 주가 걸릴 거야. 그때쯤이면 성채는 함락되고 가면 쓴 자는 떠난 뒤일 텐데, 남는 건 재와 폐허뿐이지."

TextEng: "No! Trip does not wish to die. Will no one flee with him?"
Text: "싫어! 트립은 죽기 싫어. 아무도 트립이랑 도망치지 않을 거야?"

TextEng: "We face them together and with honor!"
Text: "함께 명예롭게 맞서자!"

TextEng: "We welcome you, Mistress Death!"
Text: "죽음의 여신이여, 어서 오소서!"

TextEng: "Hundreds! Trip smells them, yes! Kobolds, orcs, goblins, and ogres. Too many for us I tell you!"
Text: "수백 마리야! 트립이 냄새 맡았어, 맞아! 코볼트, 오크, 고블린, 오우거. 우리한테는 너무 많다니까!"

TextEng: "He usually exaggerates, but I fear Trip is right this time. What do you wish to do?"
Text: "트립은 항상 과장하지만, 이번에는 맞는 것 같다. 어떻게 하겠나?"

TextEng: Kaidala's chest heaves as she tries to catch her breath. Her hand absently rubs against the horrible scarring on her face, which she has carried since before you ever met her.
Text: 카이달라가 숨을 고르려 가슴이 들썩입니다. 그녀가 어린 시절부터 지니고 있는 얼굴의 끔찍한 흉터를 무심코 문지릅니다.

TextEng: "The enemy lies just ahead. We have to intervene before they seize the keep."
Text: "적이 바로 앞에 있다. 그들이 성채를 점령하기 전에 개입해야 해."

TextEng: "No, no! We flee! Let them have the keep! We're too late."
Text: "안 돼, 안 돼! 도망쳐야 해! 성채는 그들에게 내줘! 우리는 이미 늦었어."

TextEng: "You've led us this far, Trip, only to turn tail on us now?"
Text: "여기까지 우리를 이끌어 놓고 이제 와서 꼬리를 빼려고, 트립?"

TextEng: "It's the woods! They twist and turn, Jaboli! Trip hoped we get through in time but it's too late. Come, Trip will lead us back to safety."
Text: "숲 때문이야! 구불구불 돌아가잖아, 자볼리! 트립은 제시간에 도착하길 바랐지만 너무 늦었어. 자, 트립이 안전한 곳으로 데려다줄게."

TextEng: "No one's going back, Trip, especially not you. We're late but we're not too late. Now, did anyone spy a glimpse of their leader?"
Text: "아무도 돌아가지 않아, 트립, 특히 넌. 늦긴 했지만 너무 늦지는 않았어. 그래, 누가 그들의 지도자를 봤나?"

TextEng: "No. They've led us on a merry chase north, but always stayed a step ahead."
Text: "아뇨. 북쪽으로 우리를 실컷 쫓아다니게 했지만, 항상 한 발 앞서 있었어요."

TextEng: "You haven't said much, Kaidala. What do you think?"
Text: "카이달라, 넌 별 말이 없었는데. 어떻게 생각하지?"

TextEng: "Perhaps we should run."
Text: "도망치는 게 나을지도 모르겠다."

TextEng: "We stay and fight."
Text: "남아서 싸우자."

TextEng: "Trip, you are such a cowardly fool. I ought to end your miserable life right now!"
Text: "트립, 넌 정말 비겁한 바보야. 지금 당장 네 비참한 목숨을 끝내 주겠어!"

TextEng: "Perhaps Trip should run and gather reinforcements?"
Text: "트립이 달려가서 지원군을 불러오는 건 어때?"

TextEng: "Yes, Trip, be brave!"
Text: "그래, 트립, 용기를 내!"

TextEng: "Do you have a plan?"
Text: "계획이 있나?"

TextEng: "How many do we face, best guess?"
Text: "적이 몇이나 되지?"

TextEng: "Are we just stopping then?"
Text: "그냥 멈추는 건가?"

TextEng: "What do you think, everyone?"
Text: "모두 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "So you've come back to your dear friend, Calibast. Just say the word, bring me back, and we'll be off on our merry way." Calibast tosses you a cavalier wink.
Text: "친한 친구 캘리바스트에게 다시 왔군. 한마디만 해. 날 되살려 주면 바로 떠나자." 캘리바스트가 태평하게 미소를 보내 온다.

TextEng: You see the ghostly visage of your warrior companion, Calibast, rise above his shattered corpse. The azer stares off into eternity, listening to an inaudible voice, then looks straight into your eyes and grimaces.
Text: 전사 동료 캘리바스트의 유령 같은 모습이 산산이 부서진 시체 위로 떠오릅니다. 아저가 영원 속을 응시하며, 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀를 기울입니다.

TextEng: "Fear not, my friend, you shall have no regrets!"
Text: "걱정 마, 친구, 후회 없을 거야!"

TextEng: "I would be proud to do so! You shall not regret your choice!"
Text: "기꺼이! 네 선택을 후회하지 않을 거야!"

TextEng: "Well, of course you do, <lad/lass>. Always important to know all the facts, I always say."
Text: "물론이지. 항상 사실을 다 아는 게 중요하다고 말하잖아."

TextEng: "So, fine friend, how are we to proceed?" He wags his fiery eyebrows at you and flashes you his finest, carefree grin.
Text: "그래, 좋은 친구여, 어떻게 할 거지?" 불꽃 눈썹을 흔들며 가장 태평한 미소를 짓는다.

TextEng: "Not that I don't feel sorry for the poor lad, but you hardly need Trip's assistance. I can smash my way through most locked doors or containers. And he is such a coward, he's not much good in a fight."
Text: "불쌍하긴 하지만 트립의 도움은 별로 필요 없어. 잠긴 문이나 상자는 내가 부숴 버릴 수 있거든. 게다가 그 녀석은 겁쟁이라 전투에서 쓸모가 없지."

TextEng: "Not that I don't feel sorry for the poor lad, but with your thief abilities, you hardly need Trip's assistance. And he is such a coward, he's not much good in a fight."
Text: "불쌍하긴 하지만 네 도둑 능력이면 트립의 도움은 별로 필요 없어. 게다가 그 녀석은 겁쟁이라 전투에서 쓸모가 없지."

TextEng: "Of the ladies, Jaboli is rough and easy to get along with. Kaidala is shy, but fearless in a fight. I suspect she still courts death."
Text: "여자들 중에서, 자볼리는 거칠지만 함께하기 편해. 카이달라는 수줍지만 전투에서는 두려움이 없어. 아직도 죽음을 갈망하는 것 같아서 걱정이지."

TextEng: "I owe you nothing less. You can trust me to always tell you the truth."
Text: "당연히 그래야지. 항상 진실만 말할 거라고 믿어도 돼."

TextEng: "I fear you must have lost some memories when you were brought back. Let us hope you have not lost too much else! When we met Kaidala she begged us to kill her."
Text: "되살아나면서 기억을 좀 잃은 것 같군. 너무 많이 잃지 않았길! 카이달라를 처음 만났을 때 그녀는 우리에게 빨리 죽여 달라고 애원했지."

TextEng: "Her face was a burning scar, like the forest that had been her home. When she saw us coming towards her, she collapsed in tears, begging for a quick, painless end."
Text: "그녀의 얼굴은 그녀의 고향이었던 숲처럼 타버린 흉터투성이였어. 우리가 다가가자 눈물을 흘리며 쓰러져서, 빠르고 자비로운 죽음을 구걸했지."

TextEng: "Ach! They finally got me, <FirstName>. Glad I am to have toasted to Mistress Death last night, since I see that you live. I have some inkling of the choice you face, your 'friend' having explained it to me."
Text: "으악! 결국 당했구나, <이름>. 어젯밤에 죽음의 여신에게 건배한 게 다행이야, 네가 살아 있으니. 이 이상한 목소리가 뭔지 짐작은 가지만, 네 선택에 맡기겠어."

TextEng: "Instead we brought her into our little group of outcasts and helped her rebuild her life, weak as a nymph, but strong in the forces of nature. She made a powerful druid."
Text: "대신 우리는 그녀를 우리 작은 아웃캐스트 무리에 받아들여 삶을 다시 세우도록 도왔어. 님프로서는 약하지만 자연의 힘에는 강하지. 그녀가 많은 도움이 되었어."

TextEng: "The power of my attacks is formidable, whether it be against a foe or a locked door, an advantage no one should do without."
Text: "내 공격력은 대단해. 적이든 잠긴 문이든 말이야. 없으면 아쉬울 걸."

TextEng: "Besides my winning personality, I am also resistant to fire and these charming flames are good for something more than just making me pretty, if you know what I mean."
Text: "매력적인 성격 외에도, 나는 불에 저항력이 있고 이 멋진 불꽃은 나를 잘생기게 만드는 것 말고도 쓸모가 있다고."

TextEng: "I am an azer, a dwarf from the plane of fire. I may be surrounded by flames, but I can control them when I want to touch something without burning it."
Text: "나는 아저야, 불의 차원에서 온 드워프지. 불꽃에 둘러싸여 있지만 원하면 뭔가를 태우지 않고 만질 수도 있어."

TextEng: "Of course, it means I am largely immune to fire based attacks - which can be quite handy. Did you have other questions?"
Text: "물론 그건 불 기반 공격에 거의 면역이라는 뜻이야 - 꽤 편리하지. 다른 질문 있나?"

TextEng: "Bless my soul and drink to oblivion! We have been together longer than any of the others, <FirstName>! Think of all the fun we have shared."
Text: "내 영혼을 축복하고 망각에 건배를! 다른 누구보다 오래 함께했잖아, <이름>! 우리가 나눈 즐거운 시간들을 생각해 봐."

TextEng: "We must take life by the hand and let her lead us down the path of her pleasures! Say you'll not forget the joy of our journeys."
Text: "인생의 손을 잡고 그녀의 즐거움의 길을 따라가야 해! 우리 여정의 기쁨을 잊지 않겠다고 약속해."

TextEng: "We must grab life by her hips and taste the blessed union of all her pleasures! Say you'll not forget the joy of our journeys."
Text: "인생의 허리를 잡고 모든 즐거움의 축복된 합일을 맛봐야 해! 우리 여정의 기쁨을 잊지 않겠다고 약속해."

TextEng: Calibast's face darkens in anger. "That is cruel of you to say, though I should have expected it. I always thought better of you than you deserved."
Text: 캘리바스트의 얼굴이 분노로 어두워집니다. "그건 잔인한 말이군, 예상했어야 했지만. 항상 네가 받을 만한 것보다 더 좋게 생각했는데."

TextEng: "Ha! That is what I love about you, <FirstName>, you're always one step ahead in the fun. Couple that with my prowess in battle and how can you go wrong?"
Text: "하하! 그게 네가 좋은 거야, <이름>, 항상 재미에서 한 발 앞서가지. 거기에 전투에서의 내 무용을 더하면 어떻게 실패할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "I am sure you would not want to lose my brawn and my cheerful disposition, now would you?"
Text: "내 든든한 팔과 유쾌한 성격을 잃고 싶지는 않겠지?"

TextEng: "Indeed we have, <lad/lass>. Couple that with my prowess in battle and how can you go wrong?"
Text: "그렇고말고. 거기에 전투에서의 내 무용을 더하면 어떻게 실패할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: Calibast's spirit slumps a little. "Ach, I should have tried a different tack with you, my stoic friend. Such is my fierce love of life that I hoped to draw you into it."
Text: 캘리바스트의 영혼이 조금 풀이 죽습니다. "으, 다른 방법으로 접근했어야 했는데, 과묵한 친구여. 삶에 대한 내 뜨거운 사랑이 너에게도 전해지길 바랐건만."

TextEng: "If all the fun and flirtation are not enough to hold us together, then think of the strength of my arms and my ferocity in battle. We have seen much, my friend; let us see more together."
Text: "재미와 유혹이 우리를 묶기에 부족하다면, 내 팔의 힘과 전투의 맹렬함을 생각해 줘. 많은 것을 함께 겪었잖아, 친구여."

TextEng: "If the wine, women and song don't bond us together, then think of the strength of my arms and my ferocity in battle. We have been through much, my friend; let us do more together."
Text: "술과 여자와 노래가 우리를 묶기에 부족하다면, 내 팔의 힘과 전투의 맹렬함을 생각해 줘. 많은 것을 함께 겪었잖아, 친구여."

TextEng: If a spirit could possibly become paler, Calibast suddenly does. "I understand, <FirstName>, but remember all of the good times we had, when it comes time to choose."
Text: 영혼이 더 창백해질 수 있다면, 캘리바스트가 갑자기 그렇게 됩니다. "이해하네, <이름>, 하지만 우리의 좋은 시절을 기억해 줘, 판단할 때."

TextEng: "I should like to think that being friends for so long should mean something. Well, go speak to the others."
Text: "오랜 친구라는 게 뭔가 의미가 있어야 한다고 생각했는데. 그래, 다른 사람들에게 가서 이야기해 봐."

TextEng: "Good to hear it, <lad/lass>. What would your choice be then?"
Text: "좋은 소식이군. 선택은 뭐지?"

TextEng: "I suppose you have a right to take your time choosing. Is there anything else old Calibast can do for you?"
Text: "시간을 들일 권리는 있지. 다른 것 도와줄 게 있나?"

TextEng: Calibast's soul lets out a deafening screech as it is drawn away from its body and off into eternity.
Text: 캘리바스트의 영혼이 귀를 찢는 비명을 지르며 몸에서 떨어져 영원 속으로 끌려갑니다.

TextEng: He nods, showing that he understands, and then fades away into oblivion. You hear a whisper as he goes. "Drink a toast to my soul, in remembrance." Then he is gone.
Text: 그가 고개를 끄덕여 이해했음을 보이더니 망각 속으로 사라집니다. 사라지며 속삭임이 들립니다. "내 영혼을 위해 한잔 들어 줘, 기억으로."

TextEng: "Against my better judgment, I think I will need your skills."
Text: "판단에는 어긋나지만, 네 능력이 필요할 것 같아."

TextEng: "I would like you to return and assist me."
Text: "돌아와서 나를 도와줬으면 해."

TextEng: "I have a few questions for you first."
Text: "먼저 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 다 했어."

TextEng: "Tell me what you think about the others?"
Text: "다른 동료들에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "Thanks for your candor."
Text: "솔직하게 말해 줘서 고마워."

TextEng: "What do you mean she still courts death?"
Text: "카이달라가 아직도 죽음을 갈망한다니 무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "I need to speak to the others before I decide."
Text: "결정하기 전에 다른 사람들과 이야기해야겠어."

TextEng: "What skills can you offer me, exactly?"
Text: "정확히 어떤 능력을 제공할 수 있지?"

TextEng: "Why are you on fire?"
Text: "왜 불이 붙어 있는 거야?"

TextEng: "Tell me why I should choose you."
Text: "왜 널 선택해야 하는지 말해 봐."

TextEng: "I might enjoy watching your smug charm wither in death more."
Text: "네 건방진 매력이 죽음 속에서 시들어 가는 걸 보는 게 더 재미있을 수도 있어."

TextEng: "Promise me the next three... conquests, and I'll think about it."
Text: "앞으로 세 번의... 정복을 약속하면 생각해 볼게."

TextEng: "We have had some good times together, Calibast."
Text: "우리 함께 좋은 시간을 보내긴 했지, 캘리바스트."

TextEng: "You are a lush and a letch, Calibast. Don't lump me into your failings."
Text: "넌 술주정뱅이에 바람둥이야, 캘리바스트. 네 결점에 나를 끌어들이지 마."

TextEng: "I have made a choice."
Text: "선택했어."

TextEng: "I've changed my mind; I'm not ready to choose."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어. 아직 선택할 준비가 안 됐어."

TextEng: "Enjoy your time in the underworld; you'll not be leaving it soon!"
Text: "저승에서 즐거운 시간 보내. 금방 나오지는 못할 거야!"

TextEng: "I cannot choose you, old friend."
Text: "널 선택할 수 없어, 오랜 친구."

TextEng: "Are we ready then?" Jaboli's spirit purrs quietly, waiting patiently to find out her ultimate fate.
Text: "준비가 됐나?" 자볼리의 영혼이 조용히 가르랑거리며, 자신의 최종 운명을 참을성 있게 기다린다.

TextEng: Jaboli's spirit rises up, trembling with either fear or rage. She appears to listen to an inaudible voice, and then looks at you carefully.
Text: 자볼리의 영혼이 두려움이든 분노든 떨리며 떠오릅니다. 들리지 않는 목소리에 귀 기울이다 당신을 주의 깊게 바라봅니다.

TextEng: "You have made a good choice; one I will give you no reason to regret."
Text: "좋은 선택이야. 후회할 이유를 주지 않겠어."

TextEng: "We know much about each other, yet we have often kept secrets too. I will answer as best as I can."
Text: "우리는 서로에 대해 많이 알지만 비밀도 간직해 왔지. 최선을 다해 답하겠어."

TextEng: "Then perhaps you are ready to choose, unless you wish to seek answers from the others first? Either way, I am not going anywhere until you are ready."
Text: "그럼 선택할 준비가 됐겠네. 다른 사람들에게 먼저 물어보고 싶지 않다면? 어느 쪽이든 네가 준비될 때까지 기다리겠어."

TextEng: "While I feel for the difficulties she has faced, I do not care for Kaidala overmuch. She is too insecure, which goes against my own confident nature."
Text: "그녀가 겪은 어려움은 안됐지만, 카이달라를 그다지 좋아하지는 않아. 너무 불안해하는데, 내 자신감 넘치는 성격과 맞지 않거든."

TextEng: "Calibast is strong, and a good companion, so I would recommend him on those counts. Trip is rather pathetic in a fight, but he is an excellent thief."
Text: "캘리바스트는 강하고 좋은 동료야, 그 점에서는 추천하겠어. 트립은 전투에서는 한심하지만 뛰어난 도둑이야."

TextEng: "You know your strengths and weaknesses better than I, and the decision is yours. If you desperately need a healer, then you might need the insecure nymph. I just hope you will choose me."
Text: "네 장단점은 네가 가장 잘 알고, 결정은 네 몫이야. 치유사가 절실히 필요하다면 그 불안한 님프가 필요할 수도 있어."

TextEng: "I can only ever offer an opinion, but I will always tell you the truth. I will not hide behind a false mask just to say pleasing things."
Text: "의견만 줄 수 있을 뿐이지만, 항상 진실을 말하겠어. 듣기 좋은 말을 하려고 거짓 가면 뒤에 숨지 않을 거야."

TextEng: "The damage to her physical body was bad enough, but her spirit was far worse off. She will do as you ask, but she will accept death better than any."
Text: "육체의 손상도 심했지만, 정신은 훨씬 더 심했어. 시키는 대로 하겠지만, 누구보다 죽음을 쉽게 받아들일 거야."

TextEng: "The rest of us will fight to hold on to life, but I worry that Kaidala will suddenly give in one day and let herself die when she is really needed."
Text: "나머지는 살기 위해 싸우겠지만, 카이달라가 어느 날 갑자기 포기하고 정말 필요할 때 죽게 놔둘까 봐 걱정돼."

TextEng: "Trip is weak and cowardly, but I think he could be trained to be useful. When he strikes from the shadows, he can be quite formidable."
Text: "트립은 약하고 겁쟁이지만, 훈련하면 쓸모가 있을 수 있어. 그림자에서 공격할 때는 꽤 무시무시하거든."

TextEng: "This is not a test I envy you, my friend. Still, I would rather be alive than dead. I assume that the voice speaking to me also spoke to you. So what shall you do?"
Text: "이건 부럽지 않은 시험이야, 친구. 그래도 죽는 것보단 사는 게 낫지. 나에게 말하는 목소리가 너에게도 말했겠지. 그래서 어떻게 할 거야?"

TextEng: "Magic, intelligence, a knowledge of tactics, and an ability to discern the motivations and lies of others. If I am in your party, I will try to be sure that no one deceives you."
Text: "마법, 지성, 전술 지식, 그리고 타인의 동기와 거짓말을 꿰뚫는 능력. 내가 일행에 있으면 보좌관이 되어 줄게."

TextEng: "All of these abilities wrapped up in a perfectly magnificent package... how could you resist?"
Text: "이 모든 능력이 완벽하고 멋진 포장에 담겨 있으니... 어떻게 거부할 수 있겠어?"

TextEng: "The power of the rakshasa is well known, though I am far limited in comparison to how I was before banishment. My people stripped me of my sorcererous powers, forcing me to learn something new."
Text: "락샤사의 힘은 널리 알려져 있지만, 추방당하기 전에 비하면 크게 약해졌어. 내 종족이 선천적 마법 능력을 빼앗았거든."

TextEng: "I am now a wizard, and I find my new calling to be more to my liking. I also still retain some of my natural spell resistance, despite the weakness of my exile."
Text: "이제 나는 마법사이고, 새 소명이 더 마음에 들어. 약해진 상태지만 선천적 주문 저항력도 어느 정도 남아 있어."

TextEng: Jaboli nods slowly. "I am good at analyzing people and what they say, so that I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: 자볼리가 천천히 고개를 끄덕입니다. "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있지. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "I was always smarter than most of my peers. I find the intellectual challenge of wizardry to be more in line with my own nature. So, yes, I am good at it."
Text: "동료들보다 항상 똑똑했어. 마법학의 지적 도전이 내 본성에 더 맞아. 그래서 마법에 능하냐고? 그래."

TextEng: "I am also good at analyzing people and what they say, so that I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데도 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있지. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "I have a different view on life than my people do. I would rather not discuss the details of my exile right now. I have other qualities though."
Text: "내 종족과는 다른 인생관을 가지고 있어. 추방의 자세한 내용은 지금 이야기하고 싶지 않아. 하지만 다른 자질이 있지."

TextEng: "I am good at analyzing people and what they say. I can determine what motivates them, and often I can tell if they are lying. This could be useful to you."
Text: "사람을 분석하고 그들의 말에서 동기를 파악하는 데 능해. 거짓말인지도 종종 알아낼 수 있어. 유용할 거야."

TextEng: "Not at all. It is just that such a statement would be very egotistical and very typical for one of my species. As you already know, I have a rather different view on life then the rest of my species."
Text: "전혀. 그런 말은 매우 이기적이고 전형적인 락샤사 스러울 뿐이거든. 이미 알다시피 나는 상당히 다른 관점을 가지고 있어."

TextEng: "Will you choose the path of wisdom and discernment and choose me for an ally? Oh, what a typically rakshasa thing to say. Sorry, I didn't mean it that way."
Text: "지혜와 분별의 길을 택하고 나를 동맹으로 택하겠나? 아, 전형적인 락샤사 같은 말이군. 미안, 그런 뜻은 아니었어."

TextEng: "You are a scholar of the arcane arts, as am I. While I have greatly enjoyed our time together and the things we have learned and shared, I find it highly unlikely that you would choose me."
Text: "너도 나처럼 비전 마법의 학도지. 함께한 시간과 배우고 나눈 것들이 즐거웠지만, 나를 선택해야 한다고 주장하기는 어렵군."
