Text: "고블린이라! 두개골을 부숴버릴 시간이오, <FirstName>! 놈들의 파멸을 즐기며 이 사람들의 마음을 사로잡읍시다."

TextEng: "You have cleared the goblin caves, or so I have heard, but you have not reported the job finished to my Aunt. I will take you to her so that you can tell her and she can postpone the vote for you."
Text: "고블린 동굴을 정리하셨다고 들었는데, 이모에게 완료 보고를 안 하셨잖아요. 원하시면 데려다 드릴게요."

TextEng: "Great. Just follow me, like always."
Text: "좋아요. 늘 그렇듯 따라오세요."

TextEng: "Good luck. Come speak to me if you would like a guide to take you outside the city. I will stay here until you need me."
Text: "행운을 빌어요. 도시 밖으로 안내가 필요하시면 말씀해 주세요. 필요할 때까지 여기 있을게요."

TextEng: "It is both my job and my pleasure. The keep already pays me, so I can help you for free. Where would you like to go?"
Text: "제 일이자 기쁨이에요. 거점에서 이미 급료를 받고 있으니, 무료로 도와드릴 수 있어요. 어디로 가시겠어요?"

TextEng: "If you're just looking for stuff to do, the Guildhall's always a good place to start. Besides, I never turn down a chance to poke my nose into my Aunt Serah's business and see what she's up to. And The Stan's always fun to talk to, too."
Text: "할 일을 찾고 계시다면, 길드 홀이 항상 좋은 출발점이에요. 게다가 저는 모험의 기회를 절대 마다하지 않거든요!"

TextEng: "The Stan is the master of the trades guild. He's unusual, but he usually all manner of crazy quests that he wants people to do for him."
Text: "더 스탠은 상인 길드의 길드장이에요. 좀 별난 사람이지만, 항상 온갖 기상천외한 의뢰를 갖고 있어요."

TextEng: "He pays pretty well, too, which is always nice. Of course, there are other guildmasters in the Guildhall, too, and then some others that are spread around the keep, so you could just explore if you wanted to."
Text: "보수도 꽤 후하고, 그건 항상 좋죠. 물론 길드 홀에 다른 길드장들도 있고, 시장에도 할 일이 가득해요."

TextEng: "Right away, m'<Lord/Lady>."
Text: "바로 가요, 영주님."

TextEng: "Archeologists are funny, always digging around in the dirt for something that everybody's already forgotten about. I say if we forget something happened, there's probably a good reason for it. But that's just my opinion. I'll take you there pronto."
Text: "고고학자들은 참 재미있어요. 다들 이미 잊어버린 걸 찾겠다고 항상 흙을 파고 있으니. 잠든 개는 건드리지 말라고 하잖아요, 특히 죽은 개는요."

TextEng: "I'm glad we found those because I hear he had enough in store to lay a fair-sized siege. Come on, I'll take you there."
Text: "그걸 찾아서 다행이에요. 들리는 바로는 꽤 규모 있는 포위전을 벌일 만큼 비축해 두었다고 하더라고요. 자, 그리로 데려다 드릴게요."

TextEng: "Dwarves are so industrious. It's a shame about the air quality, though. I wouldn't be able to live a day if all there was to smell was dust and dwarves... But enough of my blather. I'll take you right there."
Text: "드워프들은 정말 부지런해요. 하지만 공기 질은 안타까워요. 먼지와 흙밖에 없는 곳에서는 하루도 못 살 거예요."

TextEng: "Wow, the old ruins have always given me the heebie jeebies. My aunt says there was some powerful magic there once. I'll take you right there but there's no way I'm going inside!"
Text: "와, 그 오래된 유적은 항상 소름이 돋아요. 이모 말로는 한때 강력한 마법이 있었다고 해요. 거기까지 데려다 드릴 수 있지만, 들어가진 않을 거예요!"

TextEng: "Not very much. It seems that the enemy used some old, abandoned mines and had some excavation done to house the army."
Text: "별로 알려진 건 없어요. 적이 오래된 폐광을 이용하고 군대를 주둔시키기 위해 굴착 작업을 한 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Just a hop, skip and a jump, but watch that last jump or you'll get lost." She grins and laughs as she runs off, beckoning you to follow.
Text: "깡충깡충 금방이에요. 하지만 마지막에 조심하지 않으면 길을 잃을 수 있어요." 씩 웃으며 뛰어가면서 따라오라고 손짓합니다.

TextEng: "Great! Follow me and try to keep up!"
Text: "좋아요! 따라오세요, 뒤처지지 마시고!"

TextEng: "That's what I'm here for. What would you like to know about?"
Text: "그러라고 여기 있는 거예요. 뭘 알고 싶으세요?"

TextEng: "Is there anything else you need, m'<lord/lady>?"
Text: "더 필요한 거 있으세요, 영주님?"

TextEng: "Other than the caves, there isn't too much to talk about. There is a Hermit who keeps bees and sometimes sells their honey. Haven't seen him around in a while though."
Text: "동굴 외에는 별로 이야기할 게 없어요. 벌을 기르면서 가끔 꿀을 파는 은둔자가 있어요. 정말 맛있어요. 그 사람 외에는 거점 주변 땅이 꽤 황량해요."

TextEng: "Sometimes we get a caravan just outside the main gates. Hopefully there wasn't one there when the attack began, or they'll all be dead now."
Text: "가끔 정문 바깥에 대상이 오기도 해요. 공격이 시작됐을 때 거기 없었으면 좋겠는데, 아니면 죽었을 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "Other than that, there isn't a lot other than some hunting and the odd monster. Anything else?"
Text: "그 외에는 사냥이나 가끔 나타나는 괴물 정도예요. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "That is too bad. He was strange, but likable enough. Sad about the honey too; he always had the best."
Text: "안타깝네요. 좀 이상한 사람이었지만 나름 괜찮았거든요. 꿀도 아쉬워요. 항상 최고의 꿀이었는데."

TextEng: "That is wonderful. He always has the best honey!"
Text: "그거 정말 좋은 소식이에요. 항상 최고의 꿀이었거든요!"

TextEng: "What does he need help with?"
Text: "어떤 도움이 필요한데요?"

TextEng: "When you began to explore the caves and wreak havok on parts of the army, the enemy collapsed the tunnels leading to his main base. That's all I know. So, ready to go then?"
Text: "당신이 동굴을 탐험하며 군대의 일부를 공격하기 시작하자, 적이 본대로 향하는 터널을 무너뜨렸어요. 제가 아는 건 그게 다예요."

TextEng: "Is he really that bad? I guess I'll have to speak to Feran about this. The Hand will be too busy right now."
Text: "정말 그렇게 심각해요? 페란에게 얘기해 봐야겠네요. 핸드는 지금 너무 바쁠 테니."

TextEng: "I will do that. He really didn't seem to be a bad guy and I loved his honey."
Text: "그렇게 할게요. 정말 나쁜 사람 같진 않았고 꿀도 정말 좋아했거든요."

TextEng: "I could do that. I am always looking to make a little extra gold on the side. He really didn't seem to be a bad guy and I loved his honey."
Text: "제가 할 수 있어요. 항상 부수입을 찾고 있거든요. 정말 나쁜 사람 같진 않았고 꿀도 정말 좋아했어요."

TextEng: "There are quite a few caves near here, and ever since the army disappeared with Lord Keldrick, monsters have begun to make them their homes."
Text: "이 근처에 동굴이 꽤 많은데, 켈드릭 경과 함께 군대가 사라진 이후로 괴물들이 들어오기 시작했어요."

TextEng: "I imagine that is where the army of creatures came from. Something powerful and intelligent must be driving them to work together. Normally they just fight each other."
Text: "그 괴물 군대가 거기서 온 것 같아요. 뭔가 강력하고 지능적인 존재가 그들을 그렇게 협력하도록 조종하고 있는 게 틀림없어요."

TextEng: "I can lead you to specific caves, but it helps if you know which ones you want to go to."
Text: "특정 동굴로 안내해 드릴 수 있어요. 하지만 어디로 갈지 아시면 도움이 돼요."

TextEng: "The keep is broken up into two main sections. The Gates of Cyan is where most of the fighting took place. It opens into the South Keep, where the majority of the townspeople live and work."
Text: "거점은 크게 두 구역으로 나뉘어요. 시안의 성문은 전투가 가장 많이 벌어진 곳이에요. 시장, 여러 주거지, 이끼 나무 여관, 그리고 오래된 경비탑이 있어요."

TextEng: "The North Keep is where the wealthier townsfolk live and includes the Temple and the Silver Lily Inn. If you don't want to pay the extra cost for room charge, you might consider the Mossy Tree in the South Keep."
Text: "북쪽 거점에는 부유한 주민들이 살고 신전과 은백합 여관이 있어요. 남의 눈에 띄고 싶지 않으시면, 하수도를 통하는 걸 추천해요."

TextEng: "The North Keep also holds our Guildhall where the Banner, the Hand and the Lord all live, as well as where the guild offices are. Do you need anything more specific?"
Text: "북쪽 거점에는 길드 홀도 있는데, 기치, 핸드, 그리고 영주가 거주하는 곳이자 길드 사무실이 있는 곳이에요."

TextEng: "There are plenty of tasks that need done, but the best place for adventurers to find work is at The Trades, in the Guildhall. The Stan can probably line up some jobs for you."
Text: "해야 할 일이 많지만, 모험가들이 일을 찾기 가장 좋은 곳은 길드 홀의 상인 길드예요."

TextEng: "I hope you are getting closer to becoming the Lord of the Keep. How can I help you?" Alias grins as you approach.
Text: "거점의 영주가 되는 데 점점 가까워지고 있길 바라요. 어떻게 도와드릴까요?" 앨리어스가 당신이 다가오자 활짝 웃습니다.

TextEng: "You will need to find a room to stay in. The Mossy Tree Inn is a cheaper place to stay, but still good quality, or if you have a little more coin to spend, The Silver Lily is a very nice inn."
Text: "숙소를 찾아야 할 거예요. 이끼 나무 여관은 저렴하면서도 질이 좋고, 돈이 있으시면 북쪽 거점의 은백합 여관이 정말 고급이에요."

TextEng: "I would suggest the Temple of the Nine Gods, in the North Keep. I am sure they could help you out."
Text: "북쪽 거점에 있는 구신전을 추천해요. 분명 도움을 받을 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "There are numerous stores and merchants around here. You might want to try the Pawnshop, the Smithy, the Quartermaster, Yenna's Tower or even the Temple."
Text: "여기 주변에 가게와 상인이 많아요. 전당포, 대장간, 보급관, 아니면 바위를 가보시는 게 좋을 거예요. 락 바텀의 가게는 꽤 독특해요."

TextEng: "Just wander around and I'm sure you'll find what you need."
Text: "그냥 돌아다녀 보세요. 필요한 걸 찾으실 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "There are nine guilds, each headed by a man or woman who is outstanding in their specialty. For example, my Aunt Serah is the guildmaster of the landowners."
Text: "길드가 아홉 개 있고, 각각 해당 분야에서 뛰어난 사람이 이끌고 있어요. 예를 들어, 세라 이모는 지주 길드의 길드장이에요."

TextEng: "She owns some of the most productive farmlands in the area. I'll tell you right now that if you prove yourself by destroying some of the monstrous army that attacked us, she would likely vote for you."
Text: "이모는 이 지역에서 가장 생산적인 농지를 갖고 있어요. 미리 말씀드리면, 이모 땅의 고블린을 처치해서 실력을 증명하시면 지지해 줄 거예요."

TextEng: "She always favors deeds over words, so along with my recommendation, I'm sure you will have her vote. The rest of the guildmasters are a different story, but you'll manage. All you need is time."
Text: "이모는 항상 말보다 행동을 중시하니까, 제 추천과 함께라면 분명 이모의 표를 얻으실 거예요. 나머지 길드장들은 각자 필요한 게 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "Enivid would seem to be the obvious choice to become the Lady of the Keep, but she has alienated a lot of us. Her strict rules and obsession with order have caused many hard feelings."
Text: "에니비드가 거점의 여주가 되기에 가장 자명한 선택처럼 보이지만, 많은 사람을 멀리했어요. 법과 선에 대한 엄격한 관점이 보통 시민에게는 너무 가혹하거든요."

TextEng: "The truth is, I think she scares people. Nobody can live up to her ideal, so they are nervous around her, waiting to be judged."
Text: "솔직히, 사람들이 그녀를 무서워하는 것 같아요. 아무도 그녀의 이상에 부합할 수 없으니, 심판받을까 봐 긴장하거든요."

TextEng: "Having said that, the gods know you couldn't be much worse than Sir Becket!"
Text: "그렇긴 해도, 신들도 아시겠지만 베켓 경보다는 훨씬 나으실 거예요!"

TextEng: "Yes! I knew you would prove to be a hero. Make sure you go to the Guildhall and tell Aunt Serah. She'll probably want to reward you."
Text: "네! 영웅임을 증명할 줄 알았어요. 길드 홀에 가서 세라 이모에게 알려주세요. 아마 축하해 주실 거예요!"

TextEng: "Sir Becket is a corrupt, craven, coward! He will drain the resources of the keep and flee the next time we are attacked."
Text: "베켓 경은 부패하고 비겁한 겁쟁이예요! 거점의 자원을 빼돌리다가 다음 공격 때 도망칠 거예요. 확신해요."

TextEng: "No. I have only what I can see and hear. But as I am a scout, those are the senses that keep me alive. All my instincts tell me that he is a monster. You must be better than him."
Text: "아뇨. 제가 가진 건 보고 듣는 것뿐이에요. 하지만 정찰병으로서, 그게 저를 살려주는 감각이에요. 모든 본능이 베켓은 나쁜 사람이라고 외치고 있어요."

TextEng: "If the election were held right now, you would lose. People need to get to know you... to trust you. They would follow Enivid, because they know and respect her."
Text: "지금 당장 선거를 하면 지실 거예요. 사람들이 당신을 알고... 신뢰해야 해요. 사람들은 에니비드를 따를 거예요. 동의하든 안 하든 그녀의 관점이 분명하니까요."

TextEng: "They might follow Sir Becket, because he has had time to fool some and to control others. You are the wild card. You really need time."
Text: "베켓 경을 따를 수도 있어요. 그는 일부를 속이고 다른 이들을 조종할 시간이 있었으니까요. 당신은 변수예요. 미지의 존재이고, 그건 위험하죠."

TextEng: "I really don't pay much attention to politics. I try to spend as much time outside the keep as possible."
Text: "저는 정치에 별로 관심이 없어요. 가능한 한 거점 밖에서 시간을 보내려고 하거든요."

TextEng: "The best person to ask is probably Momma Dane. She spends most of her time helping others in the keep and she loves to talk. I'm sure she would love to tell you what you want to know."
Text: "물어보기 가장 좋은 사람은 아마 마마 데인이에요. 거점에서 다른 사람들을 도우면서 대부분의 시간을 보내고 수다를 좋아하거든요."

TextEng: "She is usually in the marketplace, where people can easily find her if they need help."
Text: "보통 시장에 있어요. 도움이 필요한 사람들이 쉽게 찾을 수 있게요."

TextEng: "The nine guildmasters will meet in the castle, where they will each cast a stone; a different color for each of the contestants. The person with the most votes wins."
Text: "아홉 명의 길드장이 성에서 모여 각자 돌을 던져요. 후보마다 다른 색의 돌이죠."

TextEng: "So you need at least four votes, with no other opponent getting more than three. You have chosen the most difficult path, but it certainly has the greatest reward."
Text: "그러니까 최소 네 표가 필요하고, 다른 후보가 세 표 이상 얻으면 안 돼요. 가장 어려운 권력의 길을 선택하셨지만, 제 생각엔 가장 좋은 길이에요."

TextEng: "Oh, and I should tell you, the more votes you get, the more secure your position will be, but don't try to get them all, or people will become suspicious. Just a suggestion."
Text: "아, 그리고 말씀드리면, 표를 많이 받을수록 지위가 안정적이지만, 전부 얻으려고 하지는 마세요. 분명 몇몇 길드장은 다른 후보로 마음이 굳어있을 거예요."

TextEng: "I can do that. Just let me gather up my stuff and then we can go."
Text: "할 수 있어요. 짐만 좀 챙기면 바로 출발해요."

TextEng: "I understand. If you want to move around the countryside quickly, come back and speak to me. Otherwise, god speed."
Text: "알겠어요. 시골을 빠르게 이동하고 싶으시면 다시 찾아와 주세요. 아니면, 행운을 빌어요."

TextEng: "I will do my best. What would you like?"
Text: "최선을 다할게요. 뭘 원하세요?"

TextEng: "I will do my best, though politics are not one of my strengths. The most important thing you need is time to gain votes over your competitors. What would you like to know?"
Text: "최선을 다하겠지만, 정치는 제 강점이 아니에요. 가장 중요한 건 표를 얻을 시간이에요. 세라 이모가 그걸 도와줄 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Aunt Serah is a very earthy woman. She has lands just outside of town. She has been asking for help from the military guild for almost a year now."
Text: "세라 이모는 매우 현실적인 분이에요. 마을 바로 밖에 토지를 가지고 있어요. 군사 길드에 도움을 요청했지만 지금은 너무 바빠서요."

TextEng: "There is a cave on her property that some goblins moved into. Unfortunately the military has been weak since Lord Keldrik left with most of our army."
Text: "이모의 땅에 있는 동굴에 고블린들이 들어왔어요. 안타깝게도 켈드릭 경이 군대를 이끌고 떠난 후 돌아오지 않아서 군사력이 약해졌거든요."

TextEng: "If you were to get rid of the goblins for her, I'm sure Aunt Serah would support your cause. I can even lead you to the caves myself."
Text: "고블린을 처치해 주시면, 세라 이모가 분명 당신을 지지할 거예요. 동굴까지 안내해 드릴 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "I suppose there are probably things you need to do first. Did you have other questions?"
Text: "먼저 해야 할 일이 있으시겠죠. 다른 질문 있으세요?"

TextEng: "She has offered a bounty of 200 gold for the clearing of the caves. That would be yours, besides the vote. She might also give you something even more precious... time."
Text: "동굴 정리에 금화 200개의 현상금을 걸었어요. 표 외에 그것도 당신 거예요. 거점의 식량 보급 할인도 해줄 수 있을 거예요."

TextEng: "If they hold the election right away, you might not have time to sway enough votes. Aunt Serah's guild usually votes together on an issue to decide how my aunt should vote."
Text: "선거를 바로 하면, 충분한 표를 확보할 시간이 없을 수 있어요. 세라 이모의 길드는 보통 가능한 빨리 선거를 하자고 투표하지만, 부탁을 들어주시면 마음을 바꿀 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "If you solve my aunt's problem, I am sure she would be willing to slow down the vote by holding off the landowner's guild vote."
Text: "이모의 문제를 해결해 주시면, 지주 길드 투표를 미뤄서 선거를 늦춰줄 거라 확신해요."

TextEng: "Well, here we are. This is as far as I go. I can remain here and help you get back to town, or I can just return to the keep. Which would you prefer?"
Text: "자, 다 왔어요. 여기까지가 제 역할이에요. 여기서 기다리면서 마을로 돌아가는 걸 도와드릴 수도 있고, 그냥 거점으로 돌아갈 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "You should be. I can tell you that right now, you wouldn't even likely get a single vote. Nobody knows you yet. Time is your worst enemy right now."
Text: "걱정하셔야 해요. 솔직히 말하면, 지금 당장은 단 한 표도 못 받으실 거예요. 아직 아무도 당신을 몰라요. 시간이 최고의 동맹이에요."

TextEng: "Unless you don't really care about winning the election... ha, ha, ha. As if anyone would turn down the Lordship of a castle, plus the income, plus the lands, and the fame that would come with the position."
Text: "선거에서 이기는 게 별로 중요하지 않은 게 아니라면요... 하하하. 도시의 영주 자리를 마다할 사람이 어디 있겠어요."

TextEng: "I mean, who knows... a good lord could expand our borders... conquer other territories... maybe even become a king."
Text: "생각해 보세요... 좋은 영주라면 영토를 넓히고... 다른 지역을 정복하고... 어쩌면 왕이 될 수도 있어요."

TextEng: Alias sighs and looks at the ground. "I don't know what drives you, so maybe I should tell you what drives me."
Text: 앨리어스가 한숨을 쉬며 땅을 바라봅니다. "당신이 뭘 원하시는지 모르겠으니, 제가 뭘 원하는지 말해볼게요."

TextEng: "The people here are not all good people, nor all bad people. Despite their many strengths, many are easily duped into following someone who looks noble, like Sir Becket."
Text: "여기 사람들이 다 좋은 사람도, 다 나쁜 사람도 아니에요. 많은 장점에도 불구하고, 자신감 있어 보인다는 이유만으로 가짜 강점을 가진 사람을 쉽게 따르곤 해요."

TextEng: "Others are impressed by the noble carriage of someone like Enivid. But neither choice is the right one. Who knows, maybe you aren't the right one either."
Text: "에니비드 같은 사람의 고귀한 태도에 감명받는 사람들도 있어요. 하지만 어느 쪽도 옳은 선택이 아니에요. 어쩌면 기분 좋은 놀라움이 있을지 모르지만..." 당신을 바라보며 망연한 표정으로 머뭇거립니다.

TextEng: A tear forms in the corner of Alias's eye. "I guess I was wrong about you then. Do as you will."
Text: 앨리어스의 눈가에 눈물이 맺힙니다. "당신에 대해 제가 틀렸나 보네요. 마음대로 하세요."

TextEng: "What do you need of me?"
Text: "제가 뭘 도와드리면 될까요?"

TextEng: "Sir Becket is thoroughly corrupt and he is a craven coward. He will drain the resources of this keep and then flee when danger comes."
Text: "베켓 경은 완전히 부패했고 비열한 겁쟁이예요. 거점의 자원을 빼돌리다가 가장 필요할 때 도망칠 거예요."

TextEng: "Enivid has good intentions, but her view of the world is too limited. She can't see any shades of gray."
Text: "에니비드는 좋은 뜻을 가지고 있지만, 세계관이 너무 좁아요. 회색 지대를 전혀 보지 못해요."

TextEng: "As you wish."
Text: "알겠어요."

TextEng: "I don't know why you are having such difficulty with becoming a leader, but I simply have a feeling that you are the one we need. Perhaps you believe I am just a foolish child, but I am more than that."
Text: "왜 지도자가 되는 게 그렇게 어려운지 모르겠지만, 당신이야말로 여기 모든 문제를 해결할 수 있는 사람이라는 느낌이 들어요."

TextEng: "Allow me to help you. You can be more than this. You could be the <Lord/Lady> we have been searching for. All you have to do is try."
Text: "도와드리게 해주세요. 당신은 그 이상이 될 수 있어요. 우리가 찾던 영주가 될 수 있어요. 노력만 하시면 돼요."

TextEng: "I guess I don't! You are a bitter disappointment! What would you have of me then?"
Text: "그런 것 같아요! 정말 실망이에요! 그럼 제가 뭘 하면 되겠어요?"

TextEng: "There is always choice. I just hope you will make the right one. So would you like to go to the caves or did you have more questions?"
Text: "항상 선택은 있어요. 옳은 선택을 하시길 바랄 뿐이에요. 그래서 동굴로 가시겠어요, 아니면 더 질문이 있으세요?"

TextEng: "That is all anyone can ask. So would you like to go to the caves or did you have more questions?"
Text: "그게 누구에게나 바랄 수 있는 전부예요. 그래서 동굴로 가시겠어요, 아니면 더 질문이 있으세요?"

TextEng: "I know you are a paladin too, but you have seen more of the world than Enivid has. You can make difficult choices that I don't think Enivid can. At least I hope so."
Text: "당신도 성기사인 건 알지만, 에니비드보다 더 넓은 세상을 봤잖아요. 그녀가 못하는 어려운 선택을 할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Then we need to focus on making you the perfect <lord/lady>. First, you need my aunt to buy you some time."
Text: "그럼 완벽한 영주로 만드는 데 집중해야 해요. 먼저, 이모에게 시간을 좀 벌어달라고 해야 해요."

TextEng: "Yes, but first you need to solve her little problem. Would you like me to take you to the caves?"
Text: "네, 하지만 먼저 이모의 작은 문제를 해결해야 해요. 동굴로 안내해 드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Aunt Serah is a woman of actions over words. If you do the job for her, then speak to her, she'll be more impressed."
Text: "세라 이모는 말보다 행동을 중시하는 분이에요. 일을 먼저 해주고 나서 말씀드리면 더 감명받으실 거예요."

TextEng: "Great! Follow me and try to keep up!"
Text: "좋아요! 따라오세요, 뒤처지지 마시고!"

TextEng: "Not yet."
Text: "아직이야."

TextEng: "That does stir the imagination."
Text: "상상력이 자극되는데."

TextEng: "I don't seek any of those things."
Text: "그런 건 원하지 않아."

TextEng: "How do you know I'm not a worse choice?"
Text: "내가 더 나쁜 선택이 아닌 걸 어떻게 알아?"

TextEng: "I don't care what you think."
Text: "네 생각은 상관없어."

TextEng: "What do you think the right choice is?"
Text: "옳은 선택이 뭐라고 생각해?"

TextEng: "Why aren't they good choices?"
Text: "왜 그들은 좋은 선택이 아니야?"

TextEng: "I can find my own way back."
Text: "돌아가는 길은 알아서 찾을게."

TextEng: "I don't want the job. You don't know me at all."
Text: "그 자리 원하지 않아. 넌 나를 전혀 몰라."

TextEng: "I see no other choice, for now."
Text: "지금으로서는 다른 선택이 없어 보여."

TextEng: "I will do my best."
Text: "최선을 다할게."

TextEng: "That has some potential."
Text: "가능성이 있는 얘기야."

TextEng: "Perfect. By the time the vote happens, I'll be ready for it."
Text: "좋아. 투표할 때쯤이면 준비가 될 거야."

TextEng: "That could be handy."
Text: "쓸모 있겠는데."

TextEng: "Shouldn't we talk to her first?"
Text: "먼저 이모한테 얘기해야 하지 않아?"

TextEng: "Right now?"
Text: "지금 당장?"

TextEng: "Take me there, then."
Text: "그럼 데려다줘."

TextEng: "What kind of proof?"
Text: "어떤 증거?"

TextEng: "Tell me about yourself."
Text: "너에 대해 얘기해 봐."

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기 하자."

TextEng: "Just wait here for me."
Text: "여기서 기다리고 있어."

TextEng: "Where did you get your name?"
Text: "이름이 어떻게 된 거야?"

TextEng: "What is your real name?"
Text: "진짜 이름이 뭐야?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "You can trust me."
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "나를 믿어도 돼."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Burst out laughing.]</Start>
Text: <StartAction>[폭소를 터뜨린다.]</Start>

TextEng: "Mmm, yes, I think I shall call you Alias."
Text: "음, 그래, 앨리어스라고 부를게."

TextEng: "There is nothing wrong with that name."
Text: "그 이름 나쁘지 않은데."

TextEng: "How did you become a scout?"
Text: "어떻게 정찰병이 됐어?"

TextEng: "Tell me about your past."
Text: "과거에 대해 얘기해 봐."

TextEng: "I knew my parents well. You were probably better off without them."
Text: "내 부모는 잘 알아. 넌 오히려 없는 게 나았을 수도 있어."

TextEng: "That's alright, I'll be back."
Text: "괜찮아, 다시 올게."

TextEng: "Life happens. Get used to it."
Text: "인생이 그런 거야. 익숙해져."

TextEng: "I too am an orphan."
Text: "나도 고아야."

TextEng: "I am sorry about your parents."
Text: "부모님 일은 유감이야."

TextEng: "No, you go back without me."
Text: "아니, 나 없이 돌아가."

TextEng: "Like I don't have enough to do."
Text: "할 일이 부족하기라도 한 것처럼."

TextEng: "Speak to The Stan, good idea."
Text: "더 스탠에게 얘기하라고, 좋은 생각이야."

TextEng: "I am always interested in old magic."
Text: "오래된 마법에는 항상 관심 있어."

TextEng: "What kind of help?"
Text: "어떤 도움?"

TextEng: "This is my moment of triumph, couldn't you congratulate me first?"
Text: "내 승리의 순간인데, 먼저 축하해줄 수 없어?"

TextEng: "Calm yourself and tell me about it."
Text: "진정하고 얘기해 봐."

TextEng: "Yes, let's go."
Text: "응, 가자."

TextEng: "What happened?"
Text: "무슨 일이야?"

TextEng: "That must be the same woman Garrot told me about."
Text: "가롯이 말한 그 여자임이 틀림없어."

TextEng: "This is the old woman in the market place?"
Text: "시장에 있던 그 할머니가?"

TextEng: "She flew away?"
Text: "날아갔다고?"

TextEng: "Grandchild?"
Text: "손주?"

TextEng: "I can handle things by myself."
Text: "혼자서도 처리할 수 있어."

TextEng: "Not right now. Maybe later."
Text: "지금은 안 돼. 나중에."

TextEng: "Is there anyway to postpone the vote?"
Text: "투표를 연기할 방법은 없어?"

TextEng: "Let's go kill some goblins."
Text: "고블린이나 죽이러 가자."

TextEng: "I am ready."
Text: "준비됐어."

TextEng: "I guess we should kill some goblins then."
Text: "그럼 고블린을 죽여야겠군."

TextEng: "How can I help her?"
Text: "이모를 어떻게 도와줘?"

TextEng: "Let's go kill some goblins."
Text: "고블린이나 죽이러 가자."

TextEng: "I am ready for the election."
Text: "선거할 준비가 됐어."

TextEng: "Ask your Aunt to stall the vote."
Text: "이모에게 투표를 늦춰달라고 해."

TextEng: "Is there anyway to postpone the vote?"
Text: "투표를 연기할 방법은 없어?"

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕."

TextEng: "Let's go kill some goblins."
Text: "고블린이나 죽이러 가자."

TextEng: "Not really."
Text: "딱히."

TextEng: "Yes."
"Can you take me somewhere?"
Text: "어딘가로 데려다줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "I changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Is there anywhere you would suggest?"
Text: "추천하는 곳이 있어?"

TextEng: "Who is The Stan?"
Text: "더 스탠이 누구야?"

TextEng: "Take me to the Illithid Caves."
Text: "일리시드 동굴로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Take me to the archeological site."
Text: "고고학 유적지로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Take me to the Masked Man's supply caves."
Text: "가면 남자의 보급 동굴로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Take me to the dwarven mines."
Text: "드워프 광산으로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "What is known about these caves?"
Text: "이 동굴에 대해 알려진 게 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Take me to the wizards' school ruins."
Text: "마법사 학교 유적으로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Take me to the Guildhall."
Text: "길드 홀로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Take me to your aunt's caves."
Text: "이모의 동굴로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "No more questions."
Text: "질문은 더 없어."

TextEng: "Tell me about outside the keep."
Text: "거점 밖에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I met the Hermit. There was something wrong with him and I was forced to kill him."
Text: "은둔자를 만났어. 뭔가 이상해서 어쩔 수 없이 죽였어."

TextEng: "I met the Hermit. He should be coming into the keep to sell honey again soon."
Text: "은둔자를 만났어. 곧 거점에 와서 꿀을 팔 거야."

TextEng: "I met the Hermit. He needs some help."
Text: "은둔자를 만났어. 도움이 필요해."

TextEng: "He needs someone to go and put him out of his misery."
Text: "고통에서 벗어나게 해줄 사람이 필요해."

TextEng: "I don't know, but you should go and see him."
Text: "모르겠지만, 가서 직접 봐."

TextEng: "He needs someone to help him sell his honey."
Text: "꿀 파는 걸 도와줄 사람이 필요해."

TextEng: "Tell me about the caves."
Text: "동굴에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "안녕."

TextEng: "Tell me about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Where can I earn some gold?"
Text: "어디서 돈을 벌 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Where can I rest?"
Text: "어디서 쉴 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Where can I get healed?'
Text: "어디서 치료받을 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Where can I get supplies?"
Text: "어디서 보급품을 구할 수 있어?"

TextEng: "Tell me about the guildmasters."
Text: "길드장들에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "The hermit needs help."
Text: "은둔자에게 도움이 필요해."

TextEng: "Tell me about my competitors."
Text: "경쟁자에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "He bothers me too."
Text: "나도 그 사람 거슬려."

TextEng: "I rather liked him."
Text: "나는 꽤 좋았는데."

TextEng: "What is wrong with Sir Becket?"
Text: "베켓 경이 뭐가 문제야?"

TextEng: "Do you have evidence of this?"
Text: "증거가 있어?"

TextEng: "What is so important about time?"
Text: "시간이 왜 그렇게 중요해?"

TextEng: "I destroyed the goblins."
Text: "고블린을 처치했어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the other guildmasters."
Text: "다른 길드장들에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Explain the election process to me."
Text: "선거 과정을 설명해 줘."

TextEng: "I should be going."
Text: "이제 가봐야겠어."

TextEng: "Let's talk of something else."
Text: "다른 얘기 하자."

TextEng: "I have more questions about politics."
Text: "정치에 대해 더 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "Take me back to where we last were."
Text: "마지막에 있던 곳으로 데려다줘."

TextEng: "Tell me more about your Aunt Serah."
Text: "세라 이모에 대해 더 알려줘."

TextEng: "Not yet."
Text: "아직이야."

TextEng: "I would expect more reward than just a vote."
Text: "표 하나보다는 더 많은 보상을 기대하는데."

TextEng: "Time?"
Text: "시간?"

TextEng: "What ever. I'm not that worried about it."
Text: "뭐, 별로 걱정 안 해."

TextEng: "Me think... me think... no, me not think. Never mind."
"Becket be good man. Him gots gold, so must be good."
"If Becket be lord, maybe me get job as guard in castle."
"Becket be rich and noble. What you got on him?"
"Why you wanna be <lord/lady>? Becket be better than you."
"Becket gonna be good Lord of Keep."
"Can no believe you beat Becket. Him would be better leader."
"You may be good in a battle, but Sir Becket knows what the keep really needs."
"You do not stand much of a chance against the likes of Sir Becket."
"How can a woman like Enivid even think she could make a good ruler?"
"Sir Becket knows how to speak to a person in a very convincing way."
"I certainly hope that Sir Becket becomes our new lord. He is the kind of leader to make a person proud."
"Sir Becket and Ellysia make a perfect couple. Maybe someday they shall be King and Queen of all the North."
"It is a sad day when a commoner like yourself can beat a noble like Sir Becket."
"You may be good in a battle, but so is Enivid, and she's lived here all her life."
"You do not stand much of a chance against the likes of Enivid."
"Just because Enivid is a woman doesn't mean she wouldn't make a good ruler!"
"Enivid sticks to her beliefs and honor no matter what the circumstances."
"I certainly hope that Enivid becomes our new lady. She is the kind of leader to make a person proud."
"Sir Becket and Ellysia make an awful couple. The way they act, you'd think they were King and Queen of all the North."
"I still think Enivid would have made a good ruler."
"I've heard that the invaders might be taking slaves for some nefarious purpose."
"I had a small home outside of the keep, but I suppose it has been destroyed by now."
"That Sir Becket is an evil man. I hope you beat him... and I mean that literally."
"You seem like a decent sort of person. I hope you win the election."
"The invaders killed my cousin! Please stop them before they kill us all!"
"I like that our <Lord/Lady> of the Keep might be a real hero."
"It is good to see we have a <lord/lady> who cares about the little people."
"These invaders makes me angry. How's a thief s'posed to work with everyone so concerned and wary of an attack?"
"There's some easy marks 'round the noble's homes, but we's careful not to hit anyone Southpaw likes."
"Nobody tells us what to do, 'cept Southpaw."
"You ever see that Sir Becket's pleasure room. Him be one unusual fella."
"Ain't no way Southpaw would ever vote for that Enivid tart."
"I gots to admit, things are sweet with Southpaw in charge of the guild."
"So, you be a <Lord/Lady> now. Ain't impressin' me much."
"You are the hero who stopped the invaders from capturing the keep. Thank you for saving us."
"I hear you are in the election. You should try to get the priests to vote for you. Many people respect their opinion."
"I enjoy the quiet solitude that can be found here."
"I don't know why, but I feel like the gods might hear me better when I pray in here."
"I have been in here praying for my loved ones ever since the attack."
"I find the temple such a peaceful place, despite the mix of gods and goddesses."
"Good of you to stop in to pay your dues, pious <lord/lady>."
"Watch what you're doing in here. My master doesn't like intruders!"
"Can you spare a coin or two for someone down on their luck? Maybe some food for the hungry?"
"I understand."
"Sorry, <mister/missus>. Don't hurt me please!"
"That is very kind of you, <sir/madam>."
"That is very kind of you, <sir/madam>."
"I have so little gold. I can only give you a single gold piece."
"I'm so hungry. Very well, here is my last coin."
"Thank you very much. Oh, I am so hungry, this is a blessing."
"Thank you for helping me out, kind <sir/madam>."
"No. Sorry."
"Forget it then. Take the food."
"I need to give you this food, from the church."
"You smell awful! Get away from me!"
"Here's ten gold."
"Here is a gold piece."
"I have some food I could sell you."
"I'll take anything I can get."
"There, everything seems to be in order. Was there something I can help you with, <sir/madam>?"
"Very good. I shall keep watch and keep house. Have a pleasant day, <sir/madam>."
"It is the hand mirror she brought with her to her death. It has the power to resurrect your friends and loved ones when they fall, so use it wisely, <Master/Mistress>."
"Oh goodness, where to begin? You showed her sister, Lady Ellysia, the truth about that philandering scoundrel, Sir Becket. What is more, you brought Ellysia back together with her true love, Feran."

"All she ever wanted was for the people she loved to be happy and you, at long last, <sir/madam>, have given them that happiness. In so doing, you have given Lady Rehan at least a taste of that same joy."

"Yes, <sir/madam>, I do believe she has. I think I even saw a smile on her face as she faded from view. But the gift, <sir/madam>, she was very insistent that you receive it as a token of her thanks."
"Are you certain you aren't the new owner of this home? I am willing to abide by the finders-keepers rule. All I want to do is be a good butler."
A ghostly voice echoes out of the flames of the candelabra. "Good <quarterday>, <sir/madam>. Might I make an inquiry and give a piece of advice?"
"Unless you are ready to make war on ghostly spirits, you should probably leave. There are some pretty wilfull ghosts here. Just thought you might want to know."
"No problem. If you need anything in particular just speak to me again."
"So, are you the new <master/mistress> of the house, or are you simply... exploring?"
"Then I shall hope the best for you. Perhaps you shall be the first to enter this home and not join it in death."
"That would be entirely inappropriate and out of character for me, thank you very much! Besides, I'm not dressed for dancing. Maybe someday you could make me a nice golem body."
"Are you just a trespasser, or are you the new owner of the manor?"

"That is unfortunate. Had I someone to butle to, I would warn them of your intrusion. As it is, I suppose I shall not bother you, <sir/madam>, though I can not promise as much from the other spirits."
"Good news, <sir/madam>! I would love to serve as your personal butler, if you can clear the other spirits out of here, that is."
"No, not really. I love being a butler. It is all I have ever known. I can be a good helper, honest I can!"
"Oh, but <sir/madam>, I can take care of the house while you are gone, tell you if anyone tries to intrude, or even warn you if someone sneaks in to assassinate you."
"Such things happen from time to time, and I would prefer to remain here with the house than go elsewhere. Please?"
"Thank you! Thank you so very much! I won't let you down, I promise. If you need anything or have any questions, just come and speak to me."
"My name was Reginald Endros, but you can just call me Lampy. That's what all the other spirits called me, and it sort of fits."
"Then... I suppose my spirit shall depart this place. I am saddened by your decision, but it is your home now."
"Very difficult to put an answer to that question. I was a butler for this manor all of my life, but when our Lady died, I found my spirit trapped in this house."
"It is good to have a <master/mistress> again and perhaps you can lift the melancholy from this place. You might want to consider throwing a few parties, don't you think?"

"For the longest time I was like the other, angry spirits in here, but then I discovered that I could enter objects and move about. So now I am a candelabra butler... Except that I've no one to butle for, of late."
"Before I can tell you that, there is some information I must know about you."
"My apologies, I am Reginald Endros, the butler for Lady Rehan's estate."

"And don't go neglecting your health, either, <sir/madam>! That outfit doesn't look proper for the season - I haven't been outside in ages, but since you have to go outside all the time, you should dress warmly."

"Oh, it's never been a truly happy home. Even before Lady Rehan passed, she would sometimes weep just as she does now. But it was never my place to console her. Only to observe, as is befitting of a butler."

"The night before she died, a man came to visit her and spent it in her bed. It was as if she took on his joy and he took her weeping sadness... But I should not gossip about my former mistress. Suffice to say it did not end well."
"At any rate, her spirit still haunts this place as do those of all of us who served her. Be careful and do what you can for her."
"At any rate, things are much better now and m'Lady Rehan's spirit, at long last, rests in peace."
"Welcome back, <Master/Mistress>! In case you haven't noticed, I've been able to brighten things up a little around here... Oh, and Lady Rehan requested that I offer you this gift on her behalf."
"That will be all."
"What have I done to deserve a gift?"
"Has Lady Rehan left us?"
"You have some advice?"
"Thanks for the advice."
"What did you want to know?"
"I do not fear them."
"What do you want to know?"
"Dance with me, Lampy!"
"I just happened to break in here."
"I am the <master/mistress> of this house."
"I own the house."
"I would love to have a butler."
"Wouldn't your spirit like to be free?"
"I don't need a butler."
"Alright."
"What is your name?"
"Are you happy?"
"No."
"What are you?"
"What happened here?"
"You could be my butler."
"Who are you?"
"What is the history of this place?"
"Let's see this gift of hers..."
"You talks to Thaddeus. He be boss."
"I did not expect to have my loyalties torn so. You are a good person, I am sure, but Enivid is my leader." Dylan frowns uncomfortably.
"There is one last thing I can do for you. Mr. Mossy owns the Mossy Tree Inn. Since you have been such a help, just ask him for the hero's rate and I'm sure he can give you a deal."
"Then we shall pay a tithe to Callahi, god of gold, tonight at the temple."
"You should speak to Dyschall, <sir/madam>. He knows the will of the gods better than we do."
"Who can know the will of the gods? Certainly not men such as us."
"We are doomed. I do not see how you could possibly clear all the forces of the Masked Man from the dungeon."
"I'm glad you came. Something has filled the prisoners we took following the battle with renewed purpose and they've broken free of their cells." Dylan offers you a weary grin.
"We have managed to hold this area, but we need more men if we are going to contain them and quell the threat."
"Sir Dylan! They tried attacking us again, but we held them off. There's no way we can stand another push."
"Calm yourself! This is no time to panic."
"You didn't see the huge hobgoblin that drives the prisoners before him! This, Sir, is the perfect time to panic!"
"Look, I need some volunteers to drive back the Masked Man's forces. If we attack them now, before they have time to regroup, we might stand a chance!"

"I just do not feel comfortable speaking to someone who is Enivid's opponent. A part of me even regrets having listened to Momma Dane and opened the gates to you in the first place. I am sorry, goodbye."
"I didn't sign up for this suicide mission. You should let us get out of here! If we can get to our homes, perhaps we can flee with our families."
"Sir Dylan, I would... ah, the pain, I would help you, but the wound I received..."
"I wish the Hand could have taken some of the militia to the gate and given me some professional soldiers! Get back to your post!"
"<FirstName>, I hate to ask this of you, but do you think you can try to push the invaders back?"
"There are some weapons and armor over there on the racks. You might want to have a look and take what you need."
"Good luck, <sir/madam>! You're the only hope we have, though even that is a slim hope. At the least, perhaps you can buy us some time."

"There aren't any soldiers, sadly. If I had some properly trained warriors to assist me I might have been able to put an end to this prison break, or at least put a dent in their number before we withdrew."
"You might still be able to rescue some of the prisoners. They're criminals, but I suppose if you set them free, they might be willing to help you."
"We're not sure where the leader is hiding out; I never even saw him. He must be down in the dungeon somewhere."
"I need to remain here and keep these men from deserting. If the prisoners try to force their way back up here, someone needs to keep them from succeeding."
"We heard some awful sounds coming from down there. We thought they were the sounds of your death. I am glad you survived. Were you able to put an end to them?"
"I hope to serve you well, Lord of Cyan." Dylan bows low at your approach.
"He's dead? You... you were able to accomplish this deed against such great odds?"
"This <man/woman> is a hero! We were surely defeated; how could you have overcome the monsters?"
"Perhaps Momma Dane was right. Perhaps you really were sent by the gods!"
"Then maybe Pharos, god of war and judgement saw fit to guide you here to satisfy your vengeance and save us in the same moment."
"That must have been some fight, <sir/madam>! I will have the masons come down and repair the cells right away."
"Should the enemy assault the gates again, we will doubtless take more prisoners and this time do a better job of holding them."
"I saw an opportunity and I came after it. Gold is my only god."
"Forget the gods, I came of my own free will to save you!"
"If the gods laid this path before me, I am proud to be chosen."
"I know nothing of these gods. I merely did my duty."
"I'll take care of it."
"Isn't there anyone else who can help me?"
"The hobgoblin is dead."
"Where is this hobgoblin?"
"What are you going to do?"
"I sought revenge against these monsters, nothing more."
"Now, is there anything I can help you with?"
Text: "자, 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?"

TextEng: "May the Nine Gods protect and inspire you."
Text: "아홉 신이 당신을 보호하고 영감을 주시길."

TextEng: "There must be something very powerful forcing them out of the deep and making them band together. Ogres certainly are too weak of mind to organize an army like that."
Text: "무언가 매우 강력한 것이 그들을 깊은 곳에서 몰아내고 뭉치게 하고 있는 것이 틀림없습니다. 오우거는 분명 저런 군대를 조직할 만큼 머리가 좋지 않습니다."

TextEng: "Those who fear thieves will sometimes give tribute to turn the god's attention from their enterprises. Pharos has no patience for his brother's plots and petty jealousies."
Text: "도둑을 두려워하는 자들은 때때로 신의 관심을 돌리기 위해 공물을 바칩니다. 파로스는 형제의 음모와 하찮은 시기심에 인내심이 없습니다."

TextEng: "Veragok. Yes, Trip knows something of this god! I give him presents, little gifts and he welcomes me in the fraternity of outcasts. He is the caring god."
Text: "베라곡이라. 네, 트립은 이 신에 대해 알아요! 작은 선물을 바치면 추방자의 형제단에 환영해 줘요. 배려하는 신이에요."

TextEng: "You think he cares for you, but he only cares if you bring him gifts. He cares only for himself!"
Text: "네가 그가 너를 걱정한다고 생각하지만, 그는 네가 선물을 가져올 때만 관심을 가진다. 자기 자신밖에 모르는 자야!"

TextEng: Trip hisses and backs away from the priest. "I shall refrain from commenting in this conversation again. This priest preaches tolerance, but his words are no more than that."
Text: 트립이 쉿 소리를 내며 사제에게서 물러납니다. "이 대화에서 더 이상 말하지 않겠어요. 이 사제는 관용을 설교하지만, 그의 말은 그 이상이 아니에요."

TextEng: "My appologies, Trip is it? Old hatreds die hard. But I should finish speaking to <FirstName>."
Text: "사과하겠습니다, 트립이라 했나요? 오래된 증오는 쉽게 죽지 않습니다. 하지만 <FirstName>에게 이야기를 끝내야 하겠습니다."

TextEng: "Rictos, The Mountain, is the opposite of Churl, and hates her as much as he does his father, Jaess. He spawns the magic that steals from all the other gods. He values knowledge and careful planning."
Text: "릭토스, 산은 처얼의 반대이며, 아버지 재스만큼이나 처얼을 증오합니다. 다른 모든 신에게서 빼앗는 마법을 낳습니다. 지식과 신중한 계획을 중시합니다."

TextEng: "His followers include those who lust for power, be they mages, generals, emperors, or common street thugs. He loves a good conspiracy and those who would crush the meek into the earth."
Text: "그의 추종자는 권력을 탐하는 자들입니다. 마법사든, 장군이든, 황제든, 평범한 거리의 건달이든. 좋은 음모를 사랑하며, 약한 자를 짓밟으려는 자를 좋아합니다."

TextEng: "Pharos and Rictos have warred since the beginning. Rictos gains power, but loses it, because of his need to crush those weaker than him."
Text: "파로스와 릭토스는 태초부터 전쟁해 왔습니다. 릭토스는 힘을 얻지만, 자신보다 약한 자를 짓밟으려는 욕구 때문에 그것을 잃습니다."

TextEng: "Most feared of all the gods, when Churl looks upon you, it is a terrible thing to behold. Her eyes are lightning, her voice thunder, and even her followers fear her presence."
Text: "모든 신 중 가장 두려운 존재로, 처얼이 당신을 바라보면 그것은 끔찍한 광경입니다. 그녀의 눈은 번개이고, 목소리는 천둥이며, 추종자들조차 그녀의 존재를 두려워합니다."

TextEng: "Her followers include pirates and sailors, barbarians, evil druids, and those who enjoy dangerous lifestyles or cruel whims."
Text: "그녀의 추종자는 해적과 선원, 야만인, 사악한 드루이드, 그리고 위험한 삶이나 잔인한 변덕을 즐기는 자들입니다."

TextEng: "Whatever has subdued these creature's natural warring instincts must be stopped. There are many enemies left in those caves."
Text: "이 피조물들의 본능적인 싸움 본능을 억누르고 있는 것이 무엇이든, 반드시 막아야 합니다. 그 동굴에는 아직 많은 적이 남아 있습니다."

TextEng: "Every time someone does something cruel or mean-spirited; every time a pure heart is tempted into evil, Churl grows in strength."
Text: "누군가 잔인하거나 비열한 행동을 할 때마다, 순수한 마음이 악에 유혹될 때마다, 처얼은 힘을 얻습니다."

TextEng: Dynschall's face seems to bleed with rage. "Pharos and Churl are destined to meet in combat, and his judgment shall destroy her. He is war for a purpose. She is meaningless, chaotic destruction."
Text: 던살의 얼굴이 분노로 물듭니다. "파로스와 처얼은 전투에서 만날 운명이며, 그의 심판이 그녀를 멸할 것입니다. 파로스는 목적을 위한 전쟁입니다. 처얼은 무의미한 혼돈의 파괴입니다."

TextEng: "To compare the two is blasphemy. Do so at peril of your own life. Neither Pharos, nor Churl would be pleased with such a comparison."
Text: "둘을 비교하는 것은 신성모독입니다. 목숨이 아깝다면 삼가십시오. 파로스도 처얼도 그런 비교에 기뻐하지 않을 것입니다."

TextEng: Dynschall grits his teeth and spits on the floor. "You insult me and my god. If you want the church as your enemy, that is a good way to go about it!"
Text: 던살이 이를 악물고 바닥에 침을 뱉습니다. "나와 내 신을 모욕하시는군요. 교회를 적으로 만들고 싶다면, 좋은 방법입니다!"

TextEng: His red face calms at your words. "I believe you didn't. Such words are... hard to hear, but to an outsider I can see how the mistake could be made."
Text: 붉어진 얼굴이 가라앉습니다. "그런 뜻이 아니었다고 믿겠습니다. 그런 말은... 듣기 힘들지만, 외부인이 그런 실수를 할 수 있다는 건 이해합니다."

TextEng: "Oh, <FirstName>, you do know how to offend a priest, don't you! Ha, ha!"
Text: "오, <FirstName>, 사제를 화나게 하는 법을 아시는군요! 하, 하!"

TextEng: "Suhili, the Great Mother, the sun, shines upon us. Jaess is the Father-God, also known as the Divine Servant, the moon. Tamose is the spoiled child, the Hermaphrodite, the dawn and the dusk."
Text: "수힐리, 위대한 어머니, 태양이 우리를 비추고 있습니다. 재스는 아버지 신, 또는 신성한 종복, 달입니다. 타모스는 버릇없는 아이, 양성체, 새벽과 황혼입니다."

TextEng: "Of course. Can you tell me whom you follow, or do you have more questions yet?"
Text: "물론입니다. 어떤 신을 따르시는지 말씀해 주시겠습니까, 아니면 더 질문이 있습니까?"

TextEng: "I shall struggle to maintain an open mind no matter whom you follow, though it might go against my very nature."
Text: "어떤 신을 따르시든 열린 마음을 유지하도록 노력하겠습니다. 제 본성에 어긋나는 일이겠지만요."

TextEng: "I shall struggle to maintain an open mind no matter whom you follow, though it might go against my very nature."
Text: "어떤 신을 따르시든 열린 마음을 유지하도록 노력하겠습니다. 제 본성에 어긋나는 일이겠지만요."

TextEng: "I would suggest the Silver Lily, here in the north keep. It costs a little more than The Mossy Tree, but Garrot runs a good, clean inn. The Mossy Tree is more adventure than rest."
Text: "북쪽 거점에 있는 은백합을 추천합니다. 이끼 나무 여관보다 좀 비싸지만, 가롯이 깨끗하고 좋은 여관을 운영합니다. 이끼 나무 여관은 쉬는 곳이라기보다 모험에 가깝습니다."

TextEng: Dynschall nods. "Well then, feel free to visit your god's shrine."
Text: 던살이 고개를 끄덕입니다. "그렇다면, 자유롭게 신의 제단을 방문하십시오."

TextEng: Dynschall frowns and obviously struggles to control his reaction. "Well then, feel free to visit your god's shrine."
Text: 던살이 눈살을 찌푸리며 반응을 억누르려 애씁니다. "그렇다면, 자유롭게 신의 제단을 방문하십시오."

TextEng: A thoughtful look crosses Dynschall's face and he nods. "Well met then. Though I am not of your faith, I think there is room for you within our organization."
Text: 던살의 얼굴에 사려 깊은 표정이 스치며 고개를 끄덕입니다. "반갑습니다. 저와 같은 신앙은 아니지만, 우리 조직 안에 당신의 자리가 있다고 생각합니다."

TextEng: "We have never had a priest to your god here in the temple, but if you are interested in joining us, you have to pass a test. Joining the temple will give you access to donations, and make you a member of our guild."
Text: "우리 신전에 당신의 신을 섬기는 사제가 없었지만, 가입에 관심이 있으시다면 시험을 통과하셔야 합니다. 신전에 가입하면 헌금에 접근할 수 있고, 길드 원이 됩니다."

TextEng: "That is... disappointing. Should you ever change your mind, feel free to ask me about it."
Text: "그것은... 유감입니다. 마음이 바뀌시면, 언제든 물어보십시오."

TextEng: "Then you shall be set two tasks. They are relatively easy, but will prove your dedication to the community, above your own self-interests."
Text: "그렇다면 두 가지 과제를 드리겠습니다. 비교적 쉽지만, 자신의 이익보다 공동체에 대한 헌신을 증명할 것입니다."

TextEng: "The first task is to distribute this food to the local beggars. There are three that spend most of their time in the central market. Return when you have completed this task and I shall set you the second."
Text: "첫 번째 과제는 이 음식을 거지들에게 나눠주는 것입니다. 중앙 시장에서 대부분의 시간을 보내는 거지가 세 명 있습니다. 과제를 마치고 돌아오시면 두 번째를 알려드리겠습니다."

TextEng: "Best of luck, <FirstName>."
Text: "행운을 빕니다, <FirstName>."

TextEng: Dynschall nods politely. "You will definitely be wanting to speak with Rafael then. He is always interested in fleecing... I mean meeting another worshiper."
Text: 던살이 정중하게 고개를 끄덕입니다. "그렇다면 라파엘에게 말씀하시는 게 좋겠습니다. 그는 항상 등쳐먹을... 아니, 같은 신자를 만나는 데 관심이 있습니다."

TextEng: Dynschall frowns a little. "That is unfortunate. Rafael will not be pleased to meet another priest of his order, since he is much like his god, and rather jealously guards his position and wealth."
Text: 던살이 약간 눈살을 찌푸립니다. "유감입니다. 라파엘은 같은 교단의 사제를 만나는 것을 반기지 않을 겁니다. 그의 신처럼 자신의 지위와 재산을 질투스럽게 지키는 자이니까요."

TextEng: "I would suggest you speak to Rafael. He runs the Temple Store. There are also a number of other merchants here in the keep. Look around and I am sure you will find them."
Text: "라파엘에게 말하십시오. 신전 상점을 운영합니다. 거점에는 다른 상인들도 있습니다. 둘러보시면 찾을 수 있을 겁니다."

TextEng: "Still, Callahi brings gold to the temple, which is always useful. Would you be interested in joining our guild?"
Text: "그래도 칼라히는 신전에 금을 가져오니 항상 유용합니다. 우리 길드에 가입하는 데 관심이 있습니까?"

TextEng: Dynschall nods politely. "You will definitely be wanting to speak with Lavos then. No wonder she has taken such an interest in you."
Text: 던살이 정중하게 고개를 끄덕입니다. "그렇다면 라보스에게 말씀하시는 게 좋겠습니다. 그녀가 당신에게 그토록 관심을 보인 이유가 있었군요."

TextEng: Dynschall frowns a little. "That is good. Lavos will be pleased to meet another priest of her order. With all of the dangers that have befallen our community lately, there has been much death."
Text: 던살이 약간 눈살을 찌푸립니다. "다행이군요. 라보스가 같은 교단의 사제를 만나면 기뻐할 것입니다. 최근 우리 공동체에 닥친 위험으로 많은 죽음이 있었으니까요."

TextEng: "Would you be interested in joining our guild?"
Text: "우리 길드에 가입하는 데 관심이 있습니까?"

TextEng: Dynschall smiles. "It is good to meet a fellow worshipper of Pharos. I trust that you will hold true to our tenants, <brother/sister>."
Text: 던살이 미소 짓습니다. "파로스의 동료 신자를 만나니 반갑습니다. 우리의 교리를 잘 지키시리라 믿습니다, 교우."

TextEng: Dynschall frowns a little. "This is a good day then, indeed. I have longed for several years to find and train a replacement who could bring honor to Pharos."
Text: 던살이 약간 눈살을 찌푸립니다. "정말 좋은 날이군요. 수년간 파로스에게 영광을 가져올 후계자를 찾아 훈련시키고 싶었습니다."

TextEng: "The years have taken their toll on both my body and my soul. If you are interested in joining our guild, I would stay long enough to help you fit into the community before I retire."
Text: "세월이 제 몸과 영혼 모두에 흔적을 남겼습니다. 가입에 관심이 있으시다면, 은퇴하기 전에 공동체에 적응하실 수 있도록 도와드리겠습니다."

TextEng: "Would you take this responsibility willingly? Are you interested in joining our guild?"
Text: "이 책임을 기꺼이 받아들이시겠습니까? 우리 길드에 가입하는 데 관심이 있습니까?"

TextEng: "Which pantheon would you like to know more about?"
Text: "어떤 판테온에 대해 더 알고 싶습니까?"

TextEng: "Tamose, the perpetual, hermaphroditic child, who is beautiful to behold, but capricious in favors. The Child is the Dawning of every new day and also the Dusk, or end of every life."
Text: "타모스, 보기에 아름답지만 은총은 변덕스러운 영원한 양성의 아이입니다. 아이는 매일 새로운 날의 새벽이자 모든 생의 끝인 황혼이기도 합니다."

TextEng: "The Stan runs the Trades Guild. You can find him in his shop, The Trades, or in the Trades Guild Office, in the Guildhall."
Text: "더 스탠이 교역 길드를 운영합니다. 그의 가게 '교역소'나 길드 홀의 교역 길드 사무실에서 만나실 수 있습니다."

TextEng: "The Child's followers include lovers, bards, builders (for Tamose loves new things), smiths and sorcerers. If Tamose smiles upon you, then you shall be richly blessed, but his attention wanders easily."
Text: "아이의 추종자는 연인, 음유시인, 건축가(타모스가 새로운 것을 사랑하므로), 대장장이, 그리고 마법사입니다. 타모스가 당신에게 미소 짓는다면 풍성한 축복을 받겠지만, 그의 관심은 쉽게 방황합니다."

TextEng: "A follower of Tamose gains strength through manipulation of events and people. As a priest of Pharos, I see the destruction inherent in the Child's whims, though his heart and intent are pure."
Text: "타모스의 추종자는 사건과 사람의 조종을 통해 힘을 얻습니다. 파로스의 사제로서, 아이의 변덕에 내재된 파괴를 보지만, 그 마음과 의도는 순수합니다."

TextEng: "The Father-God, the Moon, the Mage, the Divine Servant... he is an enigma to me. Though he was the father of the other gods, he wants his followers to serve the good of all."
Text: "아버지 신, 달, 마법사, 신성한 종복... 저에게는 수수께끼입니다. 다른 신들의 아버지이면서도, 추종자들에게 모든 이의 선을 위해 봉사할 것을 원합니다."

TextEng: "Followers of the Moon include white mages, guardians, servants, monks, paladins and those few politicians who are not corrupt. Enivid is a paladin and follower Jaess."
Text: "달의 추종자는 백마법사, 수호자, 종복, 수도승, 성기사, 그리고 타락하지 않은 소수의 정치인입니다. 에니비드는 재스의 추종자인 성기사입니다."

TextEng: "Jaess loves those who do good deeds, but do not claim them for glory. It is an attitude that I know is good, but I could never follow it. It is too humble a road."
Text: "재스는 선행을 하되 영광을 위해 주장하지 않는 자를 사랑합니다. 좋은 태도라는 것은 알지만, 저는 결코 따를 수 없습니다. 너무 겸손한 길입니다."

TextEng: "She smiles down upon us; allowing things to grow, inspiring birth and imbuing her followers with good health. When she sees evil, she burns it with her sharpest gaze."
Text: "그녀가 우리를 내려다보며 미소 짓습니다. 만물이 자라게 하고, 탄생에 영감을 주며, 추종자에게 건강을 부여합니다. 악을 보면 가장 날카로운 시선으로 태워버립니다."

TextEng: "Followers of the Sun include farmers, peasants, midwives, rangers, paladins and occasionally a druid. Her followers gain strength through creation and loving acts of kindness."
Text: "태양의 추종자는 농부, 농민, 산파, 순찰대원, 성기사, 그리고 가끔 드루이드입니다. 그녀의 추종자는 창조와 사랑의 친절을 통해 힘을 얻습니다."

TextEng: "If you would know more about Suhili, you should visit her shrine or read some of the tombs in our library."
Text: "수힐리에 대해 더 알고 싶으시다면, 그녀의 제단을 방문하거나 도서관의 서적을 읽어 보십시오."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a warrior of faith. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I welcome you as a worthy comrade."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 신앙의 전사입니다. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 합당한 동지로 환영합니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a warrior of faith; a monk. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I hope to welcome you as a worthy comrade."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 신앙의 전사, 수도승이군요. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 합당한 동지로 환영하고 싶습니다."

TextEng: "An important topic at this time, particularly for you. Enivid and Sir Becket have the advantage over you. What would you like to know?"
Text: "지금 시기에 중요한 주제입니다. 특히 당신에게요. 에니비드와 베켓 경이 당신보다 유리합니다. 무엇을 알고 싶습니까?"

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a child of nature. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I hope to welcome you as a child of faith."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 자연의 자녀이군요. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 신앙의 자녀로 환영하고 싶습니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a dabbler in the arcane arts. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I welcome you as a potential ally."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 비전 마법을 다루시는군요. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 잠재적 동맹으로 환영합니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are of questionable character; perhaps a bard."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 의심스러운 성품의 소유자입니다. 아마 음유시인이겠지요."

TextEng: "Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I warn you not to practice your charms or roguish abilities on my people."
Text: "파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 우리 백성에게 매력이나 불량한 능력을 행사하지 마시라고 경고합니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are of questionable character; a rogue."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 의심스러운 성품의 소유자입니다. 도적이군요."

TextEng: "Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I warn you not to practice your thieving abilities on my people."
Text: "파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 우리 백성에게 절도 기술을 행사하지 마시라고 경고합니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a person of faith. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I hope to welcome you as a fellow disciple."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 신앙인이군요. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 동료 제자로 환영하고 싶습니다."

TextEng: "Tell me, as a priest, which of the Nine Gods do you serve? There are three priests here in the temple. The other two are Lavos, servant of Mistress Death, and Rafael, a follower of Callahi."
Text: "말씀해 주십시오, 사제로서 아홉 신 중 누구를 섬기십니까? 이 신전에는 세 명의 사제가 있습니다. 나머지 둘은 죽음의 여주인을 섬기는 라보스와 칼라히의 추종자 라파엘입니다."

TextEng: "A fellow worshipper is always welcome, but the prospect of having the representative of another faith join us is... interesting."
Text: "동료 신자는 언제나 환영이지만, 다른 신앙의 대표가 합류한다는 전망은... 흥미롭습니다."

TextEng: "The gods wait for no <man/woman>, <Lord/Lady> <LastName>. I recommend you do what needs doing while there's still time."
Text: "신들은 누구도 기다려 주지 않습니다, 영주 <LastName>. 시간이 있을 때 해야 할 일을 하시길 권합니다."

TextEng: "She is an experienced warrior, and a paladin in the service of Jaess. She would be a good leader, though there are many who do not appreciate her righteous attitude."
Text: "경험 많은 전사이자, 재스를 섬기는 성기사입니다. 훌륭한 지도자가 될 것이지만, 그녀의 의로운 태도를 좋아하지 않는 사람도 많습니다."

TextEng: "I think, given time and experience, she will grow to understand diplomacy a little better. As a follower of Jaess, she will serve her people as best she can. Anything else?"
Text: "시간과 경험이 쌓이면 외교를 좀 더 이해하게 될 것입니다. 재스의 신자로서, 최선을 다해 백성을 섬길 겁니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "He is a loathsome man; a corrupt noble who would sell his own children to be slaves, if there was some gain in it. There is nothing else to say about him."
Text: "혐오스러운 자입니다. 이득이 있다면 자기 자식도 노예로 팔 타락한 귀족이요. 그에 대해 더 할 말은 없습니다."

TextEng: "Right now we are voting for Enivid. That could change, but I doubt it."
Text: "현재 에니비드에게 투표할 것입니다. 바뀔 수도 있지만, 의심스럽습니다."

TextEng: "I will answer what I can. What topic would you like to speak on?"
Text: "아는 한 답하겠습니다. 어떤 주제에 대해 이야기하고 싶습니까?"

TextEng: "You want me to change my vote? And who do you propose I change my vote to?"
Text: "제 투표를 바꾸라고요? 누구에게 바꾸기를 원하십니까?"

TextEng: "I see... that is an interesting suggestion."
Text: "그렇군요... 흥미로운 제안입니다."

TextEng: "None of us here at the temple are willing to support you. I doubt I would be willing to change my mind. I suppose you could speak to the other priests though. Anything else?"
Text: "이곳 신전의 누구도 당신을 지지할 의향이 없습니다. 제 마음을 바꿀 수 있을지 의심스럽습니다. 다른 사제들에게 말해 보실 수는 있겠지요. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "The other two priests seem to think that you would make a good leader. If you did not care for our community at all, I guess you would not have tried so hard."
Text: "다른 두 사제가 당신이 훌륭한 지도자가 될 것이라고 생각하는군요. 우리 공동체를 전혀 신경 쓰지 않았다면, 그렇게 열심히 하지도 않았겠지요."

TextEng: "I guess the temple could support your leadership, if you would make me a promise."
Text: "신전이 당신의 지도력을 지지할 수도 있겠습니다. 약속 하나만 해주신다면요."

TextEng: "That is the best answer you could have given. I guess maybe you do have some intelligence, maybe even some integrity (dare I hope?). Very well, the church will support your cause."
Text: "최선의 대답입니다. 어쩌면 지능이 좀 있을지도 모르겠군요. 어쩌면 진정성까지도 (감히 기대해도 될까요?). 좋습니다, 교회가 당신의 대의를 지지하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I want you to promise that if something were to happen to the community that threatened the temple, you would protect our interests above the community's."
Text: "공동체를 위협하는 일이 신전에 닥칠 경우, 공동체보다 신전의 이익을 우선시하겠다고 약속해 주십시오."

TextEng: "What kind of leader has such disdain for <his/her> people that they would say such a thing? I will never vote for you. Enivid shall be our leader. Leave this holy place!"
Text: "자기 백성을 그토록 경멸하는 지도자가 어디 있습니까! 절대 당신에게 투표하지 않겠습니다. 에니비드가 우리 지도자가 될 것입니다. 이 성스러운 장소를 떠나십시오!"

TextEng: "Since only one of my fellow priests agrees that you would make a good leader, I do not think I can vote for you. I am sorry. Was there anything else?"
Text: "동료 사제 중 한 명만이 당신이 좋은 지도자가 될 것이라 동의하니, 투표해 드릴 수 없을 것 같습니다. 죄송합니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "I would definitely vote for you, if you were a member of the Priest's Guild. Would you, as a priest of <CUSTOM6004>, like to join our guild?"
Text: "사제 길드의 일원이시라면 분명 투표하겠습니다. <CUSTOM6004>의 사제로서, 우리 길드에 가입하시겠습니까?"

TextEng: "Good enough. Was there anything else?"
Text: "좋습니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "I would definitely vote for you, if you were a member of the Priest's Guild."
Text: "사제 길드의 일원이시라면 분명 투표하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I would need to know which of the Nine Gods you follow first."
Text: "먼저 아홉 신 중 누구를 따르시는지 알아야 하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I뭢 glad you are pleased. Anything else?"
Text: "기뻐하시니 다행입니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "We will be voting for you, of course."
Text: "물론 당신에게 투표하겠습니다."

TextEng: "Now that the election has taken place, the importance of that subject has withered. Let us discuss something else."
Text: "선거가 끝난 지금, 그 주제의 중요성은 시들었습니다. 다른 이야기를 합시다."

TextEng: "Very well, have you had enough time to consider your own faith? Are you willing to tell me who you follow?"
Text: "좋습니다. 자신의 신앙에 대해 충분히 생각해 보셨습니까? 누구를 따르시는지 말씀해 주시겠습니까?"

TextEng: "Although it is my favorite topic, we have already had discourse on it. Let us talk about something else."
Text: "제가 가장 좋아하는 주제이지만, 이미 논의를 마쳤습니다. 다른 이야기를 합시다."

TextEng: "That is not a good thing to lie about, <FirstName>. I suppose everyone makes mistakes though. Which God do you truly follow?"
Text: "그것에 대해 거짓말하는 것은 좋지 않습니다, <FirstName>. 누구나 실수는 하지만요. 진정으로 따르시는 신은 누구입니까?"

TextEng: "Are you interested in joining our guild now?"
Text: "이제 우리 길드에 가입하실 의향이 있습니까?"

TextEng: "Ah yes, you return." Dynschall looks up as you approach, nodding in your direction. He seems genuinely happy to see you.
Text: "아, 돌아오셨군요." 던살이 당신이 다가오자 고개를 들어 끄덕입니다. 진심으로 반가워하는 듯합니다.

TextEng: "Speak to Rafael. He runs the Temple Store. Anything else?"
Text: "라파엘에게 말하십시오. 신전 상점을 운영하고 있습니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "How can I be of assistance, <FirstName>?"
Text: "무엇을 도와드릴까요, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "My Lord <FirstName>, it is an honor that you should come and visit our humble temple. How can I assist you now?"
Text: "영주 <FirstName>, 이 보잘것없는 신전을 방문해 주시다니 영광입니다. 어떻게 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Welcome, <Brother/Sister> <FirstName>, Cleric of <CUSTOM6004>. How can I assist you today?"
Text: "어서 오십시오, <CUSTOM6004>의 사제 <FirstName> 교우. 오늘은 어떻게 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "There have been no donations to <CUSTOM6004> at this time."
Text: "현재 <CUSTOM6004>에 대한 헌금은 없습니다."

TextEng: "There have been a couple of donations. Here is your share."
Text: "헌금이 좀 들어왔습니다. 여기 당신의 몫입니다."

TextEng: "Are you ready for your final task, <FirstName>?"
Text: "마지막 시험을 받을 준비가 되셨습니까, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "Very well. Return when you are ready."
Text: "알겠습니다. 준비되시면 돌아오십시오."

TextEng: "You distributed the food then, <FirstName>?"
Text: "음식을 나눠 주셨습니까, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "Well, don't let the food go bad. The fish is salted, but still, the poor are hungry."
Text: "음식이 상하지 않게 하십시오. 생선에 소금을 쳤지만, 가난한 자들은 배가 고픕니다."

TextEng: "I am pleased and you have done well. Though it was not a hard task, some might have been tempted to force the poor to pay for their food..."
Text: "기쁘군요. 잘하셨습니다. 어려운 일은 아니었지만, 가난한 자들에게 음식값을 받으려는 유혹에 빠질 수도 있었을 텐데..."

TextEng: "I would be pleased to offer you my services. I merely ask for a small donation to the temple. 20 gold will cure you of all woes."
Text: "기꺼이 봉사하겠습니다. 다만 신전에 소액의 헌금을 부탁드립니다. 금화 20닢이면 모든 고통을 치유해 드리겠습니다."

TextEng: "Your second test is your test of devotion. You must swear to all of the Nine Gods that you will uphold their faith and the faith of the community in all things."
Text: "두 번째 시험은 헌신의 시험입니다. 아홉 신 모두에게 모든 일에서 그들의 신앙과 공동체의 신앙을 수호하겠다고 맹세하셔야 합니다."

TextEng: "Once you have sworn, you will be a full member of the temple."
Text: "맹세를 마치시면, 신전의 정식 일원이 됩니다."

TextEng: "The gods find your vow unacceptable. Now swear truthfully and properly or leave this holy place!"
Text: "신들이 당신의 맹세를 받아들이지 않습니다. 진실되고 올바르게 맹세하시든지, 이 성스러운 장소를 떠나십시오!"

TextEng: "Then be gone from this place, foul deceiver! I will look on you no more!"
Text: "이 장소에서 나가시오, 사악한 기만자여! 더 이상 당신을 보지 않겠습니다!"

TextEng: "Some of the Gods find your vow acceptable, but others do not. Will you make the full vow and be welcomed here by all, or will you stand by the partial vow you have made?"
Text: "일부 신들은 맹세를 받아들였지만, 나머지는 그렇지 않습니다. 완전한 맹세를 하여 모든 신에게 환영받으시겠습니까, 아니면 부분적 맹세를 고수하시겠습니까?"

TextEng: <StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> "Very well. You are now a member of the mysteries of the Temple of the Nine Gods."
Text: <StartAction>[한숨]</Start> "좋습니다. 이제 아홉 신의 신전의 비의에 입문하셨습니다."

TextEng: "The gods find your vow acceptable. Welcome to the mysteries of the sacred Temple of the Nine Gods!"
Text: "신들이 맹세를 받아들였습니다. 신성한 아홉 신의 신전의 비의에 오신 것을 환영합니다!"

TextEng: "As a member of the guild, you will have the full support of our guild in your struggle to gain the throne. With you as the Lord of the keep, the church will be an effective power in the community."
Text: "길드 원으로서, 왕좌를 얻기 위한 투쟁에 우리 길드의 전적인 지지를 받으실 것입니다. 당신이 거점의 영주가 되면, 교회는 공동체에서 효과적인 권력이 될 것입니다."

TextEng: "Good luck, <Brother/Sister> <FirstName>! May the gods go with you."
Text: "행운을 빕니다, <FirstName> 교우! 신들이 함께하시길."

TextEng: "Did you think that delivering the food was really the test? I had someone watching the beggars and I know you charged them for the food they were supposed to be freely given."
Text: "음식 배달이 진짜 시험이라고 생각하셨습니까? 거지들을 감시하는 사람을 세워두었고, 무료로 나눠줘야 할 음식에 돈을 받았다는 것을 압니다."

TextEng: "Very well. Anything else?"
Text: "알겠습니다. 다른 건 없습니까?"

TextEng: "You are much like Veragok, Patron of Thieves, and he might be pleased with the way you conducted yourself, but that does not mean I have to allow you into our temple."
Text: "당신은 도둑의 수호신 베라곡과 많이 닮았습니다. 그가 당신의 행동에 기뻐할지 모르지만, 그것이 우리 신전에 들이는 것을 허락해야 한다는 뜻은 아닙니다."

TextEng: "I can no longer stand to see you here. Leave this building!"
Text: "더 이상 당신을 보는 것을 견딜 수 없습니다. 이 건물에서 나가십시오!"

TextEng: Dynschall glares at you, then turns his head and ignores you completely.
Text: 던살이 당신을 노려보더니, 고개를 돌리고 완전히 무시합니다.

TextEng: "So, young Dylan claims you are a hero, but young men often make snap judgments, without the benefit of the wisdom of age to guide them."
Text: "젊은 딜런이 당신을 영웅이라 하지만, 젊은이들은 나이의 지혜 없이 성급한 판단을 내리곤 합니다."

TextEng: "Unless I am wrong, and I am rarely wrong, you are a warrior of some skill. Being a priest of Pharos, God of War, Lord of Battles, and the Supreme Judge, I have respect for your calling."
Text: "제가 틀리지 않는다면, 그리고 좀처럼 틀리지 않습니다만, 당신은 상당한 실력의 전사입니다. 파로스, 전쟁의 신, 전투의 군주, 최고 심판자의 사제로서, 당신의 소명에 경의를 표합니다."

TextEng: "When we met earlier I was still distracted by the death of my old friend, the Banner. I would love to discuss religion with you; or are you here about the election?"
Text: "전에 만났을 때는 오랜 친구 기수장의 죽음에 정신이 없었습니다. 종교에 대해 이야기하고 싶습니다. 아니면 선거 때문에 오셨습니까?"

TextEng: "I find a lot can be told about an individual by a <man/woman>'s faith. So, which of the nine gods do you follow?"
Text: "사람의 신앙을 보면 많은 것을 알 수 있습니다. 그래서, 아홉 신 중 누구를 따르십니까?"

TextEng: Dynschall frowns at you and raises an eyebrow. "Do you not wish to tell me, or do you not follow any god?"
Text: 던살이 눈살을 찌푸리며 눈썹을 치켜올립니다. "말씀하시지 않으려는 겁니까, 아니면 어떤 신도 따르지 않으시는 겁니까?"

TextEng: "Of course, I hoped for better, but expected nothing less from a druid. Should you ever seek to worship the creators, rather than the creation, I would speak to you about it."
Text: "물론, 더 나은 것을 바랐지만, 드루이드에게서 그보다 더한 것을 기대하지도 않았습니다. 창조물이 아닌 창조자를 경배하고 싶으시다면, 말씀해 주십시오."

TextEng: "The immortal soul of every person in this community is my concern, thank you very much! Should you ever realize that and wish to speak of it, I will be here."
Text: "이 공동체의 모든 사람의 불멸의 영혼이 제 관심사입니다! 그것을 깨닫고 이야기하고 싶으시다면, 여기 있겠습니다."

TextEng: "May Pharos judge you well."
Text: "파로스가 당신을 바르게 심판하시길."

TextEng: "A private faith, to precious to share with others is rarely a strong faith. If do not allow our faith to be tested, it cannot grow. But it is your choice. Should you ever wish to talk about it, I will be here."
Text: "다른 사람과 나누기 아까운 개인적인 신앙은 좀처럼 강한 신앙이 되지 못합니다. 신앙이 시험받지 않으면, 성장할 수 없습니다. 하지만 당신의 선택입니다. 이야기하고 싶으시면, 여기 있겠습니다."

TextEng: "It is a sad and lonely path you walk, and one which is not well accepted within our community. If you ever seek the solace of a higher power, please come and speak to me about it."
Text: "슬프고 외로운 길을 걷고 계시는군요. 우리 공동체에서 잘 받아들여지지 않는 길입니다. 더 높은 힘의 위안을 구하신다면, 와서 말씀해 주십시오."

TextEng: "The Nine Gods are the balance and the sum. Each follows a different view of life, or alignment. Many break these into three categories, the Pantheon of Good, Evil and Neutrality."
Text: "아홉 신은 균형이자 총체입니다. 각각은 삶, 또는 가치관에 대한 다른 견해를 따릅니다. 많은 이들이 이를 세 가지 범주로 나누는데, 선의 판테온, 악의 판테온, 중립의 판테온입니다."

TextEng: "That is the balance, but it is a simplification, which is why we also call them the sum."
Text: "그것이 균형이지만, 단순화된 것입니다. 그래서 우리는 또한 '총체'라고 부릅니다."

TextEng: "All the gods together are more important than a single god. That is the only way that we can share a temple and get along, is through belief in the sum."
Text: "모든 신이 합쳐진 것이 단일 신보다 중요합니다. 그것이 우리가 하나의 신전을 공유하며 지낼 수 있는 유일한 방법이며, 총체에 대한 믿음을 통해서입니다."

TextEng: "If Suhili kept creating, and Mistress Death stopped destroying, what do you think would happen? All men and women would keep having children, but none would die, and eventually we would run out of room."
Text: "수힐리가 계속 창조만 하고, 죽음의 여주인이 파괴를 멈추면 어떻게 될까요? 모든 남녀가 자녀를 낳지만 아무도 죽지 않으면, 결국 공간이 부족해질 것입니다."

TextEng: "Each god has a purpose, and because of that, even if I dislike the tenets of your faith, I still recognize you have a purpose in life."
Text: "각 신에게는 목적이 있으며, 그래서 당신의 신앙 교리가 마음에 들지 않더라도, 당신에게 삶의 목적이 있다는 것을 인정합니다."

TextEng: Dynschall eyes you carefully. "That is exactly how I used to feel. Maybe I am just jaded, but I would suggest you hold those beliefs to yourself. You will have a difficult time getting along with others in this region."
Text: 던살이 당신을 주의 깊게 살핍니다. "제가 예전에 딱 그렇게 느꼈습니다. 늙어서 냉소적이 된 건지 모르겠지만, 그런 믿음은 속으로만 간직하시길 권합니다. 이 지역에서 다른 사람들과 지내기 어려울 겁니다."

TextEng: "Still, I appreciate your love of good. It is good to see someone with a little righteous fervor."
Text: "그래도 선에 대한 사랑은 높이 삽니다. 약간의 의로운 열정을 가진 사람을 보니 반갑습니다."

TextEng: "There are many who would think so, but the other priests and I agree that this philosophy helps to knit our community together, as much as anything can."
Text: "그렇게 생각하는 사람이 많겠지만, 다른 사제들과 저는 이 철학이 우리 공동체를 하나로 엮는 데 크게 기여한다고 동의합니다."

TextEng: "As a member of the guild, I will heal you for free."
Text: "길드 원으로서, 무료로 치유해 드리겠습니다."

TextEng: "Religion is very important to most of the people in our society. The few folk who do not have some faith usually feel very separate from the group."
Text: "종교는 우리 사회의 대부분의 사람들에게 매우 중요합니다. 신앙이 없는 소수의 사람들은 대개 집단에서 매우 분리된 느낌을 받습니다."

TextEng: "It does, though it really goes against my beliefs as a younger man. At one point in time, I would have tried to kill a thief as soon as I had evidence of <his/her> activities."
Text: "그렇습니다. 젊었을 때의 믿음에 정말 반하는 일이지만요. 한때는 도둑의 활동 증거가 나오면 즉시 죽이려 했을 겁니다."

TextEng: "I guess age has softened me... though if I caught one stealing from the temple... nothing would hold me back."
Text: "나이가 저를 부드럽게 만든 것 같습니다... 하지만 신전에서 도둑질하는 걸 잡으면... 아무것도 저를 막지 못할 겁니다."

TextEng: "Pharos is the God of Judgment, Lord of Battles, the Warrior. Mistress Death is the only god who did not spring from the eternal parents. She exists and has always existed."
Text: "파로스는 심판의 신, 전투의 군주, 전사입니다. 죽음의 여주인은 영원한 부모에게서 태어나지 않은 유일한 신입니다. 그녀는 존재하며, 항상 존재해 왔습니다."

TextEng: "Callahi is the God of Commerce, the Wanderer, the Morning Star."
Text: "칼라히는 상업의 신, 방랑자, 새벽별입니다."

TextEng: "Callahi is the God of Commerce, a greedy god, but also the god of diplomacy and travel. Some of the city-states in the south call him Silvertongue."
Text: "칼라히는 상업의 신이며, 탐욕스러운 신이지만, 외교와 여행의 신이기도 합니다. 남쪽의 일부 도시국가에서는 그를 은설이라 부릅니다."

TextEng: "His followers are bards, thieves, merchants, politicians and anyone traveling. He is the most powerful of the lesser gods, largely because his church is so wealthy."
Text: "그의 추종자는 음유시인, 도둑, 상인, 정치인, 그리고 여행하는 모든 자입니다. 교회가 매우 부유하기 때문에 하위 신들 중 가장 강력합니다."

TextEng: "Few merchants would be so foolhardy as to enter into large negotiations without a hefty donation to Callahi's shrine."
Text: "칼라히의 제단에 두둑한 헌금 없이 대규모 협상에 임할 만큼 무모한 상인은 거의 없습니다."

TextEng: "She is one of the most powerful gods and her true followers are among the most powerful priests in the known world. Despite this, she has few followers."
Text: "가장 강력한 신 중 하나이며, 진정한 추종자들은 알려진 세계에서 가장 강력한 사제 중 하나입니다. 그럼에도 추종자는 적습니다."

TextEng: "Her demands on her clergy are strict and they lose themselves to her service. They own nothing for themselves and must follow the dictates of the church above their own interests."
Text: "성직자에 대한 요구가 엄격하여, 봉사에 자신을 잃습니다. 자신의 소유물은 아무것도 없으며, 자신의 이익보다 교회의 명령을 따라야 합니다."

TextEng: "I love most of the people of the keep as my own children, though there are a few exceptions. What do you want to know?"
Text: "거점 사람들 대부분을 제 자식처럼 아끼지만, 예외가 몇 있습니다. 무엇을 알고 싶습니까?"

TextEng: "But everyone pays tribute to her, in hopes of good treatment in the afterlife. We all pay her some lip service, but she is not loved, except by a strange few, including our own Lavos."
Text: "하지만 모든 이가 내세에서 좋은 대우를 바라며 그녀에게 경의를 표합니다. 우리 모두 립서비스는 하지만, 기이한 소수를 제외하면 사랑받지는 못합니다. 우리 라보스도 그 중 하나지요."

TextEng: "She is very powerful, perhaps the most powerful priest in the known lands. Despite this, she lives a very simple life, eschewing anything that does not come with her station."
Text: "매우 강력한 사제입니다. 어쩌면 알려진 땅에서 가장 강력한 사제일지도 모릅니다. 그럼에도 매우 검소한 삶을 살며, 지위에 따르지 않는 것은 일체 거부합니다."

TextEng: "I would suggest you speak to her, though be wary. She seems to have taken an unnatural fascination in you. I tried to get her to tell me about it, but she does not... like me very much."
Text: "그녀와 이야기해 보시길 권합니다. 다만 조심하십시오. 당신에게 부자연스러운 관심을 보이는 것 같습니다. 이유를 물었지만, 그녀는 저를... 별로 좋아하지 않습니다."

TextEng: "Pharos the Warrior is the just god. He knows your purpose, your worthiness and when invoked, he judges whether your claim to victory is valid."
Text: "파로스 전사는 정의로운 신입니다. 당신의 목적, 가치를 알며, 기도를 받으면 승리의 자격이 정당한지 심판합니다."

TextEng: "The Banner was a follower of Pharos and in his last battle, Pharos decided to claim his follower and brought him into the otherworld. His claim to victory was just and so we won, despite our leader's death."
Text: "기수장은 파로스의 추종자였으며, 마지막 전투에서 파로스가 자신의 추종자를 데려가기로 하여 저세상으로 불렀습니다. 그의 승리 주장은 정당했고, 그래서 지도자의 죽음에도 불구하고 우리가 이겼습니다."

TextEng: "Most of his followers are warriors, paladins, monks, and those who love justice. Those who carefully deliberate and then support a just cause are his champions."
Text: "그의 추종자 대부분은 전사, 성기사, 수도승, 그리고 정의를 사랑하는 자들입니다. 신중히 숙고한 후 정의로운 대의를 지지하는 자가 그의 투사입니다."

TextEng: "Churl is the Goddess of Destruction, Lady Chaos, the Storm. Rictos is the God of Magic, the Dominator, Lord of Power, The Mountain."
Text: "처얼은 파괴의 여신, 혼돈의 여인, 폭풍입니다. 릭토스는 마법의 신, 지배자, 힘의 군주, 산입니다."

TextEng: "Veragok is the God of Darkness, Patron of Thieves, Lord of the Outcasts, the Shadow."
Text: "베라곡은 어둠의 신, 도둑의 수호신, 추방자의 군주, 그림자입니다."

TextEng: "Veragok, known to the clergy of Pharos as the coward, is the forgotten child. The weakling who hides in the shadows and welcomes the outcasts of society into his dark and corrupt world."
Text: "파로스 성직자에게 비겁자로 알려진 베라곡은 잊혀진 아이입니다. 그림자 속에 숨어 사회의 추방자들을 그의 어둡고 타락한 세계로 맞이하는 나약한 자입니다."

TextEng: "Those whose interests are only of themselves, thieves and assassins, beggars and burglars are the patrons of Veragok."
Text: "오직 자신의 이익에만 관심을 두는 자, 도둑과 암살자, 거지와 빈집털이가 베라곡의 추종자입니다."

TextEng: "No, thank you."
Text: "아니, 괜찮아."

TextEng: "I have questions about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대해 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "Tell me about Lavos."
Text: "라보스에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me more about your god, Pharos."
Text: "네 신, 파로스에 대해 더 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about the Pantheon of Evil."
Text: "악의 판테온에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about Veragok."
Text: "베라곡에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "That's all my questions about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대한 질문은 그만할게."

TextEng: "Tell me about Rictos."
Text: "릭토스에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me more about Churl."
Text: "처얼에 대해 더 알려줘."

TextEng: "What do you know about the invaders?"
Text: "침략자들에 대해 아는 게 뭐야?"

TextEng: "It sounds like Churl and your god, Pharos, have a lot in common."
Text: "처얼이랑 네 신 파로스는 공통점이 많아 보여."

TextEng: "Believe what you will. I don't care."
Text: "믿고 싶은 대로 믿어. 난 상관없어."

TextEng: "Semantics! There is little difference."
Text: "말장난이지! 차이가 별로 없잖아."

TextEng: "I apologize. I didn't mean to offend you."
Text: "사과할게. 화나게 할 뜻은 없었어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the Pantheon of Good."
Text: "선의 판테온에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I want to talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기 하자."

Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "내가 누구를 따르는지 말해 줄 수 있어."
