Text: "아니, 법전에 분명히 나와 있어! 최종 투표는 내 몫이고, 누가 되든 1도 상관 안 하니까, 동전을 던지겠어. 앞면, 에니비드. 뒷면, 베켓. 자, 동전 지갑을 어디 뒀더라..."

TextEng: "Here it is. Alright, let's start."
Text: "여기 있다. 좋아, 시작하자."

TextEng: "Thank you, <FirstName>. Hmm, an old imperial coin? Very nice. And the weight seems perfectly balanced, so no cheating."
Text: "고마워, <FirstName>. 흠, 오래된 제국 동전? 좋군. 무게도 완벽하게 균형 잡혀 있어, 속임수는 없어."

TextEng: "Well, heads it is. It seems <FirstName> is the winner."
Text: "음, 앞면이야. <FirstName>이 승자인 것 같군."

TextEng: " Well, heads it is! It seems Enivid is the winner."
Text: "음, 앞면이야! 에니비드가 승자인 것 같군."

TextEng: "I guess if you're too thick to figure something out, I'm the castellan, so I'll answer."
Text: "직접 알아낼 만큼 머리가 안 돌아간다면, 성주관인 내가 답해주지."

TextEng: "The new <Lord/Lady> of the Keep is <FullName>."
Text: "거점의 새 영주는 <FullName>입니다."

TextEng: "Here is the Lord's Helm, <Lord/Lady> <FullName>. May your reign be long and mostly peaceful. Well, one or the other, really. I don't suppose it matters much to me."
Text: "여기 영주의 투구가 있소, 영주 <FullName>. 당신의 통치가 길고 대체로 평화롭기를. 뭐, 둘 중 하나겠지. 나한테는 별 상관 없어."

TextEng: "Now, seeing how Enivid's already the Hand, we'll save any re-appointment of that position for another day. Unless you want to promote her to be your Banner, that is..."
Text: "에니비드가 이미 보좌관이니, 그 자리의 재임명은 다른 날로 미루지. 네가 그녀를 기수장으로 승진시키고 싶지 않다면 말이야..."

TextEng: "Nonsense. There must be some degree of stability and experience within the governance of the keep. Even the guilds that voted against Enivid would not want her to be gone entirely. She has proven herself time and again to be reliable."
Text: "말도 안 돼. 거점 통치에 어느 정도의 안정성과 경험이 있어야 해. 에니비드에 반대표를 던진 길드조차 그녀가 완전히 사라지길 원하지 않을 거야. 매번 신뢰할 수 있음을 증명했으니까."

TextEng: "Very well, who would you choose to be your Banner, then?"
Text: "좋아, 그럼 누구를 기수장으로 선택할 거야?"

TextEng: "It is not my choice to make, my <Lord/Lady>. You must choose the Banner on your own."
Text: "내가 할 선택이 아니야, 영주. 기수장은 네가 직접 골라야 해."

TextEng: "I would choose Jaboli. She handles authority well and with a keen sense of justice. Such compassionate leadership will be necessary."
Text: "자볼리를 선택하겠습니다. 권위를 잘 다루고 예리한 정의감이 있습니다. 그런 자비로운 지도력이 필요할 것입니다."

TextEng: "I would choose Yenna. She is very wise and is well-respected throughout the keep."
Text: "예나를 선택하겠습니다. 매우 현명하고 거점 전체에서 존경받고 있습니다."

TextEng: "Are... are you sure? Many will be upset with such a choice."
Text: "정... 정말이야? 그런 선택에 많은 사람이 화낼 거야."

TextEng: "Do not argue with your <lord/lady>! <He/She> has made a wise decision."
Text: "영주에게 이의를 제기하지 마! 현명한 결정이야."

TextEng: "That's really too bad, cause I promise you, my answers won't be helpful."
Text: "그건 안됐네, 내 대답이 도움이 안 될 거라고 약속하거든."

TextEng: "An interesting choice and not one many will welcome but you are the <Lord/Lady>."
Text: "흥미로운 선택이고 많은 사람이 환영하지 않겠지만, 네가 영주니까."

TextEng: "I shall go to Feran and tell him of his appointment. I am sure he will make a worthy Banner. He is a good warrior."
Text: "가서 페란에게 임명 사실을 전하겠어. 훌륭한 기수장이 될 거야. 좋은 전사거든."

TextEng: "I shall go to Yenna and tell her of her appointment. I am sure she will make a worthy Banner. She is wise, I as are you."
Text: "가서 예나에게 임명 사실을 전하겠어. 훌륭한 기수장이 될 거야. 현명하지, 너처럼."

TextEng: "She is but a child. I know you might have a fondness in your heart for her, but do you really think she is up to such a heavy burden?"
Text: "그녀는 아이에 불과해. 마음속으로 그녀를 좋아하는 건 알지만, 정말로 그런 무거운 짐을 감당할 수 있다고 생각해?"

TextEng: "I shall go to Alias and tell her of her appointment. I must question your wisdom in this decision, but perhaps you know her better than we do."
Text: "가서 앨리어스에게 임명 사실을 전하겠어. 이 결정에 대한 네 판단력에 의문을 제기해야겠지만, 아마 너는 우리보다 그녀를 더 잘 아는 거겠지."

TextEng: "No! I have no desire to rule over people, <FirstName>. I would make the worst Banner. Please, if you have any kind feelings for me, do not choose me."
Text: "안 돼요! 사람들을 다스리고 싶은 마음은 없어요, <FirstName>. 최악의 기수장이 될 거예요. 제발, 저한테 조금이라도 정이 있다면, 저를 선택하지 마세요."

TextEng: "Yes! Now Trip holds all the power! You shall all grovel at my feet and beg for mercy, though you shall not likely find any! Mwah ha ha ha!"
Text: "좋아요! 이제 트립이 모든 권력을 쥐었어요! 다들 트립 발 앞에 엎드려 자비를 구걸할 거예요, 자비 같은 건 없겠지만! 무하하하하!"

TextEng: "Please, m'<lord/lady>, choose someone else. No one will listen to this... creature and the keep shall be torn apart by this rift. Choose more wisely, I beg you."
Text: "제발, 영주, 다른 사람을 고르세요. 이... 생물체의 말을 아무도 듣지 않을 거고, 거점은 이 분열로 산산이 찢어질 겁니다. 더 현명하게 선택하시길 간청합니다."

TextEng: "Oh dear. We shall try to... work around this little problem. I fear there are many who shall rue this choice, some day even you might wish you had not done so."
Text: "이런. 이 작은 문제를... 어떻게든 해보겠어. 이 선택을 후회할 사람이 많을 거야, 언젠가 너도 그렇게 하지 않았으면 좋았을 거라고 바랄지도 몰라."

TextEng: "Yes, please choose a little more wisely!"
Text: "네, 제발 좀 더 현명하게 골라주세요!"

TextEng: "It's about time. Now, I have a keep to run, so if you don't mind..."
Text: "그래야지. 자, 나는 거점을 관리해야 하니까, 실례가 안 된다면..."

TextEng: "I shall do my best to keep order and justice within the keep. I take this duty very seriously."
Text: "거점의 질서와 정의를 지키기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다. 이 직무를 매우 진지하게 받아들입니다."

TextEng: "I would not have thought of Jaboli for this position, but it could be that you have made a very wise decision."
Text: "자볼리를 이 자리에 생각해 보지 않았지만, 아주 현명한 결정을 내린 건지도 몰라."

TextEng: "It doesn't feel right, <FirstName>. I'd be more comfortable as the Hand, and have Enivid become the Banner, <lad/lass>... er, m'<lord/lady>."
Text: "뭔가 맞지 않는 것 같아요, <FirstName>. 저는 보좌관이 더 편하고, 에니비드가 기수장이 되는 게 낫지 않을까요, 친구... 아, 영주."

TextEng: "Aye, mayhaps that would be wisest."
Text: "그래, 아마 그게 제일 현명하겠지."

TextEng: "I shall be steadfast as your Hand, old friend. I'll not fail you, you have my word."
Text: "당신의 보좌관으로 흔들리지 않겠어요, 오랜 친구. 실망시키지 않을게요, 약속해요."

TextEng: "The Banner is the highest ranking officer in the keep and the primary assistant to the Lord. The Banner deals mostly with civic matters and the general operations of the keep, leaving military matters to the Hand except in times of war. Who shall serve?"
Text: "기수장은 거점의 최고위 관리이자 영주의 수석 보좌관이야. 기수장은 주로 민사와 거점 운영을 담당하고, 군사 문제는 전시를 제외하면 보좌관에게 맡기지. 누가 할 거야?"

TextEng: "Very well, then. If Enivid is to be your Banner, you must choose a Hand to replace her."
Text: "좋아, 그럼. 에니비드가 기수장이 되면, 그녀를 대신할 보좌관을 골라야 해."

TextEng: "I have many warriors who are worthy. If you wish, I can choose a Hand who will be loyal to you and the keep."
Text: "합당한 전사가 많이 있습니다. 원하신다면, 당신과 거점에 충성할 보좌관을 선택하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I will do so."
Text: "그렇게 하겠습니다."

TextEng: "I would choose Calibast. He has proven himself to be a worthy warrior and loyal to you."
Text: "칼리바스트를 선택하겠습니다. 합당한 전사이자 당신에게 충성스러움을 증명했습니다."

TextEng: "And you are possibly going to be my new <lord/lady>? Gods help us all, cause you certainly won't."
Text: "네가 내 새 영주가 될 수도 있다고? 신이시여 우리를 도우소서, 네가 도울 리는 없으니까."

TextEng: "I would choose Feran. He is a good leader and loyal to the keep."
Text: "페란을 선택하겠습니다. 좋은 지도자이고 거점에 충성스럽습니다."

TextEng: "Are... are you sure? Many will be upset with such a choice."
Text: "정... 정말이야? 그런 선택에 많은 사람이 화낼 거야."

TextEng: "Do not argue with your <lord/lady>! <He/She> has made a wise decision."
Text: "영주에게 이의를 제기하지 마! 현명한 결정이야."

TextEng: "I shall go to Thaddues and tell him of his appointment. He is an odd choice for Hand but mayhaps he'll surprise us."
Text: "가서 태데우스에게 임명 사실을 전하겠어. 보좌관으로는 이상한 선택이지만, 어쩌면 놀라게 할지도 몰라."

TextEng: "The soldiers hold him in very high regard and I am sure he will make a worth hand. I shall tell Feran of his appointment."
Text: "병사들이 그를 매우 존경하고, 훌륭한 보좌관이 될 거라 확신해. 가서 페란에게 임명 사실을 전하겠어."

TextEng: "She is wise and her decisive action on the battlefield saved us all from quite a calamity. The soldiers will follow her as Hand, I believe. I will inform her of your decision."
Text: "현명하고, 전장에서의 결단력 있는 행동이 큰 재앙에서 우리 모두를 구했어. 병사들이 그녀를 보좌관으로 따를 거야. 네 결정을 전하겠어."

TextEng: "She is young but she's proven herself to be a fine scout and a brave one besides. I will inform her of your decision."
Text: "젊지만 훌륭한 정찰병이자 용감한 자임을 증명했어. 네 결정을 전하겠어."

TextEng: "I do not think I would function well in this role, <FirstName>. As Banner, I would be charged with serving justice and serving the greater needs of the keep, but the Hand must be a leader of troops."
Text: "이 역할은 잘 못할 것 같아요, <FirstName>. 기수장으로서 정의를 행하고 거점의 더 큰 필요를 섬기겠지만, 보좌관은 군대를 이끌어야 하잖아요."

TextEng: "Yes, please do."
Text: "네, 그렇게 해주세요."

TextEng: "I shall do my best to keep order and justice within the keep. I take this duty very seriously."
Text: "거점의 질서와 정의를 지키기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다. 이 직무를 매우 진지하게 받아들입니다."

TextEng: "I know I look like the muscle-bound, adventurous type, but looks can be deceiving. I actually spend most of my days and nights locked up here in the castle, pretending to work."
Text: "근육질 모험가 타입으로 보이는 건 알지만, 겉모습은 속이는 법이야. 사실 낮이고 밤이고 성에 틀어박혀서 일하는 척하고 있어."

TextEng: "I would not have thought of Jaboli for this position, but it could be that you have made a very wise decision."
Text: "자볼리를 이 자리에 생각해 보지 않았지만, 아주 현명한 결정을 내린 건지도 몰라."

TextEng: "<FirstName>, what do I know of leading troops? Nothing! For the love of nature, do not do this to me!"
Text: "<FirstName>, 군대를 이끄는 것에 대해 뭘 알겠어요? 아무것도 몰라요! 자연의 이름으로, 이러지 마세요!"

TextEng: "Yes! Now Trip holds all the power! You shall all grovel at my feet and beg for mercy, though you shall not likely find any! Mwah ha ha ha!"
Text: "좋아요! 이제 트립이 모든 권력을 쥐었어요! 다들 트립 발 앞에 엎드려 자비를 구걸할 거예요, 자비 같은 건 없겠지만! 무하하하하!"

TextEng: "The troops would never follow him, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. You need to choose someone who can lead troops into battle."
Text: "병사들이 절대 그를 따르지 않을 거야, 영주 <FirstName>. 병사들을 이끌고 전투에 나갈 수 있는 사람을 골라야 해."

TextEng: "Now that sounds like a position worthy of my talents!"
Text: "이야, 이건 제 재능에 걸맞은 자리 같은데요!"

TextEng: "Very well... My last duty is to ask you to speak to Enivid about dealing with the last of the invaders. As our <Lord/Lady>, you have the right to decide how to use the troops."
Text: "좋아... 마지막 임무로 에니비드에게 가서 남은 침략자 처리에 대해 상의해. 우리 영주로서, 군대를 어떻게 사용할지 결정할 권리가 있으니까."

TextEng: "May the gods grant you wisdom in the choices you make, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>."
Text: "신들이 당신의 선택에 지혜를 내려주시길, 영주 <FirstName>."

TextEng: "The Hand is the commander of the keep's armies and next in charge after the Banner. Now that we finally have a Lord and Banner again, the Hand will be able to focus their attention on purely military matters rather than civil ones. Who shall serve?"
Text: "보좌관은 거점 군대의 지휘관이자 기수장 다음 서열이야. 이제 영주와 기수장이 다시 생겼으니, 보좌관은 민사보다 순수한 군사 문제에 집중할 수 있을 거야. 누가 할 거야?"

TextEng: "The Banner is the highest ranking officer in the keep and the primary assistant to the Lord. The Banner deals mostly with civic matters and the general operations of the keep, leaving military matters to the Hand except in times of war."
Text: "기수장은 거점의 최고위 관리이자 영주의 수석 보좌관이야. 기수장은 주로 민사와 거점 운영을 담당하고, 군사 문제는 전시를 제외하면 보좌관에게 맡기지."

TextEng: "The Hand is the commander of the keep's armies and next in charge after the Banner. Now that we finally have a Lord and Banner again, the Hand will be able to focus their attention on purely military matters rather than civil ones."
Text: "보좌관은 거점 군대의 지휘관이자 기수장 다음 서열이야. 이제 영주와 기수장이 다시 생겼으니, 보좌관은 민사보다 순수한 군사 문제에 집중할 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "I am the new <Lord/Lady> of the Keep. Bow down before me."
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "나는 거점의 새 영주다. 내 앞에 무릎 꿇어라."

TextEng: "I am <FullName> and I go where I want."
Text: "나는 <FullName>이고, 가고 싶은 곳에 간다."

TextEng: "Kaidala."
Text: "카이달라."

TextEng: "Trip."
Text: "트립."

TextEng: "Calibast."
Text: "칼리바스트."

TextEng: "What does the role of the Hand entail?"
Text: "보좌관 역할이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "What does the role of the Banner entail?"
Text: "기수장 역할이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "What does the role of the Hand entail?"
Text: "보좌관 역할이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I have questions about the rest of the keep."
Text: "거점 나머지에 대해 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "I could never follow you."
Text: "절대 따를 수 없다."

TextEng: "If the pay is right."
Text: "보수가 맞으면."

TextEng: "I gladly accept."
Text: "기꺼이 받아들이겠어."

TextEng: "I will do no such thing."
Text: "그런 짓은 안 할 거야."

TextEng: "Do I get any help?"
Text: "도움을 받을 수 있어?"

TextEng: "What is upstairs in the Guildhall?"
Text: "길드 홀 위층에는 뭐가 있어?"

TextEng: "I guess the reward is worth it."
Text: "보상이 그만한 가치가 있겠지."

TextEng: "I accept this duty."
Text: "이 직무를 받아들이겠어."

TextEng: "What do you think about the election?"
Text: "선거에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "Can you call the election?"
Text: "선거를 시작할 수 있어?"

TextEng: "No, you'd better not."
Text: "아니, 안 하는 게 낫겠어."

TextEng: "Yes, start the election."
Text: "응, 선거를 시작해."

TextEng: "Mind your own business, old man!"
Text: "네 일이나 신경 써, 늙은이!"

TextEng: "What does a castellan do?"
Text: "성주관이 하는 일이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "So are you open to bribes?"
Text: "그래서 뇌물은 받아?"

TextEng: "I am <FirstName>, and I am in the election for the new <Lord/Lady> of the Keep."
Text: "나는 <FirstName>이고, 거점의 새 영주 선거에 출마했어."

TextEng: "Here Mykes, you can borrow my coin." <StartAction>[Use Rafael's coin.]</Start>
Text: "마이크스, 내 동전을 빌려줄게." <StartAction>[라파엘의 동전을 사용한다.]</Start>

TextEng: "I don't want Enivid to be my Hand or my Banner!"
Text: "에니비드가 내 보좌관이나 기수장이 되는 건 싫어!"

TextEng: "Enivid may remain as my Hand."
Text: "에니비드가 보좌관으로 남아도 돼."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "잘 가."

TextEng: "Who would you choose, Enivid?"
Text: "에니비드, 누구를 선택하겠어?"

TextEng: "Sir Becket."
Text: "베켓 경."

TextEng: "Enivid."
Text: "에니비드."

TextEng: "Thaddeus."
Text: "태데우스."

TextEng: "Feran."
Text: "페란."

TextEng: "Yenna."
Text: "예나."

TextEng: "I have questions for you."
Text: "질문이 있어."

TextEng: "Alias."
Text: "앨리어스."

TextEng: "I have changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "I do."
Text: "그래."

TextEng: "Kaidala."
Text: "카이달라."

TextEng: "Trip."
Text: "트립."

TextEng: "That's the right attitude!"
Text: "바로 그 태도야!"

TextEng: "You have made me your <Lord/Lady>. My decision is final!"
Text: "네가 나를 영주로 만들었어. 내 결정은 최종이야!"

TextEng: "That's all my questions."
Text: "질문은 그만할게."

TextEng: "I have changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "On second thought..."
Text: "다시 생각해 보면..."

TextEng: "Jaboli."
Text: "자볼리."

TextEng: "Calibast."
Text: "칼리바스트."

TextEng: "Then I shall choose someone else as Banner."
Text: "그럼 다른 사람을 기수장으로 선택할게."

TextEng: "Then be my Hand and Enivid can be my Banner."
Text: "그럼 네가 보좌관이 되고, 에니비드가 기수장이 되면 돼."

TextEng: "What does the role of the Banner entail?"
Text: "기수장 역할이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "Yes, I would like to promote Enivid to Banner."
Text: "에니비드를 기수장으로 승진시키겠어."

TextEng: "Who would you choose, Enivid?"
Text: "에니비드, 누구를 선택하겠어?"

TextEng: "Choose one for me then."
Text: "대신 골라줘."

TextEng: "Sir Becket."
Text: "베켓 경."

TextEng: "Thaddeus."
Text: "태데우스."

TextEng: "Feran."
Text: "페란."

TextEng: "You have been a marvelous help."
Text: "훌륭한 도움이었어."

TextEng: "Yenna."
Text: "예나."

TextEng: "Alias."
Text: "앨리어스."

TextEng: "Jaboli."
Text: "자볼리."

TextEng: "Then I shall choose someone else as Hand."
Text: "그럼 다른 사람을 보좌관으로 선택할게."

TextEng: "Then be my Banner and Enivid can remain my Hand."
Text: "그럼 네가 기수장이 되고, 에니비드가 보좌관으로 남아."

TextEng: "Your companions live again, though it was a struggle to bring them back after such a long time in my goddess's domain."
"I see you have returned. What can I do for you?"
"We shall see each other again; whether in this world or the next, who can say?"
"The mysteries of death require great study. It might be that I can answer a question or two for you."
"And what might your other concerns be?"
"What interest have I in politics or worldly affairs? My time is better spent in researching the mysteries of death and guarding over my sacred duties as a servant of the Mistress."
"If my Mistress ever decided I should have more influence, then I would do what I had to. I doubt I shall be called to such a task though. People take more comfort from a leader like Dynschall."
"Shrouded in her darkest gown, with a lustrous hood of royal color, she came to me and spoke of a <man/woman> of great importance who would serve her well."
"She even showed me your face and asked that I give some of my life force to the spirit she would send."
"I gave up that part of my life force and I still feel quite weak, but I can feel my powers returning, so the Goddess is still with me."
"The mysteries of death take years to glean, and even after a lifetime of service dedicated to my Mistress, I find there is more to learn than when I started."
"Mistress Death has always been and will always be, for where there is life, there must also be death."
"I am Lavos, servant of Mistress Death." The woman's lips barely seem to move as she speaks and her face is startlingly pale. She chuckles at your surprise.
"Ah, so the Lady Rehan has been tormenting you with her sorrow, has she?"
"If a spirit is not at rest, there is often a reason for it, <FirstName>. As a priestess of Mistress Death, exorcism is a task I cannot take lightly. But, if it is important to you, I shall do it."
"She was a noblewoman here in Cyan, young and beautiful. She had a melancholy about her, though, a wistfulness that made her seem a ghost even while still alive."

"One morning, she threw herself from a cliff. When the soldiers carried her broken body to me, I remember them commenting that she had the look about her of one in love... She has haunted that Manor ever since."
"Important enough that you would sacrifice one charge of that magic weapon you carry with you? Its powers are strong but even they will not last forever."
"Perhaps you'd better not indeed, <FirstName>. If you are going to request an exorcism, you had best have the stomach for it..."
"I thought that might be the case, <FirstName>... It's interesting what we living hold dear, is it not?"

Lavos lays her hand upon your weapon, her eyes rolling back to show their whites. The air around her seems to grow thick. "Thank you, <FirstName>. By the time you return to home, the deed will be done."
"That is true, if my Mistress grants me such high power. I am one of the few in these lands who do. Your weapon also has that power though."
"Is there aught else I can do for you?"
"Death greets you, <FirstName>, waiting with eternal patience. You are welcome in this place, though why, I do not understand."
"Do you think that such powers are just handed out to any priest? If life were so cheaply bought, we would have no fear, no justifiable reasons to develop society."
"The mysteries of death's great power are not easily purchased. My life is partially consumed to bring back a lost soul."

"This is a price I gladly pay, for in death, my Mistress shall lift me up beside her in the halls of the dead. But so long as she wants me to live, I will serve her here and protect my power and my life.""
"The power to bring a soul back is not to be taken lightly. It is a complex and draining power. Be careful what you ask for."
"However, since I was told to assist you in any way I could, if you bring me their bodies, I shall do this for you."
"The task would be harder on me than on you. That said, it is your decision to make, not mine. Is there aught else I can do for you?"
"Very well. Is their anything else you would like?"
"I cannot raise them out of thin air. I could call their spirits, but they would leave without their proper form to inhabit."
"Then I shall raise them, but it shall take some time. Come back later and it shall be done."
"If the Mistress feels favor for you, then I shall support that. I will explain my position to Dynschall, though you will likely also need Rafael's support to sway Dynschall's vote."
"I have a had vision, a glorious vision of Mistress Death, and she told me to assist you. She sent a spirit to me, and I gave the spirit the ability to bring you back from my Mistress's realm."
"Is there aught else this servant of Mistress Death can assist you?"
"I have already said that I would vote for you. Do not make me lose patience and change my mind!"
"For Death to do such a thing is unnatural. I don't like where this is leading us, <FirstName>."
"That be the voice, <FirstName>. The new one in my head. Why would Death be interested in you being alive though?"
"That is a strange thing for Mistress Death to do, <FirstName>. I fear what consequences might wait in the path before us."
"Such wonders are rare to behold and such requests rarer still. I can feel the presence of the spirit in your weapon. So do you know why my goddess favors you?"
"Whether you worship her or not is of no matter. Death must follow you, wherever you go. I guess we shall discover the reason in time. So how may I be of service?"
"That is the mark of one favored, but it does not explain why you are favored. I guess we shall discover the reason in time. So how may I be of service?"
"That is a possibility, though there are many who enjoy killing, and few of them have ever held such favor, even within the church. How may I be of service to you?"
"That is unfortunate. I guess we shall discover the reason in time. So how may I be of service?"
"I have other questions for you."
"I have other concerns."
"You seem powerful. Why aren't you the guildmaster?"
"Tell me more about your vision."
"Tell me about your goddess."
"Death greets me?"
"I own a house that is in need of an exorcism."
"Her sorrows? What do you mean?"
"Lady Rehan?"
"Yes, and I want it stopped at once."
"Tell me about this Lady Rehan."
"Perhaps I'd better not have the house exorcised after all."
"Well it's important that the house be exorcised."
"It's very important. My house must be exorcised at once."
"Perhaps I'd better not..."
"What do you mean?"
"I don't think my weapon has any charges to spare."
"Yes, I will sacrifice one charge of my weapon."
"You said you have the power to raise the dead."
"I guess you're right."
"Why one of the few?"
"I would like to raise my other companions."
"That's just too much work."
"Right, I shall go get them."
"You need their bodies?"
"I have the bodies right here."
"I want the priests' guild to vote for me."
"I find even the idea repugnant."
"Death seems to follow in my wake."
"Maybe because I enjoy killing."
"I have no idea."
"Goodbye."
"I see you have returned. What would you like now?"
Text: "또 왔구만. 뭘 원해?"

TextEng: "Let me see what you have."
Text: "뭐가 있는지 볼게."

TextEng: "You did bring the hide, didn't you, <FirstName>? You must actually have the hide with you, if I am to do anything with it."
Text: "가죽을 가져왔겠지, <FirstName>? 뭘 하려면 실제로 가죽을 갖고 있어야 해."

TextEng: "Good to see you are back. I am having great success with the manticore hide. Did you want something from me?"
Text: "돌아와서 반갑다. 맨티코어 가죽으로 잘 작업하고 있어. 뭐 필요한 거 있어?"

TextEng: "As a ranger, I will make you a member of the guild, for 100 gold."
Text: "레인저니까, 100골드에 길드 회원으로 받아줄게."

TextEng: "As a barbarian, I will make you a member of the guild, for 100 gold."
Text: "야만전사니까, 100골드에 길드 회원으로 받아줄게."

TextEng: "That is too bad. I am sure you will be able to come up with the gold somehow. It really is worth it. Anything else?"
Text: "안 됐군. 어떻게든 금을 마련할 수 있을 거야. 정말 가치가 있거든. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "Right. Your name is on the guild registry. Is there anything else?"
Text: "좋아. 길드 명부에 이름을 올렸어. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "You will be allowed to trade in any pelts you recover during your expeditions. Just tell me you have something to trade and I'll give you a deal."
Text: "원정 중에 얻은 가죽을 거래할 수 있어. 교역할 게 있다고 말하면 적정 가격에 사줄게."

TextEng: "You also get a discount from me. I should think you could make your money back in no time."
Text: "내 물건도 할인해줄게. 금방 본전 뽑을 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: This dwarf fidgets and plays with her swords as she hums an off-tune little song to herself. As you approach she sighs and taps her foot impatiently.
Text: 이 드워프는 안절부절못하며 칼을 만지작거리고, 음정이 맞지 않는 노래를 흥얼거립니다. 당신이 다가오자 한숨을 쉬며 발을 조급하게 구릅니다.

TextEng: "You look like the kind of soul who has spent a great deal of time in the wilds, so be welcomed here to the Quartermaster's Store."
Text: "야생에서 꽤 오래 지낸 것 같은 인상이야. 보급장에 온 걸 환영해."

TextEng: "Good hunting."
Text: "사냥 잘 해."

TextEng: "You look like the kind of soul who has spent a great deal of time in the wilds, so be welcomed here to the Quartermaster's Store."
Text: "야생에서 꽤 오래 지낸 것 같은 인상이야. 보급장에 온 걸 환영해."

TextEng: "You must be the new one running for Lord of the Keep. As master of the foresters' guild, I've heard a few things about you. Are you here for supplies or about the election?"
Text: "거점의 영주에 출마한 새 사람이구만. 산림 길드장으로서 너에 대해 좀 들었어. 물자 때문에 왔어, 아니면 선거 건이야?"

TextEng: "Right. Don't go getting yourself killed."
Text: "좋아. 죽지 마."

TextEng: "Why do you always say that?"
Text: "왜 항상 그런 말을 해?"

TextEng: "Well, some people need practical advice."
Text: "뭐, 어떤 사람들은 실용적인 조언이 필요하니까."

TextEng: "Very good. I do a lot of business so my stock changes quite rapidly. I hope I have something of interest to you."
Text: "좋아. 거래가 많아서 재고가 빨리 바뀌어. 마음에 드는 게 있으면 좋겠네."

TextEng: "Since you are a member of our guild, I will give you better prices."
Text: "길드 회원이니까 더 좋은 가격을 줄게."

TextEng: "Right. Go ahead."
Text: "좋아. 어서."

TextEng: "Right. I suppose you think all we do here is sit around waiting for folks to walk in and ask us questions."
Text: "좋아. 여기서 앉아서 사람들이 와서 질문하길 기다리기만 한다고 생각하겠지."

TextEng: "You mean we don't?"
Text: "우리가 그런 거 아니야?"

TextEng: "I buy wolf pelts for ten gold. Here you go. Anything else?"
Text: "늑대 가죽은 10골드에 사. 여기. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "And here I thought that's what you were paying us for, Floater!"
Text: "그래서 우리한테 돈을 내는 거 아니야, 플로터!"

TextEng: "What kind of questions would you like me to answer, <FirstName>?"
Text: "어떤 질문에 답하면 될까, <FirstName>?"

TextEng: "I can answer questions or sell you some equipment, but I prefer the latter."
Text: "질문에도 답하고 장비도 팔 수 있지만, 후자가 더 좋아."

TextEng: "What kind of information?"
Text: "어떤 정보?"

TextEng: "There's two edges on that blade, there is. On the one hand, there's the forces he brought with him. On the other, the monsters have been building up their numbers hereabouts for a long time now."
Text: "그 칼날에는 양면이 있어. 한편으로는 가면 남자가 데려온 병력이 있고. 다른 한편으로는 괴물들이 오랫동안 이 근처에서 세력을 키우고 있었어."

TextEng: "It's like they've been building up, waiting for the Masked Man to lead them. We warned the keep several years ago and that's when the Banner started to rebuild the army."
Text: "마치 가면 남자가 이끌기를 기다리며 세력을 키워온 것 같아. 몇 년 전에 거점에 경고했고, 그때 기수장이 군대를 재건하기 시작했지."

TextEng: "The Mossy Tree has a much better atmosphere."
Text: "이끼 나무가 분위기가 훨씬 좋아."

TextEng: "Right here. No better shop in town, according to me."
Text: "바로 여기. 내 생각에 이 마을에서 이보다 좋은 상점은 없어."

TextEng: "You could hunt a manticore."
Text: "맨티코어를 사냥할 수 있지."

TextEng: "The foresters' guild was created to protect the interests of the woodsmen and the hunters. We make up a large portion of the revenue for the keep, exporting furs and other products to the southern cities."
Text: "산림 길드는 나무꾼과 사냥꾼의 이익을 보호하려고 만들어졌어. 우리가 거점 수입의 큰 부분을 차지하고, 모피와 기타 산물을 남쪽 도시에 수출하지."

TextEng: "I buy bearskins at twenty gold per pelt. Here you go. Anything else?"
Text: "곰 가죽은 20골드에 사. 여기. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "The largest problem is that we get very little respect. The only other guild master who treats us well is Serah, of the landowners' guild. She knows what goes on outside the keep, so she understands."
Text: "가장 큰 문제는 존중을 거의 못 받는다는 거야. 우리를 잘 대해주는 다른 길드장은 지주 길드의 세라뿐이야. 그녀는 거점 밖에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 아니까 이해해."

TextEng: "You don't have to be rude about it."
Text: "그렇게 무례할 필요까지는 없잖아."

TextEng: "She understands that sometimes a loner needs to come into town and let loose a little. Go a little crazy."
Text: "외톨이가 가끔 마을에 와서 좀 풀어질 필요가 있다는 걸 이해하거든. 좀 미쳐보기도 하고."

TextEng: "What else would you like to know?"
Text: "다른 건 뭘 알고 싶어?"

TextEng: "As a ranger, I will make you a member of the guild, for 100 gold."
Text: "레인저니까, 100골드에 길드 회원으로 받아줄게."

TextEng: "That is too bad. I'm sure you'll be able to come up with the gold somehow. It's really worth it."
Text: "안 됐군. 어떻게든 금을 마련할 수 있을 거야. 정말 가치가 있거든."

TextEng: "Right. Your name is on the guild registry. There gonna be anything else?"
Text: "좋아. 길드 명부에 이름을 올렸어. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "You will be allowed to trade in any pelts you recover during your expeditions. Just tell me you have something to trade and I'll give you a deal."
Text: "원정 중에 얻은 가죽을 거래할 수 있어. 교역할 게 있다고 말하면 적정 가격에 사줄게."

TextEng: "You also get a discount from me. I should think you could make your money back in no time."
Text: "내 물건도 할인해줄게. 금방 본전 뽑을 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "No. You still have to prove yourself."
Text: "안 돼. 아직 실력을 증명하지 못했어."

TextEng: "Well imagine that. You've proven your excellence at hunting, then, and me and my foresters would be proud to have you as our <lord/lady>. Now let me have a look at that hide..."
Text: "이거 봐. 사냥 실력을 증명했구만. 나와 산림 길드원들은 네가 우리의 영주가 되어도 자랑스럽겠어. 자, 가죽 좀 볼게..."

TextEng: "Those are just the guild dues. Everybody pays them, so that everyone is protected and can trade here."
Text: "그건 그냥 길드 회비야. 모두 내서 다 같이 보호받고 거래할 수 있는 거야."

TextEng: "As a barbarian, I will make you a member of the guild, for 100 gold."
Text: "야만전사니까, 100골드에 길드 회원으로 받아줄게."

TextEng: "I really like you guys. We need to go drinking one of these nights!"
Text: "너희 정말 좋아. 언젠가 같이 한잔해야 해!"

TextEng: "I like your attitude, not to mention your muscles."
Text: "그 태도 마음에 들어, 근육도 말할 것 없고."

TextEng: "Ha! And a fine looking woman you be. Some good ale and some sweet lovin' are on my mind now."
Text: "하! 꽤 괜찮은 여자구만. 좋은 맥주와 달콤한 밤이 끌리는데."

TextEng: "Ha! A fine woman you are, but I have interests elsewhere..."
Text: "하! 괜찮은 여자지만, 관심은 다른 데 있어서..."

TextEng: "We shall see. We shall see."
Text: "두고 보자. 두고 봐."

TextEng: "I try not to think about it. Personally, I don't really care for either of the other candidates. Enivid doesn't like us, and Sir Becket thinks he's better than us."
Text: "생각 안 하려고 해. 솔직히 다른 후보 둘 다 별로야. 에니비드는 우리를 싫어하고, 베켓 경은 자기가 우리보다 낫다고 생각하지."

TextEng: "If I had to choose right now, I'd probably vote for Becket, since I don't know anything about you."
Text: "지금 당장 골라야 한다면, 아마 베켓에게 투표하겠어. 너에 대해 아는 게 없으니까."

TextEng: "Anyone could stand here and tell me exactly what they think I want to hear. I don't stand by words very much."
Text: "아무나 와서 듣고 싶은 말만 해줄 수 있잖아. 말은 별로 신뢰하지 않아."

TextEng: "Oh dross! It looks as though the skin was damaged. I guess those old wizards weren't as smart as they thought after all. I fear I will be unable to make that cloak for you."
Text: "이런 못쓸! 가죽이 손상된 것 같아. 옛 마법사들이 생각만큼 똑똑하지 않았나 봐. 망토를 만들 수 없을 것 같아."

TextEng: "Now, if you could prove that you understand the mind of a hunter... that would tell me something."
Text: "네가 사냥꾼의 마음을 이해한다는 걸 증명할 수 있다면... 그게 뭔가 말해줄 거야."

TextEng: "That is an argument we can have at a later time. What I want is no helpless animal."
Text: "그건 나중에 논쟁할 수 있는 문제야. 내가 원하는 건 무력한 동물이 아니야."

TextEng: "Any fool with a weapon can kill something, what I want is something more specific."
Text: "무기를 든 바보라면 뭐든 죽일 수 있어, 내가 원하는 건 좀 더 구체적인 거야."

TextEng: "Before I became the guildmaster, I was preparing to stalk a manticore that's been lingering in the ruins of the old wizards' school in the Emerald Hills. The wizards would harvest them for their hides, 'cause they're said to be easy to enchant."
Text: "길드장이 되기 전에, 에메랄드 언덕의 옛 마법사 학교 폐허에 있는 맨티코어를 추적할 준비를 하고 있었어. 마법사들이 가죽이 마법을 부여하기 쉽다고 해서 사냥했거든."

TextEng: "They had some trap involving crystals and water barrels and poison gas and luring the manticore into an enclosed space - you know wizards, they always make things more complicated than they need to be. Anyhow, I'm guessing everything should still be in place."
Text: "수정과 물통과 독가스와 맨티코어를 밀폐된 공간에 유인하는 함정이 있었어 - 마법사들 알잖아, 항상 필요 이상으로 복잡하게 만들지. 아무튼, 다 그대로 남아 있을 거야."

TextEng: "The skin of a manticore has powerful magic in it. Sometimes when you kill a manticore the normal way, the skin is too badly damaged to be useful."
Text: "맨티코어 가죽에는 강력한 마법이 있어. 보통 방법으로 죽이면, 가죽이 너무 심하게 손상되어 쓸모없을 때가 있지."

TextEng: "The wizards' trap will impair the beast in such a way that you should be able to kill it without destroying the skin. Kill the manticore and you'll have my vote. Bring it intact and I'll make it into a magic cloak for you."
Text: "마법사의 함정이 짐승을 약화시켜서 가죽을 파괴하지 않고 죽일 수 있을 거야. 맨티코어를 죽이면 내 표를 줄게. 가죽을 온전히 가져오면 마법 망토를 만들어줄게."

TextEng: "I would prefer to leave it up to you to figure it out. That is, after all, the test to see if you can think like a hunter. All I will say is that you will need at least two poison crystals."
Text: "직접 알아내는 게 낫겠어. 결국 사냥꾼처럼 생각할 수 있는지 보는 시험이니까. 한 가지만 말해주면, 독 수정이 최소 두 개는 필요해."

TextEng: "Now I should tell you that the wizards' ruins are filled with all manner of strange things and smaller monsters that feed off the remains of the manticore's kills. It should be an interesting hunt. Now are you interested?"
Text: "참고로 마법사 폐허에는 온갖 이상한 것들과 맨티코어의 먹잇감 잔해를 먹는 작은 괴물들이 가득해. 흥미로운 사냥이 될 거야. 관심 있어?"

TextEng: "That is up to you. Is there anything else you need before you leave us alone?"
Text: "그건 네 마음이야. 우리를 놔두고 가기 전에 다른 거 필요한 건?"

TextEng: "You do have my guild's vote though. Is there anything else you would like?"
Text: "그래도 우리 길드의 표는 네 거야. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "No. If you cannot prove yourself to be any better at supporting us, then we shall vote for Sir Becket."
Text: "안 돼. 우리를 더 잘 지원할 수 있다는 걸 증명하지 못하면, 베켓 경에게 투표하겠어."

TextEng: "We shall see. If you end up killing the manticore without the trap, I won't be able to make anything from it, so I can't reward you with more than my vote."
Text: "두고 봐. 함정 없이 맨티코어를 죽이면, 가죽으로 아무것도 만들 수 없으니 보상은 내 표밖에 못 줘."

TextEng: "Alias knows where the old ruins are, so she can lead you to them. Do you need anything else before you go? Some supplies maybe?"
Text: "앨리어스가 옛 폐허가 어딘지 아니까, 안내해줄 수 있어. 가기 전에 다른 거 필요해? 물자라든가?"

TextEng: "I will be voting for you, as agreed."
Text: "약속대로 너에게 투표하겠어."

TextEng: "My name is Levio'Sa, but people often refer to me as the Floating Huntress. I run this store to outfit the hunters and foresters, as well as running their guild."
Text: "이름은 레비오사지만, 사람들은 떠다니는 여사냥꾼이라고 부르기도 해. 이 상점을 운영하며 사냥꾼과 산림 길드원에게 장비를 대주고, 길드도 운영하고 있어."

TextEng: "Not that I like politics, but I don't know any hunters who would want a job like this. Not much fun being stuck inside all day, everyday."
Text: "정치를 좋아하는 건 아니지만, 이런 일을 하고 싶은 사냥꾼은 없어. 매일 실내에 갇혀 있는 게 그리 재미있진 않거든."

TextEng: "Right. Need some supplies to help out your election campaign?"
Text: "좋아. 선거 운동에 물자가 필요해?"

TextEng: "It means staying cooped up in the keep more than I like, but someone had to represent this dross."
Text: "거점에 내가 원하는 것보다 더 많이 갇혀 있어야 하지만, 누군가는 이 녀석들을 대변해야 하니까."

TextEng: "You're all heart, Floater. What would we poor fools do without you?"
Text: "순 인정이야, 플로터. 너 없으면 우리 불쌍한 바보들이 어떻게 하겠어?"

TextEng: "Sweetest woman in the world, and a great cuddle... if you like a knife in your guts. Har, har!"
Text: "세상에서 가장 다정한 여자, 안으면 기분 좋은데... 뱃속에 칼이 박히는 것만 좋아한다면. 하하!"

TextEng: "Good. The hide appears to be intact. I should be able to make something of this. In trade I will give you my old hunter's cloak."
Text: "좋아. 가죽이 온전해. 이걸로 뭔가 만들 수 있겠어. 대가로 내 오래된 사냥꾼 망토를 줄게."

TextEng: "Now that's the kind of dross that gets us in trouble. I figured with people like the Hand and the Banner running the keep, we needed someone to protect our interests."
Text: "바로 이런 못쓸 소리가 우리를 곤란하게 만들지. 보좌관이나 기수장 같은 사람들이 거점을 운영하니까, 누군가 우리 이익을 보호해야 한다고 생각했어."

TextEng: "They don't like us folk, since most of us are 'chaotic' in nature, according to the law makers. Just because we don't act all civilized and that nonsense."
Text: "우리 같은 사람들을 싫어해, 법을 만드는 자들에 따르면 대부분이 '혼돈'적 성향이라서. 문명적으로 행동하지 않는다고."

TextEng: "We like our drink strong and our bar fights brutal. That doesn't sit well with someone like the Hand."
Text: "술은 독한 게 좋고, 술집 싸움은 거친 게 좋지. 보좌관 같은 사람에게는 그게 맞지 않겠지."

TextEng: "That what we like to hear. Someone who can identify with us, unlike most of the locals."
Text: "그런 말이 듣고 싶었어. 대부분의 주민들과 달리 우리와 공감할 수 있는 사람."

TextEng: "You hear that boys and girls? 'Our type' seek out trouble!"
Text: "들었어, 형제자매들? '우리 같은' 놈들은 문제를 찾아다닌다잖아!"

TextEng: "Maybe 'our type' ought to seek a little trouble right now!"
Text: "'우리 같은 놈들'이 지금 당장 좀 문제를 찾아볼까!"

TextEng: "Yes, some butt-kicking for goodness!"
Text: "그래, 정의를 위한 두들겨 패기!"

TextEng: "Now boys, calm yourselves. There's no need to make matters worse. I'm sure <FirstName> didn't mean anything by it."
Text: "자, 얘들아, 진정해. 상황을 악화시킬 필요 없어. <FirstName>는 그런 뜻이 아니었을 거야."

TextEng: "Well, <mister/missus>, this is one guild that won't be voting for you... or selling you supplies. Now get lost."
Text: "이봐, 이 길드는 너에게 투표하지도, 물자를 팔지도 않을 거야. 꺼져."

TextEng: "Oh, sorry. Just tired of the locals and their attitudes."
Text: "아, 미안. 주민들이랑 그 태도에 좀 지쳤어."

TextEng: "I think you should find it very useful. Was there anything else?"
Text: "꽤 유용할 거야. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "Townsfolk don't mind us spending our gold here though, which is why I bought this shop when I became guildmaster. Might as well keep the gold in the family, so to speak."
Text: "주민들이 우리가 여기서 금을 쓰는 건 싫어하지 않지. 그래서 길드장이 되면서 이 상점을 산 거야. 식구끼리 금을 지키자는 거지."

TextEng: "But enough about us, what else would you like to know? Or are you ready to spend a little gold on some supplies?"
Text: "우리 얘기는 그만하고, 다른 건 뭘 알고 싶어? 아니면 물자에 금 좀 쓸 준비가 됐어?"

TextEng: "The impurities that float on top of molten metal that smiths can't stand. That뭩 what we are to a lot of the townsfolk."
Text: "쇳물 위에 뜨는 불순물, 대장장이가 싫어하는 거. 우리가 주민들한테 그런 존재야."

TextEng: "Because I could move so quietly that it seemed like I was floating above the ground. No mean feat for a dwarf out of the mountains."
Text: "너무 조용히 움직여서 땅 위에 떠 있는 것 같았거든. 산에서 온 드워프치고 쉬운 일이 아니야."

TextEng: "I loved hunting ferocious beasts. Had to give it up though, to be the guildmaster."
Text: "사나운 짐승 사냥을 좋아했어. 하지만 길드장이 되면서 그만둬야 했지."

TextEng: "Good day, m'Lord. Can I help you?"
Text: "좋은 하루, 영주님. 뭘 도와줄까?"

TextEng: Levio'Sa refuses to acknowledge your presence.
Text: 레비오사는 당신의 존재를 무시합니다.

TextEng: "I would like to trade."
Text: "거래하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "잘 가."

TextEng: "I can't afford that."
Text: "그 돈은 없어."

TextEng: "Why the 'Floating Huntress'?"
Text: "왜 '떠다니는 여사냥꾼'이야?"

TextEng: "Here's the gold."
Text: "여기 금이야."

TextEng: "What do I get out of it?"
Text: "가입하면 뭘 얻어?"

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "잘 가."

TextEng: "I would like to see your supplies."
Text: "물자를 보고 싶어."

TextEng: "I have some questions for you."
Text: "질문이 좀 있어."

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기하자."

TextEng: "I need information about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대한 정보가 필요해."

TextEng: "I have a wolf pelt."
Text: "늑대 가죽이 있어."

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기하자."

TextEng: "What do you know about the Masked Man's forces?"
Text: "가면 남자의 세력에 대해 뭘 알아?"

TextEng: "Where can I get a room?"
Text: "방은 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "Where can I get equipment?"
Text: "장비는 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "Where can I find employment?"
Text: "일자리는 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "I could what?"
Text: "뭘 할 수 있다고?"

TextEng: "Tell me about the foresters' guild."
Text: "산림 길드에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I don't care. Let's talk about something else."
Text: "상관없어. 다른 얘기하자."

TextEng: "I have a bearskin."
Text: "곰 가죽이 있어."

TextEng: "Understands what?"
Text: "뭘 이해한다고?"

TextEng: "I can't afford that."
Text: "그 돈은 없어."

TextEng: "Here's the gold."
Text: "여기 금이야."

TextEng: "What do I get out of it?"
Text: "가입하면 뭘 얻어?"

TextEng: "Will you vote for me then?"
Text: "그럼 나에게 투표해줄 거야?"

TextEng: "Why does it cost gold?"
Text: "왜 금이 들어?"

TextEng: "I have killed the manticore."
Text: "맨티코어를 죽였어."

TextEng: "What do you think about the election?"
Text: "선거에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "What would you like to know?"
Text: "뭘 알고 싶은데?"

TextEng: "How could we get to know each other better?"
Text: "어떻게 하면 서로 더 잘 알 수 있을까?"

TextEng: "What could I do to get your vote?"
Text: "네 표를 얻으려면 뭘 해야 해?"

TextEng: "I do not slaughter helpless animals, if that's what you're thinking!"
Text: "그런 생각이라면 무력한 동물을 학살하지 않아!"

TextEng: "You want me to go kill something for you?"
Text: "날 보고 뭘 죽이라고?"

TextEng: "You have something in mind?"
Text: "뭔가 생각한 게 있어?"

TextEng: "Why do I need the trap?"
Text: "왜 함정이 필요해?"

TextEng: "Can't I just kill it?"
Text: "그냥 죽이면 안 돼?"

TextEng: "You want me to use some old trap?"
Text: "옛 함정을 사용하라고?"

TextEng: "How does the trap work?"
Text: "함정이 어떻게 작동해?"

TextEng: "I won't do that."
Text: "안 할 거야."

TextEng: "I can't do that. Is there another way to get your vote?"
Text: "못하겠어. 네 표를 얻을 다른 방법이 있어?"

TextEng: "I'll do it."
Text: "하겠어."

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "넌 누구야?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기하자."

TextEng: "Why are you the guildmaster if you don't like it?"
Text: "싫으면서 왜 길드장을 해?"

TextEng: "You aren't well liked by the Hand?"
Text: "보좌관에게 미움을 받아?"

TextEng: "That's my kind of fun!"
Text: "내 취향이야!"

TextEng: "Sounds like your type seek out trouble."
Text: "너희 같은 부류는 문제를 찾아다니는 것 같군."

TextEng: "I want to join your guild."
Text: "길드에 가입하고 싶어."

TextEng: "No, I meant that your actions cause harm."
Text: "아니, 너희 행동이 해를 끼친다는 뜻이야."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "I meant that in a good way."
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "좋은 뜻으로 한 말이야."

TextEng: "I didn't mean any harm."
Text: "해를 끼칠 뜻은 없었어."

TextEng: "I can see why there are problems."
Text: "왜 문제가 있는지 알겠어."

TextEng: "Dross?"
Text: "못쓸이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I heard tell that Garrot has some kind of dark secret in his past, but nobody knows what it is."
"There's some kind of election going on, isn't there? Or is it already over?"
"It hardly seems like there's a war on when you're in a nice place like this."
"I could live here, if I could just afford it."
"This is such a nice inn."
"I sure like staying here."
"It puts the ale in its mouth and leaves the guard alone."
"It stays out of our face or it gets hurt."
"It buys a drink then goes away."
"It leaves us alone now."
"It walks away, or it gets the whip."
"It talks to the boss, not to the guards."
"My <Lord/Lady> of the Keep, I am your humble servant. The military guild will do its best to support you."
"I am sorry, but I am too busy getting our defenses ready and preparing for Enivid's election."
"I just want to get back to my family and spirit them away to safety."
"I don't care how good you are; you don't stand a chance."
"It would take a miracle to save us now!"
"The hobgoblin was huge! It drove the other monsters on like they were mere cattle!"
"We cannot hold against another attack! If Dylan would just get away from the door we could flee and save ourselves!"
"How did you destroy that horrid hobgoblin? I thought you were dead. I guess you really are a hero."
"Oh, hello there. If it isn't the nice, young hero. I sure wish I could vote in the election for you. Alas, it is not to be. So would you like to share a bit of gossip with a poor old woman?"
Text: "아이고, 이게 누구야. 착한 젊은 영웅이잖아. 선거에서 너에게 투표할 수 있으면 좋겠는데. 아쉽게도 안 되네. 그래서 불쌍한 노파와 수다 좀 떨래?"

TextEng: "Now, you come back and visit with your Momma Dane often."
Text: "자, 마마 데인한테 자주 놀러 와야 해."

TextEng: "Oh my, what a frightening, young creature; and yet he's kind of cute, in a pestilence-spreading, bottom feeder sort of way."
Text: "어머나, 무시무시한 젊은 친구네. 그래도 역병을 퍼뜨리는 밑바닥 생물치고는 좀 귀엽기도 하네."

TextEng: "Trip likes her, <FirstName>. Can we keep her, please? Trip promises to feed her and take care of her and play with her everyday."
Text: "트립이 이 할머니 좋아요, <FirstName>. 데리고 있어도 돼요, 네? 트립이 매일 밥 주고 돌보고 놀아줄게요."

TextEng: "Sorry, <FirstName>, Trip just got caught up in the excitement of this conversation."
Text: "미안해요, <FirstName>, 트립이 대화에 너무 들떠버렸어요."

TextEng: "Oh, my poor old bones couldn't handle too much work. I had a little bit of gold from my dead husband, so I moved here to retire."
Text: "이 늙은 뼈는 힘든 일을 감당할 수가 없어. 돌아가신 남편이 남긴 금이 좀 있어서, 여기로 은퇴하러 왔지."

TextEng: "It is a bit of a story, explaining why I moved here. But, probably you're not interested in a poor old woman's ramblings."
Text: "왜 여기로 이사 왔는지 설명하자면 좀 긴 이야기야. 하지만, 불쌍한 늙은 여자의 잡담에는 관심 없겠지."

TextEng: "Well, of course not. You have far more important things to worry about than me. You must have more important questions to ask me."
Text: "그렇지, 그렇고말고. 나보다 훨씬 중요한 일이 있잖아. 더 중요한 질문이 있을 거야."

TextEng: "If you are sure you're really interested. My husband was a demon hunter, which meant he lived on the road, traveling the world and looking for his prey."
Text: "정말 관심이 있다면. 남편은 악마사냥꾼이었어. 그래서 세계를 떠돌며 사냥감을 찾으며 살았지."

TextEng: "Temples would hire him, as would local governments who were being plagued by the demons. There always seemed to be plenty of the monsters for him to deal with."
Text: "사원에서 고용하기도 했고, 악마에 시달리는 지방 정부에서도 그랬어. 그가 처리할 괴물은 항상 넘쳐났지."

TextEng: "I often felt like a widow, with him being gone all the time. Then one day, one of the creatures managed to kill him and suddenly I really was a widow."
Text: "그이가 항상 떠나 있으니 과부 같은 기분이었어. 그러다 어느 날, 그 괴물 중 하나가 그를 죽이고 나는 정말로 과부가 되었지."

TextEng: "My husband refused to take me with him when he traveled because of the danger. I am sure that if I had been with him, I could have done nothing to save his life."
Text: "남편은 위험하다고 여행에 데려가지 않았어. 함께 있었다면, 목숨을 구할 수 있었을지도... 아무것도 못 했겠지만."

TextEng: "What kind of questions would you like to ask Momma Dane?"
Text: "마마 데인에게 무슨 질문을 하고 싶어?"

TextEng: "That still doesn't stop me from blaming myself. I picture him in my mind; the look of terror in his eyes, the scream that must have started to come from his lips as the demon tore his head from his neck."
Text: "그래도 자책을 멈출 수가 없어. 마음속에 그 모습이 떠올라. 눈에 비친 공포, 악마가 머리를 찢어낼 때 입에서 시작된 비명..."

TextEng: "I always told him that he would come to a bad end, if he didn't change his ways."
Text: "항상 말했어, 습관을 고치지 않으면 나쁜 끝을 맞을 거라고."

TextEng: "Yes, his life was given up in the service of a greater good."
Text: "그래, 더 큰 선을 위해 목숨을 바친 거야."

TextEng: "That is how they found his body... headless. It must have been a horrible way to go."
Text: "시체가 발견되었을 때... 머리가 없었어. 끔찍한 죽음이었을 거야."

TextEng: "But that is in the past, and I must try not to dwell on it. I was tired of living in comfort and wealth, yet constant loneliness, so I sold everything and traveled the world."
Text: "하지만 그건 과거의 일이고, 곱씹지 않으려 해야지. 편안하고 부유하지만 끊임없이 외로운 삶에 지쳐서, 모든 걸 팔고 세계를 여행했어."

TextEng: "Finally, I came to this keep. I loved the vibrancy of life here. There is always an element of danger, yet, because I do not fear death, I can live here and love life."
Text: "마침내 이 거점에 왔어. 이곳의 활기찬 삶이 좋았어. 항상 위험의 요소가 있지만, 죽음을 두려워하지 않으니 여기서 살며 삶을 사랑할 수 있지."

TextEng: "Enough wasting your precious time. You must have more important things to do than hear me go on. Thank you for listening to me though. It is nice to bend an ear once in a while with personal stories."
Text: "소중한 시간 허비하는 것은 그만하자. 내 잡담 듣는 것보다 더 중요한 일이 있을 텐데. 들어줘서 고마워. 가끔 개인적인 이야기로 귀를 빌리는 것도 좋은 거야."

TextEng: "He was one of the most powerful men in the south, though he sought no fame. Despite my affluent lifestyle, it was a lonely existence."
Text: "남편은 남부에서 가장 강력한 사람 중 하나였지만, 명성은 구하지 않았어. 부유한 생활이었지만, 외로운 삶이었어."

TextEng: "Oh yes, he left me a fair bit of gold. I lived very well, but it was a lonely existence."
Text: "아, 그럼, 꽤 많은 금을 남겼어. 잘 살았지만, 외로운 삶이었어."

TextEng: "This seems like an unusual spot to retire. Would it not have been better to live in the civilized lands of the south?"
Text: "은퇴하기에 좀 특이한 곳이네. 남쪽의 문명화된 땅에서 사는 게 낫지 않았을까?"

TextEng: "Was there any other gossip Momma Dane can share with such a sweet <boy/girl> as you?"
Text: "너처럼 착한 아이와 나눌 수다가 또 있을까?"

TextEng: "There are nine guilds, each headed by a man or woman who has somehow convinced the other members of their guild that they can represent their needs."
Text: "아홉 개의 길드가 있고, 각각 어떻게든 다른 길드원들에게 대표할 수 있다고 설득한 사람이 이끌고 있어."

TextEng: "It would be easiest to break them into groups of how each guild master would vote, if you were not in the election."
Text: "네가 선거에 출마하지 않았을 때 각 길드장이 어떻게 투표할지로 나누는 게 가장 쉬울 거야."

TextEng: "Enivid has her staunch supporters, Sir Becket has his and there are three who are relatively neutral."
Text: "에니비드에게는 확고한 지지자가 있고, 베켓 경에게도 있고, 비교적 중립적인 사람이 셋 있어."

TextEng: "Yenna is the mage guild master, Serah is the landowners guild master, and Levio뭆a is the foresters guild master."
Text: "예나가 마법사 길드장, 세라가 지주 길드장, 레비오사가 산림 길드장이야."

TextEng: "Serah is a very earthy woman, and she is Alias's aunt. She has lands just outside of town and has been asking for help from the military guild for almost a year now."
Text: "세라는 아주 소박한 여자야, 앨리어스의 이모이기도 하고. 마을 바로 밖에 땅이 있어서 거의 1년 동안 군사 길드에 도움을 요청하고 있어."

TextEng: "I am sure Alias could come up with some way for you to earn her vote. Treat Alias right, <FirstName>. She is young, but wise beyond her years."
Text: "앨리어스가 분명 네 표를 얻을 방법을 찾아줄 거야. 앨리어스를 잘 대해줘, <FirstName>. 어리지만 나이에 비해 현명해."

TextEng: "The Floating Huntress is the guildmaster of the Foresters. She was a ranger at one time, but now she has settled here at the keep and buys hides from the hunters and sells them supplies."
Text: "떠다니는 여사냥꾼이 산림 길드장이야. 한때 레인저였지만, 이제 거점에 정착해서 사냥꾼에게 가죽을 사고 물자를 팔고 있어."

TextEng: "Enivid made the mistake of insulting her and her fellow hunters, so you probably have a good chance of earning her trust. Anything else?"
Text: "에니비드가 그녀와 동료 사냥꾼들을 모욕하는 실수를 했으니, 아마 그녀의 신뢰를 얻을 좋은 기회가 있을 거야. 다른 건?"

TextEng: "Yenna is the only powerful mage in town. She is also the only guildmaster with no other members of her guild."
Text: "예나는 마을의 유일한 강력한 마법사야. 또한 길드원이 아무도 없는 유일한 길드장이기도 하고."

TextEng: "With her powers, no one really questions her, and she doesn't spend a lot of time with anyone unless she needs something for her research. I know little about her.  Anyone else?"
Text: "그녀의 힘 때문에 아무도 진짜로 따지지 않고, 연구에 필요한 게 없으면 누구와도 잘 어울리지 않아. 잘 몰라. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "I would love to chat with you about this home of ours. What questions do you have?"
Text: "우리 고향에 대해 이것저것 물어봐. 무슨 질문이 있어?"

TextEng: "Thaddeus is the merchant guild master, Southpaw is the thieves guild master, and Ellysia is the nobles guild master."
Text: "태데우스가 상인 길드장, 사우스포가 도적 길드장, 엘리시아가 귀족 길드장이야."

TextEng: "She is the most popular noble. Rich, beautiful and so beyond the realities of this world she can't be bothered to see the problems we face."
Text: "가장 인기 있는 귀족이야. 부유하고, 아름답고, 현실과 너무 동떨어져서 우리가 직면한 문제를 볼 필요도 못 느끼지."

TextEng: "She is Sir Becket's acknowledged lover, so I see little chance of you changing her vote. Anyone else?"
Text: "베켓 경의 공인된 연인이니, 투표를 바꿀 가능성은 거의 없어. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "Although Southpaw is the guildmaster of the thieves, he is actually very well liked. I often enjoy his company during the day. He has an unusual sense of humor.
Text: "사우스포가 도적의 길드장이지만, 사실 인기가 많아. 낮에 같이 시간 보내는 걸 즐기곤 해. 유머 감각이 독특하거든."

TextEng: "I must confess; part of why I enjoy his company so much is that he flatters me relentlessly. Anyone else?"
Text: "고백하자면, 그와 함께하는 게 즐거운 이유 중 하나는 끊임없이 아첨해주기 때문이야. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "Thaddeus Squilt is the merchant guildmaster and a despicable person. He uses people, then destroys them."
Text: "태데우스 스퀼트는 상인 길드장이고 비열한 인간이야. 사람을 이용하고 나서 파멸시키지."

TextEng: "I wish Gelani was still guildmaster, but she lost the position to Thaddeus. He knew who to bribe and how to get more gold for the guild."
Text: "젤라니가 아직 길드장이면 좋겠지만, 태데우스에게 자리를 빼앗겼어. 누구에게 뇌물을 주고 길드에 더 많은 금을 가져오는 법을 알았거든."

TextEng: "If you're not afraid to get your hands a little dirty, you might be able to corrupt him, but don't trust him. Anyone else?"
Text: "손을 좀 더럽힐 각오가 있다면, 그를 매수할 수 있을지도 모르지만, 절대 믿지 마. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "Oh, I forgot, Thaddeus is no longer the guildmaster. Gelani usurped his position and is voting for you now."
Text: "아, 잊었는데, 태데우스는 더 이상 길드장이 아니야. 젤라니가 자리를 빼앗고 이제 너에게 투표하고 있어."

TextEng: "Dynschall is the priests guild master, Feran is the military guild master, and The Stan is the trades guild master."
Text: "던살이 사제 길드장, 페란이 군사 길드장, 더 스탠이 직업 길드장이야."

TextEng: "Oh, those horrid monsters! How dare they attack a nice keep like this? But I'm not worried. I'm sure you will take good care of us and slaughter those beasts in no time."
Text: "아이고, 그 끔찍한 괴물들! 감히 이런 좋은 거점을 공격하다니? 하지만 걱정 안 해. 네가 우리를 잘 지켜주고 그 짐승들을 순식간에 물리칠 거야."

TextEng: "Feran is an elf with a strict code of honor and I cannot think of a single way you could get him to vote for you. He owes everything to Enivid."
Text: "페란은 엄격한 명예 규범을 가진 엘프야. 네가 투표를 얻을 방법이 하나도 생각나지 않아. 그는 에니비드에게 모든 것을 빚지고 있거든."

TextEng: "You can usually find him in his office in the castle, though at night he does occasionally spend the evening at the Mossy Tree; a tavern and inn in here in the south keep. Anyone else?"
Text: "보통 성 안 사무실에서 찾을 수 있지만, 밤에는 가끔 이끼 나무에서 저녁을 보내기도 해. 남쪽 거점에 있는 주막이야. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: Momma Dane grins and chuckles softly. "The Stan is... unusual. He runs the trades office and if you are looking to make a little gold, he's the man to see."
Text: 마마 데인이 씩 웃으며 조용히 낄낄거립니다. "더 스탠은... 독특해. 직업 사무소를 운영하고 있으니 약간의 금을 벌고 싶으면, 그 사람을 찾아가."

TextEng: "He believes in strong government and stability. If you do a job for him, do it right. Anybody else?"
Text: "강한 정부와 안정을 믿어. 그에게 일을 맡으면, 제대로 해. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "He is the head priest at the Temple of the Nine Gods. He nags me about not spending enough time communing with the gods, but I prefer people to gods."
Text: "아홉 신의 신전의 수석 사제야. 신들과 충분히 교감하지 않는다고 잔소리를 하지만, 나는 신보다 사람이 좋아."

TextEng: "Just show him proper respect. He very much believes that the church must support the community. He also listens to his followers, so talk to them as well. Anyone else?"
Text: "적절한 존경을 보여주면 돼. 교회가 공동체를 지원해야 한다고 굳게 믿고 있어. 추종자들의 말도 듣고 있으니, 그들과도 이야기해. 다른 사람은?"

TextEng: "The nine guildmasters will meet in the castle, where they will each cast a stone; a different color for each of the contestants. The person with the most votes wins."
Text: "아홉 명의 길드장이 성에 모여서, 각자 돌을 던져. 후보마다 다른 색이야. 가장 많은 표를 받은 사람이 이기지."

TextEng: "You need at least four votes, with no other opponent getting more than three. That's about it. Not too difficult to understand, even for someone with an old mind like me.
Text: "최소 네 표가 필요하고, 다른 후보가 세 표 이상 받으면 안 돼. 그게 다야. 나처럼 늙은 머리로도 이해할 수 있는 거지."

TextEng: "I know the one thing you are probably most interested in... the election. I keep my ears open and I can tell you how you stand with the guilds, or just tell you how things look, overall."
Text: "네가 가장 관심 있을 것을 알고 있어... 선거야. 귀를 열어두고 있으니 길드들과의 관계가 어떤지, 전체적으로 어떤 상황인지 알려줄 수 있어."

TextEng: "I guess that is up to you. If I wanted to be the Lady of the Keep, I should care very much, but you will do things as you see fit. I just wanted to share the gossip."
Text: "그건 네 마음이지. 내가 거점의 여영주가 되고 싶다면 아주 신경 쓰겠지만, 너는 알아서 하겠지. 그냥 수다를 나누고 싶었을 뿐이야."

TextEng: "You should really speak to Serah Blackhand. I'll bet she could find you a lovely home to purchase. She's such a dear."
Text: "세라 블랙핸드에게 가보렴. 분명 좋은 집을 구해줄 거야. 정말 착한 아이야."

TextEng: "Right now, Enivid has <CUSTOM6001> votes; Sir Becket has <CUSTOM6002>; and you have <CUSTOM6003> votes."
Text: "현재, 에니비드가 <CUSTOM6001>표, 베켓 경이 <CUSTOM6002>표, 그리고 네가 <CUSTOM6003>표야."

TextEng: "Are you sure you don't want to know who is voting for whom?"
Text: "누가 누구에게 투표하는지 알고 싶지 않아?"

TextEng: "There are guild masters who are staunch supporters of Enivid, strong supporters of Sir Becket and some who tend to remain more neutral. Which group do you want specifics on?"
Text: "에니비드의 확고한 지지자, 베켓 경의 강력한 지지자, 그리고 비교적 중립적인 길드장들이 있어. 어느 쪽에 대해 자세히 알고 싶어?"

TextEng: "What else would you like?"
Text: "다른 건 뭐 알고 싶어?"

TextEng: "These ones pick sides, but they aren't particularly attached to one side or the other. They include the landowners guild, the mage guild and the foresters guild."
Text: "이쪽은 편을 들지만 특별히 집착하지는 않아. 지주 길드, 마법사 길드, 산림 길드가 여기에 해당해."

TextEng: "Levio'Sa appears to have settled on voting for you, congratulations."
Text: "레비오사는 너에게 투표하기로 한 것 같아, 축하해."

TextEng: "Levio'Sa doesn't like either choice, but unless you prove yourself, she will end up siding with Sir Becket, just to spite Enivid."
Text: "레비오사는 어느 쪽도 마음에 안 들지만, 네가 실력을 증명하지 못하면 결국 에니비드를 괴롭히려고 베켓 경 편에 설 거야."

TextEng: "Yenna might be on your side, though I cannot be sure. We don't talk very much, since she spends most of her time in her tower."
Text: "예나는 네 편일 수도 있지만, 확신은 못해. 탑에서 대부분의 시간을 보내니 우리가 많이 이야기하지 않거든."

TextEng: "Yenna is a difficult one to read. I don't think it would take much to get her on your side, but if you don't try she'll probably end up voting for Enivid."
Text: "예나는 파악하기 어려워. 네 편으로 끌어오는 데 많은 건 안 필요할 것 같지만, 시도하지 않으면 아마 에니비드에게 투표할 거야."

TextEng: "Serah seems to have taken a liking to you. She supports you fully."
Text: "세라가 너에게 호감을 가진 것 같아. 전적으로 지지하고 있어."

TextEng: "I personally would recommend Southpaw. He's a flatterer, but such a nice boy."
Text: "사우스포를 추천할게. 아첨꾼이지만, 참 착한 아이야."

TextEng: "Serah will probably side with Enivid, unless you can prove yourself to her."
Text: "세라는 네가 실력을 증명하지 못하면 아마 에니비드 편에 설 거야."

TextEng: "Those are the thieves guild, the merchant guild, and the nobles guild."
Text: "도적 길드, 상인 길드, 귀족 길드야."

TextEng: "I don't know how you did it, but Ellysia will be voting for you now."
Text: "어떻게 했는지 모르겠지만, 엘리시아가 이제 너에게 투표할 거야."

TextEng: "Ellysia stands solidly with her lover, Sir Becket. Good luck changing her mind."
Text: "엘리시아는 연인 베켓 경을 확고히 지지하고 있어. 마음을 바꿀 행운을 빌어."

TextEng: "The merchants will now be voting for you, I am pleased to say."
Text: "상인들이 이제 너에게 투표한다니 기쁘네."

TextEng: "The merchants are firmly behind Sir Becket."
Text: "상인들은 확실히 베켓 경 뒤에 있어."

TextEng: "Southpaw, the dear, is voting for you now. I am glad someone was able to steal him away from ugly Sir Becket."
Text: "사우스포가, 그 착한 아이가, 이제 너에게 투표하고 있어. 못생긴 베켓 경에게서 빼앗은 사람이 있어 기쁘네."

TextEng: "Southpaw is voting for Sir Becket."
Text: "사우스포는 베켓 경에게 투표하고 있어."

TextEng: "Those are the priests guild, the military guild and the trades guild."
Text: "사제 길드, 군사 길드, 직업 길드야."

TextEng: "You must have impressed The Stan, because he has changed his vote to support you now."
Text: "더 스탠에게 깊은 인상을 준 게 분명해, 이제 너를 지지하기로 투표를 바꿨거든."

TextEng: "I would go speak to The Stan, such a nice young half-orc. He has jobs for everyone. Well, except little old ladies with no skills of their own."
Text: "더 스탠에게 가보렴, 참 착한 반오크 청년이야. 모두에게 일거리가 있어. 뭐, 아무 기술도 없는 늙은 할머니 빼고는."

TextEng: "The Stan and his tradesmen still support Enivid."
Text: "더 스탠과 직인들은 아직 에니비드를 지지하고 있어."

TextEng: "It is a very surprising turnabout, but now the military guild is voting for you. I am deeply impressed that you managed that."
Text: "아주 놀라운 반전인데, 군사 길드가 이제 너에게 투표하고 있어. 그걸 해낸 게 정말 인상적이야."

TextEng: "The military guild is still very much aligned with Enivid."
Text: "군사 길드는 아직 확실히 에니비드 편이야."

TextEng: "Somehow you managed to sway Dynschall's opinion. The priest guild will vote for you."
Text: "어떻게든 던살의 마음을 바꿨구나. 사제 길드가 너에게 투표할 거야."

TextEng: "The priests guild still supports Enivid."
Text: "사제 길드는 아직 에니비드를 지지하고 있어."

TextEng: "Why, I am only Momma Dane. I just enjoy visiting with nice folk here in the keep. It really is a wonderful place, don't you think. It would be such a nice place to raise a family."
Text: "뭐, 그냥 마마 데인이야. 거점에서 착한 사람들과 어울리는 게 즐거울 뿐이야. 정말 멋진 곳이지, 그렇지 않아? 가족을 기르기에 참 좋은 곳일 텐데."

TextEng: "But I am an old woman, far beyond my child rearing years. That's why I enjoy the young ones here so much. They almost make me forget the inevitable march of time."
Text: "하지만 나는 아이를 낳을 나이는 한참 지난 늙은 여자야. 그래서 여기 젊은이들이 그렇게 좋은 거야. 시간의 행진을 거의 잊게 해주거든."

TextEng: "Now, no more melancholy thoughts. Let us find a more interesting subject to converse on. We should enjoy a little gossip, perhaps."
Text: "자, 우울한 생각은 그만. 더 재미있는 화제를 찾아보자. 수다 좀 떨어볼까."

TextEng: "What hope is there for a family to live in a place so close to the wilds? There is nothing but heartache and pain in such a place."
Text: "황야에 이렇게 가까운 곳에서 가족이 살 희망이 뭐가 있겠어? 이런 곳에는 심통과 고통밖에 없어."

TextEng: "It is the pain that makes us feel life with more vibrancy. Life can be harsh, it is true, but with time, the pain fades and others can come into our lives to make us feel whole again."
Text: "고통이 삶을 더 선명하게 느끼게 해주는 거야. 삶이 가혹한 건 사실이지만, 시간이 지나면 고통은 사라지고 다른 사람들이 우리 삶에 들어와 온전함을 느끼게 해주지."

TextEng: "Yeah, see? My friend has questions about the keep, so you better be answering them quick, see?"
Text: "그래, 알겠지? 내 친구가 거점에 대해 질문이 있으니까, 얼른 대답해, 알겠지?"

TextEng: "Your words shame me. My mind needs to overcome the past, but I am not there yet."
Text: "부끄럽게 하는 말이네. 마음으로는 과거를 극복해야 한다는 걸 알지만, 아직 거기까지 이르지 못했어."

TextEng: "I would sooner raise a family outside the keep, where nature thrives. Though I fear I shall never have that opportunity."
Text: "자연이 번성하는 거점 밖에서 가족을 기르고 싶어. 그런 기회는 절대 없겠지만."

TextEng: "You are yet young, and no one knows what the future may hold for them. You still contain beauty, should you choose to look for it."
Text: "아직 젊잖아, 미래에 뭐가 기다리는지 아무도 몰라. 아름다움은 아직 있어, 찾으려 하기만 하면."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "잘 가."

TextEng: "Shut up, Trip!"
Text: "입 다물어, 트립!"

TextEng: "I'm sure she will answer my questions with out a threat, Trip."
Text: "협박 안 해도 내 질문에 대답할 거야, 트립."

TextEng: "What is wrong with you, Trip?"
Text: "너 뭐가 문제야, 트립?"

TextEng: "You had better do as he says. He sometimes loses control of himself."
Text: "그가 시키는 대로 하는 게 좋을 거야. 가끔 자제력을 잃거든."

TextEng: "I can't take you anywhere, Trip!"
Text: "너를 어디 데려갈 수가 없어, 트립!"

TextEng: "Let it go, Trip."
Text: "그만해, 트립."

TextEng: "Just shut up, Trip!"
Text: "입 좀 다물어, 트립!"

TextEng: "What do you do here in the keep?"
Text: "여기서 뭘 하고 있어?"

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "You're right. I don't really care."
Text: "맞아. 별로 관심 없어."

TextEng: "I can listen for a while."
Text: "잠깐 들어줄게."

TextEng: "Please tell me."
Text: "말해줘."

TextEng: "How did the demon kill him?"
Text: "악마가 어떻게 그를 죽였어?"

TextEng: "That's what you get for dealing with demons."
Text: "악마를 상대하면 그렇게 되는 거야."

TextEng: "That is all my questions."
Text: "질문은 그게 다야."

TextEng: "Sounds like a bad end to a noble life."
Text: "고귀한 삶의 안타까운 끝이네."

TextEng: "That is... very graphic."
Text: "그건... 꽤 생생하네."

TextEng: "I like living on the edge of danger too."
Text: "나도 위험한 곳에서 사는 게 좋아."

TextEng: "I'd prefer somewhere safer."
Text: "더 안전한 곳이 좋겠어."

TextEng: "I like the way you look at the world."
Text: "세상을 보는 방식이 마음에 들어."

TextEng: "That is a healthy attitude."
Text: "건강한 태도야."

TextEng: "Your husband must have been pretty powerful."
Text: "남편은 꽤 강력했나 봐."

TextEng: "I have questions about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대해 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "Did he make a good living?"
Text: "수입이 좋았어?"

TextEng: "What can you tell me about the guildmasters?"
Text: "길드장들에 대해 뭘 알려줄 수 있어?"

TextEng: "I changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "Tell me more."
Text: "더 알려줘."

TextEng: "Who are the neutral guild masters?"
Text: "중립 길드장은 누구야?"

TextEng: "Tell me about Serah."
Text: "세라에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "That's all my questions about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대한 질문은 그게 다야."

TextEng: "Tell me about Levio'Sa."
Text: "레비오사에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about Yenna."
Text: "예나에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Who are Sir Becket's supporters?"
Text: "베켓 경의 지지자는 누구야?"

TextEng: "Tell me about Ellysia."
Text: "엘리시아에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about Southpaw."
Text: "사우스포에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "What do you know about the invaders?"
Text: "침략자에 대해 뭘 알아?"

TextEng: "Tell me about Thaddeus."
Text: "태데우스에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Who are Enivid's supporters?"
Text: "에니비드의 지지자는 누구야?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about someone else."
Text: "다른 사람에 대해 이야기하자."

TextEng: "Tell me about Feran."
Text: "페란에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about The Stan."
Text: "더 스탠에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Tell me about Dynschall."
Text: "던살에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "Where can I get a room?"
Text: "방은 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "Explain the election process to me."
Text: "선거 과정을 설명해줘."

TextEng: "What kind of gossip?"
Text: "무슨 수다?"

TextEng: "I don't care right now."
Text: "지금은 관심 없어."

TextEng: "I just want to know where I stand in the election."
Text: "선거에서 내 위치만 알고 싶어."

TextEng: "Give me a specific breakdown of how the guilds are voting."
Text: "길드별 투표 현황을 구체적으로 알려줘."

TextEng: "I have other questions."
Text: "다른 질문이 있어."

TextEng: "The neutral guilds."
Text: "중립 길드."

TextEng: "Where can I get equipment?"
Text: "장비는 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "Foresters guild."
Text: "산림 길드."

TextEng: "Mage guild."
Text: "마법사 길드."

TextEng: "Landowners guild."
Text: "지주 길드."

TextEng: "Sir Becket's guilds."
Text: "베켓 경 지지 길드."

TextEng: "Nobles guild."
Text: "귀족 길드."

TextEng: "Merchant guild."
Text: "상인 길드."

TextEng: "Thieves guild."
Text: "도적 길드."

TextEng: "Enivid's guilds."
Text: "에니비드 지지 길드."

TextEng: "Thank you. Goodbye."
Text: "고마워. 잘 가."

TextEng: "Let's talk about another guild."
Text: "다른 길드에 대해 이야기하자."

TextEng: "Where can I find employment?"
Text: "일자리는 어디서 구해?"

TextEng: "Trades Guild."
Text: "직업 길드."

TextEng: "Military guild."
Text: "군사 길드."

TextEng: "Priests guild."
Text: "사제 길드."

TextEng: "Who are you exactly?"
Text: "정확히 누구야?"

TextEng: "Ah, I see you're back again... no wait, that's your front, ha, ha, ha! Sorry, old jokes die hard. So what can I do for you?"
"I know that it should actually be more than this, but you have done well by us here in the keep. I'm only charging you an extra ten gold."
"Good <quarterday> to you, good <master/mistress>. I am Mr. Mossy and I am very pleased to meet you. How may I be of assistance?"
"You be taking care of yourself now. Evil days are afoot, don't you know."
"It is a lucky thing that I am just full of answers too. Or full of something, according to Gelani. What would you like to know?"
"Is there anything else you be needing, <master/mistress>?"
"I know precious little about politics, I fear. You would be better served speaking to Gelani, since she was once the guildmaster of the merchants guild."
"I know precious little about politics. Go speak to Gelani in the guild office, I am sure she'll be voting for you."
"I know precious little about politics, and since Gelani was murdered, I care even less."
"Let's talk about some more pleasing subject, shall we?"
"I love most of the people of the keep as my own children, though there are a few exceptions. What do you want to know?"
"And what other quandaries might be stuck in your mind that I could help you with?"
"No problem. Come back any time and pay me. I'll keep your bill on hand."
"Big... ugly... nasty... that's about all I know. Sorry."
"Right here, of course. The Mossy Tree be the finest inn in the keep."
"Yenna carries magical equipment in her tower. I always was fascinated with her magic, there being so few mages who ever visit the keep."
"I know that Serah at the landowners guild has had some problems, you might be wanting to speak to her."
"Gelani and I get along fine, all rumors to the contrary. She be a fine woman and she was a good guildmaster too, until that god forsaken Thaddeus ruined her name."
"I would love to talk about anything you have a mind for."
"Gelani was once the guildmaster of the merchants guild, until the black-hearted Thaddeus decided he wanted the job. He started rumors about Gelani, backed by his twisted friend, Sir Becket."
"Even though the rumors weren't true, enough people believed them to oust her from her position."
"When everyone turned on her, Gelani just sort of gave up hope. Ah, it was a sad day. I wish someone would help her out, but she says it be none of my business. Any other questions?"
"T'is a terrible thing he did and I sure wish someone would help her get her life back in order. But she tells me it is none of my business, so we should talk about something else."
"Well, I do have staff to pay, otherwise I'd agree. Ten gold is not so much, in the scheme of things."
"You helped the dear soul get her life back in order and I cannot thank you enough for it."
"They found the poor dear's body in a dark alley... I... I will sorely miss her. She was a good friend and a good partner."
"Nay, must have been some thief in the night, for she had no possessions on her when they found the body."
"Then you have come to the right place, and I don't mind saying that you have excellent taste, good <master/mistress>."
"Now some folk like to spend their hard earned wages staying at the Silver Lily, and I'm not one to say anything bad about Mr. Garrot..."
"Oh, now look at me rambling on now. Gelani would have had my tongue in the old days. Now let me think... ah yes, a room. We do happen to have one available. The cost is 15 gold for a week."
"Good enough. I will have someone around to unlock the door. Just come see me when you are ready to leave so we can settle up the bill."
"Ah, there be one thing Mr. Mossy never jests about with a customer and that be gold. With the monsters invading the lands, the inn is brimming almost full with refugees and the like."
"Ah, so you be the one. I'll tell you what, give me ten gold now and I'll charge ten for every week after that to an account. You can settle up when you are ready to move on, agreed?"
"Very well then. Was there anything else I could be doing for you?"
"You be welcome here at the Mossy Tree, any time you be wanting to visit."
"Well, you can rest here in the common room for now, if you have to. Can't promise you won't get pick pocketed though... or landed on in a bar brawl. We've had a more unsavory crowd lately."
"I'll be having the door unlocked for you then. Just keep using it and come back to see me when you are ready to leave."
"Be there anything else I can do for you?"
"But you already have a room, good <master/mistress>. If you really want to pay for it again, you are more than welcome to, but why waste your gold?"
"Thank you very much, <master/mistress>. I am pleased that you chose to stay with us here at the Mossy Tree."
"My <lord/lady>, there can be no charge for you. It was a privilege and an honor to have you stay here."
"And do you think your gold is any good here now? I think not. The good deed you did for Gelani must be rewarded."
"The room is free and I will keep it open for you special, in case you change your mind and want to come and visit again."
"It was the least I could do. Thank you so much for being a guest here at the Mossy Tree."
"I am here to settle my account."
"I can't pay it."
"I have some questions for you."
"That's all my questions."
"What do you know about the election?"
"I have questions about the keep."
"That's all my questions about the keep."
"What do you know about the Masked Man's forces?"
"Where can I get a room?"
"Where can I get equipment?"
"Where can I find employment?"
"Tell me about Gelani."
"Let's talk about something else."
"What do you mean?"
"I heard about that."
"Do they know who did it?"
"I need a room."
"If you really feel that way, shouldn't the room be free?"
"Never mind."
"Fine. I'll pay."
"What? You charge that much? You must be jesting!"
"Dylan said to tell you I should get the Hero's rate."
"No thanks."
"I don't have that much right now."
"Thank you."
"Sounds good."
"Here you go."
"Thank you."
"Goodbye."
"I wish I could vote for you. You seem like a nice enough person."
"I hope the militia can hold off all those monsters."
"I certainly wish I had more time to chat, but I have too many customers right now."
"Pardon me, but I really am busy."
"If you want a room, you'll have to speak to Mister Mossy."
"I love working here. Mister Mossy always treats us well. Food and gold is better wages than most places I've worked."
"Good evening, m'<lord/lady>. Congratulations on your elevation."
