Text: "아, 제가 잘못 판단했나 봐요. 미안해요. 문제없어요, 선거에서 도움이 될 거라 생각했을 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "If you change your mind, just come back and ask me about it again."
Text: "마음이 바뀌면, 돌아와서 다시 물어보세요."

TextEng: "Well, I'd like to just give it to you, but there are taxes owing on it. A lot of debt has been accumulated that needs to be paid off. If you need gold, you should speak to The Stan."
Text: "그냥 드리고 싶지만, 세금이 밀려 있어요. 많은 빚이 쌓여서 갚아야 해요."

TextEng: "He's right across the hall and he pays well. I doubt the house will sell too quickly, so come back and ask me about it later.
Text: "더 스탠이 복도 건너편에 있고, 보수도 좋아요. 집이 금방 팔리지는 않을 테니, 나중에 다시 와서 물어보세요."

TextEng: "It sure will be nice to get those debts paid off and be rid of the old place. Manybrick Manor was a beautiful home once. I hope you enjoy it... after the ghosts are cleaned out."
Text: "빚을 갚고 그 낡은 집을 처분하면 정말 좋겠어요. 매니브릭 저택은 한때 아름다운 집이었어요. 옛 영광을 되찾으시길 바라요."

TextEng: "I know that's a lot of gold. You should go and speak to The Stan. He is right across the hall, and he pays quite well. Good luck, <FirstName>."
Text: "많은 금인 건 알아요. 더 스탠에게 가보세요. 복도 건너편이고, 보수가 꽤 좋아요. 행운을 빌어요, <FirstName>."

TextEng: "Oh, it was a while back now. The woman who lived there went insane. She threw herself off a cliff, if I remember correctly."
Text: "좀 된 일이에요. 거기 살던 여자가 미쳐서 절벽에서 뛰어내렸어요, 제 기억으로는."

TextEng: "Her sister sold the house to pay off the woman's debts but the buyers died in a gruesome fashion not a fortnight later, drowned in saltwater on the upper floor. Some say it was from the madwoman's tears."
Text: "그 자매가 여자의 빚을 갚으려고 집을 팔았는데, 구매자가 2주도 안 돼서 끔찍하게 죽었어요. 욕조에서 익사한 채로 발견됐죠."

TextEng: "Welcome to the office of the Landowners' guild, good <sir/madam>. My name is Serah Blackhand. How may I help you today?"
Text: "지주 길드 사무소에 오신 것을 환영해요. 저는 세라 블랙핸드예요. 오늘 어떻게 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "I asked, but Lavos said that if Mistress Death chose to return a few souls to haunt some house, who was she to argue? Perhaps you can do a better job of convincing her than I was able to."
Text: "물어봤는데, 라보스가 죽음의 여주인이 몇몇 영혼을 돌려보내 집에 출몰하게 했다면, 자기가 뭐라 할 수 있겠냐고 했어요. 던살 사제에게 물어보는 게 나을 거예요."

TextEng: "Are you interested in buying the haunted house for 2000 gold?"
Text: "2000골드에 유령의 집에 관심 있으세요?"

TextEng: "Why yes I am! You must be <FirstName> then. I have heard some good things about you and am pleased to meet you."
Text: "네, 맞아요! 그러면 <FirstName>이시겠네요. 좋은 이야기를 많이 들었고, 만나서 반가워요."

TextEng: "Sweet Alias needs as many friends as she can get. She spends too much time wandering on her own. So what can I do for you today?"
Text: "귀여운 앨리어스는 친구가 많이 필요해요. 혼자 돌아다니는 시간이 너무 많아요. 그래서 오늘 뭘 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "I am always pleased to be able to help. What would you like to know?"
Text: "항상 기꺼이 도와드릴게요. 뭘 알고 싶으세요?"

TextEng: "Right. Is there anything else I can do for you?"
Text: "좋아요. 다른 건 도와드릴 게 있나요?"

TextEng: "Most of my interests lay outside of town, but I will do my best to help you."
Text: "제 관심사는 대부분 마을 밖에 있지만, 최선을 다해 도와드릴게요."

TextEng: "They're on my property and I want them off! That's what I know. If you want more details on them, I would suggest speaking to Feran in the Military Guild."
Text: "제 땅에 있으니까 쫓아내고 싶어요! 그게 제가 아는 거예요. 더 자세한 건 군사 길드의 페란에게 물어보세요."

TextEng: "The Mossy Tree and the Silver Lily are both decent establishments, if you want a short term place to stay. I am the person to speak to if you want to purchase a more permanent home."
Text: "이끼 나무와 은백합 둘 다 괜찮은 숙소예요, 단기로 머물고 싶다면요. 영구적인 집을 사고 싶으시면 저에게 말씀하세요."

TextEng: "Talk to Levio'Sa. She often has unusual goods from outside of town. Southpaw runs the Pawnshop, so you might look there as well. Look around, there are plenty of merchants."
Text: "레비오사에게 가보세요. 마을 밖에서 온 특이한 물건을 가끔 갖고 있어요. 사우스포가 전당포를 운영하니 거기도 볼 만해요. 둘러보면, 상인이 많아요."

TextEng: "Be wary, friend. These are hard times."
Text: "조심하세요, 친구. 힘든 시기예요."

TextEng: "The Stan runs the trades guild. You can find him in his shop, The Trades, or in the trades guild office, in the Guildhall."
Text: "더 스탠이 직업 길드를 운영해요. 그의 가게 '직업소'나, 길드 홀의 직업 길드 사무소에서 찾을 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Well, as master of the guild, my job is to try to protect the other landowners from rising taxes, to sell land or houses as necessary, and to keep accurate records of the commons."
Text: "길드장으로서 제 일은 다른 지주들을 세금 인상에서 보호하고, 필요하면 토지나 집을 팔고, 공유지의 정확한 기록을 유지하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Any open grounds within the keep are property of the keep. Families are contracted to care for the commons, raising grains and animals, in case the keep is ever besieged."
Text: "거점 내 공터는 거점의 재산이에요. 가족들이 계약을 맺고 공유지를 돌보며, 거점이 포위될 때를 대비해 곡식과 가축을 기르고 있어요."

TextEng: "Often the families work off debts by working the commons, which means the keep doesn't have to pay for the labor. It generally works out for the benefit of all, bringing in new landowners and increasing our tax base."
Text: "가족들이 빚을 갚기 위해 공유지에서 일하기도 하는데, 거점이 노동비를 내지 않아도 되죠. 일반적으로 모두에게 이익이고, 새 지주를 유치하고 세금 기반을 넓혀요."

TextEng: "Not very much. There was quite a bit of land available after the keep's army left us, but most of it sold to families from the south, expatriated slaves and criminals."
Text: "많이는 아니에요. 거점의 군대가 떠난 후 꽤 많은 토지가 나왔지만, 대부분 남쪽에서 온 가족들, 추방된 노예와 범죄자들에게 팔렸어요."

TextEng: "When you get this far north of civilization, you don't ask a lot of background information. That's why I represent these people. Many of them are very private."
Text: "이렇게 북쪽 벽지까지 오면, 배경을 많이 묻지 않아요. 그래서 제가 이 사람들을 대변하는 거예요. 많은 이가 매우 사적인 사람들이에요."

TextEng: "Those who are poor can pay off some of their land by working the commons. Right now we have plenty of workers, with the landowners staying in the keep until the Masked Man's forces are dealt with."
Text: "가난한 사람들은 공유지에서 일하며 토지 비용을 갚을 수 있어요. 지금은 일꾼이 충분해요, 가면 남자의 세력이 처리될 때까지 지주들이 거점에 머물고 있으니까요."

TextEng: "She is a sweet child, with a pleasant disposition that really rises above the tragedies she has had to face. Her mother died while she was just a babe."
Text: "다정한 아이예요. 겪어야 했던 비극 위로 올라서는 좋은 성격을 가졌어요. 어머니는 앨리어스가 갓난아기일 때 돌아가셨어요."

TextEng: "She was only about eleven when her father went off to war, and like all the other soldiers, he was never heard from again."
Text: "아버지가 전쟁에 나간 게 열한 살쯤이었고, 다른 모든 병사들처럼 다시는 소식이 없었어요."

TextEng: "I have tried my best to raise her right, but she is a loner. It is good that she has you to work with, because she usually works alone. I would suggest you talk to her if you want to know more. Anything else?"
Text: "최선을 다해 올바르게 키우려 했지만, 외톨이 기질이 있어요. 당신과 함께 일하게 되어 다행이에요, 보통 혼자 하거든요. 더 알고 싶으면 직접 물어보세요. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "Well, we don't have any farmland available at the moment. Too many violent monsters ruining the crops and eating the livestock. Most of the landowners have sought safety here in the keep."
Text: "지금은 농지가 없어요. 난폭한 괴물들이 농작물을 망치고 가축을 잡아먹고 있거든요. 내 토지도 꽤 큰 피해를 입었어요."

TextEng: "Right, down to business. Your interest in this is keen, I imagine."
Text: "좋아요, 본론으로 들어가죠. 이 문제에 관심이 크시겠죠."

TextEng: "Our guild usually meets and votes, then I take their decision to the guild vote. I do have enough influence to sway the guild vote, however."
Text: "우리 길드는 보통 모여서 투표한 다음, 제가 그 결정을 길드 투표에 가져가요. 하지만 길드 투표를 좌우할 영향력은 충분히 있어요."

TextEng: "Did Alias tell you anything about the troubles I have been having lately?"
Text: "앨리어스가 제가 최근 겪고 있는 문제에 대해 말한 적 있나요?"

TextEng: "Ha, isn't that the truth. The girl can talk, that's for sure. She is much like my sister... was. But that is a different topic.  Back to my present troubles."
Text: "하, 맞아요. 그 아이 말이 정말 많죠. 제 자매와 많이 닮았어요... 그랬었죠. 하지만 그건 다른 얘기고. 제 현재 문제로 돌아가죠."

TextEng: "Well, you might want to pay attention this time. If you help me with my problem, I can convince the other landowners that you are our best hope."
Text: "이번에는 집중하는 게 좋을 거예요. 제 문제를 도와주시면, 다른 지주들에게 당신이 최고의 희망이라고 설득할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "If you can rid me of the goblins, I will do all that I can for you."
Text: "고블린을 처리해 주시면, 당신을 위해 할 수 있는 모든 걸 하겠어요."

TextEng: "Since you have helped me out, I see no reason why I shouldn't help you out. Killing those goblins proves you have what it takes to help the landowners out in these troubled times."
Text: "도와주셨으니, 도와드리지 않을 이유가 없죠. 고블린을 처치한 것은 이 어려운 시기에 지주들을 도울 능력이 있다는 걸 증명하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Our vote is for you, may you have luck in the running. What else would you like."
Text: "우리 표는 당신에게로. 선거에서 행운을 빌어요. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "Yes, after the siege on the keep was broken, the remaining forces turned tail and ran, losing all their spine with the Masked Man's death."
Text: "네, 거점 포위가 풀린 후 남은 세력이 꼬리를 내리고 도주했어요. 가면 남자가 죽으면서 기세를 다 잃었죠."

TextEng: "We tracked a band of his goblins to a cave on my property and, just this morning, a number of my cattle have started to go missing."
Text: "고블린 무리를 제 땅의 동굴까지 추적했는데, 오늘 아침에 소 몇 마리가 사라지기 시작했어요."

TextEng: "We do have a grand old house for sale here in the keep, but it is quite expensive and... well, you would likely not be interested."
Text: "거점 안에 오래된 대저택이 매물로 나와 있긴 한데, 꽤 비싸고... 뭐, 아마 관심 없으실 거예요."

TextEng: "I am glad you are so confident, but there is more you should know."
Text: "자신감이 넘치시니 기쁘지만, 더 알아야 할 것이 있어요."

TextEng: "Three of my personal guards figured that they were tough enough to go into the caves and take care of the goblins. They never returned but we heard a loud rumble shortly before noon."
Text: "제 경비원 세 명이 자기들이 충분히 강하다고 생각하고 동굴에 들어가 고블린을 처리하려 했어요. 돌아오지 못했지만, 정오 직전에 큰 굉음이 들렸어요."

TextEng: "The goblins must have set up a trap to kill or capture any pursuers. I went to the military guild and Feran said he would assist me, but he was overruled."
Text: "고블린들이 추적자를 죽이거나 잡기 위한 함정을 설치한 것 같아요. 군사 길드에 갔더니 페란이 도와주겠다고 했는데, 거부당했어요."

TextEng: "That argument is foolish! We provide much of the food that the residents of the keep need to survive. If you hope to become the <Lord/Lady> of the Keep, you had best learn some diplomacy!"
Text: "그 논리는 어리석어요! 거점 주민들이 생존하는 데 필요한 식량의 상당 부분을 우리가 제공해요. 거점의 영주가 되고 싶다면, 외교를 좀 배우세요!"

TextEng: "Before his death in the recent battle, the Banner had noted the increase in monster sightings in the area. He increased funding to the militia to train more guards."
Text: "최근 전투에서 죽기 전에, 기수장이 이 지역의 괴물 목격 증가를 주목했어요. 더 많은 경비대를 훈련시키기 위해 민병대 예산을 늘렸죠."

TextEng: "Those who lived outside the walls were invited to bring livestock into the keep and live here until the troops were ready. Unfortunately, the assault on the keep came sooner than we hoped and many of the recruits were killed."
Text: "성벽 밖에 사는 사람들에게 가축을 거점으로 가져와 군대가 준비될 때까지 머물라고 했어요. 안타깝게도 거점 공격이 예상보다 빨리 왔고, 신병 다수가 전사했어요."

TextEng: "If you were to do something about the Masked Man's forces, I could make sure you have our vote, as well as the time to sway a few more supporters."
Text: "가면 남자의 세력에 대해 뭔가 해주시면, 우리 표를 확실히 해드리고, 더 많은 지지자를 끌어모을 시간도 벌어드릴 수 있어요."

TextEng: "If you are unwilling to do this, that is your choice. I suppose that means I shall have to vote for Enivid. Hopefully she will be able to exterminate the Masked Man's forces before they do the same to us."
Text: "하고 싶지 않다면 그건 선택이에요. 그러면 에니비드에게 투표해야겠죠. 가면 남자의 세력을 우리보다 먼저 처치해 주길 바라면서."

TextEng: "I am fairly busy right now, so if you change your mind, feel free to return. For now, I have to get back to work."
Text: "지금 좀 바빠요. 마음이 바뀌면 돌아오세요. 지금은 일을 해야 해요."

TextEng: "My duties here in the guild also include the selling of property. There is a place for sale that would normally cost around ten thousand gold. There are a few problems with the house though."
"I am sorry, but I don't even know who you are. Maybe if I knew a little about you, I could make a judgment call in this matter."
Text: "미안하지만 누구신지도 모르겠어요. 좀 더 알게 되면 판단할 수 있을 것 같아요."

TextEng: "Prove your abilities and I will cut the cost of the house considerably. If you really want to be the <Lord/Lady> of the Keep, you should set up a permanent home here."
"Thank you, <FirstName>. If you are capable of doing this, then you have the ability to become a strong ruler. Actions speak louder than words, I always say."
"If you don't want to have to search for the proper cave, I would suggest you speak to Alias. I am sure she would be pleased to lead you right there."
"Otherwise, my property lies to the east. The goblin caves are not far from my house. Was there anything else you needed?"
"Well, eventually someone is going to have to, but not yet. If you were to clear the goblins out of their cave, the other landowners would know you were serious and capable of helping them."

"By the Hand, Enivid... The woman means well but she's too cautious by far. The militia's spread thin to be sure but there must be someone among the guard who can be spared from the walls to protect the outlying lands."
"They are all dead then? Do you have something to prove what you say?"
"A grizzly trophy, but one that definitely proves the job was done. I imagine you will find me here, whenever you are finished."
"I thought it was pretty self-explanatory. Anyone can say they did the job, even if all they did was enter the caves, see some goblins, did unseemly things in their armor, then ran away."
"What a disgusting thing. Very well, I will keep it to show the other landowners, to prove your worth to them."

"If you can clear the goblins from my land, that would prove you know how to handle yourself in a fight. The only house presently on the market... well, let's just say it is peculiar and leave it at that."
Text: "제 땅에서 고블린을 쫓아내 주시면, 싸움을 다룰 줄 안다는 걸 증명하는 거예요. 현재 유일한 매물은 유령의 집이에요."

TextEng: "Now, for your reward, here is the 200 gold, and you are now our candidate for the election. I can also hold off the election three times for you. I will have Alias come and get you if a vote is called."
"Good. If you decide that you would like a permanent place here in Cyan, I have a house I can give you a real deal on. Sure, it has problems, but I think it might be perfect for you."
"Well, there is a house for sale. Showing that you have long-range plans in the Keep by purchasing a house would probably help your position."

"The problem is that the only house we have right now has several problems. First it is an expensive, old house. I can help you there, since it hasn't sold in the four years it has been on the market."
"Well, that is all I have to offer. If gold is the problem, you should speak to The Stan. He's right across the hall and he pays well. If you should change your mind, all you have to do is ask."
"If you don't have enough support, then you won't win. I should think that is obvious. The more people get to know and respect you, the more likely they are to vote for you."
"Most guild masters will tell you that nothing could convince them to vote for you, but don't believe it. Everybody has a price. Everybody."

"An important vote can be held off three times, if guilds are not ready to vote yet. Most guild masters don't take advantage of this, but I do, because my guild is notorious for being slow to reach a decision."
"Everyone is used to my petitions for time, so they won't suspect anything if I do it for you. They'll just think my fellow landowners are being difficult again."
Serah raises an eyebrow in your direction, frowning at the same time.
"Since you have done such a kind turn for me, I would love to respond in kind. You seem to be able to hold your own in a fight, so mayhap a haunted house just might interest you."
Text: "친절하게 도와주셨으니, 보답하고 싶어요. 싸움에서 자신을 지킬 줄 아시니, 이 거래가 좋을 거예요."

TextEng: "And how may I be of assistance today?"
Text: "오늘은 어떻게 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Pleased to make your acquaintance, I am. The name is Sebastion Fitch, but my friends just call me Southpaw. I'm the thieves guildmaster, and you must be the new hero in town."
Text: "만나서 반가워요. 이름은 세바스티온 피치인데, 친구들은 그냥 사우스포라고 불러요. 도적 길드장이고, 당신이 마을의 새 영웅이시겠죠."

TextEng: "If that is what it takes, then yes. But if you can convince Enivid to release him, that would be all for the better."
Text: "그래야 한다면 그래요. 하지만 에니비드를 설득해서 풀어줄 수 있다면, 그게 훨씬 나아요."

TextEng: "All you need to do is open his door and let him out, or get release papers from Enivid and take them to the guard. Either way, once he is free return here."
Text: "문을 열어서 내보내기만 하면 돼요, 아니면 에니비드에게 석방 서류를 받아서 경비병에게 가져가거나요. 어쨌든 자유롭게 되면 여기로 돌아오세요."

TextEng: "Then I don't think you will be a member of our thieves guild."
Text: "그렇다면 우리 도적 길드의 일원은 못 되실 것 같네요."

TextEng: "You don't sound terribly convinced you can do this. Try not to get Stiletto, the prisoner, killed."
Text: "할 수 있다는 확신이 별로 없어 보이네요. 수감자 스틸레토가 죽지 않게 해주세요."

TextEng: "There are several benefits to belonging to the thieves guild, but we will discuss those once you are a member. So will you rescue my friend?"
Text: "도적 길드에 속하면 여러 혜택이 있지만, 그건 가입하고 나서 얘기하죠. 그래서 제 친구를 구출해 주실 건가요?"

TextEng: "Good. Try not to get Stiletto, the prisoner, killed. May Veragok cover you with his divine darkness and obscure you from your enemies."
Text: "좋아요. 수감자 스틸레토가 죽지 않게 해주세요. 베라곡이 신성한 어둠으로 당신을 감싸 적의 눈에서 숨겨주시길."

TextEng: "Now, was there anything else I can do for you?"
Text: "자, 다른 것도 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Since you have joined our guild, we will, naturally, support your claim to the throne. Is there anything else I can do for you?"
Text: "우리 길드에 가입하셨으니, 당연히 왕좌에 대한 당신의 주장을 지지할 거예요. 다른 것도 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Your act of freeing Stiletto, no matter the reason, shows me you are a worthy candidate. I will vote for you on one condition."
Text: "이유가 뭐든 스틸레토를 풀어준 행동은 당신이 합당한 후보라는 것을 보여줘요. 조건 하나만 들어주시면 투표하겠어요."

TextEng: "I have a 'friend' who got on the bad side of Enivid and languished in prison until someone set him free. I think that someone was you."
Text: "에니비드의 미움을 산 '친구'가 있었는데, 누군가 풀어줄 때까지 감옥에서 고생했어요. 그 누군가가 당신인 것 같아요."

TextEng: "There has been talk all over town about you and the election. So how can old Southpaw be of assistance today? Would you like to purchase some legitimate goods?"
Text: "마을 전체가 당신과 선거 얘기로 떠들썩해요. 이 늙은 사우스포가 오늘 어떻게 도와드릴까요? 합법적인 물건을 사시겠어요?"

TextEng: "He left a little gift here for you. He said he wished he could thank you in person, but he had some unfinished business to take care of."
Text: "여기 당신을 위한 작은 선물을 남겼어요. 직접 감사 인사를 하고 싶었지만, 마무리할 일이 있다고 했어요."

TextEng: "Your act of freeing a thief, no matter the reason, shows me you are a worthy candidate. I will vote for you on one condition."
Text: "이유가 뭐든 도적을 풀어준 행동은 당신이 합당한 후보라는 것을 보여줘요. 조건 하나만 들어주시면 투표하겠어요."

TextEng: "Simple, you must promise to stop crime in our city by supporting the thieves guild."
Text: "간단해요, 도적 길드를 지원해서 도시의 범죄를 막겠다고 약속해 주세요."

TextEng: "I can sense the power of this cloak. It is a rare and valuable gift, <FirstName>."
Text: "이 망토에서 힘이 느껴지네요. 희귀하고 귀한 선물이에요, <FirstName>."

TextEng: He looks shocked, and then laughs. "I don't work that way, I'm afraid. Besides, it would look bad if one of the candidates suddenly died. It would probably cause something similar to a civil war."
Text: 그는 충격을 받더니 웃습니다. "저는 그런 식으로 일하지 않아요, 유감이지만요. 게다가, 후보 중 하나가 갑자기 죽으면 안 좋겠죠. 내전 비슷한 게 벌어질 거예요."

TextEng: "I have no respect for the man myself. He is haughty and irritable, but at least he leaves us thieves alone. I'll vote for him over Enivid any day."
Text: "저도 그 남자를 존경하지 않아요. 거만하고 짜증스럽지만, 적어도 우리 도적은 내버려 두거든요. 에니비드보다는 언제든 그 사람에게 투표하겠어요."

TextEng: "I guess I shall vote for Sir Becket. What choice do I have? This city doesn't need a ruler like Enivid who will try to 'purge' the streets of crime."
Text: "베켓 경에게 투표하는 수밖에 없겠네요. 무슨 선택이 있겠어요? 이 도시에 거리의 범죄를 '척결'하겠다는 에니비드 같은 통치자는 필요 없어요."

TextEng: "We will be voting for you, past favors having been rendered. Anything else?"
Text: "지난번의 은혜가 있으니, 당신에게 투표하겠어요. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "Sounds like a justification for breaking the law to me."
Text: "법을 어기기 위한 변명처럼 들린다고요?"

TextEng: "This man makes sense, Trip can see that. Do you think if we ate his brain we would gain his knowledge?"
Text: "이 사람 말이 맞아요, 트립이 보기에도요. 뇌를 먹으면 지식을 얻을 수 있을까요?"

TextEng: "Very well, have a good day, <sir/madam>."
Text: "알겠어요, 좋은 하루 되세요."

TextEng: "What?"
Text: "뭐라고요?"

TextEng: "Oh, nothing, nothing. Trip never said a word, not one!"
Text: "아, 아무것도 아니에요, 아무것도! 트립은 한마디도 안 했어요, 하나도!"

TextEng: "Oh yes, everything here is honestly purchased merchandise. No stolen goods are sold in this pawnshop. Not a chance."
Text: "아, 네, 여기 있는 건 전부 정직하게 매입한 상품이에요. 이 전당포에서 장물이 팔리는 일은 없어요. 절대로요."

TextEng: "Well... there are occasional infractions... I suppose. One can never be truly positive. But if I recognize a particular item, I always offer to sell it back to the original owner for the cost I paid."
Text: "글쎄... 가끔 위반이 있기는... 하죠. 완전히 확신할 수는 없으니까요. 하지만 특정 물건을 알아보면, 항상 제가 지불한 비용에 원래 주인에게 되팔겠다고 제안해요."

TextEng: "That would be true if I was telling the thieves what to take, or who to take it from, but I don't. And if I happen to make a little profit occasionally, so does the local government."
Text: "도적들에게 뭘 훔칠지, 누구한테 훔칠지 지시했다면 그렇겠지만, 그러지 않아요. 가끔 작은 이익이 생기면, 지방 정부도 마찬가지거든요."

TextEng: "Taxation is the most profitable crime of all. Anything else, while you're throwing around insults?"
Text: "과세야말로 가장 수익성 좋은 범죄예요. 모욕을 퍼붓는 김에 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "I could... and occasionally I do, if I have a good buyer or don't like the person the item was stolen from... but that is a rarity. Usually I prefer to keep a fairly decent reputation."
Text: "할 수는 있어요... 가끔 그러기도 하고요, 좋은 구매자가 있거나 물건을 도둑맞은 사람이 마음에 안 들면... 하지만 드문 일이에요. 보통은 꽤 괜찮은 평판을 유지하는 게 좋거든요."

TextEng: "It is part of the deal we had with the late Banner. He allowed us full guild status, so long as I kept a tight rein on the thieves."
Text: "고 기수장과의 거래의 일부였어요. 제가 도적들을 단단히 관리하는 한, 완전한 길드 자격을 허가해 줬죠."

TextEng: "The balance works well and keeps me in business with little interference from the guards."
Text: "이 균형이 잘 작동해서, 경비대의 간섭 없이 장사를 할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Very well. What would you like to talk about? Me, I like to talk about selling things. Maybe you would like to talk about buying some of those same things I like to sell."
Text: "좋아요. 무슨 얘기를 하고 싶으세요? 저는 물건 파는 얘기를 좋아해요. 제가 팔고 싶은 물건을 사는 얘기를 하시는 건 어떨까요."

TextEng: "Certainly! Just let me dig through some of this... lesser merchandise, so I can find you the good stuff."
Text: "물론이죠! 이 하급 물건들 사이를 좀 뒤져서... 좋은 물건을 찾아드릴게요."

TextEng: "If it is precious to them, they pay. If not, they let me keep it and sell it, and I split the profits with them. It is better than the alternative, which is simply losing everything."
Text: "소중한 물건이면 돈을 내요. 아니면 제가 보관하고 팔게 두고, 이익을 나누죠. 그냥 다 잃는 것보다는 나으니까요."

TextEng: "Not at first, of course, but once they realize the alternative, they usually get over it. I have even had some thank me later. But that's rare. My policy just makes for better neighbors."
Text: "처음에는 물론 아니지만, 대안을 깨달으면 대개 받아들여요. 나중에 감사해하는 사람도 있었어요. 드물지만요. 제 방침은 그냥 더 좋은 이웃을 만들 뿐이에요."

TextEng: "Of course, if Enivid becomes the new lord, things could get more difficult, but I'm going to do everything in my power to make sure she doesn't get elected."
Text: "물론, 에니비드가 새 영주가 되면 상황이 어려워질 수 있지만, 그녀가 당선되지 않도록 온 힘을 다할 거예요."

TextEng: "I think she is beautiful, determined, and loves her community, but she is also cold-hearted and conceited. Others disagree with me, but that is how I see it. She must not win the next election."
Text: "아름답고, 결단력 있고, 공동체를 사랑하지만, 냉정하고 자만하기도 해요. 다른 사람들은 동의하지 않지만, 제 눈에는 그래요. 다음 선거에서 이기면 안 돼요."

TextEng: "Stiletto mentioned you'd be by and said to treat you well. He left a little gift here for you and said he wished he could thank you in person, but he had some unfinished business to take care of."
Text: "스틸레토가 당신이 올 거라며 잘 대해주라고 했어요. 여기 당신을 위한 작은 선물을 남기고, 직접 감사 인사를 하고 싶었지만 마무리할 일이 있다고 했어요."

TextEng: "I can sense the power of this cloak. It is a rare and valuable gift, <FirstName>."
Text: "이 망토에서 힘이 느껴지네요. 희귀하고 귀한 선물이에요, <FirstName>."

TextEng: "I have been told that you are a follower of Veragok, so I will give you a discounted price."
Text: "베라곡의 추종자라고 들었으니, 할인된 가격으로 드릴게요."

TextEng: "Now, as a member of the guild, would you be wanting my regular merchandise, or something special?"
Text: "자, 길드 원이시니, 일반 상품을 원하세요, 아니면 특별한 걸 원하세요?"

TextEng: "One of my thieves raided an old wizard's tower not long ago and came back with some magical boots, bracers and a belt."
Text: "얼마 전에 우리 도적 하나가 오래된 마법사 탑을 털고 마법 장화, 팔보호대, 허리띠를 가져왔어요."

TextEng: "All of these items are defensive in nature. The boots are worth about 5500 gold, but I would gladly sell it to you for 4500. Are you interested?"
Text: "전부 방어용 물건이에요. 장화는 금화 5500닢 정도 하지만, 기꺼이 4500에 드릴게요. 관심 있으세요?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "Sorry, but I have to pay the thief and the government, so I need some profit. 4500 is a good price for these beauties."
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> "미안하지만, 도적한테도 정부한테도 돈을 내야 하니까 이익이 좀 있어야 해요. 4500이면 이 물건치곤 좋은 가격이에요."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "Fine. For you, I'll drop it to 3500. That's the best I can do."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "좋아요. 당신이니까 3500으로 깎아 드릴게요. 이게 최선이에요."

TextEng: "Were you able to free Stiletto?"
Text: "스틸레토를 풀어줄 수 있었어요?"

TextEng: "There you go. I hope they help you."
Text: "여기 있어요. 도움이 됐으면 좋겠네요."

TextEng: "There you go. I hope they help you."
Text: "여기 있어요. 도움이 됐으면 좋겠네요."

TextEng: "I'm sorry. I forgot that I already sold the boots. Old age must be getting to me already."
Text: "죄송해요. 장화는 이미 팔았다는 걸 깜빡했네요. 벌써 늙었나 봐요."

TextEng: "Well, you are a bungler, aren't you. I'll keep selling you items, but don't expect anything else from me now."
Text: "이야, 꽤 서투르시네요. 물건은 계속 팔겠지만, 더 이상은 기대하지 마세요."

TextEng: "Very well, if you find the funds I'll sell them to you later, so long as no one else buys them first."
Text: "알겠어요, 돈을 구하시면 나중에 팔아 드릴게요, 다른 사람이 먼저 안 사간다면요."

Text: "여기 있어요. 도움이 됐으면 좋겠네요."

Text: "죄송해요. 허리띠는 이미 팔았다는 걸 깜빡했네요. 벌써 늙었나 봐요."

TextEng: "Very well. Only the best prices for you."
Text: "알겠어요. 당신에겐 최고의 가격만 드리죠."

TextEng: "Information takes time and time is money, so let's make it quick, right?"
Text: "정보는 시간이 걸리고 시간은 돈이니, 빨리 합시다, 네?"

TextEng: "Excellent! I am sure you must now be in a mood to purchase some of our fine, legitimate goods."
Text: "좋아요! 이제 우리의 훌륭하고 합법적인 상품을 살 기분이시겠죠."

TextEng: "The keep is a large place and there are those who know it better than I, and who have more time on their hands. I suggest you ask someone in the market place."
Text: "거점은 넓은 곳이라, 저보다 잘 아는 사람들이 있고, 시간도 더 많아요. 시장에서 누군가에게 물어보시는 게 좋겠어요."

TextEng: "I am impressed, <FirstName>... very impressed."
Text: "대단하네요, <FirstName>... 정말 대단해요."

TextEng: "Any other questions?"
Text: "다른 질문은요?"

TextEng: "The guild has guidelines for our members to follow, to keep friction between the thieves and the local citizens to a minimum. We discourage assassins and we pay our taxes."
Text: "길드에는 회원들이 따라야 할 지침이 있어서, 도적과 주민 사이의 마찰을 최소화해요. 암살자는 권장하지 않고, 세금도 내요."

TextEng: "But we don't like to give away guild secrets, so that is enough on that topic. Anything else?"
Text: "하지만 길드 비밀을 알려주는 건 좋아하지 않으니, 이 정도면 충분하겠죠. 다른 건요?"

TextEng: "As a member of our guild, you are welcome to purchase special goods from my hidden stock."
Text: "우리 길드 원이시니, 숨겨둔 재고에서 특별 물건을 사실 수 있어요."

TextEng: "When I was young I was caught cutting a purse from a noble. To teach me a lesson, the noble removed my hand with his sword."
Text: "어릴 때 귀족의 지갑을 베어 훔치다 잡혔어요. 교훈을 주겠다고, 그 귀족이 칼로 제 손을 잘랐죠."

TextEng: "I have learned to be quite adept with my left hand. A Southpaw is a left-handed person, which I guess I am now, by default. I could have had a healer try to grow it back, but I'm used to it now."
Text: "왼손을 꽤 능숙하게 쓰게 됐어요. 사우스포는 왼손잡이라는 뜻인데, 이제 저절로 그렇게 된 셈이죠. 치유사에게 다시 자라게 할 수도 있었지만, 이제 익숙해졌어요."

TextEng: "It serves as a reminder to me of why I try to help thieves stay alive. It also serves as a lesson to scare some of the young ones into staying straight."
Text: "도적들이 살아남도록 돕는 이유를 상기시켜 주기도 하고, 젊은이들을 겁줘서 바른 길로 가게 하는 교훈이기도 해요."

TextEng: "Killing can be an effective lesson, but only to those who do not die. You can't teach much to a corpse."
Text: "죽이는 것도 효과적인 교훈이 될 수 있지만, 죽지 않은 자에게만요. 시체한테는 가르칠 게 별로 없거든요."

TextEng: "Not really. Truth is, it is important for our survival in the keep."
Text: "별로요. 사실 거점에서 살아남으려면 중요한 일이에요."

TextEng: "There is nothing noble about it. It is common sense."
Text: "고상한 건 아무것도 없어요. 상식이죠."

TextEng: "I guess that means that this package is for you. It had a little note that said, 'Please give this to my rescuer. S.' I figured you were the one, but I wanted to make sure."
Text: "그럼 이 꾸러미가 당신 거겠네요. 작은 쪽지가 붙어 있었어요, '내 구출자에게 전해 주세요. S.' 당신인 줄 알았지만, 확인하고 싶었거든요."

TextEng: "You can tell pretty quickly which young ones will make good thieves and which will just bungle the job and get caught. A job gone wrong can lead to deaths, something I encourage my thieves to avoid."
Text: "어떤 젊은이가 좋은 도적이 될지, 어떤 놈이 일을 망치고 잡힐지 금방 알 수 있어요. 일이 잘못되면 사람이 죽을 수 있고, 그건 제가 도적들에게 피하라고 권하는 거예요."

TextEng: "Our thieves guild has guidelines that help to keep us welcome in the keep. Many of my best thieves are folk that no one would suspect at all."
Text: "우리 도적 길드에는 거점에서 환영받도록 하는 지침이 있어요. 최고의 도적들 중 많은 이가 아무도 의심하지 않을 사람들이에요."

TextEng: "But that is really enough revelation of trade secrets, I think. Do you have other questions?"
Text: "하지만 영업 비밀 공개는 이 정도면 충분하겠죠. 다른 질문 있으세요?"

TextEng: "I have never met such a practical criminal. Your parents must be proud!"
Text: "이렇게 실용적인 범죄자는 처음 봤어요. 부모님이 자랑스러워하시겠네!"

TextEng: "My father was a thief and my mother was a barmaid, so if they were still alive, I imagine they would indeed be proud. Can you say the same?"
Text: "아버지는 도적이었고 어머니는 술집 아가씨였으니, 살아 계셨다면 정말 자랑스러워하셨겠죠. 당신도 그렇게 말할 수 있어요?"

TextEng: "My father was a druid and my mother was a nymph. My father would like what I have become, but my mother would have been disgusted by my scars. I am too ugly for a nymph."
Text: "트립의 아버지는 드루이드였고 어머니는 님프였어요. 아버지라면 트립이 된 모습을 좋아하셨겠지만, 어머니는 상처 때문에 역겨워하셨을 거예요. 트립은 님프에게는 너무 못생겼거든요."

TextEng: "You have nothing to be ashamed of girl. You seem to have more in your head than any nymph I've ever heard of. But we have wandered off topic."
Text: "부끄러워할 것 없어요, 아가씨. 내가 들어본 어떤 님프보다 머릿속에 든 게 많아 보여요. 하지만 주제에서 벗어났네요."

TextEng: "I no longer feel like speaking to you, <sir/madam>. Please make a purchase or leave my store."
Text: "더 이상 대화하고 싶지 않아요. 물건을 사시든지 가게를 나가세요."

TextEng: "Enivid is a paladin and has a real dislike for what she calls 'shady' characters. She has tried to have the entire guild and my shop closed down before, but the Banner understood the politics better."
Text: "에니비드는 성기사라 '수상한' 인물이라 부르는 자들을 정말 싫어해요. 전에 길드 전체와 제 가게를 폐쇄하려 했지만, 기수장은 정치를 더 잘 이해했죠."

TextEng: "Without me, the thieves would get out of control and then people start getting killed and merchandise gets shipped south, instead of remaining in the area."
Text: "저 없이는 도적들이 통제 불능이 되고, 사람이 죽기 시작하고, 물건은 이 지역에 남지 않고 남쪽으로 빠져나갈 거예요."

TextEng: "Then welcome to the thieves guild, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. You will now have access to a cheaper rate on our wares, and some special equipment as well."
Text: "그럼 도적 길드에 오신 걸 환영해요, 영주 <FirstName>. 이제 우리 물건을 더 싼 가격에 사실 수 있고, 특별 장비도 이용할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "As it is, the government takes a tax from our coffers, helping to pay for the guards. But Enivid thinks she can just shut us down and hunt down the thieves."
Text: "현재로서는 정부가 우리 금고에서 세금을 가져가서 경비대 비용에 보태고 있어요. 하지만 에니비드는 그냥 우리를 폐쇄하고 도적들을 사냥하면 된다고 생각하죠."

TextEng: "Of course, <sir/madam>. I am sorry to have gone off so. It is an emotional subject to me."
Text: "물론이죠. 흥분해서 죄송해요. 감정적인 주제라서요."

TextEng: "I'm not sure if you actually grasp the realities of our situation any better than the Hand does. If Enivid only realized how much crime we prevent, she'd have to put us on the payroll."
Text: "보좌관보다 우리 상황의 현실을 더 잘 이해하시는지 모르겠네요. 에니비드가 우리가 얼마나 많은 범죄를 예방하는지 알기만 하면, 우리를 급여 명단에 올려야 할 거예요."

TextEng: "Then we could never support you. I am sorry. Are you interested in my goods, or will you be leaving now?"
Text: "그렇다면 당신을 지지할 수 없어요. 죄송해요. 물건에 관심이 있으신 건가요, 아니면 가시는 건가요?"

TextEng: Southpaw stares into your eyes, then nods and quickly pulls out a sheet of paper and a stylus. "You won't mind signing a document to that effect then, would you?"
Text: 사우스포가 당신의 눈을 바라보더니 고개를 끄덕이고 빠르게 종이와 첨필을 꺼냅니다. "그럼 그 뜻의 서류에 서명하시는 건 괜찮으시겠죠?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "Very good, now I shall... wait a second... this isn't even your name! You don't think I have thieves who try these tricks all the time? Sign it for real!"
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> "좋아요, 이제 제가... 잠깐만... 이건 당신 이름도 아니잖아요! 이런 수법을 쓰는 도적이 날마다 있다는 걸 모르세요? 제대로 서명하세요!"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "Good enough. I shall keep this on hand, in case you try to break your word when all that power goes to your head."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "됐어요. 혹시 권력이 머리에 올라가서 약속을 어기려 할 때를 대비해 보관해 둘게요."

TextEng: "I guess the guild shall be voting for you as the next <Lord/Lady> of the Keep."
Text: "길드가 당신을 거점의 차기 영주로 투표하겠네요."

TextEng: "What else can old Southpaw do for you?"
Text: "이 늙은 사우스포가 또 뭘 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> "Do I really look that gullible to you? Now sign it or walk."
Text: <StartCheck>[실패]</Start> "제가 그렇게 잘 속는 것 같아요? 서명하시든지 나가세요."

TextEng: "I can sense the power of this cloak. It is a rare and valuable gift, <FirstName>."
Text: "이 망토에서 힘이 느껴지네요. 희귀하고 귀한 선물이에요, <FirstName>."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "It goes against my very nature, but I suppose I shall trust you."
Text: <StartCheck>[성공]</Start> "제 본성에 어긋나지만, 당신을 믿어보겠어요."

TextEng: "Half of being the <Lord/Lady> of the Keep is signing important papers. I guess we can safely assume you won't make much of a <Lord/Lady>."
Text: "거점 영주의 일 중 절반은 중요한 서류에 서명하는 거예요. 당신은 별로 좋은 영주가 되지 못하겠네요."

TextEng: "Therefore we could never support you. I am sorry. Are you interested in my goods, or will you be leaving now?"
Text: "그러니 당신을 지지할 수 없어요. 죄송해요. 물건에 관심이 있으신 건가요, 아니면 가시는 건가요?"

TextEng: [The document says that as the Lord of the Keep, you promise to uphold the current contract between the keep and the Guild.]
Text: [서류에는 거점의 영주로서, 거점과 길드 간의 현행 계약을 유지할 것을 약속한다고 적혀 있습니다.]

TextEng: "It simply gives the guild a chance to defend any members in a court of law, and we get a vote among the guild masters. There are a few small legal points, but that's the essence."
Text: "간단히 말하면, 길드 원을 법정에서 변호할 기회를 주고, 길드장들 사이에서 투표권을 얻는 거예요. 사소한 법적 조항이 몇 개 있지만, 핵심은 그거예요."

TextEng: "Perfect. I think we shall get along just fine, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?"
Text: "완벽해요. 우리 잘 지낼 수 있을 것 같아요, 영주 <FirstName>. 다른 것도 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "We have specific rules regarding what our thieves are allowed to do. We do not allow assassinations, nor do we steal from the poor. That's more than you can say for most Thieves Guilds."
Text: "도적들이 뭘 해도 되는지에 대한 구체적인 규칙이 있어요. 암살은 허용하지 않고, 가난한 자에게서 훔치지도 않아요. 대부분의 도적 길드보다 낫죠."

TextEng: "There are other ways we help, but I think you get the picture. So? What do you think?"
Text: "우리가 돕는 다른 방법도 있지만, 감을 잡으셨을 거예요. 그래서, 어떻게 생각하세요?"

TextEng: "As a paladin, I would think your position would be as problematic as the current Hand's position is."
Text: "성기사로서, 현 보좌관의 입장만큼이나 난처하실 거라 생각하는데요."

TextEng: "I have a 'friend' who has gotten on the bad side of Enivid and languishes in prison at this very minute, crammed in there with the Masked Man's soldiers captured in the battle. If you freed him, I would vote for you."
Text: "에니비드의 미움을 산 '친구'가 있는데, 지금 이 순간에도 전투에서 잡힌 가면 남자의 병사들과 함께 감옥에 갇혀 있어요. 그를 풀어주시면 당신에게 투표하겠어요."

TextEng: "Welcome to my humble shop, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. How might I be of assistance?"
Text: "보잘것없는 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요, 영주 <FirstName>. 어떻게 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "Either convince Enivid to set him free, or break him out of prison. Just be careful not to run around killing the guards. That would be bad form indeed."
Text: "에니비드를 설득해서 풀어주든지, 감옥에서 탈출시키든지요. 다만 경비병을 죽이고 다니지는 마세요. 그건 정말 안 좋은 행동이에요."

TextEng: "If that is what it takes, then yes. But if you can convince Enivid to release him, that would be all for the better."
Text: "그래야 한다면 그래요. 하지만 에니비드를 설득해서 풀어줄 수 있다면, 그게 훨씬 나아요."

TextEng: "All he needs is his door opened, or get Enivid to order his release. Either way, once he is free return here."
Text: "문만 열어주면 돼요, 아니면 에니비드에게 석방 명령을 받거나요. 어쨌든 자유롭게 되면 여기로 돌아오세요."

TextEng: "You don't sound terribly convinced you can do this. Try not to get Stiletto, the prisoner, killed."
Text: "할 수 있다는 확신이 별로 없어 보이네요. 수감자 스틸레토가 죽지 않게 해주세요."

TextEng: "You mean besides the lands and wealth that come with the title <Lord/Lady> of the Keep? Perhaps Stiletto will have something for you, if you treat him well."
Text: "거점 영주 직함에 따라오는 땅과 재산 말고요? 스틸레토를 잘 대해주시면 뭔가 줄지도 몰라요."

TextEng: "Good. Try not to get Stiletto, the prisoner, killed. May Veragok cover you with his divine darkness and obscure you from your enemies."
Text: "좋아요. 수감자 스틸레토가 죽지 않게 해주세요. 베라곡이 신성한 어둠으로 당신을 감싸 적의 눈에서 숨겨주시길."

TextEng: "As a thief, I imagine you would be an excellent supporter of our cause."
Text: "도적으로서, 우리 대의를 훌륭하게 지지해 주실 거라 생각해요."

TextEng: "Would you be interested in joining our guild? Not only would we be willing to support your bid for the throne, but I can also offer you some 'special' purchases."
Text: "우리 길드에 가입할 생각이 있으세요? 왕좌를 향한 당신의 도전을 지지할 뿐 아니라, '특별한' 구매 기회도 드릴 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Of course, <sir/madam>, we cannot all be rational, intelligent creatures, now can we? What can I do for you now?"
Text: "물론이죠, 우리 모두가 이성적이고 지적인 존재가 될 수는 없죠, 그렇지 않겠어요? 이제 뭘 도와드릴까요?"

TextEng: "A sadly common attitude within our guild. Still, we need the fresh blood."
Text: "안타깝게도 우리 길드 안에서도 흔한 태도예요. 그래도 새 피가 필요하죠."

TextEng: "Well, well, well, if it isn't a customer, come to visit my humble shop." You look down to see a strange, slick halfling giving you a wide grin.
Text: "이거, 이거, 이거, 손님이 이 보잘것없는 가게를 찾아오시다니." 아래를 내려다보니, 매끈한 하플링이 환하게 웃으며 당신을 올려다봅니다.

TextEng: "Good, we always need fresh blood. "
Text: "좋아요, 새 피는 항상 필요하죠."

TextEng: "Do you swear to obey our rules and respect the guild? Do you promise to protect our interests, should you win the election?"
Text: "우리 규칙을 따르고 길드를 존중하겠다고 맹세하시겠어요? 선거에서 이기시면 우리의 이익을 보호하겠다고 약속하시겠어요?"

TextEng: "Protect your fellow thieves when you can. Use as little force as possible when taking a target (we don't like assassins... if they are detected)."
Text: "동료 도적을 가능하면 보호하세요. 목표물을 잡을 때 가능한 한 적은 힘을 사용하세요 (암살자는 좋아하지 않아요... 들키는 암살자는요)."

TextEng: "Finally, sell your goods here. You can use other shopkeepers, but you support your guild by dealing with me. I will also protect your identity from the guards, which others might not. Do you swear?"
Text: "마지막으로, 물건은 여기서 파세요. 다른 상인을 이용할 수도 있지만, 저와 거래해야 길드를 지원하는 거예요. 경비대에서 당신의 신원도 보호해 드릴 거예요, 다른 곳은 안 그럴 수도 있어요. 맹세하시겠어요?"

TextEng: "Then welcome to the thieves guild, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. You will now have access to a cheaper rate on our wares, and some special equipment as well."
Text: "그럼 도적 길드에 오신 걸 환영해요, 영주 <FirstName>. 이제 우리 물건을 더 싼 가격에 사실 수 있고, 특별 장비도 이용할 수 있어요."

TextEng: "Just agree to abide by guild rules and pay your annual dues, and you are in. What? Did you expect us to force you to run around doing quests for us? Gold is all we really care about here."
Text: "길드 규칙을 따르고 연회비를 내기만 하면 돼요. 뭐요? 우리가 이리저리 뛰어다니며 퀘스트를 시킬 거라 생각했어요? 여기서 진짜 중요한 건 금이에요."

TextEng: "Protect your fellow thieves when you can. Use as little force as possible when taking a target (we don't like assassins... if they are detected)."
Text: "동료 도적을 가능하면 보호하세요. 목표물을 잡을 때 가능한 한 적은 힘을 사용하세요 (암살자는 좋아하지 않아요... 들키는 암살자는요)."

TextEng: "Finally, sell your goods here. You can use other shopkeepers, but you support your guild by dealing with me. I will also protect your identity from the guards, which others might not."
Text: "마지막으로, 물건은 여기서 파세요. 다른 상인을 이용할 수도 있지만, 저와 거래해야 길드를 지원하는 거예요. 경비대에서 당신의 신원도 보호해 드릴 거예요, 다른 곳은 안 그럴 수도 있어요."

TextEng: "I have a 'friend' who has gotten on the bad side of Enivid and languishes in prison at this very minute. If you could possibly get him free, you would be welcome here."
Text: "에니비드의 미움을 산 '친구'가 있는데, 지금 이 순간에도 감옥에서 고생하고 있어요. 그를 풀어줄 수 있다면, 여기서 환영받으실 거예요."

TextEng: "You might have to sneak in and break him out of prison, but if you can convince Enivid to release him, that would be all for the better."
Text: "몰래 들어가서 감옥에서 꺼내야 할 수도 있지만, 에니비드를 설득해서 풀어줄 수 있다면 그게 훨씬 나아요."

TextEng: "Not yet."
Text: "아직."

TextEng: "Goodbye."
Text: "잘 가."

TextEng: "I'm not interested."
Text: "관심 없어."

TextEng: "I guess I could grace your guild with my presence."
Text: "내가 길드를 빛내줄 수도 있겠지."

TextEng: "I would love to join."
Text: "기꺼이 가입하겠어."

TextEng: "What are the rules?"
Text: "규칙이 뭔데?"

TextEng: "No."
Text: "아니."

TextEng: "I do."
Text: "맹세해."

TextEng: "What do I have to do to join the guild?"
Text: "길드에 가입하려면 뭘 해야 해?"

TextEng: "What are the rules?'
Text: "규칙이 뭔데?"

TextEng: "What am I supposed to do?"
Text: "내가 뭘 해야 해?"

TextEng: "You want me to break him out of jail?"
Text: "감옥에서 빼내라고?"

TextEng: "I don't think so."
Text: "그건 좀 힘들 것 같아."

TextEng: "I'll try."
Text: "해볼게."

TextEng: "I would like to make a purchase."
Text: "물건을 사고 싶어."

TextEng: "What else is in it for me?"
Text: "나한테 또 뭐가 좋은데?"

TextEng: "I'll do it."
Text: "할게."

TextEng: "What do you want?"
Text: "뭘 원해?"

TextEng: "What condition is that?"
Text: "그 조건이 뭔데?"

TextEng: "Do you want someone to take care of her for you?"
Text: "누가 대신 처리해 줄까?"

TextEng: "What do you think of Sir Becket?"
Text: "베켓 경에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "So what are you going to do?"
Text: "그래서 어떻게 할 건데?"

TextEng: "Legitimate goods?"
Text: "합법적인 물건?"

TextEng: "Sounds like you're a con artist."
Text: "사기꾼 같은데."

TextEng: "Why not just secretly sell the items?"
Text: "그냥 몰래 물건을 팔면 안 돼?"

TextEng: "Why would you do that?"
Text: "왜 그래?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기 하자."

TextEng: "Why would an owner pay for something that was stolen?"
Text: "주인이 왜 도둑맞은 물건에 돈을 내?"

TextEng: "Do they appreciate it?"
Text: "고마워해?"

TextEng: "Tell me about the election."
Text: "선거에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "So you don't like Enivid?"
Text: "그럼 에니비드를 안 좋아해?"

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "됐어."

TextEng: "What special items do you have?"
Text: "특별한 물건은 뭐가 있어?"

TextEng: "Never mind."
Text: "됐어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the boots."
Text: "장화에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I can't afford that."
Text: "그 돈은 없어."

TextEng: "No, he is dead."
Text: "아니, 죽었어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "Couldn't you give me a better deal then that?"
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "좀 더 깎아줄 수 없어?"

TextEng: "I'll take them."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "I'll take them."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the bracers."
Text: "팔보호대에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I can't afford that."
Text: "그 돈은 없어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "Couldn't you give me a better deal then that?"
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "좀 더 깎아줄 수 없어?"

TextEng: "I'll take them."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "Yes, I helped him escape."
Text: "응, 탈출을 도왔어."

TextEng: "I'll take them."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the belt."
Text: "허리띠에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I can't afford that."
Text: "그 돈은 없어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "Couldn't you give me a better deal then that?"
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "좀 더 깎아줄 수 없어?"

TextEng: "I'll take it."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "Yes, Enivid let him go."
Text: "응, 에니비드가 풀어줬어."

TextEng: "I'll take it."
Text: "사겠어."

TextEng: "Regular stock."
Text: "일반 상품."

TextEng: "I want to ask you some questions."
Text: "질문이 좀 있어."

TextEng: "That's all my questions."
Text: "질문은 그게 다야."

TextEng: "I have questions about the keep."
Text: "거점에 대해 물어볼 게 있어."

TextEng: "Tell me about the Thieves Guild."
Text: "도적 길드에 대해 알려줘."

TextEng: "I have more questions."
Text: "질문이 더 있어."

TextEng: "Why do they call you Southpaw?"
Text: "왜 사우스포라고 불러?"

TextEng: "A better lesson is to remove the thief's head."
Text: "더 나은 교훈은 도적의 머리를 자르는 거야."

TextEng: "That seems like it would be counterproductive to your business."
Text: "그건 네 사업에 역효과 아니야?"

TextEng: "That last part is almost noble."
Text: "마지막 부분은 거의 고상하네."

TextEng: "Why would you do that?"
Text: "왜 그래?"

TextEng: "How do you feel about the election?"
Text: "선거에 대해 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기 하자."

TextEng: "Would you consider voting for me?"
Text: "나한테 투표할 생각 없어?"

TextEng: "I could never support a thieves guild."
Text: "도적 길드를 지지할 수는 없어."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Truth]</Start> "I would fully support the Thieves Guild."
Text: <StartAction>[진실]</Start> "도적 길드를 전적으로 지지하겠어."

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> <StartAction>[Write a fake signature.]</Start>
Text: <StartCheck>[허풍]</Start> <StartAction>[가짜 서명을 쓴다.]</Start>

TextEng: <StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "You can trust me."
Text: <StartCheck>[설득]</Start> "날 믿어도 돼."

TextEng: "I don't sign documents."
Text: "서류에 서명 안 해."

TextEng: "Let me read it first."
Text: "먼저 읽어볼게."

TextEng: "What is the current contract between the thieves guild and the keep?"
Text: "도적 길드와 거점 사이의 현행 계약이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I'll sign."
Text: "서명할게."

TextEng: <StartAction>[Lie]</Start> "I would fully support the Thieves Guild."
Text: <StartAction>[거짓말]</Start> "도적 길드를 전적으로 지지하겠어."

TextEng: "How do you prevent crime?"
Text: "어떻게 범죄를 예방해?"

TextEng: "What am I supposed to do?"
Text: "내가 뭘 해야 해?"

TextEng: "You want me to break him out of jail?"
Text: "감옥에서 빼내라고?"

TextEng: "I don't think so."
Text: "그건 좀 힘들 것 같아."

TextEng: "I'll try."
Text: "해볼게."

TextEng: "What else is in it for me?"
Text: "나한테 또 뭐가 좋은데?"

TextEng: "I'll do it."
Text: "할게."

TextEng: "Right then, thanks for the help. Stop by the Pawnshop later. I think you'll be pleased." Stiletto grins at you before slipping past you and into the shadows beyond.
"So you came back. Is there a reason, or do you just enjoy watching others suffer?" The halfling offers you a morbid wink.
"Ha, ha! I like ya, funny <man/woman>. Alright then, I'll try to be serious. I doubt I'll succeed though."
"I was relatively new in town and I saw this woman who looked like she needed a break from the heavy load in her purse."
"Naturally, the gentleman in me decided I should give her a hand. No sooner had I slipped my knife into her purse strings, then I found myself on the ground with my arm trapped behind my back."
"It turns out that the fancy lady I was trying to rob was Enivid, the Hand, captain of the guards and head of the military. I just thought it was some showy armor!"

"Apparently she isn't terribly fond of thieves, and even less fond of ones that try to steal from her. So here I sit, feeling terribly remorseful and full of self-loathing, wishing I could make amends."
His eyes grow large and soulful. "Oh yes, m'<lord/lady>. I would do anything to be free of here... I mean free of my sordid past."
"I would rather not. If you get the chance, speak to Southpaw. He'd vouch for me, I'm sure, and he's a respected member of the community."
"Ah, well... enjoy your killing spree. If ya get bored, I can offer you a little something to set me free."
"My name is Stiletto. And you would be?"
"Right. Should have seen that one coming. Try to keep a smile up in here, and what good does it do you? What do you want then?"
A halfling prisoner stands whistling in his cell, seemingly oblivious to all that is going on around him. Then he looks up at you and gives you a roguish grin.
"Well, that would be bloody decent of you. Just pop that door open and I'll be on my way."
"Well, I'm not going anywhere, unless the Hand decides to hang me. Still, I'd rather ya didn't take to long."
"If that be the same key that opens the other prison doors, it won't help me, I'm afraid. This is a special cell, where the Hand can lock up her own personal prisoners."
"I am afraid I did something to upset the higher authorities. I'm in a fair bit of trouble, so if you could just find a way for me to get out, I'd be much obliged."
"You seem to have gotten yourself into some serious trouble."

"The milk of human compassion not good enough for ya? I guess not. I haven't a thing on me, but if you let me go, I'll leave a nice little gift for ya with the master of the thieves guild at the pawnshop."
"You don't, now do ya? But if ya kill me you get nothing. If ya set me free, ya have a chance that it'll work out in your favor. What have ya got to lose?"
The halfling grimaces, then shrugs and decides to ignore you.
"Ya mean you can't do it? This is some rescue. I tell you what, if you could give me a set of lock picks, I bet I could get it open myself."
"It's not like I'm going anywhere. What are your questions?"
"Have you come to poke a sharp stick in me then, or are you more of a curiosity seeker?"
"You could go speak to the Hand and try to convince her to let me go... ha, ha, ha! Oh, I almost kept a straight face that time!"
"Great, now just give me a second."
"Trip can open it for you. Yes, Trip is good at such things!"
"And I thought the rats in my cell were large. But since this one talks and swears it can open my cell, I'm willing to change my opinion on the value of rats entirely."
"But what is in it for Trip if he opens the door? That is what I am wondering!"
"Well, maybe I won't change my opinion entirely, but a little. If you could even give me some lockpicks, I could do it."
"I'd say I'm pleased to meet ya, but since I don't know if you're here to rescue me or kill me, I'll reserve judgment."
"I'll just wait here then. No rush, but if you'd care to open the door, I'd be happy to vacate the cell for someone else."
"Aye, I should've known. Don't suppose there is anything I could do to change your mind?"
"I promise that if you free me, I will leave a nice gift for ya at the Pawnshop. That's the best I can do, since the Hand and her guards stripped me of everything they could find."
"I was exhausted by my regular job as a free person, so I thought I'd just hop into a prison cell and take a much needed break!"
"Wait... wait, I'm sorry about that. I'll try to be more serious now, though I doubt I'll succeed."
"Good point. Sorry about that. I'll try to be more serious, though I doubt I'll succeed."
"I have some lock picks."
"What are you doing in there?"
"I'll just let you get back to your rest then."
"Do you usually insult people who might be able to free you?"
"I know I look like I should have a sense of humor, but I don't."
"Seriously, why are you in prison?"
"Who caught you?"
"What happened?"
"I think I'll kill you now."
"You can just stay in here and rot, for all I care."
"Are you truly repentant of your crime?"
"I don't believe you. You will have to stay here."
"I was killing the enemy captives who escaped their cells."
"Who are you?"
"I'll ask the questions here."
"Goodbye."
"Would you like me to let you out?"
"I'm here to rescue you."
"No, I changed my mind."
"Hang in there, I'll be back."
"I have the key right here. Just a second."
"What did you do?"
"Not so fast. Is there a reward you can offer me?"
"How do I know I can trust you?"
"I want the simple pleasure of killing you."
"How do I get it open?"
"I have other questions."
"Is there any other way?"
"I'll go get some."
"I have some lock picks here."
"I was just looking for something to kill."
"Is there a reward for freeing you?"
"I am <FirstName>."
"I'll have to think about it."
"No, thanks. I just like killing."
"Any reward if I set you free?"
"Like what?"
"What can Thaddeus do for you today? Will it be ale or information?"
"You just killed a man for gold; a fair number of the guild members probably wouldn't like to hear about that."
"Indeed. Now how about my gold?"
<StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> Thaddeus sneers at you. "Keep the gold... I was only having a little fun with you."
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "Keep the gold... I was only having a little fun with you."
<StartCheck>[Failure]</Start> Thaddeus sneers at you. "Keep the gold... I was only having a little fun with you."
<StartCheck>[Success]</Start> "Keep the gold... I was only having a little fun with you."
"I see. Very well then, keep the 100 gold and don't worry about the assassination, I was only having a little... fun with you."
"I mean that if you give me back my 100 gold, I'll forget you assassinated my good friend Typhus! How difficult is that to understand?"
"I think I might be starting to see a pattern here. I'll tell you what, you keep that gold and I'll give you my vote. There is one more little job I need done though."
"There is a woman named Gelani who used to be the master of the merchants' guild. She is a popular lady, part owner of The Mossy Tree and some of her supporters have been causing me grief."
"I think Gelani needs to go away for a while... let us say... for eternity."
"That looked pretty easy, hardly worth 100 gold, but a deal is a deal. Here is your gold, I just hope this doesn't make trouble for your election campaign."
"The pay for being <Lord/Lady> of the keep is high indeed, with the potential for all sorts of corruption and vice. Besides, I just paid you 100 gold for a very easy task. Think about it."
"Sir Becket thinks he deserves to rule, which makes him difficult to work with. I like you better. I think we'd have a better relationship, so do this little favor for me and you'll get your vote."

"That is unfortunate to hear. I guess Sir Becket is the better candidate then. Oh, and don't think you can go telling anyone about this little deal. No one will believe you... or those that do won't care."
"Goodbye, for now."
"Indeed! Very well, once Gelani has left our beloved keep for good, and moved on to the realm of Mistress Death, you will get my vote."
"Goodbye, for now."
"This guy's a real professional, <FirstName>. You'd better be careful around him."
"I guess that is your repayment for helping such an obviously twisted criminal. I think you killed the wrong one."
"Oh, he is a nasty, trickster, <FirstName>! I would love to get him into a dark alley and tear out his throat and chew off his ears, I would!"

"He is testing you, <FirstName>. He wants to know how easy you would be to manipulate as the <lord/lady>. Give him what he wants, and he'll think he can control you. It might be an easy way to get a vote."
"Why would I ask you to kill one of my oldest and dearest friends? Deus, Mac, did I ask <FirstName> to kill my old friend Typhus?"
"You just killed a man for gold; a fair number of the guild members probably wouldn't like to hear about that."
"I hear Gelani is gone. Here's an extra little something for your trouble. So tell me, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>, how can Thaddeus help you today?" Thaddeus gives you a leering wink.
"Welcome to The Tarnished Tankard, friend!" With a quick grin and a clap of his hands, this gnome greets you in an expansive manner.
"I am Thaddeus Squilt, sole proprietor of this fine establishment and master of the merchants' guild. And might I know who it is that I am speaking to?"
"Indeed! The very <man/woman> who has challenged my benefactor, Sir Becket. I hope you aren't here to sway my vote, ha, ha. That could be expensive indeed."
"If you are here about the election, this conversation could get expensive. If you are here for a drink, or just for some local gossip, I would be pleased to assist you."
"Come back and visit anytime. We always like patrons with coin to spend."
"That is the second job of a tavern keeper, local gossip collector, ha. What would you like to know?"
"Are you certain? Would you like a drink before you go?"
"I love most of the people of the keep as my own children, though there are a few exceptions. What do you want to know?"
"He did? That's not the way I remember it. How about you, Deus? Mac?"
"Was there anything else you wanted to know about?"
"The army will destroy them. I'm not too worried. Everyone likes to get hysterical about these sort of things, but this is the frontier; we're supposed to expect monster attacks."
"I don't really care where you stay, just don't pass out here, or you'll likely be robbed... by the patrons or the staff, take your pick."
"I would suggest you try the Pawnshop. Southpaw gets some very interesting equipment from his... sources."
"I know Serah, the landowners guild master has been complaining about goblins on her land. She's usually in the Guild Office, in the Guildhall."

"Ha, ha, a good tale that one! Gelani, part owner of The Mossy Tree was the guild master for a while. The problem was, she kept agreeing with the Banner when it came to increasing taxes for the army."
"Now, if there is one thing that merchants and nobles hate, it's paying taxes. One day Sir Becket was in here, as he often is, and we got to talking about the tax rates."
"When he realized that I would help his love, Elyssia, stop the Banner from increasing taxes again, he came up with a plan."
"Very well, though I think it is a terribly clever tale. What else would you like to know about?"
"Wait, I'm not at the best part yet!"
"Typhus just walk in here all nice, then <FirstName> jump him and kill him. That be what me saw."

"I began to spread rumors that she was proposing a plan to double taxes! The rumor spread so fast that Gelani was suddenly being tripped and having little accidents in the streets and even in her own tavern."
"Her own partner became upset when it was discovered that Gelani was stealing from their profits, something he discovered too late was completely false."
"By the time she was replaced, Gelani's self-confidence was shattered. She didn't even put up a fight! It was wonderful!"
"It does make the perfect ending to the story, doesn't it? Brings a tear to my eye... ha!"
"That would have made the story better. Still, the story might not be over yet. Anything else?"
"It wouldn't work with the time frame you have; besides, twice so soon would probably backfire. Anything else you would like to know?"
"I know... sheer genius! So what else would you like to know?"
"The Tarnished Tavern welcomes those patrons who aren't welcome in certain other establishments. It means people coming here have a far more interesting time than elsewhere."
"Why, you never know when you be visited by a thief, pummeled in a tavern brawl, or catch some disease from... well, never mind that. It's all in good fun!"
"I am afraid to tell you this, but I will be voting for Sir Becket. He assisted me in getting my position in the guild and he has helped finance me several times."
"It laughs at man then kills him."
"Ah, here comes Typhus and it looks like he is very upset. In fact, he rather seems to have the look of someone about to kill me."
"Thaddeus, you backstabbing, little bastard! I am going to cut off your buttocks and feed them to you! You've ruined me!"
"There, there Typhus, calm yourself. You must learn not to be such a sore loser."
"Sore loser? I just lost my family and my livelihood because of your 'help', so now I'm going to help you lose your life!"
"<FirstName>, how would you like to make a few quick and easy credits... and a little respect? All you have to do is take care of this... unfortunate incident."
<StartAction>[Sigh]</Start> "Good help is so hard to find. Deus... Mac... take care of this for me."
"Yes boss."
"So... enough pleasure, back to business."
"Wonderful! Just come back and see me when you're done. Hey, Typhus, meet my new friend. <He/She>'s going to kill you now! Ha, ha, ha!"
"It's gone beyond that now. Even if he leaves, he'll just come back. This needs to be finished here."
"There, you see what kind of trouble you could get into around here? Luckily, I am in a generous mood and am willing to forget that this all happened."
"100 gold, for a very simple job."
"Everyone here knows Typhus started it. Guards can't do much about that."
"Deal with my friend Typhus over there and we'll talk..."
"I will be voting for Sir Becket. You don't do favors for me, I don't do favors for you. Now, what else?"
"I am still waiting for word about Gelani. Unless she takes a permanent vacation, I will be voting for Sir Becket. Anything else?"
"I will be voting for you, as agreed. Anything else?"
"Indeed! I will fix one for you immediately. We have several types. Would you like an ale (1 gp), a glass of wine (1gp), some honey mead (5gp), or a Flaming Orc's Breath (10gp)?"
"That is unfortunate. So what else can I do for you?"
"Foul stuff, but potent! I hope you have the stomach for it. I've seen a lot of people pass out from one of these."
"Some strange old woman was in here once and claimed that the ghosts in the graveyard were hiding treasure. I've never heard of ghosts in the graveyard since her ramblings though. Anything else?"
"It would look bad if my accounts came up short though, if you know what I mean."
"This drink wouldn't be so expensive if that hermit was a little better at his job. I'll bet the old fool has some good treasure from back when he was sane. Anything else?"

"I do enjoy a nice glass of wine myself. Say, I've heard that Sir Becket cheats on that noble wench, Ellysia. If a person could get evidence of that, I'll bet it would be valuable information. Anything else?"
"Right, here you go, one ale. Say, I don't know if you heard, but somebody tried to steal The Stan's magic boots the other day. Woo hoo, was that funny. I love it when people are stupid!"
"Anyways, would you like to have another drink?"
"I trust all is going well with the monsters, m'Lord <FirstName>."
"Gelani doesn't deserve that position. Get out of my tavern!"
"I take some offense at your tone, but please, go on. It's not as if I'm going to have you killed or anything, just because you get on my bad side."
"But you asked me to do it!"
<StartCheck>[Bluff]</Start> "I'll have Enivid shut you down for this."
<StartCheck>[Persuade]</Start> "You get your 100 gold, if I get your vote."
"You'll get nothing from me."
"I don't know what you mean."
"Here is your 100 gold back."
"But he started it!"
"I want more than that."
"How do I know I can trust you?"
"I will kill no one else for you."
"I'd be happy to do that for you."
"What do you mean?"
"I am your future <Lord/Lady> <FullName>."
"I am <FirstName>."
"<FullName>. Perhaps you've heard of me."
"Goodbye."
"I am looking for some information."
"That's all I wanted to know."
"I want to know about the keep."
"That's all my questions about the keep."
"What do you know about the Masked Man's forces?"
"Where can I get a room?"
"Where can I get equipment?"
"Where can I find employment?"
"How did you become the merchants' guild master?"
"I don't want to hear anymore."
"This isn't that good a story."
"What was this plan?"
"And now she is dead! Great fun!"
"So nobody got killed? How disappointing."
"Great plan. I should try something like that."
"That's horrible!"
"Tell me about your tavern."
"Let's talk about the election."
"Let me explain something to you."
"I won't kill a man for you."
"Sure, I'll do it."
"You want me to convince him to leave?"
"How much?"
"Won't I get in trouble with the guards?"
"Never mind."
"I would like a drink."
"I changed my mind."
"I'll try a Flaming Orc's Breath."
"I'll have some honey mead."
"I'll have some wine."
"I'll have an ale."
"That's all."
<StartCheck>[Intimidate]</Start> "I'll kill you unless you shut your mouth and vote for me."
"The Stan sees that you have returned. How may The Stan assist you now?"
"The archeologist never returned, as he said he would, but I guess I need to pay you anyways."
"Very impressive. The Stan sees that you are an accomplished adventurer and would like you to have your payment in full."
"Were you wanting another of The Stan's exciting quests, or were you wondering about the election?"
"Now, The Stan is positive you will be wanting to go to our enemy's hideout. Good day to you, my <lord/lady>."
"You have completed all of The Stan's quests for now. Best of luck in the election."
The large half orc stands laughing with a couple of friends. As you approach he turns and smiles cheerfully.
"Looks like another young scallywag has come to test their mettle on a challenging quest from The Stan."
"The Stan said you were a scallywag... not in an unfriendly way though. The Stan merely thinks you look like the type of person who enjoys a good adventure."
"The Stan? Do you not recognize the superiority of The Stan? Are you not humbled by the very presence of The Stan? The Stan is insulted. What a grievous wound indeed!"
"The Stan! You haven't heard of The Stan? Well, The Stan is insulted. What a grievous wound indeed!"
"But The Stan is strong and resilient! The Stan can take the insults of low minded individuals and ignore them as the sting of a wasp."
"The archeologist came back and was very happy. This makes The Stan happy."
"Bees sting... wasps bite."
"Are you a wasp? No, The Stan does not think so. Do not presume to know more than The Stan, for that would be true folly."
"Are you looking for adventure, or are you here about the election?"
"The Stan wishes you safe journeys."
"The Stan knows now who was foolish enough to steal from The Stan. The Stan hopes that you have learned your lesson and will respect the sanctity of The Trades store."
"The Stan finds your address most pleasing and forgives your earlier lack of scruples. Is there anything else The Stan can do for you?"
"The Stan will ask you to leave now. The Stan will be giving you neither jobs nor advice now. The Stan will also do his best to make sure you are not the next <Lord/Lady> of the Keep."
"The Stan accepts your apology. Is there anything else The Stan can do for you?"
"The Stan enjoys sharing his knowledge and wisdom with all who enter his presence."
"The Stan is happy to serve those who show The Stan the respect he is due."
"Here is your pay, and a little something extra for a job well done."
"The Stan's knowledge of all things in the keep is unparalleled, and you show wisdom in coming to The Stan for his advice."
"The Stan is glad to have had this chance to enlighten you. Is there anything else The Stan can help you with?"
"The Stan stood on the walls and fought their ilk, and their brutish ways were no match for the unmatched capabilities of The Stan."
"Most fled from The Stan's terrible wrath, for it was a frightening thing to behold. Should they come again, The Stan shall meet them and throw them back again."
"The Stan would suggest the Silver Lily, in the north keep. It is a place of refinement and sweet sustenance. The Stan would also suggest you purchase a house from Serah."
"Glassy has, in the opinion of The Stan, formidable weapons and armor. That is where The Stan would send you."
"The Stan runs the Trades Guild. Why would you ask such a foolish question? All come to The Stan with quests."
"That is what The Stan's mother named him. What else should The Stan call himself?"
"The Stan's mother never spoke directly to The Stan, she would just say things like 'The Stan had better clean his room,' and The Stan would obey."
"The Stan's mother was none too proud of The Stan's orcish father. But that is fine, for The Stan is strong and is none too proud of his mother."
"The farmers said they never got their cows back. I assume the beasts are dead?"
"But this is a topic which The Stan no longer wishes to discuss. So choose another topic from which you would gain insights from The Stan."
"The Stan is the foremost authority for the trades guild. The Stan has keen understanding of the three contenders. What would you ask of him?"
"You stole the shoes of The Stan. The Stan cannot trust you to be a lawful leader. If you wanted The Stan's vote, you should not have stolen from him."
"If The Stan is pleased with the work you do for him, The Stan would know you were serious about the trade of an adventurer."
"Only one job must be completed, although The Stan would be pleased if all were accomplished."
"The Stan is pleased with the work you have done for him. You are serious about your life as an adventurer and The Stan thinks you would make a good leader."
"The Stan's guild will vote for <FirstName>. Is there anything else The Stan can do to help you?"
"The Stan tries not to spend a great deal of time thinking of such a base person, but there are times when he preys on the mind."
"Sir Becket hired some of The Stan's tradesmen to refurbish his mansion. Sir Becket took over a year to pay his debts off. This filled The Stan with great anger."
"The next time Sir Becket has to have something fixed, The Stan will not be supplying him with labor."
"Well, that is most unfortunate. The Stan is disappointed in you, for you have brought shame and disgrace upon The Stan's name. With such admonishment, The Stan hopes you will do better next time."
"Having a strong leader who knows how to enforce the law is important for the trades. If people fear for their lives or their wealth then employment suffers."
"Enivid is the epitome of law. The Stan knows there are problems she will encounter, but she could learn to adapt."
"The Stan has one job left."
"The Stan has two jobs left. Cows or dwarves."
"The Stan has two jobs left. Dwarves or the archeologist."
"The Stan has two jobs left. Cows or the archeologist."
"The Stan has three jobs at present. Dwarves, cows or an archeologist. Assisting the archeologist is my most important job, though all need to be done."
"The Stan knows that adventure isn't for everyone. How else can The Stan, in his infinite wisdom, assist you?"
"Good, which of The Stan's fine adventures would you care to enjoy?"
"Go speak to Alias as soon as you are ready to go."
"Yes, the farmers reported that their cows came home. The Stan is pleased to give you your payment of 300 gold."
"The farmers will be pleased when they see their herds again. If you get the cattle out of the caves, they should wander home."
"Speak to Alias when you are ready to go."
"The Stan is pleased and the dwarves shall be too. The Stan will inform the dwarves and all you need to do is return to me when you are done."
"Alias knows where the dwarves were mining, so she can lead you there."
"There are some who say that this keep was built on the ruins of another keep, and that the old, dark magic of an ancient empire yet lives on in these old stones."

"The most noted scholar in the north, Ohio Smith, has found an old ruin not far from here, but the place is infested with undead. If the stories are true, then the very fate of this keep might be contained within that ruin."
"Help the archeologist, and 1000 gold is yours. It is a princely sum, but a most dangerous and important task. Alias can lead you to him."
"Those foul yet clever lizard-kin, the kobolds, are supplying the Masked Man's army with food gathered from the poor peasants and landowners in the area."
"The farmers have come to ask that someone go and free their cows from the clutches of the cunning kobolds. And they offer 500 gold in return."
"The monsters have also stolen stores of grain, so you might be able to get the cows to follow you by using it. Alias can show you where their cave is."
"Did you kill all the duergar, or just the duergar mage?"
"Imagine an adventure in the deepest, darkest mines, where foul, evil duergar have wrested control from their fairer kin. Where brutal, cunnning traps and vicious, challenging fights await you."

"This is one of the grand adventures The Stan has to offer you. A twisted and powerful mage leads the duergar and the dwarves would have you kill him, that they might drive their evil cousins from their home."
"The pay is 500 gold, but there is a magic weapon in it for you if you also kill the other duergar leaders. The mage is the main target, but you're welcome to do it all. What do you say?"
"You are already on an adventure for The Stan. You will have to finish that quest first, before The Stan can offer you another."
"The Stan is pleased to see you, <Lord/Lady> <FirstName>. I hope the miners I sent to clear the tunnels out are doing their jobs properly. Best of luck."
The Stan ignores you completely.
"The Stan will be waiting here."
"Well, that is something anyways. Here is your gold, as agreed upon."
"I finished a job."
"I killed all the duergar and found this hammer."
"What did you call me?"
"You have an inflated opinion of yourself."
"Who?"
"The Stan?"
"Goodbye."
"I have a problem with some magic shoes."
"The <FirstName> thinks The Stan is an ass."
"The Stan is most deserving of my respect."
"I hate you."
"I'm sorry."
"I have some other questions for you."
"Let's talk about something else."
"I have questions about the keep."
"That's all my questions about the keep."
"What do you know about the Masked Men's forces?"
"Where can I get a room?"
"Yes."
"Where can I get equipment?"
"Where can I find employment?"
"Why do you refer to yourself as The Stan?"
"Didn't she just call you Stan?"
