"Yip! That be so good honey. Grrr, me needs more soon."
"Me drip honey on me foot, yip! Me lick it off!"
"Look at ants, yip! Them moves! That be so funny! Me want more honey now, yip!"
"Mommy be wrong, honey be good for kobolds, yip!"
"All that be good, be honey, yip!"
"Yip, now me understands meaning of life!"
"Yip, mmm... honey."
A rather sickly and emaciated kobold walks towards you, sniffing the air. "Grr. You comes bringing gifts? You brings honey for us, yip?"
"Me no smells honey on you. Yip!, you goes and gets honey, or we no feeds you. That be agreement, yip!"
"Yip! You not knows master? You be intruder, maybe? Grr, me not care, if you gives us honey! You get honey!"
"Honey set kobold minds free, yip! Kobolds gains big thoughts with honey help! There be nothing likes honey, yip!"
"Yip! That be agreement! You breaks agreement, you dies, grrr!"
"Yip, yip! You goes and gets honey! We no feeds you 'til then! Yip!"
"Yip! With the master be our agreement, of course, yip!"
"Yip! You not knows master? You be intruder, maybe? Grr, me not care, if you gives us honey! You get honey!"
"Honey set kobold minds free, yip! Kobolds gains big thoughts with honey help! There be nothing likes honey, yip!"
"Me smells honey on you, yip! You gives to us, then we feeds you, just like agreed yip!"
"Yip, yip! Me takes and shares honey with all kobolds, yip! You go find food, by self!"
"Yip! With the master be our agreement, of course, yip!"
"I will not be your servant and fetch honey for you!"
"Who is your agreement with?"
"Who is the Master?"
"Why the interest in honey?"
"I'll go get some."
"Who is your agreement with?"
"Who is the Master?"
"Why the interest in honey?"
"You'll get no honey from me!"
"Here, take it."
A terrified goblin runs towards the exit to this cave. He looks wounded and highly surprised at your entrance.
"Out of way, stupid <race> person! It kills and eats us all if we do not flee!"
"No, no, no! Leave me alone, stupid <race> person!"
"Fine, stupid <man/woman>. Never trust <race> <man/woman>! That what Uncle Bertie always said! Me gone now!"
"I not knows much about master. Only couple goblins talks to him. They be real scared of him, so I not going back to goblin cave either."
"I go north, find nicer place to live. Maybe live in nice safe dragon cave."
"You take the time to kill me instead of running, you be dead soon too."
"You not get out of my way unless I tells you? Fine, stupid <race> door blocker."
"Master says go get manticore and capture it and bring it back to him. He sends his orcs with us, to make sure we do it."
"We comes into cave and find manticore sleeping. We figure we tie it up quick and drag it back, but stupid orc steps on manticore tail."
"Now it mad and other orcs and goblins get killed and eaten. Now, let me go so me can leave. Me no wants to work for master who sends orcs and goblins to capture big, stinky manticore!"
"Ah, no! Leave me alone!"
"Oh, thank you. Take crystal. Maybe you figure what to do with it. I go quick now!"
"Umm... I find this crystal, filled with funny liquid. Orc thinks it might be poison, but what him know? I give it to you, you let me go."
"I hate goblins! Time to die!"
"What will you give me, if I let you live?"
"I'll just kill you and take it off your corpse."
"Alright, give it to me and off you go."
"Give it to me now!"
"Tell me about your master."
"Stop, or I'll kill you first!"
"What are you babbling about?"
"Slow down and tell me what you're talking about."
"Thanks for the information. Time to die now!"
"Get out of here then."
"If you are done gathering your reward, just head for the exit. I'll catch up with you."
Text: "보상을 다 챙겼으면, 출구로 향해. 내가 따라갈게."

TextEng: A beholder passes through the floor before you and begins to laugh. "So, my grandchild is everything I ever hoped for. You have done me proud, <FirstName>."
Text: 비홀더가 당신 앞에서 바닥을 뚫고 올라와 웃기 시작합니다. "그래, 내 손주는 내가 바라던 모든 것이야. 자랑스럽구나, <FirstName>."

TextEng: "I can be the woman of your dreams. A sexual goddess. Or perhaps someone closer to you than that."
Text: "네 꿈속의 여자가 될 수 있어. 매혹의 여신. 아니면 그보다 더 가까운 누군가."

TextEng: "People will always wonder. I mean, you lost. Your grip on power is that much more tenuous. You will find it will be harder to get people to agree with you, to work with you."
Text: "사람들은 항상 의심할 거야. 네가 졌으니까. 권력 장악이 그만큼 불안정해. 사람들과 합의하고 함께 일하기가 더 어려울 거야."

TextEng: "In the end, they will do it to survive, but not without some resentment. I was disappointed in your performance. It really wasn't that difficult. I wish you had tried harder."
Text: "결국 살아남기 위해 따르겠지만, 반감 없이는 아닐 거야. 네 성과에 실망했어. 그렇게 어려운 일이 아니었는데. 좀 더 노력했으면 좋았을 텐데."

TextEng: "But it matters not. You are still going to be crowned, King of the North. Like it or not."
Text: "하지만 상관없어. 좋든 싫든, 여전히 북방의 왕으로 대관식을 치르게 될 거야."

TextEng: "A bit of a formality here, I'm afraid. No queen can rule the north, but a female king can. Don't ask me why, it is just bound up in some stupid tradition."
Text: "약간의 형식적 절차가 있어. 북방을 여왕이 다스릴 수는 없지만, 여성 왕은 가능해. 왜냐고 묻지 마, 그냥 어리석은 전통에 얽힌 거야."

TextEng: "Go ahead and ask then."
Text: "그래, 물어봐."

TextEng: "It is all quite easy. It is... a part of my nature. I was trained to be this way, and I learned quickly.
Text: "다 아주 쉬워. 내... 본성의 일부야. 이렇게 되도록 훈련받았고, 빨리 배웠어."

TextEng: "Perhaps you would care to see it without the armor? No, that's probably going too far."
Text: "갑옷 없이 보고 싶어? 아니, 그건 너무 나가는 거겠지."

TextEng: "Ha, ha, ha! That is true, but it doesn't bother me. Such niceties of society are rarely a concern where I am from. Come now, doesn't my form... arouse your interest?"
Text: "하, 하, 하! 맞는 말이지만, 상관없어. 사회의 그런 예절은 내가 온 곳에서는 별로 중요하지 않거든. 자, 이 모습이... 흥미를 끌지 않아?"

TextEng: "Then again, maybe you would be more interested in a good-by-day, bad-by-night woman? Does this form please you, my lord?"
Text: "아니면 낮에는 착하고 밤에는 나쁜 여자가 더 좋아? 이 모습이 마음에 드니, 도련님?"

TextEng: "What is a true form? I haven't stayed a single form in so many centuries, I doubt I could remember what I looked like."
Text: "진짜 모습이라니? 수백 년 동안 하나의 모습을 유지한 적이 없으니, 원래 어떻게 생겼는지 기억도 안 나."

TextEng: "I suppose the form I took during most of my training is the closest thing to my true nature. Here... what do you think?"
Text: "훈련 중에 주로 취했던 모습이 내 본성에 가장 가까울 거야. 자... 어떻게 생각해?"

TextEng: "I was the personal assassin for a very powerful devil at one time. Before he was... destroyed; though I imagine he will not be gone forever."
Text: "한때 아주 강력한 악마의 전속 암살자였어. 그가... 파괴되기 전에. 물론 영원히 사라지지는 않았을 거야."

TextEng: "He made me... from the couplings of succubi and dopplegangers. There were others like me, but they are all dead now. Killed in various missions for my former master."
Text: "그가 나를... 서큐버스와 도플갱어의 결합으로 만들었어. 나 같은 존재가 더 있었지만, 지금은 다 죽었어. 옛 주인을 위한 임무에서."

TextEng: "I do not like to think of myself as evil, no. I am a survivor and I do what I must to stay alive. Sometimes that means taking evil actions. Sometimes it means saving a life."
Text: "나 자신을 악하다고 생각하고 싶지는 않아. 나는 생존자이고, 살아남기 위해 필요한 일을 해. 때로는 악한 행동을 하고, 때로는 생명을 구하기도 하지."

TextEng: "I am part demon, as are you. The part of me that is doppleganger gives me more clarity of thought and less of the absolute need for chaos that my demon half craves."
Text: "나는 반은 악마야, 너도 마찬가지고. 도플갱어인 부분이 사고를 더 명확하게 해주고, 악마 쪽이 갈망하는 혼돈에 대한 절대적 욕구를 줄여줘."

TextEng: "I do not wish to say his name, lest he be alive and I draw his attention to my activities on this plane of existence."
Text: "그의 이름을 말하고 싶지 않아. 혹시 살아 있어서 이 존재계에서의 내 활동에 주목하게 될까 봐."

TextEng: "He would not be happy with some of the choices I have made. It is of no mattter to you, at least not right now. Maybe someday in the future we will discuss these things."
Text: "내가 한 선택 중 일부에 그는 만족하지 않을 거야. 너와는 상관없는 일이야, 적어도 지금은. 언젠가 나중에 이런 것들을 얘기하게 될지도."

TextEng: "Don't worry about your friends. They are still alive, just unconscious for a while. I thought it better if we could talk in private."
Text: "네 친구들은 걱정 마. 아직 살아 있어, 잠시 기절했을 뿐이야. 우리끼리 얘기하는 게 낫겠다고 생각했거든."

TextEng: "I wish to cement our relationship. I want you to be my ally. To that end I will answer any questions you have. I imagine the curiosity about your heritage must be burning you up inside."
Text: "우리 관계를 굳히고 싶어. 네가 내 동맹이 되길 원해. 그래서 네 질문에 뭐든 대답할 거야. 네 혈통에 대한 궁금증이 속에서 타오르고 있을 거라 짐작해."

TextEng: "Really? Good. What have you decided?"
Text: "그래? 좋아. 무엇을 결정했니?"

TextEng: "The first reason is that I need someone to help me gain access to the army of the undead who waits in another plane. If you have done your research properly, you will already know something about the army."
Text: "첫 번째 이유는 다른 차원에서 대기하고 있는 언데드 군대에 접근할 수 있도록 도와줄 사람이 필요하기 때문이야. 제대로 조사했다면, 그 군대에 대해 이미 뭔가 알고 있겠지."

TextEng: "Excellent. You show more promise than I dared to hope. I am proud to call you my grandchild. There is more you should know about this army and the plane they come from."
Text: "훌륭해. 감히 바랐던 것보다 더 전도유망하구나. 너를 내 손주라 부르게 되어 자랑스러워. 이 군대와 그들이 오는 차원에 대해 더 알아야 할 것이 있어."

TextEng: "Pitiful. I cannot believe you are actually my kin. Very well, I shall tell you."
Text: "한심하군. 정말 내 혈육이라는 게 믿기지 않아. 좋아, 내가 알려주지."

TextEng: "There is an ancient magic that was wrought when this keep was first built. There was an ancient gate built to another plane, that stood not far removed from here."
Text: "이 거점이 처음 지어졌을 때 만들어진 고대 마법이 있어. 여기서 멀지 않은 곳에 다른 차원으로 통하는 고대 문이 세워져 있었지."

TextEng: "The other plane contained an army of undead creatures. No one knows what happened to them, for no one has ever survived a trip to their lands."
Text: "그 다른 차원에는 언데드 군대가 있었어. 그들에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 아무도 몰라, 그 땅으로 가서 살아 돌아온 자가 없거든."

TextEng: "The land itself is entirely dead. Any living creature that sets foot upon it, or breathes the air in it, begins to immediately decay and die."
Text: "그 땅 자체가 완전히 죽어 있어. 살아 있는 존재가 그곳에 발을 딛거나 공기를 마시면, 즉시 부패하고 죽기 시작해."

TextEng: "When the undead army enters our plane, they also suffer, but more slowly. The wizards who made the gate discovered all of this and wanted to be sure that no single person could use the army."
Text: "언데드 군대가 우리 차원에 들어오면, 그들도 고통받아, 하지만 더 느리게. 문을 만든 마법사들이 이 모든 것을 발견하고 한 사람이 군대를 사용할 수 없도록 확실히 해두고 싶었어."

TextEng: "They created two keys. One key is used on the gate, to open the passage. The other key is the throne of the keep. The one who sits on the throne is master of the army."
Text: "그래서 두 개의 열쇠를 만들었어. 하나는 문에 사용하여 통로를 여는 열쇠. 다른 하나는 거점의 왕좌야. 왕좌에 앉은 자가 군대의 주인이 되지."

TextEng: "Oh don't be such a bore. I had to come here by a deeper route, that is all. It's just sweet, old Momma Dane. Don't let this beholder form fool you."
Text: "아이고, 그렇게 재미없게 굴지 마. 좀 깊은 길로 올 수밖에 없었을 뿐이야. 다정한 늙은 마마 데인이잖아. 이 비홀더 모습에 속지 마."

TextEng: "Because your enemy is already on the move with his armies. He comes to massacre all who live in the north, because of a prophesy that speaks of his downfall."
Text: "네 적이 이미 군대를 이끌고 움직이고 있기 때문이야. 자신의 몰락을 말하는 예언 때문에 북방에 사는 모든 자를 학살하러 오고 있어."

TextEng: "I can tell you no more, though. Not until you sit safely upon your throne in the keep."
Text: "하지만 더는 말해줄 수 없어. 네가 거점의 왕좌에 안전히 앉을 때까지."

TextEng: "I found a prophesy that led me north. I then found the key that the old lord had left in the gate. I took the key and studied the prophesy for many years, before I headed south again."
Text: "나를 북방으로 이끈 예언을 찾았어. 그리고 옛 영주가 문에 남겨둔 열쇠를 찾았지. 열쇠를 가져가 여러 해 동안 예언을 연구한 후, 다시 남쪽으로 향했어."

TextEng: "Once certain conditions of the prophesy are met, I will reveal the rest to you. For now, you need to trust me, at least until I can prove the truth of my words."
Text: "예언의 특정 조건이 충족되면 나머지를 밝히겠어. 지금은 나를 믿어야 해, 적어도 내 말의 진실을 증명할 수 있을 때까지."

TextEng: "With you on the throne, I can go to the gate and summon the undead army. Then you will have the force to destroy your enemy."
Text: "네가 왕좌에 앉으면, 내가 문으로 가서 언데드 군대를 소환할 수 있어. 그러면 적을 물리칠 힘을 갖게 되지."

TextEng: "I cannot tell you any more about the future, but I know that you will need a strength of arms not present here in the north. Your enemy is already on the march."
Text: "미래에 대해 더는 말해줄 수 없지만, 현재 북방에 없는 군사력이 필요할 거라는 건 확실해. 네 적은 이미 진군 중이야."

TextEng: "I cannot tell you that. Not yet. Once you are on the throne and you are surrounded by powerful defenders, then my fears will be eased and I will tell you of the prophesy."
Text: "아직은 말할 수 없어. 네가 왕좌에 앉아 강력한 수호자들에 둘러싸이면, 그때 내 걱정이 풀리고 예언을 말해줄 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "Your enemy is so powerful, that should I speak his name, it is possible that he will be able to pinpoint our exact location."
Text: "네 적은 너무 강력해서, 내가 그의 이름을 말하면 우리의 정확한 위치를 찾아낼 수 있을 거야."

TextEng: "Yes. He found the first key, but couldn't control the undead army. He entered their realm with his army and perished. Perhaps his corpse has even joined the army."
Text: "그래. 그가 첫 번째 열쇠를 찾았지만, 언데드 군대를 통제하지 못했어. 자기 군대와 함께 그들의 영역에 들어갔다가 죽었지. 아마 그의 시체도 군대에 합류했을 거야."

TextEng: "They were murdered, shortly after you were born. I cannot tell you more than that, but I promise you, I will. Once we have cemented our alliance and you are in control of the north, then I will reveal our enemy."
Text: "네가 태어난 직후에 살해당했어. 지금은 그 이상 말할 수 없지만, 약속할게. 동맹을 맺고 네가 북방을 지배하게 되면, 적을 밝히겠어."

TextEng: "Of course I am Momma Dane... or, that is a name I go by... sometimes. I simply had to come here by a deeper route, that is all. Do not let the form of a beholder fool you."
Text: "물론 내가 마마 데인이지... 아니, 그건 내가 쓰는 이름 중 하나야... 가끔. 좀 깊은 길로 올 수밖에 없었을 뿐이야. 비홀더 모습에 속지 마."

TextEng: "He is powerful, and you will need all the help you can get to defeat him. Even if you decide to kill me, it will not stop him. He will hunt you down, just as he hunted down your father and killed him."
Text: "그는 강력하고, 너는 그를 물리치기 위해 모든 도움이 필요할 거야. 나를 죽여도 그를 막을 수 없어. 네 아버지를 사냥해서 죽인 것처럼 너를 쫓아올 거야."

TextEng: "Had I not managed to spirit you away, you too would be dead. He killed your mother, just because she loved your father."
Text: "내가 너를 빼돌리지 않았다면, 너도 죽었을 거야. 네 아버지를 사랑했다는 이유만으로 네 어머니를 죽였어."

TextEng: "What would you like to speak of?"
Text: "무슨 얘기를 하고 싶어?"

TextEng: "Really? I would like you to think back to your first foray to the gates of Keep Cyan. If I remember correctly, all it took was that meddling witchwoman, Yenna, and you were dead."
Text: "그래? 시안 거점의 문 앞에 처음 갔을 때를 떠올려 봐. 내 기억이 맞다면, 그 참견쟁이 마녀 예나 하나에 네가 죽었잖아."

TextEng: "There is a prophesy. Once certain conditions are fulfilled, I will be able to speak it to you. Until then, you cannot know, or you might balk at your destiny."
Text: "예언이 있어. 특정 조건이 충족되면 말해줄 수 있어. 그때까지는 알 수 없어, 아니면 네 운명 앞에서 주저할지도 모르니까."

TextEng: "No. If you cannot accept my word that it is in your best interest not to know yet, then take this as a means of keeping myself alive."
Text: "안 돼. 아직 알지 않는 게 네 이익이라는 내 말을 받아들일 수 없다면, 이건 나를 살려두는 수단이라고 생각해."

TextEng: "I know the blood lust in you is probably driving you to want to destroy me. If you kill me, you will never know who killed your parents."
Text: "네 안의 피의 갈망이 나를 파괴하고 싶게 몰아가고 있겠지. 나를 죽이면, 누가 네 부모를 죽였는지 절대 알 수 없을 거야."

TextEng: "I escaped my home plane while my master was battling a hero on another plane. I found myself in this plane, alone and without anything to assist me, besides my own natural abilities."
Text: "주인이 다른 차원에서 영웅과 싸우는 동안 고향 차원을 탈출했어. 이 차원에 홀로 도착했고, 타고난 능력 외에는 아무것도 없었지."

TextEng: "I found myself in the southern city of Telmaki and I began to steal clothing, food and anything else that caught my eye. It was easy, as I would simply assume the appearance of someone I met."
Text: "남쪽의 도시 텔마키에 도착했고, 옷, 음식, 눈에 띄는 것은 뭐든 훔치기 시작했어. 만난 사람의 모습으로 변하면 되니까 쉬웠지."

TextEng: "I even got to attend the execution of some of the original people I imitated. It was... interesting. Unfortunately I stayed too long and a strange man came to town. A demonhunter."
Text: "내가 흉내 냈던 원래 사람의 처형에 참석하기도 했어. 흥미로웠지. 안타깝게도 너무 오래 머물렀고, 이상한 남자가 마을에 왔어. 악마사냥꾼이."

TextEng: "Oh, come now, young <man/woman>. You know who I am. I am sweet, old Momma Dane. Don't let this beholder form fool you - I simply had to come here by a deeper route, is all."
Text: "에이, 이리 와, 젊은이. 내가 누군지 알잖아. 다정한 늙은 마마 데인이야. 이 비홀더 모습에 속지 마 - 좀 깊은 길로 올 수밖에 없었을 뿐이야."

TextEng: "Think about the fact that you are part demon too. You might not find it so noble. Demonhunters don't care if you claim to be good. They don't believe in reformed demons."
Text: "너도 반은 악마라는 걸 생각해 봐. 그렇게 고귀하지 않을 수도 있어. 악마사냥꾼은 네가 선하다고 주장해도 신경 안 써. 개심한 악마는 믿지 않거든."

TextEng: "I found him. I was fascinated as I watched him explore the city, following the minutest clues of each crime. How did he know it was a demon? Instinct, I would guess."
Text: "그를 찾았어. 그가 도시를 탐색하며 각 범죄의 미세한 단서를 따라가는 것을 지켜보면서 매료되었지. 그가 악마라는 걸 어떻게 알았을까? 본능이겠지."

TextEng: "Don't jump ahead of the story! I was fascinated as I watched him explore the city, following the minutest clues of each crime. How did he know it was a demon? Instinct, I would guess."
Text: "이야기를 앞서 가지 마! 그가 도시를 탐색하며 각 범죄의 미세한 단서를 따라가는 것을 지켜보면서 매료되었어. 그가 악마라는 걸 어떻게 알았을까? 본능이겠지."

TextEng: "I took too many chances, assuming the forms of people who were unlikely to have committed such crimes. I even managed to get a priest burned at the stake for assaulting a young noblewoman."
Text: "너무 많은 모험을 했지, 그런 범죄를 저지를 리 없는 사람들로 변신하면서. 한번은 젊은 귀족 여성을 습격한 죄로 사제를 화형에 처하게 만들기도 했어."

TextEng: "He put it all together and got closer and closer to finding me."
Text: "그가 모든 단서를 맞추고 점점 나에게 가까이 다가왔어."

TextEng: "I decided I would be better off taking the initiative, so I went to him. I assumed a pleasing shape, similar to this, but with less wing, larger breasts."
Text: "선수를 치는 게 낫겠다고 생각해서 그에게 갔어. 이것과 비슷하되 날개는 적고 가슴은 더 큰 매력적인 모습으로 변신했지."

TextEng: "Then I seduced him and married him. It never fails to amaze me how easy it is to control a man with a little provocative clothing and a good leer. It's the leer that's really important."
Text: "그를 유혹해서 결혼했어. 약간의 도발적인 옷과 잘 던진 눈길만으로 남자를 조종하기가 얼마나 쉬운지 놀라울 따름이야. 중요한 건 눈길이야."

TextEng: "Then, once I was with child, I revealed myself to him for what I really was. I hoped he would consider our child and believe me when I said I was reformed."
Text: "아이를 가진 후, 내 정체를 밝혔어. 우리 아이를 생각해서 내가 개심했다는 걸 믿어주길 바랐어."

TextEng: "No. He was repulsed and drew his weapon on me. I did what I had to do. I assumed a much larger form, then tore his head off."
Text: "안 그랬어. 역겨워하며 무기를 들이댔지. 어쩔 수 없이 해야 할 일을 했어. 훨씬 큰 형태로 변신해서 그의 머리를 뜯어냈어."

TextEng: "It was. You have no idea how hard it is to fight the impulses that drive me. I have a heritage that is frightening, but powerful. You share this heritage."
Text: "너도 그 충동과 싸우는 게 얼마나 힘든지 모를 거야. 무시무시하지만 강력한 혈통을 가지고 있어. 너도 이 혈통을 공유하고 있고."

TextEng: "Does this form make you more comfortable? Aren't I a kindly old lady? Ha, ha, ha!"
Text: "이 모습이 더 편하니? 다정한 할머니 아니니? 하, 하, 하!"

TextEng: "I know. You have no idea how hard it is to fight the impulses that drive me. I have a heritage that is frightening, but powerful. You share this heritage."
Text: "너도 그 충동과 싸우는 게 얼마나 힘든지 모를 거야. 무시무시하지만 강력한 혈통을 가지고 있어. 너도 이 혈통을 공유하고 있고."

TextEng: "Surely you have noticed moments when your heart races at the kill? Try that magnified by one hundred and you will begin to understand just how restrained I really am."
Text: "살육의 순간에 심장이 뛰는 것을 느낀 적이 있을 거야. 그것을 백 배로 증폭시켜 봐. 그러면 내가 얼마나 절제하고 있는지 이해하기 시작할 거야."

TextEng: "Now, have you heard enough, or do you have other questions?"
Text: "자, 충분히 들었어, 아니면 다른 질문이 있어?"

TextEng: "If you kill me, you will never discover who killed your parents, until it is too late and his armies are upon you. You need me. You need every ally you can get."
Text: "나를 죽이면, 누가 네 부모를 죽였는지 절대 모르게 될 거야, 적의 군대가 닥칠 때까지. 내가 필요해. 얻을 수 있는 모든 동맹이 필요해."

TextEng: "Good. I will not allow you to kill me. If you even attempt it, I shall flee and let you face your enemy alone. When he is done with you, then I shall have more children."
Text: "좋아. 나를 죽이게 두지 않을 거야. 시도하기만 하면 도망치고 네 적에게 홀로 맞서게 할 거야. 그가 너를 처리하면, 나는 다른 아이를 낳겠어."

TextEng: "I will not allow you to kill me. If you even attempt it, I shall flee and let you face your enemy alone. When he is done with you, then I shall have more children."
Text: "나를 죽이게 두지 않을 거야. 시도하기만 하면 도망치고 네 적에게 홀로 맞서게 할 거야. 그가 너를 처리하면, 나는 다른 아이를 낳겠어."

TextEng: "Let us face this enemy together. Let me prove that I am an honest person, despite my heritage. Despite your heritage."
Text: "이 적에게 함께 맞서자. 내 혈통에도 불구하고 내가 정직한 사람이라는 것을 증명하게 해줘. 네 혈통에도 불구하고."

TextEng: "Then goodbye. If you should somehow survive your enemy, I might return. We can do battle then, or if your mind has become less closed, perhaps we shall work together towards greater things."
Text: "그럼 잘 가. 어찌 되었건 적에게서 살아남는다면, 돌아올지도. 그때 싸우든지, 아니면 마음이 좀 열렸다면, 함께 더 큰 일을 도모할 수 있겠지."

TextEng: "A good idea. How about I let him take on his true form. When you are satisfied, he can become your weapon again."
Text: "좋은 생각이야. 진짜 모습으로 변하게 해줄게. 만족하면, 다시 네 무기가 되면 되지."

TextEng: "Hello, <FirstName>. It is about time we met face-to-face. What questions do you have for me?"
Text: "안녕하시오, <FirstName>. 이제야 얼굴을 마주하게 되었소. 무엇이 궁금하시오?"

TextEng: "But maybe this isn't the form you would find most interesting? Who would you like me to be?"
Text: "하지만 이게 네가 가장 흥미로워할 모습은 아닐지도? 내가 누구로 변하면 좋겠어?"

TextEng: "Aye. I have enjoyed every moment I have spent with you. It is almost as good as being alive again. Even better, in some ways. I don't have to worry about myself getting killed anymore."
Text: "그렇소. 당신과 함께한 모든 순간이 즐거웠소. 다시 살아 있는 것과 거의 같았소. 아니, 어떤 면에서는 더 나았소. 내가 죽을 걱정을 안 해도 되니까."

TextEng: "Not yet. Someday I might wish to make the journey to the next world, but for now, I like what we are doing together."
Text: "아직은 아니오. 언젠가 저승으로 떠나고 싶을 수도 있지만, 지금은 우리가 함께하는 이 일이 좋소."

TextEng: "Ah, she is an interesting creature, isn't she. She can be everything a man or woman could desire, yet her base instincts give her an edge of danger that you are unlikely to find in any other mate."
Text: "아, 흥미로운 존재이지. 남자든 여자든 바라는 모든 것이 될 수 있지만, 그 본능은 다른 어떤 짝에서도 찾기 어려운 위험한 매력을 주오."

TextEng: "I do not wish to recount the days of my seduction, nor the day in which I found out I was betrayed. She kept my soul, never allowing it to be released to the realm of Mistress Death."
Text: "유혹당하던 날들이나, 배신당한 날에 대해 이야기하고 싶지 않소. 그녀는 내 영혼을 붙잡고, 죽음의 여주인의 영역으로 풀어주지 않았소."

TextEng: "After some time, I discovered that I no longer wanted to be parted from her. I watched her raise our child, with more love than I could have expected."
Text: "시간이 지나면서, 그녀와 떨어지고 싶지 않다는 것을 깨달았소. 그녀가 우리 아이를 기대 이상의 사랑으로 키우는 것을 지켜보았소."

TextEng: "I also watched her weep at the death of our child, as she fled with you cuddled to her breast. I am not saying that she is perfect, nor that she doesn't have a wide streak of evil in her."
Text: "우리 아이가 죽을 때 그녀가 당신을 품에 안고 도망치며 울던 것도 보았소. 그녀가 완벽하다거나, 깊은 악의가 없다고 말하는 것은 아니오."

TextEng: "But there is also good in her. I can see that now. That is why she deserves my help. That is why she deserves your help, also."
Text: "하지만 그녀에게도 선한 면이 있소. 이제 그것을 볼 수 있소. 그래서 그녀는 내 도움을 받을 자격이 있소. 당신의 도움도 받을 자격이 있소."

TextEng: "I was born in the southern highlands and raised with a weapon in my hand. My clan, for all races in the highlands belong to a clan, worshipped a demon called Gishtara."
Text: "남쪽 고원지대에서 태어나 무기를 손에 쥐고 자랐소. 고원의 모든 종족이 속하는 우리 부족은 기슈타라라는 악마를 숭배했소."

TextEng: "One day our shaman held a special ordeal, summoning the demon to support his worshippers. The shaman lost control of his abomination, and it turned on my people."
Text: "어느 날 주술사가 특별한 시련을 열어 악마를 소환해 추종자들을 도우려 했소. 주술사가 그 괴물의 통제를 잃었고, 내 백성에게 등을 돌렸소."

TextEng: "I was one of the few survivors. I dragged my body to a neighboring clan, holding my intestines in with one hand, pulling myself forward with my other."
Text: "나는 얼마 안 되는 생존자 중 하나였소. 한 손으로 내장을 붙잡고 다른 손으로 기어가며 이웃 부족까지 몸을 끌고 갔소."

TextEng: "I can be the man of your dreams. A sexual god. Or perhaps someone closer to you than that. How is this for a hot lover?"
Text: "네 꿈속의 남자가 될 수 있어. 매혹의 신. 아니면 그보다 더 가까운 누군가. 이 정도면 열정적인 연인으로 어때?"

TextEng: "Indeed. I dedicated my life to the destruction of all demons and their spawn."
Text: "그렇소. 평생을 모든 악마와 그 후손의 파괴에 바쳤소."

TextEng: "Can a creature such as her ever fully tell the truth? I don't know. But the essence of what she has told you is true. Some details she has omitted, some embellished."
Text: "그녀 같은 존재가 온전히 진실을 말할 수 있는가? 모르겠소. 하지만 그녀가 말한 것의 본질은 사실이오. 일부 세부 사항은 빠뜨리고, 일부는 부풀렸소."

TextEng: "But I do think you will need her for the trials ahead. Your enemy, though I cannot tell you who it is, is one tough bastard. You'll need all the help you can get."
Text: "하지만 앞으로의 시련에 그녀가 필요할 것이오. 당신의 적은, 누구인지 말할 수 없지만, 만만치 않은 놈이오. 얻을 수 있는 모든 도움이 필요할 것이오."

TextEng: "Very well, I shall transform back into your weapon now. Best of luck, <FirstName>. I shall always be with you."
Text: "좋소, 다시 무기로 변하겠소. 행운을 비오, <FirstName>. 항상 함께하겠소."

TextEng: "We shall awaken the undead army of the Nether Planes and use it to defeat your implacable foe!"
Text: "하계의 언데드 군대를 깨워 난공불락의 적을 물리치는 데 쓸 거야!"

TextEng: "I have no desire to be the ruler of anything. I simply wish to see my offspring succeed... to leave a legacy behind me. Someday I will die, though my life has seemed immortal so far."
Text: "어떤 것의 통치자가 되고 싶은 욕심은 없어. 단지 내 후손이 성공하는 것을 보고 싶을 뿐이야... 내 뒤에 유산을 남기고. 언젠가 죽겠지만, 지금까지의 삶은 불멸처럼 느껴졌어."

TextEng: "I will serve you to the best of my ability. You shall rule the keep, not as a petty lord, but as the King of the North!"
Text: "최선을 다해 너를 섬기겠어. 보잘것없는 영주가 아닌, 북방의 왕으로서 거점을 다스리게 될 거야!"

TextEng: "And?"
Text: "그래서?"

TextEng: "Then we may proceed. Let us go and claim your army. Let us go and claim your destiny... King of the North!"
Text: "그럼 시작하자. 네 군대를 차지하러 가자. 네 운명을 차지하러... 북방의 왕이여!"

TextEng: "But first you should gather your reward from the illithid's treasure. It had some very useful items stored up. Every advantage we can gain, we will need."
Text: "하지만 먼저 일리시드의 보물에서 보상을 챙겨야 해. 아주 유용한 물건들을 저장해 두었거든. 얻을 수 있는 모든 이점이 필요해."

TextEng: "Or maybe you would like to play with the bad boys? Does this form please you, my lady?"
Text: "아니면 나쁜 남자와 놀고 싶어? 이 모습이 마음에 드니, 아가씨?"

TextEng: "I should have thought that was obvious. He was your half-brother. One of you was bound to win... I wanted only the best. Now, let's go."
Text: "말 안 해도 뻔한 거 아니니. 그는 네 이복형제였어. 둘 중 하나가 이기게 되어 있었고... 나는 최고만을 원했어. 자, 가자."

TextEng: "Do you think I have kept you alive for this long, just to betray and destroy you? Be rational. If you want to, you can betray and destroy me later, after your enemy is dead."
Text: "이렇게 오랫동안 널 살려 놓은 게, 배신하고 파괴하려고 한 거라 생각해? 이성적으로 생각해. 원한다면, 적이 죽은 후에 나를 배신하고 파괴해도 돼."

TextEng: "By that time, I think you will know you can trust me. You shall see."
Text: "그때쯤이면, 나를 믿을 수 있다는 걸 알게 될 거야. 두고 봐."

TextEng: "The only way you stand a chance at defeating your enemy, even with the undead army, is if you can neutralize some of his allies, or even get them to join you."
Text: "언데드 군대가 있어도 적을 물리칠 수 있는 유일한 방법은 적의 동맹 일부를 무력화하거나, 심지어 네 편으로 끌어들이는 거야."

TextEng: "Politically, a petty lordling in the north doesn't count for much of anything, but as king, you would be an attractive alternative."
Text: "정치적으로, 북방의 보잘것없는 영주는 아무 가치도 없지만, 왕이라면 매력적인 대안이 될 수 있어."

TextEng: "By now my words might have revealed who your enemy is, but do not make reference to him. Not yet. You must trust me in this."
Text: "지금쯤 내 말에서 적이 누구인지 짐작했을 수도 있지만, 그를 언급하지 마. 아직은. 이것만은 나를 믿어야 해."

TextEng: "It is of no consequence. When you left the keep, your friend, Alias, killed the new lord and then, when she was caught, she told the council that she did it for the sake of the keep."
Text: "상관없어. 네가 거점을 떠난 후, 네 친구 앨리어스가 새 영주를 죽이고, 잡히자 거점을 위해 한 일이라고 의회에 말했어."

TextEng: "She told them that the keep was doomed, if they did not accept you as their King!"
Text: "거점이 파멸한다, 너를 왕으로 받아들이지 않으면!"

TextEng: "Well, someone who looked like her. Don't worry, she was very persuasive. She is imprisoned, but the people have declared you as their new ruler. They eagerly await your return."
Text: "글쎄, 그녀처럼 생긴 누군가가. 걱정 마, 매우 설득력이 있었어. 그녀는 감옥에 있지만, 주민들은 너를 새 통치자로 선언했어. 네 귀환을 간절히 기다리고 있지."

TextEng: "If you are worried about the child, don't. Once you return, you can assume your role as the new King of the North and set her free."
Text: "아이가 걱정되면, 걱정 마. 돌아가면 북방의 새 왕으로서 역할을 맡고 그녀를 풀어줄 수 있어."

TextEng: "Has Momma Dane told me the truth?"
Text: "마마 데인이 진실을 말한 거야?"

TextEng: "That is all the questions I have for you."
Text: "질문은 그게 다야."

TextEng: "Let's talk about this alliance."
Text: "동맹 얘기를 하자."

TextEng: "I have made a decision."
Text: "결정했어."

TextEng: "I think I shall kill you, instead."
Text: "대신 널 죽이겠어."

TextEng: "I accept your allegiance."
Text: "네 충성을 받아들이겠어."

TextEng: "Yes, let's go."
Text: "그래, 가자."

TextEng: "I forgot to ask. What was the deal with the illithid?"
Text: "깜빡했는데. 일리시드는 뭐였어?"

TextEng: "How do I know I can trust you?"
Text: "널 어떻게 믿어?"

TextEng: "Tell me about this undead army."
Text: "언데드 군대에 대해 말해줘."

TextEng: "Why the King of the North?"
Text: "왜 북방의 왕이야?"

TextEng: "What is your true form?"
Text: "네 진짜 모습은 뭐야?"

TextEng: "But I lost the election."
Text: "하지만 나는 선거에서 졌잖아."

TextEng: "Alias did that?"
Text: "앨리어스가 그랬다고?"

TextEng: "Then what was the point of going through the election?"
Text: "그럼 선거를 치른 의미가 뭐야?"

TextEng: "You mean queen, don't you?"
Text: "여왕 아니야?"

TextEng: "I have more questions."
Text: "질문이 더 있어."

TextEng: "How do you do that?"
Text: "어떻게 그렇게 하는 거야?"

TextEng: "I don't care what form you take."
Text: "어떤 모습이든 상관없어."

TextEng: "No, that form doesn't please me!"
Text: "아니, 그 모습은 마음에 안 들어!"

TextEng: "I thought you said you were my grandmother!?!"
Text: "내 할머니라면서!?!"

TextEng: "You have wings!"
Text: "날개가 있잖아!"

TextEng: "You are a succubus?"
Text: "서큐버스야?"

TextEng: "Trained for what?"
Text: "무슨 훈련?"

TextEng: "What are you?"
Text: "넌 뭐야?"

TextEng: "So you are evil?"
Text: "그럼 넌 악한 거야?"

TextEng: "Back, beholder, before I slay you."
Text: "물러서라, 비홀더, 죽이기 전에."

TextEng: "So, you are a demon."
Text: "그래서 넌 악마야."

TextEng: "Who was your master?"
Text: "네 주인은 누구였어?"

TextEng: "And what are your plans now?"
Text: "그래서 지금 계획이 뭐야?"

TextEng: "I have made a decision."
Text: "결정했어."

TextEng: "Why do you need an ally?"
Text: "왜 동맹이 필요해?"

TextEng: "I know that there are two keys to controlling it."
Text: "그걸 통제하는 열쇠가 두 개 있다는 건 알아."

TextEng: "I have heard about such an army, but know little about it."
Text: "그런 군대에 대해 들어본 적은 있지만, 자세히는 몰라."

TextEng: "I know nothing of an undead army."
Text: "언데드 군대에 대해 아는 게 없어."

TextEng: "Go on."
Text: "계속해."

TextEng: "Why not?"
Text: "왜 안 돼?"

TextEng: "What is your second reason?"
Text: "두 번째 이유는 뭐야?"

TextEng: "How do you know all of this?"
Text: "이걸 어떻게 다 알아?"

TextEng: "Momma Dane?"
Text: "마마 데인?"

TextEng: "That is why you needed me to be the ruler?"
Text: "그래서 내가 통치자가 되어야 했던 거야?"

TextEng: "Who is my enemy?"
Text: "내 적이 누구야?"

TextEng: "That is what the old lord didn't know."
Text: "그게 옛 영주가 몰랐던 거군."

TextEng: "What happened to my parents?"
Text: "내 부모에게 무슨 일이 있었어?"

TextEng: "Let's talk about something else."
Text: "다른 얘기하자."

TextEng: "I can handle anything on my own."
Text: "뭐든 혼자 감당할 수 있어."

TextEng: "Why does someone hate me so much?"
Text: "왜 누군가가 그렇게 나를 미워하는 거야?"

TextEng: "Tell me now!"
Text: "지금 당장 말해!"

TextEng: "How are you my grandmother?"
Text: "어떻게 내 할머니인 거야?"

TextEng: "A noble profession."
Text: "고귀한 직업이네."

TextEng: "He found you?"
Text: "그가 널 찾았어?"

TextEng: "Who are you?"
Text: "넌 누구야?"

TextEng: "A demonhunter? You don't mean my magic weapon..."
Text: "악마사냥꾼? 설마 내 마법 무기..."

TextEng: "You told me once that your husband was a demonhunter."
Text: "전에 남편이 악마사냥꾼이었다고 했잖아."

TextEng: "This is taking to long. Hurry it up."
Text: "너무 길어. 빨리 해."

TextEng: "So you killed him?"
Text: "그래서 그를 죽인 거야?"

TextEng: "Go on."
Text: "계속해."

TextEng: "He didn't, did he?"
Text: "안 그랬지?"

TextEng: "You almost sound as though you enjoyed it."
Text: "즐기는 것처럼 들리는데."

TextEng: "I guess it was self-defense."
Text: "정당방위였겠지."

TextEng: "Disgusting."
Text: "역겹군."

TextEng: "I think I shall kill you now."
Text: "지금 널 죽이겠어."

TextEng: "I have changed my mind."
Text: "마음이 바뀌었어."

TextEng: "You are a creature of evil and I cannot let you live."
Text: "넌 악의 존재이고, 살려둘 수 없어."

TextEng: "All right. You have convinced me."
Text: "좋아. 설득당했어."

TextEng: "Never."
Text: "절대 안 돼."

TextEng: "I don't trust you."
Text: "널 믿을 수 없어."

TextEng: "I would like to speak to my grandfather first."
Text: "먼저 할아버지와 얘기하고 싶어."

TextEng: "Do you like being my weapon?"
Text: "내 무기가 된 게 좋아?"

TextEng: "Would you like to be free?"
Text: "자유로워지고 싶어?"

TextEng: "Why do you serve Momma Dane?"
Text: "왜 마마 데인을 섬기는 거야?"

TextEng: "What do you mean?"
Text: "무슨 뜻이야?"

TextEng: "That's abominable."
Text: "끔찍하군."

TextEng: "Worked out well for me."
Text: "나한테는 잘 됐네."

TextEng: "That must have been hard."
Text: "힘들었겠다."

TextEng: "Tell me about yourself."
Text: "네 이야기를 들려줘."

TextEng: "That's why you became a demon hunter."
Text: "그래서 악마사냥꾼이 된 거군."

TextEng: "Should I follow you now?"
"As you wish."
"Good enough. The Stan has always been a reliable source of assistance. After what I saw about an hour ago, I'll need all the assistance I can get."
"True enough, but I believe that the current problems in the keep might be linked to my studies here. Um... who are you exactly?"
Ohio chuckles. "I like your sense of humor. You're going to need it when I tell you what I saw about an hour ago."
"Good, because I strongly believe that my research here might have a direct link to the problems the keep is currently experiencing. Um... who are you exactly?"
"That is a very long name, <FullName>, soon to be <Lord/Lady> of the Keep. I think I'll just call you <FirstName>. I guess I'd better tell you what happened about an hour ago."
"I was hiding, waiting for some help to come along, when I heard someone speaking in a harsh, guttural language. I recognized the goblin tongue, but some of the words were strange."
"Then I saw a dark-skinned elf and I knew I was in trouble."

"It seemed to be in charge of a large group of goblins, making me think that it is probably a general of some sort in the Masked Man's army. They went into the caves, lending weight to my theory of a link."
"I suspect they are searching for the same information I am. We need to get in there and make sure they don't get it."
"All right, I suppose it is important for you to know what you are getting into. I believe that when the former lord and his army disappeared, they went to another plane of reality."
"I will do so. Let's hurry."
"I think that this ruin and the keep were linked at one time, as magical keys for performing a very powerful and very dangerous magic."
"Recently I discovered a journal kept by the advisor to our former lord. The journal detailed his research into the magical properties of the keep."
"Well, if you wish to merely take me into the ruins and keep me alive, then no. If you want to know what might be in our way, and why we are here in the first place, then yes."
"As you wish. The ruins are full of undead, plus the goblins and the drow. They haven't returned since they entered. Let's get going."
"I don't know much more than the adviser's ruminations on the possibility of opening a portal to another world and access to an army of undead."
"The problem is that the journal I found was full, and it didn't complete the story. I think there was probably a later journal that the advisor had on him."
"Whatever else he discovered, no one knows. The advisor disappeared the day before the new lord and his army left the keep. I think he may have come here."
"Right. I'm as ready as I'll ever be. I'll follow your lead."
"No. I imagine it will cost him a few goblins to get past the undead, if they are able to get past them at all. I wonder how the old advisor managed to get past them?"
"He never said anything about the undead being in the ruins. Perhaps something happened since that time? Fascinating stuff."
"Yes? We need to keep going. We don't want the enemy to discover the information before we do."
"There must be something in these ruins that the advisor was getting his information from. I suspect there must be some kind of magical guide to the information we seek."
"Well, keep in mind that this is mostly supposition based on one man's magical research and it might not be highly accurate."
"Of course, but we should hurry. We don't want the forces of the Masked Man to gain any advantage over us."
"Little is known, except that it is a place of vast power and not a single living soul. What would happen to someone who entered the plane and was trapped there?"
"So few answers, so many questions. Hopefully we will discover more inside."
"The mages of an ancient empire that used to rule this continent tapped into an ancient, dead world. They were able to harness the powers of this world to draw the armies into this one."
"What happened to that world... nobody knows. Certainly the advisor warned his lord that such powers must be used with extreme care, a warning that must have fallen on deaf ears."
"That is one of the answers I seek in these ruins. If the advisor was right, there should be some way to control the armies from this plane."
"The journal suggested that it was a private army of an ancient empire. The empire used it to take control of this entire continent, according to some hieroglyphics the advisor found."
"If this army still exists, it would probably be quite large. The mages of the empire would take the dead of those conquered and add them to their army."
"As I said. Let's go."
Ohio Smith looks at the jars, the chest and then the door. "Well, this is interesting. I assume there is some kind of magical puzzle to get through the door. Fascinating."
Ohio Smith looks at the broken orb and sighs, "That is truly unfortunate. What a magnificent find this would have been had the orb been intact."
"Still, there is plenty here for me to research, and it is possible that I might find more clues to the disappearance of our former lord's army."
"Thank you for your assistance, <FirstName>. I will contact The Stan and make sure he pays you. Good luck in the election, though why anyone would want the hassle of running a keep, I have no idea."
"The engravings in this room are fascinating. I have learned much about the culture that built the ruins, though not much that would be handy to you."
"All I know so far is that these people really worshipped death. Fascinating!"
"Oh, leave me alone. I'm not slowing you down that much."
"Really? Let me see that. Ah... that explains much, doesn't it! And yet it leaves so many questions."
"What caused the undead to rise again? What are the two triggers? Where did the armies go? Perhaps we shall discover more when we find this orb he spoke of."
"I hate to waste the time, but I suppose you know what you're doing."
This unusually intense man walks towards you, quickly gauging you with a look. "I hope your presence here means that someone in the keep is finally taking me seriously."
"Wait a little longer."
"I need you to wait here."
"The Stan sent me. I am <FullName>."
"With all the troubles the keep has been having, you're lucky anyone noticed you at all."
"I am Person-Who-Keeps-You-Alive, but you may call me <FirstName>."
"I take everything seriously."
"I am <FullName>, soon to be <Lord/Lady> of the Keep."
"Follow me."
"Where is this creature now?"
"Why? What's so frightening about a dark-elf?"
"There was a drow here?"
"Why would the enemy be seeking this information?"
"What exactly are we looking for?"
"You had better tell me about your research."
"Do I really need to know about this?"
"Then let's just get going."
"Then continue."
"So this could be dangerous to us?"
"What kind of magic are we talking about here?"
"We had better get going."
"Let's keep going."
"Have you seen the drow since he entered?"
"What are we looking for then?"
"I have questions about this undead army."
"Let's talk about something else."
"What do you know about this other plane?"
"Who made the army?"
"Who controls this army?"
"How large is this army?"
"You're slowing me down. Hurry up!"
"I found this journal."
